units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|Although they are unusually tall and dark-skinned, the people here appear to be human. You wouldn't know it from the architecture, however: the buildings with their curved, twisted surfaces and ramifying arches look more alien than any human dwelling you have seen before.|23|0
units.english: Although they are unusually tall and dark-skinned, the people here appear to be human. You wouldn't know it from the architecture, however: the buildings with their curved, twisted surfaces and ramifying arches look more alien than any human dwelling you have seen before.
units.italian: Benché siano insolitamente alti e abbiano la pelle scura, la gente qui sembra umana. L'architettura però non lo direbbe: gli edifici, con le loro superfici curve e contorte e gli archi che si diramano, sembrano più alieni di qualsiasi dimora umana tu abbia mai visto.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Stranger still, no one is speaking: the usual background murmur of voices that you would associate with a spaceport is absent here. Instead, the locals are communicating in a rapid and graceful sign language, their hands tracing arcs through the air almost faster than your eyes can follow.|24|0
units.english: Stranger still, no one is speaking: the usual background murmur of voices that you would associate with a spaceport is absent here. Instead, the locals are communicating in a rapid and graceful sign language, their hands tracing arcs through the air almost faster than your eyes can follow.
units.italian: E c'è di più strano: nessuno parla. Il solito brusio di voci che assoceresti a uno spazioporto qui non c'è. Al suo posto, la gente del posto comunica con una lingua dei segni rapida e aggraziata, con le mani che tracciano archi nell'aria quasi più veloci di quanto i tuoi occhi riescano a seguire.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	A few of them approach your ship and one of them greets you out loud, but instead of speaking he sings the words in a high, monotone chant: "Do you comprehend the ancestral tongue?"|25|0
units.english: A few of them approach your ship and one of them greets you out loud, but instead of speaking he sings the words in a high, monotone chant: "Do you comprehend the ancestral tongue?"
units.italian: Alcuni si avvicinano alla tua nave e uno di loro ti saluta ad alta voce, ma invece di parlare intona le parole in un canto acuto e monotono: "Comprendi la lingua ancestrale?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Say, "Yes, I do.")|27|0
units.english: (Say, "Yes, I do.")
units.italian: (Di': "Sì, la comprendo.")

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Try to chant, "Yes, I do.")|28|0
units.english: (Try to chant, "Yes, I do.")
units.italian: (Prova a intonare: "Sì, la comprendo.")

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Their expressions are inscrutable; you aren't sure if they even understood you or not. They turn away from you for a second and converse in sign language.|31|0
units.english: Their expressions are inscrutable; you aren't sure if they even understood you or not. They turn away from you for a second and converse in sign language.
units.italian: Le loro espressioni sono imperscrutabili; non sai nemmeno se ti abbiano capito. Si voltano dall'altra parte per un secondo e conversano nella lingua dei segni.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	You sing, "Yes, I do," trying to match the leader's pitch. As you do so, several of them hum notes that harmonize with you.|34|0
units.english: You sing, "Yes, I do," trying to match the leader's pitch. As you do so, several of them hum notes that harmonize with you.
units.italian: Canti "Sì, la comprendo", cercando di imitare il tono del capo. Mentre lo fai, diversi di loro emettono note che si armonizzano con la tua.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Two of them walk up to you. One is carrying a small device that looks like a handheld scanner. The other unwraps a small foil package, pulls out a lancet, and jabs his finger with it. A dark, red drop of blood wells up. He presses his finger onto a port on the scanner, then hands you another one of the packets. "We kindly request that you identify yourself," he chants. Several of the others hum along with him.|36|0
units.english: Two of them walk up to you. One is carrying a small device that looks like a handheld scanner. The other unwraps a small foil package, pulls out a lancet, and jabs his finger with it. A dark, red drop of blood wells up. He presses his finger onto a port on the scanner, then hands you another one of the packets. "We kindly request that you identify yourself," he chants. Several of the others hum along with him.
units.italian: Due di loro ti vengono incontro. Uno porta un piccolo dispositivo che sembra uno scanner portatile. L'altro apre un pacchetto di stagnola, tira fuori una lancetta e si punge il dito. Ne sgorga una goccia di sangue scura e rossa. Preme il dito su una porta dello scanner, poi ti porge un altro dei pacchetti. "Ti chiediamo cortesemente di identificarti," intona. Diversi degli altri cantano all'unisono con lui.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Give them a blood sample.)|38|0
units.english: (Give them a blood sample.)
units.italian: (Dagli un campione di sangue.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Refuse to give them a sample.)|40|0
units.english: (Refuse to give them a sample.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta di dare un campione.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Run back to my ship and escape from here.)|42|0
units.english: (Run back to my ship and escape from here.)
units.italian: (Corri alla tua nave e fuggi da qui.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	You run into your airlock, slam the door shut, and blast off from the planet. Already, several of their ships are moving to intercept you. It seems that you are no longer welcome in this region of space...|44|0
units.english: You run into your airlock, slam the door shut, and blast off from the planet. Already, several of their ships are moving to intercept you. It seems that you are no longer welcome in this region of space...
units.italian: Corri nell'airlock, sbatti la porta e decolli dal pianeta. Diverse loro navi si stanno già muovendo per intercettarti. Sembra che tu non sia più gradito in questa regione di spazio...

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	You try to pull away, but the man's hand snakes out and grabs you by the wrist. Before you are even able to react he jabs your finger and shoves it onto the scanner. "You are in our space," he sings. "You will abide by our rules." No longer a monotone, his song is a jarring and atonal melody.|48|0
units.english: You try to pull away, but the man's hand snakes out and grabs you by the wrist. Before you are even able to react he jabs your finger and shoves it onto the scanner. "You are in our space," he sings. "You will abide by our rules." No longer a monotone, his song is a jarring and atonal melody.
units.italian: Cerchi di divincolarti, ma la mano dell'uomo scatta e ti afferra il polso. Prima che tu possa reagire ti punge il dito e lo preme sullo scanner. "Sei nel nostro spazio," intona. "Rispetterai le nostre regole." Non è più monotono: il suo canto è una melodia stridente e atonale.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Several of them gather around the one with the scanner as if waiting to see what the results will be. As you watch them you notice that all of them, even the women, have their hair cropped short. Also, their clothing looks like nothing that has ever been in fashion at any point in human history that you know of.|50|0
units.english: Several of them gather around the one with the scanner as if waiting to see what the results will be. As you watch them you notice that all of them, even the women, have their hair cropped short. Also, their clothing looks like nothing that has ever been in fashion at any point in human history that you know of.
units.italian: Diversi di loro si radunano intorno a quello con lo scanner, come in attesa di vedere il risultato. Mentre li osservi noti che tutti, anche le donne, hanno i capelli tagliati corti. E i loro vestiti non somigliano a nulla che sia mai stato di moda in nessun momento della storia umana che tu conosca.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Finally the scanner beeps, and a yellow light flashes. You can almost feel the tension leaving the air as the crowd relaxes. "So you are pure. You are human," chants one of the women. "You are one of us."|51|0
units.english: Finally the scanner beeps, and a yellow light flashes. You can almost feel the tension leaving the air as the crowd relaxes. "So you are pure. You are human," chants one of the women. "You are one of us."
units.italian: Alla fine lo scanner emette un bip e una luce gialla lampeggia. Senti quasi la tensione uscire dall'aria mentre la folla si rilassa. "Quindi sei puro. Sei umano," intona una delle donne. "Sei uno di noi."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Of course I'm human. But what are human beings doing out here?"|53|0
units.english: "Of course I'm human. But what are human beings doing out here?"
units.italian: "Certo che sono umano. Ma cosa ci fanno degli esseri umani quaggiù?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Who are you?"|54|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi siete?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Several of them burst into song, singing together in harmony, "We are the hidden ones. We are the Remnant. In time of great chaos to this place we came, lest all true-born humans be killed or enslaved, by those who evolved not, but unwisely were made."|56|0
units.english: Several of them burst into song, singing together in harmony, "We are the hidden ones. We are the Remnant. In time of great chaos to this place we came, lest all true-born humans be killed or enslaved, by those who evolved not, but unwisely were made."
units.italian: Diversi di loro scoppiano a cantare, in armonia: "Noi siamo i nascosti. Noi siamo i Remnant. In tempo di grande caos venimmo in questo luogo, perché nessun umano di vera nascita fosse ucciso o reso schiavo da coloro che non si evolsero, ma empiamente furono creati."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	As they continue to sing, you begin to piece together their story. They are the descendants of people who fled to this region of space through an unstable wormhole at the peak of the first Alpha War, which means they have been here for more than half a millennium. That doesn't explain why their culture is so radically different, though.|57|0
units.english: As they continue to sing, you begin to piece together their story. They are the descendants of people who fled to this region of space through an unstable wormhole at the peak of the first Alpha War, which means they have been here for more than half a millennium. That doesn't explain why their culture is so radically different, though.
units.italian: Mentre continuano a cantare, cominci a ricostruire la loro storia. Sono i discendenti di chi fuggì in questa regione di spazio attraverso un cunicolo instabile all'apice della prima guerra contro gli Alpha, il che significa che sono qui da più di mezzo millennio. Questo però non spiega perché la loro cultura sia così radicalmente diversa.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Eventually they invite you to a dinner. Their food has strange and complex flavors, not all of them pleasant, but you do your best to be polite and pretend to enjoy it all. The meal itself is generous and stretches out as your hosts consume considerably more food than you would expect for such a trim group. After the meal, they entertain you by singing songs, some of which you recognize as classical Earth music. It appears that people in this culture use sign language for day to day communication, and use their voices only for making music.|58|0
units.english: Eventually they invite you to a dinner. Their food has strange and complex flavors, not all of them pleasant, but you do your best to be polite and pretend to enjoy it all. The meal itself is generous and stretches out as your hosts consume considerably more food than you would expect for such a trim group. After the meal, they entertain you by singing songs, some of which you recognize as classical Earth music. It appears that people in this culture use sign language for day to day communication, and use their voices only for making music.
units.italian: Alla fine ti invitano a cena. Il loro cibo ha sapori strani e complessi, non tutti gradevoli, ma fai del tuo meglio per essere cortese e fingere di apprezzarlo tutto. Il pasto è abbondante e si protrae, visto che i tuoi ospiti consumano molto più cibo di quanto ti aspetteresti da un gruppo così asciutto. Dopo cena ti intrattengono cantando canzoni, alcune delle quali riconosci come musica classica terrestre. Sembra che in questa cultura si usi la lingua dei segni per la comunicazione quotidiana, e la voce solo per fare musica.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	When you return to your ship, you do a search on videos of historical dialects of human sign language. None of them bear even a passing resemblance to the language of these people who call themselves the Remnant.|59|0
units.english: When you return to your ship, you do a search on videos of historical dialects of human sign language. None of them bear even a passing resemblance to the language of these people who call themselves the Remnant.
units.italian: Quando torni alla nave cerchi video di dialetti storici della lingua dei segni umana. Nessuno di essi somiglia neppure vagamente alla lingua di questa gente che si fa chiamare Remnant.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|As you break orbit and get ready to escape, you receive a message from <planet>. A chant comes from your speakers.|65|0
units.english: As you break orbit and get ready to escape, you receive a message from <planet>. A chant comes from your speakers.
units.italian: Mentre esci dall'orbita e ti prepari a fuggire ricevi un messaggio da <planet>. Dagli altoparlanti esce un canto.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"My compatriots seem to have gotten off on the wrong foot. I am Prefect Chilia of the Remnant. We established ourselves here as a bastion of humanity to survive when the rest of human space was under threat by the Alphas.|66|0
units.english: "My compatriots seem to have gotten off on the wrong foot. I am Prefect Chilia of the Remnant. We established ourselves here as a bastion of humanity to survive when the rest of human space was under threat by the Alphas.
units.italian: "I miei compatrioti sembrano aver cominciato male. Sono il Prefetto Chilia dei Remnant. Ci siamo stabiliti qui come baluardo dell'umanità per sopravvivere quando il resto dello spazio umano era minacciato dagli Alpha.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"The blood test we requested is mandatory for all who come to our worlds. We will not tolerate the presence of anyone of Alpha heritage. Should you agree to the blood test and pass, we will allow you to visit our worlds in peace."|67|0
units.english: "The blood test we requested is mandatory for all who come to our worlds. We will not tolerate the presence of anyone of Alpha heritage. Should you agree to the blood test and pass, we will allow you to visit our worlds in peace."
units.italian: "L'esame del sangue che abbiamo chiesto è obbligatorio per chiunque venga sui nostri mondi. Non tolleriamo la presenza di nessuno di origine Alpha. Se accetti l'esame e lo superi, ti permetteremo di visitare i nostri mondi in pace."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Okay, I'll take the blood test."|69|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take the blood test."
units.italian: "Va bene, accetto l'esame del sangue."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"I'm not taking any blood test."|71|0
units.english: "I'm not taking any blood test."
units.italian: "Non intendo fare nessun esame del sangue."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Then leave immediately or be eliminated. You will not be welcomed here again."|75|0
units.english: "Then leave immediately or be eliminated. You will not be welcomed here again."
units.italian: "Allora vattene subito, o sarai eliminato. Qui non sarai più il benvenuto."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Please return to <planet>. Be on your best behavior, as there will be no third chance."|81|0
units.english: "Please return to <planet>. Be on your best behavior, as there will be no third chance."
units.italian: "Torna su <planet>, per favore. Comportati al meglio: non ci sarà una terza possibilità."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|87|0
units.english: Discovered a strange, isolated human community in an otherwise uninhabited region of space south of the Core. Angered them by refusing to submit to some sort of blood test.
units.italian: Ho scoperto una strana comunità umana isolata in una regione di spazio altrimenti disabitata a sud del Core. Li ho fatti arrabbiare rifiutandomi di sottopormi a una specie di esame del sangue.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|88|0
units.english: The Remnant are a group of unusual-looking humans that live in a secluded section of the galaxy. It is unclear how long they have lived apart from the rest of humanity, but they have been free of human influences for long enough that their culture is wildly different from any found in human record. Their buildings seem to be alien in origin, and they communicate amongst each other primarily with sign language. When they do use their voices they sing or chant, rather than speak.
units.italian: I Remnant sono un gruppo di umani dall'aspetto insolito che vivono in una sezione appartata della galassia. Non è chiaro da quanto vivano separati dal resto dell'umanità, ma sono stati liberi da influenze umane abbastanza a lungo perché la loro cultura sia molto diversa da qualsiasi altra documentata. I loro edifici sembrano di origine aliena, e tra loro comunicano soprattutto con la lingua dei segni. Quando usano la voce, cantano o intonano invece di parlare.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|92|0
units.english: Discovered a strange, isolated human community in an otherwise uninhabited region of space south of the Core. They call themselves the Remnant.
units.italian: Ho scoperto una strana comunità umana isolata in una regione di spazio altrimenti disabitata a sud del Core. Si fanno chiamare Remnant.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|93|0
units.english: Half a millennium ago, during the Alpha Wars, a group of humans fleeing the conflict and looking for a safer place to live discovered a wormhole into a region of space known as the Ember Waste. They built settlements there, and chose to call themselves the Remnant. Although they no longer fear the Alphas as much as they once did, they still have not rejoined human society.
units.italian: Mezzo millennio fa, durante le guerre contro gli Alpha, un gruppo di umani in fuga dal conflitto e in cerca di un luogo più sicuro in cui vivere scoprì un cunicolo verso una regione di spazio nota come Distesa di Braci. Vi costruirono insediamenti e scelsero di chiamarsi Remnant. Anche se non temono più gli Alpha come un tempo, non sono ancora rientrati nella società umana.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|Since their colonies were first formed, the Remnant's culture has changed drastically. They communicate in sign language, using their voices only for singing. Their food and architecture and much of their technology is strange, and much of it has been borrowed or stolen from nearby alien species.|94|0
units.english: Since their colonies were first formed, the Remnant's culture has changed drastically. They communicate in sign language, using their voices only for singing. Their food and architecture and much of their technology is strange, and much of it has been borrowed or stolen from nearby alien species.
units.italian: Da quando furono fondate le loro colonie, la cultura dei Remnant è cambiata radicalmente. Comunicano con la lingua dei segni, usando la voce solo per cantare. Il loro cibo, la loro architettura e gran parte della loro tecnologia sono strani, e molto è stato preso in prestito o rubato alle specie aliene vicine.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|106|0
units.english: Discovered a strange, isolated human community in an otherwise uninhabited region of space south of the Core. They call themselves the Remnant.
units.italian: Ho scoperto una strana comunità umana isolata in una regione di spazio altrimenti disabitata a sud del Core. Si fanno chiamare Remnant.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|log|107|0

Vi costruirono insediamenti e scelsero di chiamarsi Remnant. Anche se non temono più gli Alpha come un tempo, non sono ancora rientrati nella società umana.

Their food and architecture and much of their technology is strange, and much of it has been borrowed or stolen from nearby alien species.|108|0
units.english: Since their colonies were first formed, the Remnant's culture has changed drastically. They communicate in sign language, using their voices only for singing. Their food and architecture and much of their technology is strange, and much of it has been borrowed or stolen from nearby alien species.
units.italian: Da quando furono fondate le loro colonie, la cultura dei Remnant è cambiata radicalmente. Comunicano con la lingua dei segni, usando la voce solo per cantare. Il loro cibo, la loro architettura e gran parte della loro tecnologia sono strani, e molto è stato preso in prestito o rubato alle specie aliene vicine.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|Your return trip is a bit more nerve-wracking. Unlike the previous time, your flight computer keeps blaring warnings that the ships escorting you are weapons-hot and locked on. As soon as you land, your ship is surrounded by soldiers with a variety of weapons, and the same man appears in the midst of them. As before, he pricks his finger, presses it to a spot on the device, then offers a still-sealed lancet to you. He begins chanting in a severe tone, "The first may be a misunderstanding, but now you know our law. Will you submit to a blood test, or be declared guilty once and for all?"|110|0
units.english: Your return trip is a bit more nerve-wracking. Unlike the previous time, your flight computer keeps blaring warnings that the ships escorting you are weapons-hot and locked on. As soon as you land, your ship is surrounded by soldiers with a variety of weapons, and the same man appears in the midst of them. As before, he pricks his finger, presses it to a spot on the device, then offers a still-sealed lancet to you. He begins chanting in a severe tone, "The first may be a misunderstanding, but now you know our law. Will you submit to a blood test, or be declared guilty once and for all?"
units.italian: Il viaggio di ritorno è un po' più snervante. A differenza della volta precedente, il computer di volo continua a strillare avvertimenti: le navi che ti scortano hanno le armi calde e ti stanno puntando. Appena atterri la nave viene circondata da soldati armati in vario modo, e lo stesso uomo compare in mezzo a loro. Come prima, si punge il dito, lo preme su un punto del dispositivo, poi ti offre una lancetta ancora sigillata. Comincia a intonare con tono severo: "La prima volta può essere un malinteso, ma ora conosci la nostra legge. Ti sottoporrai all'esame del sangue, o sarai dichiarato colpevole una volta per tutte?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Provide the blood sample.)|112|0
units.english: (Provide the blood sample.)
units.italian: (Fornisci il campione di sangue.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	(Refuse and run for my ship.)|114|0
units.english: (Refuse and run for my ship.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta e corri alla tua nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	As you turn to start running back to your ship, the soldiers nearby begin raising their weapons and firing at you. As you feel your body begin to liquefy under the assault of the strange energy bolts, the last thing you see is the look of pity, resignation, and confusion on the face of the man with the scanner. Probably wondering why you would decide to return if you were just going to run again. You suppose they'll never know...|116|0
units.english: As you turn to start running back to your ship, the soldiers nearby begin raising their weapons and firing at you. As you feel your body begin to liquefy under the assault of the strange energy bolts, the last thing you see is the look of pity, resignation, and confusion on the face of the man with the scanner. Probably wondering why you would decide to return if you were just going to run again. You suppose they'll never know...
units.italian: Mentre ti volti per correre alla nave, i soldati vicini cominciano ad alzare le armi e a spararti. Mentre senti il corpo liquefarsi sotto l'assalto di quegli strani dardi di energia, l'ultima cosa che vedi è l'espressione di pietà, rassegnazione e confusione sul viso dell'uomo con lo scanner. Probabilmente si chiede perché tu sia tornato se poi saresti scappato di nuovo. Supponi che non lo sapranno mai...

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Several of them gather around the one with the scanner as if waiting to see what the results will be. As you watch them you notice that all of them, even the women, have their hair cropped short. Also, their clothing looks like nothing that has ever been in fashion at any point in human history that you know of.|120|0
units.english: Several of them gather around the one with the scanner as if waiting to see what the results will be. As you watch them you notice that all of them, even the women, have their hair cropped short. Also, their clothing looks like nothing that has ever been in fashion at any point in human history that you know of.
units.italian: Diversi di loro si radunano intorno a quello con lo scanner, come in attesa di vedere il risultato. Mentre li osservi noti che tutti, anche le donne, hanno i capelli tagliati corti. E i loro vestiti non somigliano a nulla che sia mai stato di moda in nessun momento della storia umana che tu conosca.

units.english: Finally the scanner beeps, and a yellow light flashes. You can almost feel the tension leaving the air as the crowd relaxes. "So you are pure. You are human," chants one of the women. "You are one of us."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Of course I'm human. But what are human beings doing out here?"|123|0
units.english: "Of course I'm human. But what are human beings doing out here?"
units.italian: "Certo che sono umano. Ma cosa ci fanno degli esseri umani quaggiù?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	"Who are you?"|124|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi siete?"

In time of great chaos to this place we came, lest all true-born humans be killed or enslaved, by those who evolved not, but unwisely were made."|126|0
units.english: Several of them burst into song, singing together in harmony, "We are the hidden ones. We are the Remnant. In time of great chaos to this place we came, lest all true-born humans be killed or enslaved, by those who evolved not, but unwisely were made."
units.italian: Diversi di loro scoppiano a cantare, in armonia: "Noi siamo i nascosti. Noi siamo i Remnant. In tempo di grande caos venimmo in questo luogo, perché nessun umano di vera nascita fosse ucciso o reso schiavo da coloro che non si evolsero, ma empiamente furono creati."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	As they continue to sing, you begin to piece together their story. They are the descendants of people who fled to this region of space through an unstable wormhole at the peak of the first Alpha War, which means they have been here for more than half a millennium. That doesn't explain why their culture is so radically different, though.|127|0
units.english: As they continue to sing, you begin to piece together their story. They are the descendants of people who fled to this region of space through an unstable wormhole at the peak of the first Alpha War, which means they have been here for more than half a millennium. That doesn't explain why their culture is so radically different, though.
units.italian: Mentre continuano a cantare, cominci a ricostruire la loro storia. Sono i discendenti di chi fuggì in questa regione di spazio attraverso un cunicolo instabile all'apice della prima guerra contro gli Alpha, il che significa che sono qui da più di mezzo millennio. Questo però non spiega perché la loro cultura sia così radicalmente diversa.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	Eventually they invite you to a dinner. Their food has strange and complex flavors, not all of them pleasant, but you do your best to be polite and pretend to enjoy it all. After the meal, they entertain you by singing songs, some of which you recognize as classical Earth music. It appears that people in this culture use sign language for day to day communication, and use their voices only for making music.|128|0
units.english: Eventually they invite you to a dinner. Their food has strange and complex flavors, not all of them pleasant, but you do your best to be polite and pretend to enjoy it all. After the meal, they entertain you by singing songs, some of which you recognize as classical Earth music. It appears that people in this culture use sign language for day to day communication, and use their voices only for making music.
units.italian: Alla fine ti invitano a cena. Il loro cibo ha sapori strani e complessi, non tutti gradevoli, ma fai del tuo meglio per essere cortese e fingere di apprezzarlo tutto. Dopo cena ti intrattengono cantando canzoni, alcune delle quali riconosci come musica classica terrestre. Sembra che in questa cultura si usi la lingua dei segni per la comunicazione quotidiana, e la voce solo per fare musica.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Remnant|	When you return to your ship, you do a search on videos of historical dialects of human sign language. None of them bear even a passing resemblance to the language of these people who call themselves the Remnant.|129|0
units.english: When you return to your ship, you do a search on videos of historical dialects of human sign language. None of them bear even a passing resemblance to the language of these people who call themselves the Remnant.
units.italian: Quando torni alla nave cerchi video di dialetti storici della lingua dei segni umana. Nessuno di essi somiglia neppure vagamente alla lingua di questa gente che si fa chiamare Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|log|178|0
units.english: Became stuck in the Ember Waste, but was given a Quantum Key Stone by an old woman who claims to have once been stuck in Republic space under similar circumstances.
units.italian: Sono rimasto bloccato nella Distesa di Braci, ma una vecchia signora mi ha dato una Pietra Chiave Quantistica, sostenendo di essere rimasta bloccata allo stesso modo nello spazio della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|You wander the <origin> spaceport feeling very lost in this strange region of space. Having flown around for a few weeks with no idea of how to get out, you wonder if you'll be stuck here forever.|180|0
units.english: You wander the <origin> spaceport feeling very lost in this strange region of space. Having flown around for a few weeks with no idea of how to get out, you wonder if you'll be stuck here forever.
units.italian: Giri per lo spazioporto di <origin> sentendoti molto perso in questa strana regione di spazio. Dopo aver volato per qualche settimana senza idea di come uscirne, ti chiedi se resterai bloccato qui per sempre.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	You sit down on a bench and think about how you're going to get out of this situation. While you think, an old woman approaches you and signs something.|181|0
units.english: You sit down on a bench and think about how you're going to get out of this situation. While you think, an old woman approaches you and signs something.
units.italian: Ti siedi su una panchina e pensi a come uscire da questa situazione. Mentre pensi, una vecchia signora ti si avvicina e fa un segno.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Sorry, I don't understand."|183|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't understand."
units.italian: "Scusa, non capisco."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	The old woman chuckles to herself. "You seem lost," she says. You nod. To your surprise, she doesn't sing everything she says like the other Remnant.|184|0
units.english: The old woman chuckles to herself. "You seem lost," she says. You nod. To your surprise, she doesn't sing everything she says like the other Remnant.
units.italian: La vecchia ridacchia fra sé. "Sembri perduto," dice. Annuisci. Con tua sorpresa, non canta tutto quello che dice come gli altri Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"I'm guessing you don't know about the wormholes."|185|0
units.english: "I'm guessing you don't know about the wormholes."
units.italian: "Immagino che tu non sappia dei cunicoli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"The what?"|187|0
units.english: "The what?"
units.italian: "Di cosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"I do, I just can't get through them."|188|0
units.english: "I do, I just can't get through them."
units.italian: "Lo so, ma non riesco ad attraversarli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"There are red wormholes scattered around this region of space. You can only access them if you have a Key Stone on your ship, though. Don't ask me how it works, but that's how it is."|191|0
units.english: "There are red wormholes scattered around this region of space. You can only access them if you have a Key Stone on your ship, though. Don't ask me how it works, but that's how it is."
units.italian: "In questa regione di spazio ci sono cunicoli rossi sparsi qua e là. Però puoi accedervi solo se hai una Pietra Chiave sulla nave. Non chiedermi come funziona, ma è così."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Lost your Key Stone?" she asks with another chuckle. "Or maybe your jump drive, and now you're stuck here? No problem."|195|0
units.english: "Lost your Key Stone?" she asks with another chuckle. "Or maybe your jump drive, and now you're stuck here? No problem."
units.italian: "Hai perso la tua Pietra Chiave?" chiede con un'altra risatina. "O magari il propulsore iperspaziale, e ora sei bloccato qui? Nessun problema."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|label|197|0
units.english: key stone
units.italian: key stone

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	The woman reaches into a bag that she has with her and hands you a Quantum Key Stone. "Just put this on your ship and you can be on your way out of here."|198|0
units.english: The woman reaches into a bag that she has with her and hands you a Quantum Key Stone. "Just put this on your ship and you can be on your way out of here."
units.italian: La donna fruga in una borsa che porta con sé e ti porge una Pietra Chiave Quantistica. "Mettila sulla nave e potrai andartene da qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"You're just giving this to me?"|200|0
units.english: "You're just giving this to me?"
units.italian: "Me la stai dando così, e basta?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"What's the catch?"|202|0
units.english: "What's the catch?"
units.italian: "Dov'è l'inganno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	She chuckles again. "No catch."|203|0
units.english: She chuckles again. "No catch."
units.italian: Ridacchia di nuovo. "Nessun inganno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	The woman sits down on the bench next to you. "I was once lost in Republic space for many years after losing my Key Stone. I know what it can be like to be away from your people for that long, so I'd rather not see you share the same fate."|206|0
units.english: The woman sits down on the bench next to you. "I was once lost in Republic space for many years after losing my Key Stone. I know what it can be like to be away from your people for that long, so I'd rather not see you share the same fate."
units.italian: La donna si siede sulla panchina accanto a te. "Anch'io una volta sono rimasta bloccata nello spazio della Repubblica per molti anni, dopo aver perso la mia Pietra Chiave. So cosa significa essere lontani dalla propria gente così a lungo, quindi preferisco non vederti fare la stessa fine."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Thanks for the help. I'll go fit this on my ship."|208|0
units.english: "Thanks for the help. I'll go fit this on my ship."
units.italian: "Grazie dell'aiuto. Vado a montarla sulla nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"How'd you get to Republic space?"|209|0
units.english: "How'd you get to Republic space?"
units.italian: "Come sei arrivata nello spazio della Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	You say goodbye to the woman and begin walking to your ship. "Safe travels, Captain," she sings with a big grin on her face as you walk away.|212|0
units.english: You say goodbye to the woman and begin walking to your ship. "Safe travels, Captain," she sings with a big grin on her face as you walk away.
units.italian: Saluti la donna e ti avvii alla nave. "Buon viaggio, capitano," intona con un gran sorriso mentre ti allontani.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"I was an adventurous spirit in my youth," she says. "One day I found my way out of the Ember Waste and back to what I learned was the rest of humanity. For years my people had hidden here believing the Alphas had killed everyone else, but I discovered that we had little to fear.|216|0
units.english: "I was an adventurous spirit in my youth," she says. "One day I found my way out of the Ember Waste and back to what I learned was the rest of humanity. For years my people had hidden here believing the Alphas had killed everyone else, but I discovered that we had little to fear.
units.italian: "In gioventù avevo spirito avventuroso," dice. "Un giorno trovai la via per uscire dalla Distesa di Braci e tornai a quello che scoprii essere il resto dell'umanità. Per anni la mia gente si era nascosta qui credendo che gli Alpha avessero ucciso tutti gli altri, ma io scoprii che avevamo poco da temere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"I explored the Republic for many months, learning what had happened since the Alpha Wars, but when I attempted to return to the Ember Waste to tell my people, I found that my Key Stone had been stolen at some point during my journey. I had no way to return."|217|0
units.english: "I explored the Republic for many months, learning what had happened since the Alpha Wars, but when I attempted to return to the Ember Waste to tell my people, I found that my Key Stone had been stolen at some point during my journey. I had no way to return."
units.italian: "Ho esplorato la Repubblica per molti mesi, scoprendo cosa era successo dopo le guerre contro gli Alpha, ma quando ho cercato di tornare nella Distesa di Braci per dirlo alla mia gente, ho scoperto che la mia Pietra Chiave era stata rubata in qualche momento del viaggio. Non avevo modo di tornare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	She lets out a long sigh. "I don't want to bore you with all the details, but I resigned myself to my new life. I met a man, had two daughters, but never lost hope of returning to my true home. One day, after my daughters had grown and my husband had passed in an accident, I decided to go on another adventure. I dusted off my old ship, and soon discovered the Hai."|218|0
units.english: She lets out a long sigh. "I don't want to bore you with all the details, but I resigned myself to my new life. I met a man, had two daughters, but never lost hope of returning to my true home. One day, after my daughters had grown and my husband had passed in an accident, I decided to go on another adventure. I dusted off my old ship, and soon discovered the Hai."
units.italian: Emette un lungo sospiro. "Non voglio annoiarti con tutti i dettagli, ma mi rassegnai alla mia nuova vita. Conobbi un uomo, ebbi due figlie, ma non persi mai la speranza di tornare alla mia vera casa. Un giorno, quando le mie figlie erano cresciute e mio marito era morto in un incidente, decisi di partire per un'altra avventura. Spolverai la mia vecchia nave e presto scoprii gli Hai."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"The who?"|222|0
units.english: "The who?"
units.italian: "I chi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"How you've become lost here without having discovered the Hai first is beyond me." She chuckles. "The Hai are a peaceful alien people north of humanity. Go looking for a purple wormhole in the uninhabited systems of the Far North. You may find your way there.|223|0
units.english: "How you've become lost here without having discovered the Hai first is beyond me." She chuckles. "The Hai are a peaceful alien people north of humanity. Go looking for a purple wormhole in the uninhabited systems of the Far North. You may find your way there.
units.italian: "Come tu sia finito qui senza aver prima scoperto gli Hai è per me un mistero." Ridacchia. "Gli Hai sono un popolo alieno pacifico a nord dell'umanità. Vai a cercare un cunicolo viola nei sistemi disabitati del Far North. Potresti trovare la strada.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"You've met the Hai?"|228|0
units.english: "You've met the Hai?"
units.italian: "Hai incontrato gli Hai?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Well of course. How else would I have been able to return home?|229|0
units.english: "Well of course. How else would I have been able to return home?
units.italian: "Ma certo. In quale altro modo sarei potuta tornare a casa?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"To my surprise, the Hai had a large number of Quantum Key Stones." She pauses for a moment. "Might be a good idea for you to bring some of those Hai keystones here. Anyway, I was so thrilled that I didn't even ask any questions about how they had them. I bought one and flew as fast as I could back to the Ember Waste, and I've been here ever since."|232|0
units.english: "To my surprise, the Hai had a large number of Quantum Key Stones." She pauses for a moment. "Might be a good idea for you to bring some of those Hai keystones here. Anyway, I was so thrilled that I didn't even ask any questions about how they had them. I bought one and flew as fast as I could back to the Ember Waste, and I've been here ever since."
units.italian: "Con mia sorpresa, gli Hai avevano un gran numero di Pietre Chiave Quantistiche." Si ferma un momento. "Potrebbe essere una buona idea portare qui alcune di quelle pietre chiave degli Hai. Comunque, ero così entusiasta che non feci nemmeno domande su come le avessero. Ne comprai una e volai il più in fretta possibile verso la Distesa di Braci, e da allora sono qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"How long ago was that?"|234|0
units.english: "How long ago was that?"
units.italian: "Quanto tempo fa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"What about your daughters?"|235|0
units.english: "What about your daughters?"
units.italian: "E le tue figlie?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Well I got lost when I was 17 and returned when I was 64, so perhaps some 130 years ago now that I returned." She chuckles at the surprised look on your face as you realize that she is nearly 200 years old. "Uncovering ancient alien technology is quite the blessing.|238|0
units.english: "Well I got lost when I was 17 and returned when I was 64, so perhaps some 130 years ago now that I returned." She chuckles at the surprised look on your face as you realize that she is nearly 200 years old. "Uncovering ancient alien technology is quite the blessing.
units.italian: "Beh, mi sono persa a 17 anni e sono tornata a 64, quindi forse 130 anni fa, ora che sono tornata." Ridacchia davanti alla tua espressione sorpresa quando capisci che ha quasi 200 anni. "Scoprire antiche tecnologie aliene è una bella benedizione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"Oh, I only told them about deciding to travel the galaxy. Never told them about returning home. I made trips to see them every so often, but they both passed many decades ago now. It seems like the Republic can't quite get anyone to live past 130 years.|242|0
units.english: "Oh, I only told them about deciding to travel the galaxy. Never told them about returning home. I made trips to see them every so often, but they both passed many decades ago now. It seems like the Republic can't quite get anyone to live past 130 years.
units.italian: "Oh, a loro ho solo detto che avevo deciso di viaggiare per la galassia. Mai che sarei tornata a casa. Ogni tanto facevo un viaggio per vederle, ma sono morte entrambe da molti decenni ormai. Sembra che la Repubblica non riesca a far vivere nessuno oltre i 130 anni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Lost in Ember Waste|	"I really must get going, now," she says. The woman gets up to leave, but before walking away she turns to you and sings, "Safe travels, Captain," with a big grin on her face. You say goodbye to her in return and part ways.|245|0
units.english: "I really must get going, now," she says. The woman gets up to leave, but before walking away she turns to you and sings, "Safe travels, Captain," with a big grin on her face. You say goodbye to her in return and part ways.
units.italian: "Ora devo proprio andare," dice. La donna si alza per andarsene, ma prima di allontanarsi si volta verso di te e intona: "Buon viaggio, capitano," con un gran sorriso sul viso. La saluti anche tu e vi separate.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|name|251|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|description|252|0
units.english: Assist in defending <planet> from a Korath raid, then return to the planet.
units.italian: Aiuta a difendere <planet> da un'incursione Korath, poi torna sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|In the relative quiet of this Remnant spaceport, it's unusually jarring when an alarm siren begins howling. All around you, people are rushing to get their ships into the air. Even though no one stops to explain to you what is happening, it's pretty clear that this is a planetary defense operation.|259|0
units.english: In the relative quiet of this Remnant spaceport, it's unusually jarring when an alarm siren begins howling. All around you, people are rushing to get their ships into the air. Even though no one stops to explain to you what is happening, it's pretty clear that this is a planetary defense operation.
units.italian: Nel relativo silenzio di questo spazioporto dei Remnant è insolitamente stridente quando una sirena comincia a ululare. Intorno a te la gente corre a mettere in aria le proprie navi. Anche se nessuno si ferma a spiegarti cosa succede, è abbastanza chiaro che si tratta di un'operazione di difesa planetaria.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|	(Assist the defenders.)|261|0
units.english: (Assist the defenders.)
units.italian: (Aiuta i difensori.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|	(Stay here, and don't help them.)|263|0
units.english: (Stay here, and don't help them.)
units.italian: (Resta qui e non aiutarli.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|	You remain behind on the planet. You probably just missed out on a great opportunity to earn the gratitude of the Remnant.|264|0
units.english: You remain behind on the planet. You probably just missed out on a great opportunity to earn the gratitude of the Remnant.
units.italian: Resti sul pianeta. Probabilmente hai appena perso una grande occasione per guadagnarti la gratitudine dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 1|dialog|278|0
units.english: There are still Korath raiders circling overhead. You should take off and help the Remnant ships to fight them.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora predoni Korath che volteggiano sopra la tua testa. Dovresti decollare e aiutare le navi dei Remnant a combatterli.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|name|286|0
units.english: Remnant bounty
units.italian: Taglia dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|description|287|0
units.english: A Korath ship is flying around Remnant territory. Hunt it down and destroy it, then return to <planet> for payment.
units.italian: Una nave Korath sta volando intorno al territorio dei Remnant. Dagli la caccia e distruggila, poi torna su <planet> per il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|The people here are grateful for your help in fighting off the Korath raid, and they offer you a payment of <payment>. They explain to you (in song, of course; the explanation takes the form of an epic ballad) that these raids have been taking place for nearly a century.|293|0
units.english: The people here are grateful for your help in fighting off the Korath raid, and they offer you a payment of <payment>. They explain to you (in song, of course; the explanation takes the form of an epic ballad) that these raids have been taking place for nearly a century.
units.italian: La gente qui è grata per il tuo aiuto nel respingere l'incursione Korath, e ti offre un pagamento di <payment>. Ti spiegano (cantando, naturalmente; la spiegazione prende la forma di una ballata epica) che queste incursioni vanno avanti da quasi un secolo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Have you done anything to try to stop the Korath from raiding you?"|295|0
units.english: "Have you done anything to try to stop the Korath from raiding you?"
units.italian: "Avete fatto qualcosa per cercare di fermare le incursioni dei Korath?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"What do you think the Korath are hoping to accomplish?"|296|0
units.english: "What do you think the Korath are hoping to accomplish?"
units.italian: "Secondo voi cosa sperano di ottenere i Korath?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Of course not," chants one of them. "Why would we give up a good opportunity to plunder new technology?" His voice is such a perfect monotone that you can't tell whether the comment was meant facetiously or not.|299|0
units.english: "Of course not," chants one of them. "Why would we give up a good opportunity to plunder new technology?" His voice is such a perfect monotone that you can't tell whether the comment was meant facetiously or not.
units.italian: "Certo che no," intona uno di loro. "Perché dovremmo rinunciare a una buona occasione di saccheggiare nuova tecnologia?" La sua voce è così perfettamente monotona che non capisci se la battuta fosse ironica o meno.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Perhaps they seek new territory, or perhaps they are just innately aggressive," chants one person.|303|0
units.english: "Perhaps they seek new territory, or perhaps they are just innately aggressive," chants one person.
units.italian: "Forse cercano nuovo territorio, o forse sono semplicemente aggressivi per natura," intona una persona.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Of course," says another, "the fact that our ships dump their cargo when the raiders attack probably makes us a tempting target."|304|0
units.english: "Of course," says another, "the fact that our ships dump their cargo when the raiders attack probably makes us a tempting target."
units.italian: "Certo," dice un altro, "il fatto che le nostre navi abbandonino il carico quando i predoni attaccano probabilmente ci rende un bersaglio tentante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	A third person explains, "We do that intentionally, to keep luring them back. The technology we gain when we manage to plunder one of their ships more than outweighs the cargo we lose."|305|0
units.english: A third person explains, "We do that intentionally, to keep luring them back. The technology we gain when we manage to plunder one of their ships more than outweighs the cargo we lose."
units.italian: Una terza persona spiega: "Lo facciamo di proposito, per continuare a attirarli. La tecnologia che otteniamo quando riusciamo a saccheggiare una delle loro navi vale molto più del carico che perdiamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	While you're conversing with the group, a uniformed woman walks up and tells them something in sign language. They sign back and point to you. She says to you, "Thank you for your help. A Korath ship that came with the raiders and fled the battle is still lurking around our territory. Would you be willing to hunt it down?"|308|0
units.english: While you're conversing with the group, a uniformed woman walks up and tells them something in sign language. They sign back and point to you. She says to you, "Thank you for your help. A Korath ship that came with the raiders and fled the battle is still lurking around our territory. Would you be willing to hunt it down?"
units.italian: Mentre conversi con il gruppo, una donna in uniforme si avvicina e dice loro qualcosa nella lingua dei segni. Rispondono a segni e ti indicano. Lei ti dice: "Grazie per il tuo aiuto. Una nave Korath che è venuta con i predoni ed è fuggita dalla battaglia sta ancora aggirandosi nel nostro territorio. Saresti disposto a darle la caccia?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Sure."|310|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Sorry, I don't have time to help you out."|311|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to help you out."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho tempo per aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|	"Thank you," she sings. "It keeps jumping between systems in our territory. Maybe its jump drive was damaged or something, and it cannot escape. I will spread the information that you've taken on the bounty for hunting it, so others will not risk their lives fighting it."|314|0
units.english: "Thank you," she sings. "It keeps jumping between systems in our territory. Maybe its jump drive was damaged or something, and it cannot escape. I will spread the information that you've taken on the bounty for hunting it, so others will not risk their lives fighting it."
units.italian: "Grazie," intona. "Continua a saltare da un sistema all'altro nel nostro territorio. Forse il suo propulsore iperspaziale è danneggiato o qualcosa del genere, e non riesce a fuggire. Diffonderò la notizia che hai accettato la taglia per dargli la caccia, così gli altri non rischieranno la vita combattendola."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|dialog|328|0
units.english: You have destroyed the Korath ship that was left over from the raid on <planet>. You can now return there to collect your payment.
units.italian: Hai distrutto la nave Korath rimasta dall'incursione su <planet>. Ora puoi tornarci per riscuotere il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|dialog|333|0
units.english: The same woman meets you when you land on <planet>. "Again, thank you," she says. "I will suggest to others that they might offer you similar bounty hunting jobs in the future." She pays you <payment>.
units.italian: La stessa donna ti accoglie quando atterri su <planet>. "Di nuovo grazie," dice. "Suggerirò ad altri che potrebbero offrirti lavori simili di caccia alle taglie in futuro." Ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 2|log|334|0
units.english: Recently, Korath ships have begun raiding Remnant worlds. The Remnant have decided not to try to discourage these raids, because they are a perfect opportunity to steal jump drives and other valuable alien technology from the Korath.
units.italian: Di recente le navi Korath hanno cominciato a fare incursioni sui mondi dei Remnant. I Remnant hanno deciso di non cercare di scoraggiarle, perché sono un'occasione perfetta per rubare ai Korath propulsori iperspaziali e altra preziosa tecnologia aliena.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|name|340|0
units.english: Remnant surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|description|341|0
units.english: Travel to the <waypoints> system, destroy any Korath ships you find there, then deploy a Remnant surveillance satellite to give them advance warning of Korath raids in the future. Return to <planet> when you are done.
units.italian: Recati nel sistema <waypoints>, distruggi tutte le navi Korath che ci trovi, poi schiera un satellite di sorveglianza dei Remnant per dar loro un preavviso delle future incursioni Korath. Torna su <planet> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|A man approaches your ship soon after you collect your latest bounty, and sings, "You have been most helpful in fighting the Korath. Would you be willing to assist us in another way?"|350|0
units.english: A man approaches your ship soon after you collect your latest bounty, and sings, "You have been most helpful in fighting the Korath. Would you be willing to assist us in another way?"
units.italian: Un uomo si avvicina alla tua nave poco dopo che hai riscosso l'ultima taglia e intona: "Ci sei stato di grande aiuto nel combattere i Korath. Saresti disposto ad assisterci in un altro modo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	"Sure, tell me more."|352|0
units.english: "Sure, tell me more."
units.italian: "Certo, dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you out anymore."|353|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you out anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa più darvi una mano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	He explains that they hope to gain advance notice of future raids by setting up remote surveillance equipment in the system in the Ember Waste that is closest to Korath space. The equipment will communicate with the Remnant via something called an "entangled particle pair" that does not require a hyperspace relay network. Ironically, this is technology that the Remnant acquired by raiding the Korath decades ago.|356|0
units.english: He explains that they hope to gain advance notice of future raids by setting up remote surveillance equipment in the system in the Ember Waste that is closest to Korath space. The equipment will communicate with the Remnant via something called an "entangled particle pair" that does not require a hyperspace relay network. Ironically, this is technology that the Remnant acquired by raiding the Korath decades ago.
units.italian: Ti spiega che sperano di ottenere un preavviso delle future incursioni installando apparecchiature di sorveglianza remote nel sistema della Distesa di Braci più vicino allo spazio Korath. L'apparecchiatura comunicherà con i Remnant tramite una cosa chiamata "coppia di particelle intrecciate", che non richiede una rete di relè iperspaziale. Ironia della sorte, è una tecnologia che i Remnant hanno acquisito saccheggiando i Korath decenni fa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	"I will mark the target system on your map," he says, "and give you the equipment necessary to deploy the surveillance satellite. Please do not deploy it while any Korath ships are watching. Our scouts encountered Palavrets, but they have crippled them enough to where they should not be a problem."|357|0
units.english: "I will mark the target system on your map," he says, "and give you the equipment necessary to deploy the surveillance satellite. Please do not deploy it while any Korath ships are watching. Our scouts encountered Palavrets, but they have crippled them enough to where they should not be a problem."
units.italian: "Segnerò il sistema bersaglio sulla tua mappa," dice, "e ti darò l'apparecchiatura necessaria a schierare il satellite di sorveglianza. Ti prego di non schierarlo mentre qualche nave Korath guarda. Le nostre esploratrici hanno incontrato dei Palavret, ma li hanno messi fuori combattimento quel tanto che basta perché non siano più un problema."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|dialog|371|0
units.english: Now that you are alone, you are able to deploy the Remnant surveillance satellite unobserved. Time to report back to <planet>.
units.italian: Ora che sei solo puoi schierare il satellite di sorveglianza dei Remnant senza essere visto. È il momento di riferire su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|dialog|373|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you haven't deployed the surveillance satellite yet. Return to <waypoints> and make sure that all of the Korath there have been eliminated.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora schierato il satellite di sorveglianza. Torna su <waypoints> e assicurati che tutti i Korath siano stati eliminati.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|When you return to <planet>, the same Remnant man meets you and says that they have begun receiving data from the surveillance satellite that you deployed. "Thank you for your assistance," he sings. He pays you <payment>.|378|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, the same Remnant man meets you and says that they have begun receiving data from the surveillance satellite that you deployed. "Thank you for your assistance," he sings. He pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, lo stesso uomo dei Remnant ti accoglie e dice che hanno cominciato a ricevere dati dal satellite di sorveglianza che hai schierato. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto," intona. Ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	"You're welcome."|380|0
units.english: "You're welcome."
units.italian: "Non c'è di che."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	"You know, a great way to say 'thank you' would be to offer me a license to buy your technology."|382|0
units.english: "You know, a great way to say 'thank you' would be to offer me a license to buy your technology."
units.italian: "Sai, un ottimo modo per dire 'grazie' sarebbe offrirmi una licenza per comprare la vostra tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Defense 3|	He grins, very slightly. "That is not my decision alone to make," he says, "but I will put in a word for you and see what I can do."|384|0
units.english: He grins, very slightly. "That is not my decision alone to make," he says, "but I will put in a word for you and see what I can do."
units.italian: Sorride, molto lievemente. "Non è una decisione che spetta solo a me," dice, "ma intercederò per te e vedrò cosa posso fare."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|As you are walking through the spaceport, a man comes up to you and introduces himself as the manager of the local outfitter. "Greetings, outsider," he says. "I have heard many good things about you and your assistance to our people. Would you be interested in going on a quest for me?"|395|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a man comes up to you and introduces himself as the manager of the local outfitter. "Greetings, outsider," he says. "I have heard many good things about you and your assistance to our people. Would you be interested in going on a quest for me?"
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un uomo ti si avvicina e si presenta come il gestore dell'equipaggiamento locale. "Salve, straniero," dice. "Ho sentito molte cose buone di te e del tuo aiuto alla nostra gente. Ti interesserebbe partire per una missione per me?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"What kind of quest?"|397|0
units.english: "What kind of quest?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di missione?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Sorry, I'm not interested."|399|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Please, I assure you, this quest will be very lucrative for you.|401|0
units.english: "Please, I assure you, this quest will be very lucrative for you.
units.italian: "Ti prego, te lo assicuro, questa missione sarà molto redditizia per te.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"You may have noticed the red anomalies scattered within this region of space. What you may not have known is that these are wormholes, accessible only with the possession of a Quantum Key Stone. My people highly value these Key Stones because of this, but our mines produce very few of them." The manager shows you a Key Stone that he has with him.|404|0
units.english: "You may have noticed the red anomalies scattered within this region of space. What you may not have known is that these are wormholes, accessible only with the possession of a Quantum Key Stone. My people highly value these Key Stones because of this, but our mines produce very few of them." The manager shows you a Key Stone that he has with him.
units.italian: "Avrai notato le anomalie rosse sparse in questa regione di spazio. Quello che forse non sapevi è che sono cunicoli, accessibili solo a chi possiede una Pietra Chiave Quantistica. La mia gente tiene molto a queste Pietre Chiave proprio per questo, ma le nostre miniere ne producono pochissime." Il gestore ti mostra una Pietra Chiave che ha con sé.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"We have explored all of the Ember Waste, but have been unable to find any large concentrations of these stones."|410|0
units.english: "We have explored all of the Ember Waste, but have been unable to find any large concentrations of these stones."
units.italian: "Abbiamo esplorato tutta la Distesa di Braci, ma non siamo riusciti a trovare grandi concentrazioni di queste pietre."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"You seem to be able to easily explore outside of this region. If you manage to discover a source of Key Stones outside of the Ember Waste, would you please inform me of them?"|411|0
units.english: "You seem to be able to easily explore outside of this region. If you manage to discover a source of Key Stones outside of the Ember Waste, would you please inform me of them?"
units.italian: "Sembri riuscire a esplorare facilmente fuori da questa regione. Se riuscissi a scoprire una fonte di Pietre Chiave fuori dalla Distesa di Braci, vorresti informarmene?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"If I find anything, I'll let you know."|413|0
units.english: "If I find anything, I'll let you know."
units.italian: "Se trovo qualcosa, te lo farò sapere."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"No thanks. This seems like a wild goose chase to me."|414|0
units.english: "No thanks. This seems like a wild goose chase to me."
units.italian: "No, grazie. Mi sembra una caccia al tesoro senza senso."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	The outfitter manager thanks you. "We'll discuss payment once you return," he says.|417|0
units.english: The outfitter manager thanks you. "We'll discuss payment once you return," he says.
units.italian: Il gestore ti ringrazia. "Parleremo del pagamento quando torni," dice.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|You find the outfitter manager and tell him that you have good news. "You found another world where the stones can be mined?" he asks.|421|0
units.english: You find the outfitter manager and tell him that you have good news. "You found another world where the stones can be mined?" he asks.
units.italian: Trovi il gestore e gli dici che hai buone notizie. "Hai trovato un altro mondo dove si possono estrarre le pietre?" chiede.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"I've seen that before," you say.|425|0
units.english: "I've seen that before," you say.
units.italian: "L'ho già vista, quella roba," dici.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	He looks at you with surprise. "You found another world where these stones can be mined?"|426|0
units.english: He looks at you with surprise. "You found another world where these stones can be mined?"
units.italian: Ti guarda con sorpresa. "Hai trovato un altro mondo dove si possono estrarre queste pietre?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|As you are walking through the spaceport, a man comes up to you and introduces himself as the manager of the local outfitter. He says, "I could not help but notice that you have a Key Stone that looks different from the ones from our mines. You may have noticed the red anomalies scattered within this region of space. What you may not have known is that these are wormholes, accessible only with the possession of a Quantum Key Stone. My people highly value these Key Stones because of this, but our mines produce very few of them. Have you found another world where these stones can be mined?"|430|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a man comes up to you and introduces himself as the manager of the local outfitter. He says, "I could not help but notice that you have a Key Stone that looks different from the ones from our mines. You may have noticed the red anomalies scattered within this region of space. What you may not have known is that these are wormholes, accessible only with the possession of a Quantum Key Stone. My people highly value these Key Stones because of this, but our mines produce very few of them. Have you found another world where these stones can be mined?"
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un uomo ti si avvicina e si presenta come il gestore dell'equipaggiamento locale. Dice: "Non ho potuto fare a meno di notare che hai una Pietra Chiave diversa da quelle delle nostre miniere. Avrai notato le anomalie rosse sparse in questa regione di spazio. Quello che forse non sapevi è che sono cunicoli, accessibili solo a chi possiede una Pietra Chiave Quantistica. La mia gente tiene molto a queste Pietre Chiave proprio per questo, ma le nostre miniere ne producono pochissime. Hai trovato un altro mondo dove si possono estrarre?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Yes, in the territory of some aliens far to the north of here."|434|0
units.english: "Yes, in the territory of some aliens far to the north of here."
units.italian: "Sì, nel territorio di alcuni alieni molto a nord di qui."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Yes, but I would prefer not to tell you where."|436|0
units.english: "Yes, but I would prefer not to tell you where."
units.italian: "Sì, ma preferirei non dirti dove."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"That is understandable," he says. "I am a businessman and I understand how valuable certain trade secrets can be. But perhaps I can interest you in a mutually profitable endeavor?"|438|0
units.english: "That is understandable," he says. "I am a businessman and I understand how valuable certain trade secrets can be. But perhaps I can interest you in a mutually profitable endeavor?"
units.italian: "È comprensibile," dice. "Sono un uomo d'affari e so quanto possano valere certi segreti commerciali. Ma forse posso interessarti a un'iniziativa vantaggiosa per entrambi?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Intriguing," he sings. "Are they aware of how valuable these stones are?" You tell him about the Hai, that they are an old species and that to them the Key Stones are just good luck charms. "Perhaps they have forgotten the true use of the Stones," says the man. "This may give us an opportunity for a mutually profitable endeavor."|442|0
units.english: "Intriguing," he sings. "Are they aware of how valuable these stones are?" You tell him about the Hai, that they are an old species and that to them the Key Stones are just good luck charms. "Perhaps they have forgotten the true use of the Stones," says the man. "This may give us an opportunity for a mutually profitable endeavor."
units.italian: "Interessante," intona. "Sanno quanto valgono queste pietre?" Gli racconti degli Hai, che sono una specie antica e che per loro le Pietre Chiave sono solo portafortuna. "Forse hanno dimenticato il vero uso delle pietre," dice l'uomo. "Questo potrebbe darci l'occasione per un'iniziativa vantaggiosa per entrambi."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Tell me more," you say.|445|0
units.english: "Tell me more," you say.
units.italian: "Dimmi di più," dici.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	He says, "If you could fetch me a large supply of these stones, say fifty of them, I would purchase them from you for a high enough price that you would earn a tidy profit. What do you say?"|446|0
units.english: He says, "If you could fetch me a large supply of these stones, say fifty of them, I would purchase them from you for a high enough price that you would earn a tidy profit. What do you say?"
units.italian: Dice: "Se potessi procurarmi una grande scorta di queste pietre, diciamo cinquanta, te le comprerei a un prezzo abbastanza alto da lasciarti un bel guadagno. Che ne dici?"

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Sure, I would be glad to accept that deal."|448|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to accept that deal."
units.italian: "Certo, sarei felice di accettare l'accordo."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"Sorry, I'm really not interested in doing business with you Remnant folks."|449|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm really not interested in doing business with you Remnant folks."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho proprio interesse a fare affari con voi Remnant."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	After a bit of haggling, he agrees to pay you six million credits in exchange for a cargo of fifty Hai "keystones." Given how cheap they are to purchase in Hai space, you will be earning a very tidy profit on the deal.|452|0
units.english: After a bit of haggling, he agrees to pay you six million credits in exchange for a cargo of fifty Hai "keystones." Given how cheap they are to purchase in Hai space, you will be earning a very tidy profit on the deal.
units.italian: Dopo un po' di trattative accetta di pagarti sei milioni di crediti in cambio di un carico di cinquanta "pietre chiave" degli Hai. Considerato quanto costano poco nello spazio degli Hai, realizzerai un guadagno molto consistente.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	"We look forward to receiving this shipment," he sings. "Just instruct the dockworkers to load them into your cargo bay."|453|0
units.english: "We look forward to receiving this shipment," he sings. "Just instruct the dockworkers to load them into your cargo bay."
units.italian: "Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere questa partita," intona. "Basta dire agli scaricatori di caricarla nella tua stiva."

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones|	He glances at his commlink and starts tapping at something. "We look forward to your return," he trills, before striding away still looking at his display.|454|0
units.english: He glances at his commlink and starts tapping at something. "We look forward to your return," he trills, before striding away still looking at his display.
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata al suo commlink e comincia a digitare qualcosa. "Non vediamo l'ora che tu torni," trilla, prima di allontanarsi a passo svelto continuando a guardare il suo display.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones done|You visit the local outfitter and tell the manager that you have brought a shipment of "quantum keystones" to sell to him. He is overjoyed, and gladly pays you six million credits for them. You can't help noticing that based on how much the Key Stones sell for here, he will be earning even more profit than you did, even though you did nearly all the work.|460|0
units.english: You visit the local outfitter and tell the manager that you have brought a shipment of "quantum keystones" to sell to him. He is overjoyed, and gladly pays you six million credits for them. You can't help noticing that based on how much the Key Stones sell for here, he will be earning even more profit than you did, even though you did nearly all the work.
units.italian: Vai dall'equipaggiamento locale e dici al gestore che hai portato una partita di "pietre chiave quantistiche" da vendergli. È fuori di sé dalla gioia, e ti paga volentieri sei milioni di crediti. Non puoi fare a meno di notare che, a giudicare da quanto si vendono qui le Pietre Chiave, guadagnerà ancora più di te, anche se hai fatto quasi tutto il lavoro.

units.id: conversation:remnant key stones done|	"You have made a valuable contribution to our people by doing this," he says. "These stones will allow more of our ships to explore the Ember Waste and discover the secrets that it holds."|461|0
units.english: "You have made a valuable contribution to our people by doing this," he says. "These stones will allow more of our ships to explore the Ember Waste and discover the secrets that it holds."
units.italian: "Facendo questo hai dato un contributo prezioso alla nostra gente," dice. "Queste pietre permetteranno a più delle nostre navi di esplorare la Distesa di Braci e scoprire i segreti che custodisce."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones (Pre-Hai) 1|name|466|0
units.english: Key Stones
units.italian: Pietre Chiave

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones (Pre-Hai) 1|description|467|0
units.english: The manager of the outfitter on <planet> is interested in finding alternative sources of Key Stones. The Remnant have explored the entire Ember Waste, so you will need to search elsewhere for these stones.
units.italian: Il gestore dell'equipaggiamento su <planet> è interessato a trovare fonti alternative di Pietre Chiave. I Remnant hanno esplorato tutta la Distesa di Braci, quindi dovrai cercare queste pietre altrove.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Found Keystones|While exploring the Hai spaceport, you notice something interesting about some of the Hai ships. Many of them appear to be decorated with a stone that looks very similar to the Quantum Key Stones found in the Ember Waste. You ask a nearby Hai what they are, and she tells you that the stones are good luck charms that many Hai use on their ships that can be purchased from any Hai outfitter.|495|0
units.english: While exploring the Hai spaceport, you notice something interesting about some of the Hai ships. Many of them appear to be decorated with a stone that looks very similar to the Quantum Key Stones found in the Ember Waste. You ask a nearby Hai what they are, and she tells you that the stones are good luck charms that many Hai use on their ships that can be purchased from any Hai outfitter.
units.italian: Mentre esplori lo spazioporto degli Hai, noti qualcosa di interessante in alcune delle loro navi. Molte sembrano decorate con una pietra molto simile alle Pietre Chiave Quantistiche che si trovano nella Distesa di Braci. Chiedi a una Hai lì vicino cosa sono, e lei ti dice che sono portafortuna che molti Hai usano sulle navi, acquistabili da qualsiasi fornitore di equipaggiamento Hai.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Found Keystones|	You should return to the Remnant outfitter manager to tell him about the stones in Hai space.|496|0
units.english: You should return to the Remnant outfitter manager to tell him about the stones in Hai space.
units.italian: Dovresti tornare dal gestore dei Remnant per parlargli delle pietre nello spazio degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones (Pre-Hai) 2|name|503|0
units.english: Key Stones
units.italian: Pietre Chiave

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones (Pre-Hai) 2|description|504|0
units.english: The manager of the outfitter on <planet> has offered to pay you six million credits in exchange for a shipment of fifty quantum keystones (which you will have to purchase from the Hai).
units.italian: Il gestore dell'equipaggiamento su <planet> ti ha offerto sei milioni di crediti in cambio di una partita di cinquanta pietre chiave quantistiche (che dovrai acquistare dagli Hai).

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones (Pre-Hai) 2|dialog|512|0
