units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't have 50 "quantum keystones" to give to the outfitter. Buy the keystones from the Hai before returning here.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai 50 "pietre chiave quantistiche" da dare al gestore. Compra le pietre chiave dagli Hai prima di tornare qui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones|name|522|0
units.english: Keystones
units.italian: Pietre-Chiave

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones|description|523|0
units.english: The manager of the outfitter on <planet> has offered to pay you six million credits in exchange for a shipment of fifty quantum keystones (which you will have to purchase from the Hai).
units.italian: Il gestore dell'equipaggiamento su <planet> ti ha offerto sei milioni di crediti in cambio di una partita di cinquanta pietre chiave quantistiche (che dovrai acquistare dagli Hai).

units.id: mission:Remnant: Key Stones|dialog|541|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't have 50 "quantum keystones" to give to the outfitter. Buy the keystones from the Hai before returning here.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai 50 "pietre chiave quantistiche" da dare al gestore. Compra le pietre chiave dagli Hai prima di tornare qui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|name|550|0
units.english: Space creatures
units.italian: Creature spaziali

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|description|551|0
units.english: A man on the Remnant homeworld of <planet> asked you to collect data on some strange space creatures in the <waypoints> system, in another part of the Ember Waste.
units.italian: Un uomo sul mondo natale dei Remnant, <planet>, ti ha chiesto di raccogliere dati su alcune strane creature spaziali nel sistema <waypoints>, in un'altra parte della Distesa di Braci.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|As you explore the spaceport, you meet a Remnant man wearing some sort of optical prosthesis over his eyes, a visor with several tiny cameras mounted on it. "Ah," he sings, "the outsider. Human yet not of our culture, distinct from our mindset. That is useful. Would you be willing to invest in a research project?"|559|0
units.english: As you explore the spaceport, you meet a Remnant man wearing some sort of optical prosthesis over his eyes, a visor with several tiny cameras mounted on it. "Ah," he sings, "the outsider. Human yet not of our culture, distinct from our mindset. That is useful. Would you be willing to invest in a research project?"
units.italian: Mentre esplori lo spazioporto incontri un uomo dei Remnant che porta una specie di protesi ottica sugli occhi, una visiera con diverse minuscole telecamere montate sopra. "Ah," intona, "lo straniero. Umano ma non della nostra cultura, diverso dalla nostra mentalità. Questo è utile. Saresti disposto a investire in un progetto di ricerca?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Perhaps. Tell me more."|561|0
units.english: "Perhaps. Tell me more."
units.italian: "Forse. Dimmi di più."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Sorry, I'm not interested."|562|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Excellent," he sings. "Centuries ago, we discovered some space-dwelling organisms elsewhere in the Waste, and undertook to study them. Certain mistakes were made, certain underestimations, and we can no longer safely approach these organisms. Would you be willing to visit their home system and collect some sensor data? I call this an investment, because I cannot pay you until I publish the results of these studies."|564|0
units.english: "Excellent," he sings. "Centuries ago, we discovered some space-dwelling organisms elsewhere in the Waste, and undertook to study them. Certain mistakes were made, certain underestimations, and we can no longer safely approach these organisms. Would you be willing to visit their home system and collect some sensor data? I call this an investment, because I cannot pay you until I publish the results of these studies."
units.italian: "Eccellente," intona. "Secoli fa scoprimmo degli organismi che vivono nello spazio altrove nella Distesa, e ci mettemmo a studiarli. Furono fatti certi errori, certe sottovalutazioni, e non possiamo più avvicinarci a quegli organismi in sicurezza. Saresti disposto a visitare il loro sistema d'origine e raccogliere qualche dato dei sensori? Lo chiamo investimento perché non posso pagarti finché non pubblico i risultati di questi studi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Yes, I'd be glad to."|566|0
units.english: "Yes, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Sì, ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Wait, that sounds super shady. Can you explain why you think it's safe for me to enter that star system, but not for you to do so?"|568|0
units.english: "Wait, that sounds super shady. Can you explain why you think it's safe for me to enter that star system, but not for you to do so?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, sembra molto losco. Puoi spiegarmi perché pensi che sia sicuro per me entrare in quel sistema stellare, ma non per te?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	He says, "We studied the organisms and determined that they could not possibly be sentient. Therefore we saw no moral issues with collecting, well, ah... a sample. Unexpected things happened and certain grudges have been, ah, borne against Remnant ships for centuries as a result."|571|0
units.english: He says, "We studied the organisms and determined that they could not possibly be sentient. Therefore we saw no moral issues with collecting, well, ah... a sample. Unexpected things happened and certain grudges have been, ah, borne against Remnant ships for centuries as a result."
units.italian: Dice: "Abbiamo studiato gli organismi e stabilito che non potevano essere senzienti. Quindi non vedemmo problemi morali nel prelevare, beh, ehm... un campione. Sono successe cose inattese e da allora certe navi dei Remnant si portano dietro, ah, qualche rancore da secoli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Well, as long as you don't ask me to do something that will get me in similar trouble, I'll help you out."|573|0
units.english: "Well, as long as you don't ask me to do something that will get me in similar trouble, I'll help you out."
units.italian: "Beh, finché non mi chiedi di fare qualcosa che mi metta nei guai allo stesso modo, ti aiuto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you."|575|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Are you sure?" he chants. "We could learn some incredible things."|577|0
units.english: "Are you sure?" he chants. "We could learn some incredible things."
units.italian: "Sei sicuro?" intona. "Potremmo imparare cose incredibili."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"No, I'm really not interested."|579|0
units.english: "No, I'm really not interested."
units.italian: "No, non mi interessa davvero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Fine, tell me what you want me to do."|581|0
units.english: "Fine, tell me what you want me to do."
units.italian: "Va bene, dimmi cosa vuoi che faccia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	He sings, "Thank you. To begin with, all I ask is that you visit this star system and scan the creatures with certain special equipment that I will provide. Report back to me when you are done."|584|0
units.english: He sings, "Thank you. To begin with, all I ask is that you visit this star system and scan the creatures with certain special equipment that I will provide. Report back to me when you are done."
units.italian: Intona: "Grazie. Per cominciare, ti chiedo solo di visitare questo sistema stellare e scansionare le creature con un'apparecchiatura speciale che ti fornirò. Riferisci quando hai finito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"How should I find you?"|586|0
units.english: "How should I find you?"
units.italian: "Come faccio a trovarti?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"What is your name?"|587|0
units.english: "What is your name?"
units.italian: "Come ti chiami?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	"Don't worry," he says, "I will find you. You are our only visitor from the outside in many decades; when you land here, it quickly becomes known."|590|0
units.english: "Don't worry," he says, "I will find you. You are our only visitor from the outside in many decades; when you land here, it quickly becomes known."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice, "ti troverò io. Sei il nostro unico visitatore dall'esterno da molti decenni; quando atterri qui si viene a sapere in fretta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|	He says, "My name is..." and then performs an elaborate gesture with his hands. "Do not worry if you can not perform my name," he says, "I will seek you out when you land. You will not need to ask around for me."|594|0
units.english: He says, "My name is..." and then performs an elaborate gesture with his hands. "Do not worry if you can not perform my name," he says, "I will seek you out when you land. You will not need to ask around for me."
units.italian: Dice: "Mi chiamo..." e poi esegue un elaborato gesto con le mani. "Non preoccuparti se non riesci a pronunciare il mio nome," dice, "ti verrò a cercare io quando atterri. Non dovrai chiedere in giro di me."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|dialog|607|0
units.english: There are indeed some strange space-faring life forms in this system. You collect measurements with the special sensors, and then prepare to return to <planet>.
units.italian: In questo sistema ci sono davvero delle strane forme di vita che viaggiano nello spazio. Raccogli le misurazioni con i sensori speciali, poi ti prepari a tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 1|dialog|609|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you're missing something! Either you haven't visited <waypoints> to scan the void sprites, or your escort carrying the scanning equipment has not arrived in the system.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O non hai visitato <waypoints> per scansionare gli spettri del vuoto, o la tua scorta con l'apparecchiatura di scansione non è arrivata nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|name|615|0
units.english: Scan the void sprites
units.italian: Scansiona gli spettri del vuoto

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|description|616|0
units.english: Return to the <waypoints> system, and use an outfit scanner on one of each of the types of void sprites to see if you can tell how their propulsion works.
units.italian: Torna nel sistema <waypoints> e usa uno scanner per equipaggiamento su uno di ciascun tipo di spettro del vuoto, per vedere se riesci a capire come funziona la loro propulsione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|Sure enough, soon after you land, the Remnant researcher with the optical prosthesis arrives at your ship. When he looks at the data that you collected using his special scanners, he is disappointed. He chants, "I had hoped the scanners would show us how the creatures are able to generate enough force to fly out of the gravity wells of their planets, but this tells me nothing. Perhaps it would help if you scan them more closely. Could you equip your ship with one of the scanners that are used to inspect the outfits that ships are carrying, and see if that scanner yields additional information?"|623|0
units.english: Sure enough, soon after you land, the Remnant researcher with the optical prosthesis arrives at your ship. When he looks at the data that you collected using his special scanners, he is disappointed. He chants, "I had hoped the scanners would show us how the creatures are able to generate enough force to fly out of the gravity wells of their planets, but this tells me nothing. Perhaps it would help if you scan them more closely. Could you equip your ship with one of the scanners that are used to inspect the outfits that ships are carrying, and see if that scanner yields additional information?"
units.italian: Come previsto, poco dopo che atterri il ricercatore dei Remnant con la protesi ottica arriva alla tua nave. Quando guarda i dati che hai raccolto con i suoi scanner speciali, resta deluso. Intona: "Speravo che gli scanner ci mostrassero come le creature riescano a generare abbastanza spinta per uscire dai pozzi gravitazionali dei loro pianeti, ma questo non mi dice nulla. Forse aiuterebbe se le scansionassi più da vicino. Potresti equipaggiare la nave con uno degli scanner usati per ispezionare l'equipaggiamento che le navi trasportano, e vedere se quello scanner fornisce informazioni aggiuntive?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."|625|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."
units.italian: "Va bene, installerò uno scanner per equipaggiamento e vedrò cosa mi dice."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Are you sure they won't interpret the scanner beam as an attack?"|627|0
units.english: "Are you sure they won't interpret the scanner beam as an attack?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che non interpreteranno il raggio dello scanner come un attacco?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"I doubt it," he says. "It is a very low-power beam. And after all, you were not attacked just now when you scanned them with my equipment."|629|0
units.english: "I doubt it," he says. "It is a very low-power beam. And after all, you were not attacked just now when you scanned them with my equipment."
units.italian: "Ne dubito," dice. "È un raggio a potenza molto bassa. E dopotutto non sei stato attaccato poco fa, quando li hai scansionati con la mia apparecchiatura."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."|631|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."
units.italian: "Va bene, installerò uno scanner per equipaggiamento e vedrò cosa mi dice."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Wait, are you saying that you thought I might get attacked last time around, and you didn't tell me that?"|633|0
units.english: "Wait, are you saying that you thought I might get attacked last time around, and you didn't tell me that?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, stai dicendo che pensavi che l'altra volta potessi essere attaccato, e non me l'hai detto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	He says, "It was a small enough chance that I did not see a need to worry you."|635|0
units.english: He says, "It was a small enough chance that I did not see a need to worry you."
units.italian: Dice: "Era una possibilità abbastanza remota da non rendere necessario preoccuparti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Sorry, I don't want to help with this project anymore."|637|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to help with this project anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non voglio più aiutarti con questo progetto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|	"Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."|639|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll install an outfit scanner and see what it can tell me."
units.italian: "Va bene, installerò uno scanner per equipaggiamento e vedrò cosa mi dice."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 2|dialog|653|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you haven't scanned the void sprites in <waypoints>. Make sure you scan all the void sprites using an outfit scanner.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai scansionato gli spettri del vuoto su <waypoints>. Assicurati di scansionarli tutti con uno scanner per equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|name|661|0
units.english: Visit void sprite planets
units.italian: Visita i pianeti degli spettri

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|description|662|0
units.english: Use the Puffin to explore the two gas giants where the void sprites live. Then, return to <planet>.
units.italian: Usa il Puffin per esplorare i due giganti gassosi dove vivono gli spettri del vuoto. Poi torna su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|blocked|667|0
units.english: The Remnant researcher has another job for you, but you're going to have to free up some cargo space in order to take it on.
units.italian: Il ricercatore dei Remnant ha un altro lavoro per te, ma dovrai liberare un po' di spazio nel carico per accettarlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|The Remnant researcher seems disappointed that an outfit scan didn't reveal any information about the void sprites, but he is also excited about a new idea for studying them. "I found that we have several old mothballed ships suitable for exploring the upper atmosphere of a gas giant," he says. "Until I can publish my results I will not have the resources to compensate you, but I can provide you with one of our ships. Then you could land on the void sprite worlds and observe them in their natural habitat."|672|0
units.english: The Remnant researcher seems disappointed that an outfit scan didn't reveal any information about the void sprites, but he is also excited about a new idea for studying them. "I found that we have several old mothballed ships suitable for exploring the upper atmosphere of a gas giant," he says. "Until I can publish my results I will not have the resources to compensate you, but I can provide you with one of our ships. Then you could land on the void sprite worlds and observe them in their natural habitat."
units.italian: Il ricercatore dei Remnant sembra deluso che una scansione dell'equipaggiamento non abbia rivelato nulla sugli spettri del vuoto, ma è anche entusiasta di una nuova idea per studiarli. "Ho scoperto che abbiamo diverse vecchie navi in disarmo adatte a esplorare l'alta atmosfera di un gigante gassoso," dice. "Finché non potrò pubblicare i miei risultati non avrò le risorse per pagarti, ma posso fornirti una delle nostre navi. Così potresti atterrare sui mondi degli spettri del vuoto e osservarli nel loro habitat naturale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"How much will it cost to buy one?"|674|0
units.english: "How much will it cost to buy one?"
units.italian: "Quanto costerebbe comprarne una?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"You said before you cannot safely approach these organisms. How will I land on their planets in one of your ships?"|675|0
units.english: "You said before you cannot safely approach these organisms. How will I land on their planets in one of your ships?"
units.italian: "Hai detto che non potete avvicinarvi a questi organismi in sicurezza. Come farò ad atterrare sui loro pianeti con una delle vostre navi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Didn't you say before that anyone entering that system in a Remnant ship gets attacked?"|679|0
units.english: "Didn't you say before that anyone entering that system in a Remnant ship gets attacked?"
units.italian: "Non avevi detto che chiunque entri in quel sistema con una nave dei Remnant viene attaccato?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you anymore."|683|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in helping you anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa più aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Only a few million credits," he says. "Do not worry, I will provide you with one. Consider it an advance on the resources I owe you. And, just think of how much you will be doing to advance the cause of science."|686|0
units.english: "Only a few million credits," he says. "Do not worry, I will provide you with one. Consider it an advance on the resources I owe you. And, just think of how much you will be doing to advance the cause of science."
units.italian: "Solo qualche milione di crediti," dice. "Non preoccuparti, te ne fornirò una io. Considerala un anticipo sulle risorse che ti devo. E pensa a quanto farai per la causa della scienza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Do not worry about it," he says. "These exploration craft are exceptionally fast and maneuverable. Even if you do provoke a negative reaction, you should be able to dodge any direct confrontation."|690|0
units.english: "Do not worry about it," he says. "These exploration craft are exceptionally fast and maneuverable. Even if you do provoke a negative reaction, you should be able to dodge any direct confrontation."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice. "Queste navi da esplorazione sono eccezionalmente veloci e maneggevoli. Anche se provocassi una reazione negativa, dovresti riuscire a evitare qualsiasi scontro diretto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Okay, I'll do it."|694|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Sorry, that's more than I'm willing to commit to."|695|0
units.english: "Sorry, that's more than I'm willing to commit to."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, è più di quanto sia disposto a impegnarmi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Excellent," he says. "This ship is an antique, so be careful with the shields. They are projected around the ship and are unable to adapt to new obstacles. Hard-shell shields, I believe they were called at the time of the Exodus, as opposed to the skin shields of today that fit close to the hull." He pauses and looks thoughtful, then continues. "Just make sure nothing valuable is near the hull when the shields activate - it will either be sheared in two or break the shields. And it is important to know that the pressure suit included with the ship is able to remotely activate and deactivate the shields and other ship systems."|698|0
units.english: "Excellent," he says. "This ship is an antique, so be careful with the shields. They are projected around the ship and are unable to adapt to new obstacles. Hard-shell shields, I believe they were called at the time of the Exodus, as opposed to the skin shields of today that fit close to the hull." He pauses and looks thoughtful, then continues. "Just make sure nothing valuable is near the hull when the shields activate - it will either be sheared in two or break the shields. And it is important to know that the pressure suit included with the ship is able to remotely activate and deactivate the shields and other ship systems."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice. "Questa nave è un pezzo d'antiquariato, quindi sta' attento agli scudi. Sono proiettati intorno alla nave e non riescono ad adattarsi a nuovi ostacoli. Scudi a guscio duro, credo si chiamassero al tempo dell'Esodo, al contrario degli scudi a pelle di oggi che aderiscono allo scafo." Si ferma e resta pensieroso, poi continua. "Assicurati solo che non ci sia nulla di prezioso vicino allo scafo quando gli scudi si attivano: verrebbe tagliato in due o farebbe saltare gli scudi. Ed è importante sapere che la tuta pressurizzata inclusa con la nave può attivare e disattivare a distanza gli scudi e gli altri sistemi della nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	He moves to step away, then looks back at you. "My notes indicate that there is a superstition about how visiting Crataegusa in the Cardea system was considered to bring good fortune to explorers. There is no scientific reason that should be the case, but might be worth landing on it anyway."|699|0
units.english: He moves to step away, then looks back at you. "My notes indicate that there is a superstition about how visiting Crataegusa in the Cardea system was considered to bring good fortune to explorers. There is no scientific reason that should be the case, but might be worth landing on it anyway."
units.italian: Fa per allontanarsi, poi si volta verso di te. "Le mie note indicano che esiste una superstizione secondo cui visitare Crataegusa, nel sistema Cardea, porta buona fortuna agli esploratori. Non c'è nessuna ragione scientifica perché sia così, ma potrebbe valere la pena atterrarci comunque."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|You have dodged the Archon and landed on the second of the two gas giants where the void sprites live. The hull of your tiny ship creaks and groans under the high atmospheric pressure, but seems to be holding together. Its sensors pick up flocks of void sprites floating between the planet's cloud layers, presumably feeding on airborne creatures too small to detect from this range.|711|0
units.english: You have dodged the Archon and landed on the second of the two gas giants where the void sprites live. The hull of your tiny ship creaks and groans under the high atmospheric pressure, but seems to be holding together. Its sensors pick up flocks of void sprites floating between the planet's cloud layers, presumably feeding on airborne creatures too small to detect from this range.
units.italian: Hai evitato l'Archon e sei atterrato sul secondo dei due giganti gassosi dove vivono gli spettri del vuoto. Lo scafo della tua piccola nave scricchiola e geme sotto l'alta pressione atmosferica, ma sembra reggere. I sensori captano stormi di spettri del vuoto che fluttuano tra gli strati di nuvole del pianeta, presumibilmente nutrendosi di creature aeree troppo piccole per essere rilevate a questa distanza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	You also observe some void sprites leaving the planet, soaring upward on thermal updrafts. As they rise, their bodies swell to several times their original size, like an aerostat balloon gaining altitude. But clearly they have another form of propulsion as well, something akin to the antigravity repulsors that human ships use to travel from a planet's surface into orbit.|712|0
units.english: You also observe some void sprites leaving the planet, soaring upward on thermal updrafts. As they rise, their bodies swell to several times their original size, like an aerostat balloon gaining altitude. But clearly they have another form of propulsion as well, something akin to the antigravity repulsors that human ships use to travel from a planet's surface into orbit.
units.italian: Osservi anche alcuni spettri del vuoto lasciare il pianeta, librandosi verso l'alto sulle correnti termiche. Mentre salgono, i loro corpi si gonfiano fino a diverse volte la dimensione originale, come un pallone aerostatico che prende quota. Ma evidentemente hanno anche un altro tipo di propulsione, qualcosa di simile ai repulsori antigravitazionali che le navi umane usano per passare dalla superficie di un pianeta all'orbita.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	After collecting some atmospheric samples for good measure, you prepare to return to <planet>. Hopefully the Archon will calm down once it sees that you have not attacked or disturbed the Sprites on either of these planets.|713|0
units.english: After collecting some atmospheric samples for good measure, you prepare to return to <planet>. Hopefully the Archon will calm down once it sees that you have not attacked or disturbed the Sprites on either of these planets.
units.italian: Dopo aver raccolto qualche campione atmosferico per buona misura, ti prepari a tornare su <planet>. Speri che l'Archon si calmi quando vedrà che non hai attaccato né disturbato gli spettri su nessuno dei due pianeti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|log|718|0
units.english: The "void sprites" are space-dwelling lifeforms. They are apparently not sentient. They evolved in the atmosphere of a gas giant, but have some biological mechanism for altering or reflecting gravity that allows them to fly into outer space, in the same way that human ships use antigravity to escape a planet's gravity well. The void sprites are not particularly powerful or dangerous creatures, but they are guarded by a Drak Archon.
units.italian: Gli "spettri del vuoto" sono forme di vita che abitano lo spazio. A quanto pare non sono senzienti. Si sono evoluti nell'atmosfera di un gigante gassoso, ma possiedono un qualche meccanismo biologico per alterare o riflettere la gravità che permette loro di volare nello spazio profondo, come le navi umane usano l'antigravità per sfuggire al pozzo gravitazionale di un pianeta. Gli spettri del vuoto non sono creature particolarmente potenti o pericolose, ma sono custoditi da un Archon Drak.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|log|719|0
units.english: Archons are partly biological, but do not seem to be naturally evolved creatures. Some of their biological characteristics may have been based on the "void sprites" that inhabit the Ember Waste.
units.italian: Gli Archon sono in parte biologici, ma non sembrano creature evolute naturalmente. Alcune delle loro caratteristiche biologiche potrebbero essere basate sugli "spettri del vuoto" che abitano la Distesa di Braci.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|The Remnant researcher is ecstatic when he sees all the data you collected. "I will begin assembling this into a research paper immediately!" he sings. "It may be months before it is published, but when it is you will be named as a co-author, and I will share the credit with you."|721|0
units.english: The Remnant researcher is ecstatic when he sees all the data you collected. "I will begin assembling this into a research paper immediately!" he sings. "It may be months before it is published, but when it is you will be named as a co-author, and I will share the credit with you."
units.italian: Il ricercatore dei Remnant è al settimo cielo quando vede tutti i dati che hai raccolto. "Comincerò subito a trasformarli in un articolo di ricerca!" intona. "Potrebbero volerci mesi prima che venga pubblicato, ma quando lo sarà sarai indicato come coautore, e dividerò il merito con te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"What do you know about the Archon that attacked me?"|723|0
units.english: "What do you know about the Archon that attacked me?"
units.italian: "Cosa sai dell'Archon che mi ha attaccato?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"I'm glad I could help you out. I'll look forward to hearing from you."|724|0
units.english: "I'm glad I could help you out. I'll look forward to hearing from you."
units.italian: "Sono contento di esserti stato utile. Aspetterò tue notizie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	He begins singing you a song about the Archons. The song says that the Archons are servants of the mysterious Drak, whom no one has seen but whom the Quarg claim to speak to and take orders from. "That's all our histories say," he sings, "but what interests me is the biological similarities between the Archons and the void sprites. We do not think the Archons are naturally evolved creatures. Perhaps their creators incorporated elements of void sprite biology into them when they were made. Or perhaps the Archons just feel an affinity with them because they are both space-faring organisms."|727|0
units.english: He begins singing you a song about the Archons. The song says that the Archons are servants of the mysterious Drak, whom no one has seen but whom the Quarg claim to speak to and take orders from. "That's all our histories say," he sings, "but what interests me is the biological similarities between the Archons and the void sprites. We do not think the Archons are naturally evolved creatures. Perhaps their creators incorporated elements of void sprite biology into them when they were made. Or perhaps the Archons just feel an affinity with them because they are both space-faring organisms."
units.italian: Comincia a cantarti una canzone sugli Archon. La canzone dice che gli Archon sono servitori dei misteriosi Drak, che nessuno ha mai visto ma a cui i Quarg dicono di parlare e da cui dicono di ricevere ordini. "Questo è tutto quello che dicono le nostre cronache," intona, "ma quello che mi interessa sono le somiglianze biologiche tra gli Archon e gli spettri del vuoto. Non crediamo che gli Archon siano creature evolute naturalmente. Forse i loro creatori vi hanno incorporato elementi della biologia degli spettri del vuoto quando li hanno fatti. O forse gli Archon provano semplicemente affinità per loro, perché entrambi sono organismi che viaggiano nello spazio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Well, I'll look forward to hearing the results of your research when it is done."|729|0
units.english: "Well, I'll look forward to hearing the results of your research when it is done."
units.italian: "Beh, aspetterò con interesse i risultati della tua ricerca quando sarà conclusa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	"Do you think the Archons will continue to be angry at me?"|731|0
units.english: "Do you think the Archons will continue to be angry at me?"
units.italian: "Pensi che gli Archon continueranno a essere arrabbiati con me?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	He says, "As long as you did not harm any of the void sprites, I doubt they will bear you a permanent grudge. The Archons are thinking creatures, after all; they cannot blame you for your curiosity."|733|0
units.english: He says, "As long as you did not harm any of the void sprites, I doubt they will bear you a permanent grudge. The Archons are thinking creatures, after all; they cannot blame you for your curiosity."
units.italian: Dice: "Finché non hai fatto male a nessuno degli spettri del vuoto, dubito che ti porteranno un rancore permanente. Gli Archon sono creature pensanti, dopotutto; non possono biasimarti per la tua curiosità."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Void Sprites 3|	You thank him for the information and tell him that you will look forward to reading the results of his study (and, getting paid for your help) once it is complete.|734|0
units.english: You thank him for the information and tell him that you will look forward to reading the results of his study (and, getting paid for your help) once it is complete.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per le informazioni e gli dici che aspetterai con interesse di leggere i risultati del suo studio (e di essere pagato per il tuo aiuto) quando sarà completo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|name|753|0
units.english: License Training
units.italian: Licenza: addestramento

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|description|754|0
units.english: Transport a prefect to <destination> so he can tell you more about the Remnant license.
units.italian: Trasporta un prefetto su <destination> perché ti spieghi di più sulla licenza dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|log|771|0
units.english: The prefects have reached a consensus: now considered a valuable friend of the Remnant, and given permission to purchase their ships and technology.
units.italian: I prefetti hanno raggiunto un consenso: ora sono considerato un prezioso amico dei Remnant e ho il permesso di acquistare le loro navi e la loro tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|An elderly man approaches your ship and introduces himself as a local "prefect," presumably some sort of government position. In a song so elaborate that he must have composed and practiced it ahead of time, he informs you that a scientific study on the void sprites has just been published, and as the co-author you are entitled to a payment of two million credits, which he presents to you.|773|0
units.english: An elderly man approaches your ship and introduces himself as a local "prefect," presumably some sort of government position. In a song so elaborate that he must have composed and practiced it ahead of time, he informs you that a scientific study on the void sprites has just been published, and as the co-author you are entitled to a payment of two million credits, which he presents to you.
units.italian: Un uomo anziano si avvicina alla tua nave e si presenta come un "prefetto" locale, presumibilmente una qualche carica di governo. In una canzone così elaborata che deve averla composta e provata in anticipo, ti informa che è appena stato pubblicato uno studio scientifico sugli spettri del vuoto, e che come coautore hai diritto a un pagamento di due milioni di crediti, che ti porge.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"When your name came up in the study," he says, "I asked around and discovered that you have helped us in other ways as well. The other prefects have reached a consensus that you should be considered a valuable friend of the Remnant, and shall henceforth be given permission to purchase our ships and technology." He hands you a small cube that looks like it is made of interlocking blocks of material similar to their ships.|774|0
units.english: "When your name came up in the study," he says, "I asked around and discovered that you have helped us in other ways as well. The other prefects have reached a consensus that you should be considered a valuable friend of the Remnant, and shall henceforth be given permission to purchase our ships and technology." He hands you a small cube that looks like it is made of interlocking blocks of material similar to their ships.
units.italian: "Quando è uscito il tuo nome nello studio," dice, "ho chiesto in giro e ho scoperto che ci hai aiutato anche in altri modi. Gli altri prefetti hanno raggiunto un consenso: devi essere considerato un prezioso amico dei Remnant, e da ora in poi avrai il permesso di acquistare le nostre navi e la nostra tecnologia." Ti porge un piccolo cubo che sembra fatto di blocchi di materiale incastrati tra loro, simile a quello delle loro navi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"I'm honored. Thank you."|777|0
units.english: "I'm honored. Thank you."
units.italian: "È un onore. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Is there anything else I can do to assist your people?"|779|0
units.english: "Is there anything else I can do to assist your people?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcos'altro che posso fare per aiutare la tua gente?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"I do not have anything at the moment," he says, "but I am sure other Remnant will have tasks you can help with, now that you have demonstrated your trustworthiness. We have been keeping track of you, and we are impressed with your curiosity, perseverance, and ability to survive where most would be destroyed. All three are valued characteristics among the Remnant, and thus many will welcome your assistance on their projects."|780|0
units.english: "I do not have anything at the moment," he says, "but I am sure other Remnant will have tasks you can help with, now that you have demonstrated your trustworthiness. We have been keeping track of you, and we are impressed with your curiosity, perseverance, and ability to survive where most would be destroyed. All three are valued characteristics among the Remnant, and thus many will welcome your assistance on their projects."
units.italian: "Al momento non ho nulla," dice, "ma sono certo che altri Remnant avranno compiti in cui potrai aiutarli, ora che hai dimostrato di essere affidabile. Ti abbiamo tenuto d'occhio, e siamo rimasti colpiti dalla tua curiosità, dalla tua perseveranza e dalla tua capacità di sopravvivere dove la maggior parte verrebbe distrutta. Sono tutte e tre caratteristiche apprezzate tra i Remnant, e quindi molti accoglieranno con favore il tuo aiuto nei loro progetti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	As he talks, he gestures for you to walk with him towards a nearby hall. Inside, you discover that it is one of the many cafeterias that seem to be common in Remnant starports. He picks up two trays from the window and leads you to an empty table. "While you are welcome to become one of us, we suspect that you are a citizen of the galaxy - wandering hither and yon building coalitions and enmities with species and groups across the breadth of accessible space, unfettered by conventional allegiances. As such, we hope that you will continue to explore and stop by to let us know what you have found. We ask only that you keep the secret with which you are trusted and bring us word of anything that might influence humanity's long-term survival."|782|0
units.english: As he talks, he gestures for you to walk with him towards a nearby hall. Inside, you discover that it is one of the many cafeterias that seem to be common in Remnant starports. He picks up two trays from the window and leads you to an empty table. "While you are welcome to become one of us, we suspect that you are a citizen of the galaxy - wandering hither and yon building coalitions and enmities with species and groups across the breadth of accessible space, unfettered by conventional allegiances. As such, we hope that you will continue to explore and stop by to let us know what you have found. We ask only that you keep the secret with which you are trusted and bring us word of anything that might influence humanity's long-term survival."
units.italian: Mentre parla, ti fa cenno di camminare con lui verso una sala vicina. Dentro scopri che è una delle tante mense che sembrano comuni negli spazioporti dei Remnant. Prende due vassoi dalla finestrella e ti guida a un tavolo vuoto. "Sei il benvenuto a diventare uno di noi, ma sospettiamo che tu sia un cittadino della galassia: vaghi qua e là costruendo coalizioni e inimicizie con specie e gruppi in tutta l'estensione dello spazio accessibile, senza vincoli di fedeltà convenzionali. Per questo speriamo che continuerai a esplorare e a passare da noi per dirci cosa hai trovato. Ti chiediamo solo di custodire il segreto in cui sei stato messo a parte e di portarci notizia di qualunque cosa possa influenzare la sopravvivenza dell'umanità nel lungo periodo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What secret do you want me to keep?"|784|0
units.english: "What secret do you want me to keep?"
units.italian: "Quale segreto volete che custodisca?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"I would be honored to be one of the Remnant."|786|0
units.english: "I would be honored to be one of the Remnant."
units.italian: "Sarei onorato di essere uno dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"While I have enjoyed my time among you, I can never stay in one place."|788|0
units.english: "While I have enjoyed my time among you, I can never stay in one place."
units.italian: "Per quanto abbia apprezzato il tempo passato tra voi, non potrò mai restare in un solo posto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"|790|0
units.english: "What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa costituisce 'cose che influenzano la sopravvivenza dell'umanità'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	He takes a bite before responding. "Basically, anything that might either pose an existential threat to humanity, or anything that we might learn from and put to use to ensure humanity's survival. It might be an invading fleet of automated machines or a spaceborn plague. But it is just as possible you might find beings that we can work alongside to form strong partnerships or ancient ruins with old technology that points us towards new discoveries. The possibilities are indeed infinite."|792|0
units.english: He takes a bite before responding. "Basically, anything that might either pose an existential threat to humanity, or anything that we might learn from and put to use to ensure humanity's survival. It might be an invading fleet of automated machines or a spaceborn plague. But it is just as possible you might find beings that we can work alongside to form strong partnerships or ancient ruins with old technology that points us towards new discoveries. The possibilities are indeed infinite."
units.italian: Prende un boccone prima di rispondere. "In pratica, qualunque cosa che possa rappresentare una minaccia esistenziale per l'umanità, o qualunque cosa da cui potremmo imparare e che potremmo mettere a frutto per garantire la sopravvivenza umana. Potrebbe essere una flotta invasora di macchine automatiche o una pestilenza nata nello spazio. Ma è altrettanto possibile che tu trovi esseri con cui possiamo collaborare per stringere solidi rapporti, o antiche rovine con tecnologia che ci indichi nuove scoperte. Le possibilità sono davvero infinite."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	He nods, smiling. "You are not there yet, but I think you might well become one of us before too long." He takes a bite from his plate, then continues. "Keep learning, and you may well earn yourself a place among us."|797|0
units.english: He nods, smiling. "You are not there yet, but I think you might well become one of us before too long." He takes a bite from his plate, then continues. "Keep learning, and you may well earn yourself a place among us."
units.italian: Annuisce, sorridendo. "Non ci sei ancora, ma credo che potresti diventare uno di noi prima di quanto pensi." Prende un boccone dal piatto, poi continua. "Continua a imparare, e potresti guadagnarti un posto tra noi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What secret do you want me to keep?"|799|0
units.english: "What secret do you want me to keep?"
units.italian: "Quale segreto volete che custodisca?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"|801|0
units.english: "What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa costituisce 'cose che influenzano la sopravvivenza dell'umanità'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	He nods. "Thank you for confirming our impression. We are grateful to have you with us, and look forward to hearing about your travels."|804|0
units.english: He nods. "Thank you for confirming our impression. We are grateful to have you with us, and look forward to hearing about your travels."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Grazie per aver confermato la nostra impressione. Ti siamo grati di essere con noi, e aspettiamo di sentire dei tuoi viaggi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What secret do you want me to keep?"|806|0
units.english: "What secret do you want me to keep?"
units.italian: "Quale segreto volete che custodisca?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"|808|0
units.english: "What constitutes 'things that influence humanity's survival'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa costituisce 'cose che influenzano la sopravvivenza dell'umanità'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	He sips on a thick drink before responding. "Quite simply, the fact that we are here. To the best of our knowledge, only the Drak and the Korath know that we exist, and of those only the Korath have raided our worlds. Our intention is to be the last bastion of humanity, and we rely on secrecy to achieve that goal." He pauses for a moment to eat, then he continues. "The Alphas are a fearsome threat, but they may be the least of humanity's worries in the grand scheme of things. We strive to maintain whatever advantages we can in case any of those threats proves itself such, and one of our best tools is surprise. If no one knows we are here, we have the advantage over any that might seek to conquer or destroy us.|811|0
units.english: He sips on a thick drink before responding. "Quite simply, the fact that we are here. To the best of our knowledge, only the Drak and the Korath know that we exist, and of those only the Korath have raided our worlds. Our intention is to be the last bastion of humanity, and we rely on secrecy to achieve that goal." He pauses for a moment to eat, then he continues. "The Alphas are a fearsome threat, but they may be the least of humanity's worries in the grand scheme of things. We strive to maintain whatever advantages we can in case any of those threats proves itself such, and one of our best tools is surprise. If no one knows we are here, we have the advantage over any that might seek to conquer or destroy us.
units.italian: Prende un sorso di una bevanda densa prima di rispondere. "Semplicemente, il fatto che siamo qui. Per quanto ne sappiamo, solo i Drak e i Korath sanno che esistiamo, e tra loro solo i Korath hanno fatto incursioni sui nostri mondi. La nostra intenzione è essere l'ultimo baluardo dell'umanità, e per raggiungere questo scopo ci affidiamo alla segretezza." Si ferma un momento per mangiare, poi continua. "Gli Alpha sono una minaccia spaventosa, ma potrebbero essere la minore delle preoccupazioni dell'umanità nel quadro generale. Ci sforziamo di mantenere tutti i vantaggi che possiamo, nel caso una di quelle minacce si riveli tale, e uno dei nostri strumenti migliori è la sorpresa. Se nessuno sa che siamo qui, abbiamo il vantaggio su chiunque voglia conquistarci o distruggerci.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Of course, maintaining the secrecy of our capabilities is also very important - and the reason why you had to prove yourself before we let you purchase our ships and outfits - but it is secondary to the fundamental secrecy of our existence. Ideally, no one should know we exist. Those who do know should think of us as little more than refugees struggling to survive in a hostile environment."|812|0
units.english: "Of course, maintaining the secrecy of our capabilities is also very important - and the reason why you had to prove yourself before we let you purchase our ships and outfits - but it is secondary to the fundamental secrecy of our existence. Ideally, no one should know we exist. Those who do know should think of us as little more than refugees struggling to survive in a hostile environment."
units.italian: "Naturalmente, mantenere segrete le nostre capacità è anch'esso molto importante, ed è il motivo per cui hai dovuto dimostrare il tuo valore prima di lasciarti acquistare le nostre navi e il nostro equipaggiamento, ma è secondario rispetto alla segretezza fondamentale della nostra esistenza. Idealmente nessuno dovrebbe sapere che esistiamo. Chi lo sa dovrebbe considerarci poco più che profughi che lottano per sopravvivere in un ambiente ostile."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	He waves dismissively. "I am sure you have more questions, but let us leave it there for now. Our meals await, and, well, I need to show you some things in regards to our security procedures. So finish your meal, and let's head over to <destination>."|814|0
units.english: He waves dismissively. "I am sure you have more questions, but let us leave it there for now. Our meals await, and, well, I need to show you some things in regards to our security procedures. So finish your meal, and let's head over to <destination>."
units.italian: Fa un gesto come per dire che non importa. "Sono certo che hai altre domande, ma per ora fermiamoci qui. I nostri pasti ci aspettano e, beh, devo mostrarti alcune cose riguardo alle nostre procedure di sicurezza. Quindi finisci di mangiare, e andiamo su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|Once you reach space, the prefect interrupts your normal routine. "I'm sure you've noticed that your 'license' isn't exactly a normal ID card. There's a reason for that, namely that it has extra circuitry in it and includes a couple sensors on the surface. I don't understand everything in it, but the security specialists assure me that it is incredibly resistant to being hacked or compromised."|818|0
units.english: Once you reach space, the prefect interrupts your normal routine. "I'm sure you've noticed that your 'license' isn't exactly a normal ID card. There's a reason for that, namely that it has extra circuitry in it and includes a couple sensors on the surface. I don't understand everything in it, but the security specialists assure me that it is incredibly resistant to being hacked or compromised."
units.italian: Una volta nello spazio, il prefetto interrompe la tua routine normale. "Sono certo che avrai notato che la tua 'licenza' non è esattamente una normale carta d'identità. C'è un motivo: contiene circuiti aggiuntivi e un paio di sensori in superficie. Non capisco tutto quello che c'è dentro, ma gli specialisti della sicurezza mi assicurano che è incredibilmente resistente agli attacchi informatici e alla manomissione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Okay, sounds good."|820|0
units.english: "Okay, sounds good."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi sembra giusto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"How do you know what regular licenses look like?"|822|0
units.english: "How do you know what regular licenses look like?"
units.italian: "Come fate a sapere che aspetto hanno le licenze normali?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	The old man smiles. "While we might not have access to modern licenses, we do have all our old entertainment programs from before the Exodus. Some of them included details such as what licenses looked like. While things might have changed in the intervening years, licenses were historically governed by petty bureaucracy, and those are very resistant to change. So it seemed very likely that things have not changed much. And definitely not so much as to resemble ours." He seems amused, but then his smile fades.|823|0
units.english: The old man smiles. "While we might not have access to modern licenses, we do have all our old entertainment programs from before the Exodus. Some of them included details such as what licenses looked like. While things might have changed in the intervening years, licenses were historically governed by petty bureaucracy, and those are very resistant to change. So it seemed very likely that things have not changed much. And definitely not so much as to resemble ours." He seems amused, but then his smile fades.
units.italian: Il vecchio sorride. "Anche se non abbiamo accesso alle licenze moderne, abbiamo tutti i nostri vecchi programmi di intrattenimento di prima dell'Esodo. Alcuni contenevano dettagli come l'aspetto delle licenze. Le cose potranno anche essere cambiate negli anni, ma storicamente le licenze erano governate da una burocrazia meschina, e quella è molto restia ai cambiamenti. Quindi sembrava molto probabile che le cose non fossero cambiate granché. E di sicuro non al punto da somigliare alle nostre." Sembra divertito, poi il sorriso svanisce.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Then again, ancestral space never designed their licenses to withstand much. They are incentivized to be not so secure, are they not? Enough money and the right connections, and licenses for anything can be acquired. These?" He holds up a Remnant license. "Not so much." He shakes his head and becomes serious. "Now, your license has a handful of connection pads on the bottom which can be connected to your ship's IFF. When you are inbound for landing, simply tap this code on the license, and the cube will verify the pattern as well as your fingerprints and a few other biometrics to ensure you are indeed living and conscious, and then transmit an encrypted code. Our IFF systems will verify the transmitted signal and respond accordingly."|824|0
units.english: "Then again, ancestral space never designed their licenses to withstand much. They are incentivized to be not so secure, are they not? Enough money and the right connections, and licenses for anything can be acquired. These?" He holds up a Remnant license. "Not so much." He shakes his head and becomes serious. "Now, your license has a handful of connection pads on the bottom which can be connected to your ship's IFF. When you are inbound for landing, simply tap this code on the license, and the cube will verify the pattern as well as your fingerprints and a few other biometrics to ensure you are indeed living and conscious, and then transmit an encrypted code. Our IFF systems will verify the transmitted signal and respond accordingly."
units.italian: "D'altra parte, lo spazio ancestrale non ha mai progettato le proprie licenze per resistere a molto. Hanno interesse a che non siano troppo sicure, no? Basta denaro e le conoscenze giuste, e si possono ottenere licenze per qualsiasi cosa. Queste?" Solleva una licenza dei Remnant. "Non proprio." Scuote la testa e diventa serio. "Ora, la tua licenza ha una serie di contatti sul fondo che si collegano all'IFF della tua nave. Quando sei in avvicinamento per atterrare, basta digitare questo codice sulla licenza, e il cubo verificherà lo schema, le tue impronte e altri dati biometrici per accertarsi che tu sia davvero vivo e cosciente, poi trasmetterà un codice cifrato. I nostri sistemi IFF verificheranno il segnale trasmesso e risponderanno di conseguenza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"That sounds thorough."|826|0
units.english: "That sounds thorough."
units.italian: "Sembra accurato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"So why have I not been shot down yet?"|828|0
units.english: "So why have I not been shot down yet?"
units.italian: "Allora perché non mi avete ancora abbattuto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"What is an 'IFF' system?"|830|0
units.english: "What is an 'IFF' system?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è un sistema 'IFF'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"You aren't familiar with IFF?" he asks, looking slightly incredulous. "IFF stands for 'Identify Friend or Foe,' and is the general name for the system that identifies your ship to those around it. It is what determines which ships should be highlighted red or orange on your system map, and provides limited movement detail to allied ships so that targeting systems can fire past you. I do not know about their current practices, but historically the Navy and most other organizations had complex methods of verifying the identify of other ships, so it is not simply a case of having your IFF state that you are a friendly."|831|0
units.english: "You aren't familiar with IFF?" he asks, looking slightly incredulous. "IFF stands for 'Identify Friend or Foe,' and is the general name for the system that identifies your ship to those around it. It is what determines which ships should be highlighted red or orange on your system map, and provides limited movement detail to allied ships so that targeting systems can fire past you. I do not know about their current practices, but historically the Navy and most other organizations had complex methods of verifying the identify of other ships, so it is not simply a case of having your IFF state that you are a friendly."
units.italian: "Non conosci l'IFF?" chiede, con aria un po' incredula. "IFF sta per 'Identify Friend or Foe', identificazione amico o nemico, ed è il nome generale del sistema che identifica la tua nave per chi ti sta intorno. È ciò che determina quali navi devono essere evidenziate in rosso o arancione sulla mappa del sistema, e fornisce agli alleati dettagli limitati sui movimenti così che i sistemi di puntamento possano sparare oltre la tua posizione. Non so quali siano le pratiche attuali, ma storicamente la Marina e la maggior parte delle altre organizzazioni avevano metodi complessi per verificare l'identità delle altre navi, quindi non basta che il tuo IFF dichiari che sei amichevole."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Thanks for the explanation."|833|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie per la spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"That sounds thorough."|835|0
units.english: "That sounds thorough."
units.italian: "Sembra accurato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"So why have I not been shot down yet?"|837|0
units.english: "So why have I not been shot down yet?"
units.italian: "Allora perché non mi avete ancora abbattuto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|label|838|0
units.english: shot down
units.italian: shot down

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Because every system has potential failures and vulnerabilities, we ensure that people are always involved in the decision making process. Our initial scans showed that you were not likely an Alpha, and we were curious as to who you were and what opportunities might come of it. Since then the various monitors of the system have had to manually designate you as 'friendly' every time you made an approach. It worked, for a time. But now it is time to make your acceptance official. While our monitors are effective, it still wastes time to force them to track you and cancel the alerts every time you approach. Since you are trustworthy, better to give you the means to identify yourself so our defenses can focus on real threats.|839|0
units.english: "Because every system has potential failures and vulnerabilities, we ensure that people are always involved in the decision making process. Our initial scans showed that you were not likely an Alpha, and we were curious as to who you were and what opportunities might come of it. Since then the various monitors of the system have had to manually designate you as 'friendly' every time you made an approach. It worked, for a time. But now it is time to make your acceptance official. While our monitors are effective, it still wastes time to force them to track you and cancel the alerts every time you approach. Since you are trustworthy, better to give you the means to identify yourself so our defenses can focus on real threats.
units.italian: "Perché ogni sistema ha possibili guasti e vulnerabilità, e ci assicuriamo che le persone siano sempre coinvolte nel processo decisionale. Le nostre prime scansioni hanno mostrato che non eri probabilmente un Alpha, ed eravamo curiosi di sapere chi fossi e quali opportunità ne sarebbero potute nascere. Da allora i vari monitor del sistema hanno dovuto designarti manualmente come 'amichevole' ogni volta che ti avvicinavi. Ha funzionato, per un po'. Ma ora è il momento di rendere ufficiale la tua accettazione. Anche se i nostri monitor sono efficaci, costringerli a seguirti e annullare gli allarmi a ogni avvicinamento fa perdere tempo. Dato che sei affidabile, è meglio darti i mezzi per identificarti, così le nostre difese possono concentrarsi sulle minacce reali.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	The prefect nods in agreement. "We take our security very seriously.|842|0
units.english: The prefect nods in agreement. "We take our security very seriously.
units.italian: Il prefetto annuisce. "Prendiamo la sicurezza molto seriamente.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Now, before we arrive at <planet>, pick a pattern for yourself. Something short - a second or two at most, and something memorable to you." The prefect turns away from you to install a small device on the side of one of your bridge consoles, and connects a few wires into the panel. "Now, insert your license here, and tap your pattern on the license." He looks away as you follow his directions.|844|0
units.english: "Now, before we arrive at <planet>, pick a pattern for yourself. Something short - a second or two at most, and something memorable to you." The prefect turns away from you to install a small device on the side of one of your bridge consoles, and connects a few wires into the panel. "Now, insert your license here, and tap your pattern on the license." He looks away as you follow his directions.
units.italian: "Ora, prima di arrivare su <planet>, scegli uno schema tutto tuo. Qualcosa di breve, un secondo o due al massimo, e qualcosa che ricordi facilmente." Il prefetto si volta dall'altra parte per installare un piccolo dispositivo sul lato di una delle console del ponte, e collega qualche filo al pannello. "Ora inserisci la licenza qui, e digita il tuo schema sulla licenza." Guarda altrove mentre segui le sue istruzioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Done? Good. When we approach <planet>, you will have a few options: for a normal approach when everything is nominal, tap your pattern on the license. If there is a threat following you in - an enemy ship or some other kind of danger you want the monitors to watch for, pinch or squeeze the license instead. And if you have a problem onboard, such as having been captured and forced to fly the ship in, tap the license in a random pattern. Lastly, if you are having trouble landing due to injury or damage to the ship, just press briefly on the license. If you don't touch the license at all, the monitors will assume that you are either incapacitated or otherwise not in command of your ship. We will still attempt to let you land safely and provide assistance, but will also be standing ready to destroy you and block your approach if we think you are becoming a threat."|845|0
units.english: "Done? Good. When we approach <planet>, you will have a few options: for a normal approach when everything is nominal, tap your pattern on the license. If there is a threat following you in - an enemy ship or some other kind of danger you want the monitors to watch for, pinch or squeeze the license instead. And if you have a problem onboard, such as having been captured and forced to fly the ship in, tap the license in a random pattern. Lastly, if you are having trouble landing due to injury or damage to the ship, just press briefly on the license. If you don't touch the license at all, the monitors will assume that you are either incapacitated or otherwise not in command of your ship. We will still attempt to let you land safely and provide assistance, but will also be standing ready to destroy you and block your approach if we think you are becoming a threat."
units.italian: "Fatto? Bene. Quando ci avviciniamo a <planet>, avrai alcune opzioni: per un avvicinamento normale, quando tutto è nella norma, digita il tuo schema sulla licenza. Se ti segue qualcuno, una nave nemica o un altro tipo di pericolo che vuoi far controllare ai monitor, pizzica o stringi la licenza. E se hai un problema a bordo, per esempio se sei stato catturato e costretto a pilotare la nave, digita sulla licenza uno schema casuale. Infine, se hai difficoltà ad atterrare per una ferita o per danni alla nave, premi brevemente la licenza. Se non tocchi affatto la licenza, i monitor supporranno che tu sia inabile o comunque non al comando della nave. Cercheremo comunque di farti atterrare in sicurezza e di darti assistenza, ma saremo anche pronti a distruggerti e a bloccare il tuo avvicinamento se pensiamo che stia diventando una minaccia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|As you enter the upper atmosphere of <planet>, the prefect gestures toward the small bracket he installed on your console. You insert your license and tap the pattern you created. He checks his commlink and then nods. "Your license and clearance have been accepted, Captain <first>. Carry on with landing as normal."|848|0
units.english: As you enter the upper atmosphere of <planet>, the prefect gestures toward the small bracket he installed on your console. You insert your license and tap the pattern you created. He checks his commlink and then nods. "Your license and clearance have been accepted, Captain <first>. Carry on with landing as normal."
units.italian: Mentre entri nell'alta atmosfera di <planet>, il prefetto indica la staffa che ha installato sulla tua console. Inserisci la licenza e digiti lo schema che hai creato. Lui controlla il commlink e annuisce. "La tua licenza e la tua autorizzazione sono state accettate, capitano <first>. Procedi con l'atterraggio come al solito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	You proceed with the approach and landing, with the prefect pointing out noteworthy features along the way. He also points out various approach paths, including preferred routes to take if you are being chased. "If you have a hostile threat on your tail, take this landing corridor, which will expose trailing ships to fire from these points. And if you have something sticking tight in your shadow, do a roll at this point or that point. That will expose them to our high-precision batteries."|849|0
units.english: You proceed with the approach and landing, with the prefect pointing out noteworthy features along the way. He also points out various approach paths, including preferred routes to take if you are being chased. "If you have a hostile threat on your tail, take this landing corridor, which will expose trailing ships to fire from these points. And if you have something sticking tight in your shadow, do a roll at this point or that point. That will expose them to our high-precision batteries."
units.italian: Prosegui con avvicinamento e atterraggio, mentre il prefetto ti indica gli elementi degni di nota lungo il percorso. Ti indica anche vari corridoi di avvicinamento, comprese le rotte preferibili se sei inseguito. "Se hai una minaccia ostile alle calcagna, prendi questo corridoio di atterraggio, che esporrà le navi che ti seguono al fuoco da questi punti. E se hai qualcosa incollato nella tua scia, fai un rollio a questo punto o a quello. Le esporrà alle nostre batterie di alta precisione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Thank you for the advice."|851|0
units.english: "Thank you for the advice."
units.italian: "Grazie dei consigli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"I'm surprised you are telling me all this."|853|0
units.english: "I'm surprised you are telling me all this."
units.italian: "Sono sorpreso che tu mi dica tutto questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	"Oh, do not worry that you know too much. There are far more defenses that I have not mentioned, and we are always improving them. Generally, our defenses should be invisible to you - as in, they stay out of your way."|854|0
units.english: "Oh, do not worry that you know too much. There are far more defenses that I have not mentioned, and we are always improving them. Generally, our defenses should be invisible to you - as in, they stay out of your way."
units.italian: "Oh, non preoccuparti di sapere troppo. Ci sono molte più difese di quelle che ho menzionato, e le miglioriamo continuamente. In genere le nostre difese dovrebbero essere invisibili per te, nel senso che restano fuori dalla tua strada."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Technology Available|	Your approach goes smoothly, and you glide past a number of anti-air batteries that are methodically covering the sky around you. Once the <ship> has settled safely to the ground, the prefect pulls the license from the socket and hands it back to you. "At the risk of sounding like a parody: keep it secret, keep it safe. May the Embers burn bright for you." And with that, the old prefect walks off your ship.|856|0
units.english: Your approach goes smoothly, and you glide past a number of anti-air batteries that are methodically covering the sky around you. Once the <ship> has settled safely to the ground, the prefect pulls the license from the socket and hands it back to you. "At the risk of sounding like a parody: keep it secret, keep it safe. May the Embers burn bright for you." And with that, the old prefect walks off your ship.
units.italian: L'avvicinamento fila liscio, e scivoli oltre diverse batterie antiaeree che coprono metodicamente il cielo intorno a te. Una volta che la <ship> si è posata al sicuro a terra, il prefetto estrae la licenza dalla presa e te la restituisce. "A rischio di sembrare una parodia: tienila segreta, tienila al sicuro. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te." E detto questo, il vecchio prefetto scende dalla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|name|861|0
units.english: Learn Remnant Sign
units.italian: Impara i segni

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|description|862|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> for more lessons on how to speak using Remnant sign language.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per altre lezioni su come parlare usando la lingua dei segni dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|As you make your way through the spaceport, you become increasingly aware of how quiet it is. Looking around, you note that it doesn't seem any less busy than usual, just that only a handful of people are paying attention to you. As a result, they have reverted to their normal gestures instead of singing. It feels oddly isolating, and eerie, to realize that there are hundreds of conversations going on around you, yet you can't understand a single one.|880|0
units.english: As you make your way through the spaceport, you become increasingly aware of how quiet it is. Looking around, you note that it doesn't seem any less busy than usual, just that only a handful of people are paying attention to you. As a result, they have reverted to their normal gestures instead of singing. It feels oddly isolating, and eerie, to realize that there are hundreds of conversations going on around you, yet you can't understand a single one.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto ti accorgi sempre di più di quanto sia silenzioso. Guardandoti intorno noti che non sembra meno affollato del solito, solo che pochissime persone ti rivolgono attenzione. Di conseguenza sono tornati ai loro gesti normali invece di cantare. È stranamente isolante, e inquietante, rendersi conto che ci sono centinaia di conversazioni intorno a te, eppure non ne capisci nemmeno una.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	(Ask someone to teach me.)|882|0
units.english: (Ask someone to teach me.)
units.italian: (Chiedi a qualcuno di insegnarmi.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	(Ignore it.)|883|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	Looking around the spaceport, you eventually find someone at what looks like an information desk.|886|0
units.english: Looking around the spaceport, you eventually find someone at what looks like an information desk.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno nello spazioporto, alla fine trovi qualcuno a quello che sembra un banco informazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	"I would like to learn your sign language."|888|0
units.english: "I would like to learn your sign language."
units.italian: "Vorrei imparare la vostra lingua dei segni."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	(Sing a short verse about not understanding people because my hands are still.)|890|0
units.english: (Sing a short verse about not understanding people because my hands are still.)
units.italian: (Canta una breve strofa sul non capire la gente perché le mie mani sono ferme.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	She looks at you with a confused expression, her hands making a few quick gestures. After a moment she points at the hand scanner embedded in the desk.|893|0
units.english: She looks at you with a confused expression, her hands making a few quick gestures. After a moment she points at the hand scanner embedded in the desk.
units.italian: Ti guarda con un'espressione confusa, le mani che fanno qualche gesto rapido. Dopo un momento indica lo scanner per le mani incassato nel banco.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	She looks surprised, but then recovers and sings a verse about how hands can learn, but must be cautious, and gestures at the hand scanner embedded in the desk.|896|0
units.english: She looks surprised, but then recovers and sings a verse about how hands can learn, but must be cautious, and gestures at the hand scanner embedded in the desk.
units.italian: Sembra sorpresa, ma poi si riprende e canta una strofa su come le mani possano imparare, ma debbano essere caute, e fa un gesto verso lo scanner per le mani incassato nel banco.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	As you place your hand on the scanner, you feel a quick tingle as it scans your hand, then a pinprick as it extracts a drop of blood. The lady behind the desk looks at her screen. She nods, taps on the screen a few times, then retrieves a data pad from beneath the desk.|898|0
units.english: As you place your hand on the scanner, you feel a quick tingle as it scans your hand, then a pinprick as it extracts a drop of blood. The lady behind the desk looks at her screen. She nods, taps on the screen a few times, then retrieves a data pad from beneath the desk.
units.italian: Mentre appoggi la mano sullo scanner, senti un rapido formicolio mentre ti scansiona la mano, poi una puntura mentre preleva una goccia di sangue. La donna dietro il banco guarda il suo schermo. Annuisce, tocca lo schermo un paio di volte, poi prende un datapad da sotto il banco.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	She hands the pad to you, and sings a brief verse about perseverance and hope.|899|0
units.english: She hands the pad to you, and sings a brief verse about perseverance and hope.
units.italian: Ti porge il datapad e canta una breve strofa sulla perseveranza e sulla speranza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	Back on your ship you flip the pad on. The data pad appears to be loaded with a number of historic musicals and operas where the meaning of the lyrics has been replicated with gestures as subtitles. It is interspersed with what appear to be Remnant children's videos slowly explaining gestures and pausing to give you the opportunity to practice.|900|0
units.english: Back on your ship you flip the pad on. The data pad appears to be loaded with a number of historic musicals and operas where the meaning of the lyrics has been replicated with gestures as subtitles. It is interspersed with what appear to be Remnant children's videos slowly explaining gestures and pausing to give you the opportunity to practice.
units.italian: Tornato sulla nave accendi il datapad. Il dispositivo sembra caricato con diversi musical e opere storici in cui il significato dei testi è replicato con gesti usati come sottotitoli. In mezzo ci sono quelli che sembrano video per bambini dei Remnant, che spiegano lentamente i gesti e si fermano per darti l'opportunità di esercitarti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 1|	You spend a few hours going through the lessons. It takes a while to start vaguely understanding the signs, but you eventually learn how to sign a number of basic phrases. Eventually, the pad goes black and a note pops up on the screen informing you that additional lessons are available from the director's desk on Aventine.|901|0
units.english: You spend a few hours going through the lessons. It takes a while to start vaguely understanding the signs, but you eventually learn how to sign a number of basic phrases. Eventually, the pad goes black and a note pops up on the screen informing you that additional lessons are available from the director's desk on Aventine.
units.italian: Passi qualche ora sulle lezioni. Ci vuole un po' prima di iniziare a capire vagamente i segni, ma alla fine impari a segnare un certo numero di frasi di base. A un certo punto il datapad si spegne e sullo schermo compare un avviso che informa che altre lezioni sono disponibili al banco del direttore su Aventine.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|name|906|0
units.english: Learn Remnant Sign
units.italian: Impara i segni

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|description|907|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> for more lessons on how to speak using Remnant sign language.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per altre lezioni su come parlare usando la lingua dei segni dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|While searching for the director's desk in the Aventine spaceport, you are very conscious of all the conversations going on around you.
