You manage to catch a word here and there, but not enough to understand the conversations. With some trouble, you ask for directions using what you have learned, and you arrive at a similar desk in a busy plaza.|914|0
units.english: While searching for the director's desk in the Aventine spaceport, you are very conscious of all the conversations going on around you. You manage to catch a word here and there, but not enough to understand the conversations. With some trouble, you ask for directions using what you have learned, and you arrive at a similar desk in a busy plaza.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi il banco del direttore nello spazioporto di Aventine, sei molto consapevole di tutte le conversazioni che si svolgono intorno a te. Riesci a cogliere una parola qua e là, ma non abbastanza per capire le conversazioni. Con qualche difficoltà chiedi indicazioni usando quello che hai imparato, e arrivi a un banco simile in una piazza affollata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	It looks like the person behind the desk has been expecting you. They gesture very slowly, asking how your lessons are going using very basic signs and songs. After a few minutes of conversation, they ask you to place your hand on the scanner, which takes a sample of your blood, and then give you a data chip with more lessons.|915|0
units.english: It looks like the person behind the desk has been expecting you. They gesture very slowly, asking how your lessons are going using very basic signs and songs. After a few minutes of conversation, they ask you to place your hand on the scanner, which takes a sample of your blood, and then give you a data chip with more lessons.
units.italian: Sembra che la persona dietro il banco ti stesse aspettando. Gesticola molto lentamente, chiedendoti come vanno le lezioni con segni e canti molto elementari. Dopo qualche minuto di conversazione ti chiede di appoggiare la mano sullo scanner, che preleva un campione del tuo sangue, e poi ti dà un chip dati con altre lezioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	You return to your ship and begin going through the lessons. These lessons focus more on purely conversing through sign with almost no singing.|916|0
units.english: You return to your ship and begin going through the lessons. These lessons focus more on purely conversing through sign with almost no singing.
units.italian: Torni alla nave e cominci a seguire le lezioni. Queste si concentrano di più sulla conversazione pura a segni, quasi senza canto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	Just as last time, the screen goes black and reveals a note saying that there will be a final package of lessons waiting for you on Viminal.|917|0
units.english: Just as last time, the screen goes black and reveals a note saying that there will be a final package of lessons waiting for you on Viminal.
units.italian: Proprio come l'altra volta, lo schermo si spegne e rivela un avviso: un ultimo pacchetto di lezioni ti aspetterà su Viminal.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|log|922|0
units.english: Have been introduced to the basics of the Remnant sign language. Will need to practice using the video lessons for some time in order to fully understand Remnant sign language.
units.italian: Ho appreso le basi della lingua dei segni dei Remnant. Dovrò esercitarmi con le video lezioni per un po' di tempo per capire davvero la lingua dei segni dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|As soon as you land, you look around for someone to ask directions from. Approaching a dockhand who doesn't appear to be busy, you carefully sign, "Can you direct me to the port director?" He looks at you curiously for a moment and replies with exaggerated slowness. You thank him and head towards the spaceport following his directions.|924|0
units.english: As soon as you land, you look around for someone to ask directions from. Approaching a dockhand who doesn't appear to be busy, you carefully sign, "Can you direct me to the port director?" He looks at you curiously for a moment and replies with exaggerated slowness. You thank him and head towards the spaceport following his directions.
units.italian: Appena atterri ti guardi intorno in cerca di qualcuno a cui chiedere indicazioni. Avvicinandoti a uno scaricatore che non sembra occupato, segni con attenzione: "Puoi indicarmi dove trovo il direttore del porto?" Lui ti guarda incuriosito per un momento e risponde con lentezza esagerata. Lo ringrazi e ti dirigi verso lo spazioporto seguendo le sue indicazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	Once again the director seems to be expecting you, and has a simple conversation with you about how the flight was and how your lessons are progressing. You manage to convey that you have learned a bit, and he gives you a few tips on your rehearsed phrases before directing you to place your hand on the scanner. Once again, the scanner takes a sample of your blood.|925|0
units.english: Once again the director seems to be expecting you, and has a simple conversation with you about how the flight was and how your lessons are progressing. You manage to convey that you have learned a bit, and he gives you a few tips on your rehearsed phrases before directing you to place your hand on the scanner. Once again, the scanner takes a sample of your blood.
units.italian: Anche questa volta il direttore sembra aspettarti, e fa una conversazione semplice con te su come è andato il volo e su come procedono le lezioni. Riesci a comunicargli che hai imparato qualcosa, e lui ti dà qualche consiglio sulle frasi che hai provato prima di indicarti di appoggiare la mano sullo scanner. Ancora una volta lo scanner preleva un campione del tuo sangue.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	(Sign asking what the scanners are for.)|927|0
units.english: (Sign asking what the scanners are for.)
units.italian: (Segna chiedendo a cosa servono gli scanner.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	(Sing a verse about my confusion of the hand scanners.)|928|0
units.english: (Sing a verse about my confusion of the hand scanners.)
units.italian: (Canta una strofa sulla mia confusione riguardo agli scanner per le mani.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	The man begins to sign, but then realizes that you don't understand much of what he is signing, so he switches to singing. "Long ago it was decided that being infiltrated by Alpha agents was a big risk, and we couldn't depend on our interstellar network to remain secure. So we implemented a policy where the first time a Remnant is granted formal access to a new planet their purity and identity is verified. Thus even if someone hacked our networks to give themselves a clean identity, they would still be caught when they started working on a new planet. We also don't broadcast that requirement on our networks, simply enforce it locally. It isn't foolproof, but it adds an additional layer of safety."|929|0
units.english: The man begins to sign, but then realizes that you don't understand much of what he is signing, so he switches to singing. "Long ago it was decided that being infiltrated by Alpha agents was a big risk, and we couldn't depend on our interstellar network to remain secure. So we implemented a policy where the first time a Remnant is granted formal access to a new planet their purity and identity is verified. Thus even if someone hacked our networks to give themselves a clean identity, they would still be caught when they started working on a new planet. We also don't broadcast that requirement on our networks, simply enforce it locally. It isn't foolproof, but it adds an additional layer of safety."
units.italian: L'uomo comincia a segnare, ma poi capisce che non comprendi molto di ciò che segna, così passa a cantare. "Molto tempo fa si decise che essere infiltrati da agenti Alpha era un rischio enorme, e non potevamo contare sul fatto che la nostra rete interstellare restasse sicura. Così abbiamo adottato una politica per cui la prima volta che a un Remnant viene concesso l'accesso formale a un nuovo pianeta si verificano la sua purezza e la sua identità. Così, anche se qualcuno violasse le nostre reti per darsi un'identità pulita, verrebbe comunque scoperto quando comincia a lavorare su un nuovo pianeta. Inoltre non diffondiamo questo requisito sulle nostre reti, lo applichiamo semplicemente in loco. Non è a prova di errore, ma aggiunge un ulteriore livello di sicurezza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	You thank the man for explaining the scanners to you and accept the next set of lessons.|930|0
units.english: You thank the man for explaining the scanners to you and accept the next set of lessons.
units.italian: Ringrazi l'uomo per aver spiegato gli scanner e accetti il gruppo successivo di lezioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	You spend a few hours viewing some of the lessons, one of which involves watching an ancient show about a merchant captain making his way through the galaxy with an unlikely crew, re-enacted by a cast of Remnant who sing and sign their way through the dialogs with exaggerated simplicity. It is oddly familiar, but you can't quite place it. You notice that it seems to have a lot of subtext about the dangers of manipulation and government secrecy, especially surrounding genetics.|931|0
units.english: You spend a few hours viewing some of the lessons, one of which involves watching an ancient show about a merchant captain making his way through the galaxy with an unlikely crew, re-enacted by a cast of Remnant who sing and sign their way through the dialogs with exaggerated simplicity. It is oddly familiar, but you can't quite place it. You notice that it seems to have a lot of subtext about the dangers of manipulation and government secrecy, especially surrounding genetics.
units.italian: Passi qualche ora a guardare alcune lezioni; una consiste in uno spettacolo antico su un capitano mercantile che viaggia per la galassia con un equipaggio improbabile, messo in scena da un cast di Remnant che cantano e segnano i dialoghi con esagerata semplicità. È stranamente familiare, ma non riesci a collocarlo. Noti che sembra avere molto sottotesto sui pericoli della manipolazione e della segretezza dei governi, soprattutto in materia di genetica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign 2|	Skimming through the rest of the lessons, you notice that there is a lot more here than the last two times. It may take some time to get through it all, but you should be fairly fluent if you practice over a couple of months.|932|0
units.english: Skimming through the rest of the lessons, you notice that there is a lot more here than the last two times. It may take some time to get through it all, but you should be fairly fluent if you practice over a couple of months.
units.italian: Scorrendo il resto delle lezioni ti accorgi che qui c'è molto più materiale delle altre due volte. Potrebbe volerci del tempo per finire tutto, ma dovresti diventare piuttosto fluente se ti eserciti per un paio di mesi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign Follow Up|log|943|0
units.english: Have achieved a degree of fluency in the Remnant sign language sufficient for general conversation.
units.italian: Ho raggiunto una discreta fluenza nella lingua dei segni dei Remnant, sufficiente per una conversazione generica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign Follow Up|As you make your way into the spaceport, it occurs to you that one of the information directors who gave you the instructional videos might appreciate how much you have learned over the past months of practice. You stretch your fingers and stop by the desk where you are able to have a simple conversation with the information director.|945|0
units.english: As you make your way into the spaceport, it occurs to you that one of the information directors who gave you the instructional videos might appreciate how much you have learned over the past months of practice. You stretch your fingers and stop by the desk where you are able to have a simple conversation with the information director.
units.italian: Mentre entri nello spazioporto ti viene in mente che uno dei direttori dell'informazione che ti ha dato i video didattici potrebbe apprezzare quanto hai imparato nei mesi di esercizio. Ti sgranchisci le dita e passi dal banco, dove riesci a fare una conversazione semplice con il direttore dell'informazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Learn Sign Follow Up|	"Congratulations, Captain <last>!" the director signs. "Your fluency is good enough that even those unwilling to sing with a stranger should be comfortable working with you. At this rate you will be one of us in more ways than just by blood. I look forward to seeing what results from your work with us." The director is interrupted by the arrival of other Remnant asking for something and bids you farewell with an apologetic gesture.|946|0
units.english: "Congratulations, Captain <last>!" the director signs. "Your fluency is good enough that even those unwilling to sing with a stranger should be comfortable working with you. At this rate you will be one of us in more ways than just by blood. I look forward to seeing what results from your work with us." The director is interrupted by the arrival of other Remnant asking for something and bids you farewell with an apologetic gesture.
units.italian: "Congratulazioni, capitano <last>!" segna il direttore. "La tua fluenza è abbastanza buona che anche chi non è disposto a cantare con uno straniero dovrebbe trovarsi a suo agio a lavorare con te. Di questo passo sarai uno di noi in più modi che solo per il sangue. Aspetto di vedere cosa nascerà dal tuo lavoro con noi." Il direttore viene interrotto dall'arrivo di altri Remnant che chiedono qualcosa e ti saluta con un gesto di scusa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|name|952|0
units.english: Investigate Ivan
units.italian: Indaga su Ivan

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|description|953|0
units.english: Travel to <stopovers> where Ivan's office is in order to ask him what he knows about the Ember Waste, then return to <destination> with your findings.
units.italian: Recati su <stopovers>, dove si trova l'ufficio di Ivan, per chiedergli cosa sa della Distesa di Braci, poi torna su <destination> con i risultati.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	While wandering the spaceport, you think back to the scientists from the Deep that you helped discover the Ember Waste. Given that the Remnant value their secrecy, they may be interested in knowing about this.|983|0
units.english: While wandering the spaceport, you think back to the scientists from the Deep that you helped discover the Ember Waste. Given that the Remnant value their secrecy, they may be interested in knowing about this.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ripensi agli scienziati del Deep che hai aiutato a scoprire la Distesa di Braci. Dato che i Remnant tengono alla loro segretezza, potrebbero essere interessati a saperlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Find a prefect to tell.)|985|0
units.english: (Find a prefect to tell.)
units.italian: (Trova un prefetto a cui dirlo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Don't tell the Remnant.)|987|0
units.english: (Don't tell the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Non dirlo ai Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	While wandering the spaceport, you think back to the scientists researching the wormhole in Terminus. Given that the Remnant value their secrecy, they may be interested in knowing about this.|991|0
units.english: While wandering the spaceport, you think back to the scientists researching the wormhole in Terminus. Given that the Remnant value their secrecy, they may be interested in knowing about this.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ripensi agli scienziati che studiano il cunicolo a Terminus. Dato che i Remnant tengono alla loro segretezza, potrebbero essere interessati a saperlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Find a prefect to tell.)|993|0
units.english: (Find a prefect to tell.)
units.italian: (Trova un prefetto a cui dirlo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Don't tell the Remnant.)|994|0
units.english: (Don't tell the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Non dirlo ai Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You ask one of the Remnant in the spaceport where you would be able to find a prefect, and they point you to what looks like an information desk of sorts. There you tell the attendant that you have something potentially important to discuss in regards to Remnant security. They tap a few buttons then give you directions down a hallway. You quickly find yourself in an armory where several Remnant guards are in the process of cleaning their weapons. One stands up and comes over to you.|1000|0
units.english: You ask one of the Remnant in the spaceport where you would be able to find a prefect, and they point you to what looks like an information desk of sorts. There you tell the attendant that you have something potentially important to discuss in regards to Remnant security. They tap a few buttons then give you directions down a hallway. You quickly find yourself in an armory where several Remnant guards are in the process of cleaning their weapons. One stands up and comes over to you.
units.italian: Chiedi a uno dei Remnant nello spazioporto dove potresti trovare un prefetto, e ti indica quello che sembra una specie di banco informazioni. Lì dici all'addetto che hai qualcosa di potenzialmente importante di cui discutere riguardo alla sicurezza dei Remnant. Digita qualche tasto e ti indica una direzione lungo un corridoio. Ti ritrovi presto in un'armeria dove alcune guardie dei Remnant stanno pulendo le armi. Una si alza e viene verso di te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Greetings, Captain. I am Prefect Torza. I was told you had information that could be important to our security." He takes a seat on a bench on the far side of the room from the other Remnant and gestures for you to do the same. "What do you have to tell us?"|1001|0
units.english: "Greetings, Captain. I am Prefect Torza. I was told you had information that could be important to our security." He takes a seat on a bench on the far side of the room from the other Remnant and gestures for you to do the same. "What do you have to tell us?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano. Sono il prefetto Torza. Mi è stato detto che hai informazioni che potrebbero essere importanti per la nostra sicurezza." Si siede su una panchina sul lato opposto della stanza rispetto agli altri Remnant e ti fa cenno di fare lo stesso. "Cosa hai da dirci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I helped a group of scientists from the Deep to discover the Ember Waste."|1006|0
units.english: "I helped a group of scientists from the Deep to discover the Ember Waste."
units.italian: "Ho aiutato un gruppo di scienziati del Deep a scoprire la Distesa di Braci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"A group of scientists from the Deep has discovered the Ember Waste."|1007|0
units.english: "A group of scientists from the Deep has discovered the Ember Waste."
units.italian: "Un gruppo di scienziati del Deep ha scoperto la Distesa di Braci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza's eyes go wide. "Why would you do this?" he asks. "Do you not understand that our secrecy is of utmost importance?"|1012|0
units.english: Torza's eyes go wide. "Why would you do this?" he asks. "Do you not understand that our secrecy is of utmost importance?"
units.italian: Gli occhi di Torza si spalancano. "Perché l'hai fatto?" chiede. "Non capisci che la nostra segretezza è della massima importanza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I don't believe that they will be a threat to you."|1014|0
units.english: "I don't believe that they will be a threat to you."
units.italian: "Non credo che rappresenteranno una minaccia per voi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'm sorry, but I helped them before coming to understand this."|1016|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I helped them before coming to understand this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma li ho aiutati prima di capire questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza seems to relax slightly. "This is unfortunate. I cannot get angry at you for that which you did not understand. But now that you do understand, seek to not make this same mistake in the future.|1018|0
units.english: Torza seems to relax slightly. "This is unfortunate. I cannot get angry at you for that which you did not understand. But now that you do understand, seek to not make this same mistake in the future.
units.italian: Torza sembra rilassarsi un po'. "È spiacevole. Non posso arrabbiarmi con te per quello che non capivi. Ma ora che lo capisci, cerca di non ripetere lo stesso errore in futuro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"What do they know?"|1019|0
units.english: "What do they know?"
units.italian: "Cosa sanno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I helped a group of scientists who were researching the wormhole in Terminus."|1024|0
units.english: "I helped a group of scientists who were researching the wormhole in Terminus."
units.italian: "Ho aiutato un gruppo di scienziati che stavano studiando il cunicolo a Terminus."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I discovered that a group of scientists are researching the wormhole in Terminus."|1025|0
units.english: "I discovered that a group of scientists are researching the wormhole in Terminus."
units.italian: "Ho scoperto che un gruppo di scienziati sta studiando il cunicolo a Terminus."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do they know how to enter it?" Torza asks, not sounding concerned with this new information.|1027|0
units.english: "Do they know how to enter it?" Torza asks, not sounding concerned with this new information.
units.italian: "Sanno come entrarci?" chiede Torza, senza sembrare preoccupato dalla nuova informazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No," you say. "But they know, or at least think, that it is a wormhole, and are attempting to learn how to enter it."|1028|0
units.english: "No," you say. "But they know, or at least think, that it is a wormhole, and are attempting to learn how to enter it."
units.italian: "No," dici. "Ma sanno, o almeno pensano, che è un cunicolo, e stanno cercando di capire come entrarci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Well, it is unlikely that they will ever learn. The only way to stabilize the wormholes is by using a Key Stone, but I have never heard of one being found in Ancestral space. Learning what these scientists know would still be helpful, though. Would you be able to get us a copy of their findings?"|1029|0
units.english: "Well, it is unlikely that they will ever learn. The only way to stabilize the wormholes is by using a Key Stone, but I have never heard of one being found in Ancestral space. Learning what these scientists know would still be helpful, though. Would you be able to get us a copy of their findings?"
units.italian: "Beh, è improbabile che lo scoprano mai. L'unico modo per stabilizzare i cunicoli è usare una Pietra Chiave, ma non ho mai sentito di una trovata nello spazio ancestrale. Sapere cosa sanno questi scienziati sarebbe comunque utile, però. Riusciresti a procurarci una copia dei loro risultati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'll try. The lead scientist told me where his office is."|1031|0
units.english: "I'll try. The lead scientist told me where his office is."
units.italian: "Ci proverò. Lo scienziato capo mi ha detto dove si trova il suo ufficio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."|1033|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo che riuscirò."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. I do not expect anything to come of this for now, but, should anything occur, we can be more prepared than we otherwise would have been." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "May the Embers burn bright for you."|1034|0
units.english: "This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. I do not expect anything to come of this for now, but, should anything occur, we can be more prepared than we otherwise would have been." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: "È spiacevole," risponde Torza. "Ma grazie per averci informato. Non mi aspetto che ne nasca nulla per ora, ma, se dovesse succedere qualcosa, potremo essere più preparati di quanto saremmo stati altrimenti." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1038|0
units.english: "This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: "È un bene," risponde Torza. "Una volta che avrai i risultati, torna allo spazioporto qui e consegnali al banco informazioni. Li esamineremo poco dopo." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Buon viaggio, capitano. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|label|1041|0
units.english: told before
units.italian: told before

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Since you last told the Remnant about Ivan's research on the wormhole in Terminus, you have helped him to discover the Ember Waste. The Remnant may be interested in being updated on Ivan's progress.|1042|0
units.english: Since you last told the Remnant about Ivan's research on the wormhole in Terminus, you have helped him to discover the Ember Waste. The Remnant may be interested in being updated on Ivan's progress.
units.italian: Da quando hai parlato ai Remnant della ricerca di Ivan sul cunicolo a Terminus, lo hai aiutato a scoprire la Distesa di Braci. I Remnant potrebbero essere interessati ad aggiornamenti sui progressi di Ivan.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Find a prefect to tell.)|1044|0
units.english: (Find a prefect to tell.)
units.italian: (Trova un prefetto a cui dirlo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Don't update the Remnant.)|1045|0
units.english: (Don't update the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Non aggiornare i Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You approach a spaceport information desk and ask to see Prefect Torza, whom you spoke to the last time you informed the Remnant about the Deep researching the wormhole. Luckily, Torza is on-world at the moment, and you are told to meet him in the cafeteria. When you arrive, you find that Torza has just finished a meal and is about to leave.|1048|0
units.english: You approach a spaceport information desk and ask to see Prefect Torza, whom you spoke to the last time you informed the Remnant about the Deep researching the wormhole. Luckily, Torza is on-world at the moment, and you are told to meet him in the cafeteria. When you arrive, you find that Torza has just finished a meal and is about to leave.
units.italian: Ti avvicini a un banco informazioni dello spazioporto e chiedi di vedere il prefetto Torza, con cui hai parlato l'ultima volta che hai informato i Remnant della ricerca del Deep sul cunicolo. Per fortuna Torza è sul pianeta in questo momento, e ti dicono di incontrarlo in mensa. Quando arrivi scopri che Torza ha appena finito di mangiare e sta per andarsene.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Ah, Captain. I was told you were looking for me. We should find a private place to talk."|1049|0
units.english: "Ah, Captain. I was told you were looking for me. We should find a private place to talk."
units.italian: "Ah, capitano. Mi hanno detto che mi cercavi. Dovremmo trovare un posto appartato per parlare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You follow Torza to a similar armory as before. "Is there an update to the research on the Threshold that the Deep are doing?" he asks after sitting down.|1050|0
units.english: You follow Torza to a similar armory as before. "Is there an update to the research on the Threshold that the Deep are doing?" he asks after sitting down.
units.italian: Segui Torza in un'armeria simile a quella di prima. "Ci sono novità sulla ricerca che il Deep sta facendo sul Threshold?" chiede dopo essersi seduto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I've helped the scientists learn how to pass through the wormhole."|1052|0
units.english: "I've helped the scientists learn how to pass through the wormhole."
units.italian: "Ho aiutato gli scienziati a capire come attraversare il cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"The scientists have discovered how to pass through the wormhole."|1053|0
units.english: "The scientists have discovered how to pass through the wormhole."
units.italian: "Gli scienziati hanno scoperto come attraversare il cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza's eyes go wide. "Why would you do this?" he asks. "Do you not understand that our secrecy is of utmost importance?"|1058|0
units.english: Torza's eyes go wide. "Why would you do this?" he asks. "Do you not understand that our secrecy is of utmost importance?"
units.italian: Gli occhi di Torza si spalancano. "Perché l'hai fatto?" chiede. "Non capisci che la nostra segretezza è della massima importanza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I don't believe that they will be a threat to you."|1060|0
units.english: "I don't believe that they will be a threat to you."
units.italian: "Non credo che rappresenteranno una minaccia per voi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'm sorry, but I helped them before coming to understand this."|1062|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I helped them before coming to understand this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma li ho aiutati prima di capire questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Liar!" Torza yells at you while standing up from the bench. "You told us of these scientists after we had already trusted you with a license." Torza walks away from you angrily, then turns his head.|1066|0
units.english: "Liar!" Torza yells at you while standing up from the bench. "You told us of these scientists after we had already trusted you with a license." Torza walks away from you angrily, then turns his head.
units.italian: "Bugiardo!" ti urla contro Torza alzandosi dalla panchina. "Ci hai parlato di questi scienziati dopo che ti avevamo già affidato una licenza." Torza si allontana arrabbiato, poi gira la testa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"What do they know?"|1067|0
units.english: "What do they know?"
units.italian: "Cosa sanno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"It is not a matter of them being a threat," Torza says angrily. "They may be peaceful, but whoever they tell or whoever may learn from them may not be.|1071|0
units.english: "It is not a matter of them being a threat," Torza says angrily. "They may be peaceful, but whoever they tell or whoever may learn from them may not be.
units.italian: "Non è questione che siano una minaccia," dice Torza con rabbia. "Potranno anche essere pacifici, ma chiunque lo dica a qualcuno o chiunque possa imparare da loro potrebbe non esserlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"What do they know?"|1072|0
units.english: "What do they know?"
units.italian: "Cosa sanno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza's eyes go wide. "What do they know?"|1076|0
units.english: Torza's eyes go wide. "What do they know?"
units.italian: Gli occhi di Torza si spalancano. "Cosa sanno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They don't know about the Remnant, at least not yet."|1080|0
units.english: "They don't know about the Remnant, at least not yet."
units.italian: "Non sanno dei Remnant, almeno non ancora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They have only discovered the void sprites."|1083|0
units.english: "They have only discovered the void sprites."
units.italian: "Hanno scoperto solo gli spettri del vuoto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They know where the Remnant are in the Ember Waste."|1087|0
units.english: "They know where the Remnant are in the Ember Waste."
units.italian: "Sanno dove sono i Remnant nella Distesa di Braci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They have scans of a few Remnant ships."|1091|0
units.english: "They have scans of a few Remnant ships."
units.italian: "Hanno scansioni di alcune navi dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They have samples of some Remnant technology."|1095|0
units.english: "They have samples of some Remnant technology."
units.italian: "Hanno campioni di tecnologia dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"They are actively surveilling Remnant worlds."|1099|0
units.english: "They are actively surveilling Remnant worlds."
units.italian: "Stanno sorvegliando attivamente i mondi dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza seems to calm down greatly after hearing this. "This is most fortunate. We will need to work to ensure that this remains the case."|1106|0
units.english: Torza seems to calm down greatly after hearing this. "This is most fortunate. We will need to work to ensure that this remains the case."
units.italian: Torza sembra calmarsi molto dopo aver sentito questo. "Questo è davvero fortunato. Dovremo lavorare per assicurarci che resti così."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza seems to calm down greatly after hearing this. "Then may they not anger the Archon with their curiosity, as we have."|1112|0
units.english: Torza seems to calm down greatly after hearing this. "Then may they not anger the Archon with their curiosity, as we have."
units.italian: Torza sembra calmarsi molto dopo aver sentito questo. "Allora speriamo che non facciano arrabbiare l'Archon con la loro curiosità, come è successo a noi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza pauses for a long while. "I assume it only makes sense that they would know of us after discovering the Ember Waste."|1118|0
units.english: Torza pauses for a long while. "I assume it only makes sense that they would know of us after discovering the Ember Waste."
units.italian: Torza tace a lungo. "Immagino sia ovvio che sappiano di noi dopo aver scoperto la Distesa di Braci."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza pauses for a long while. "These scientists knowing of our whereabouts is much more of a concern than them having scans of our ships."|1124|0
units.english: Torza pauses for a long while. "These scientists knowing of our whereabouts is much more of a concern than them having scans of our ships."
units.italian: Torza tace a lungo. "Che questi scienziati sappiano dove siamo è molto più preoccupante delle loro scansioni delle nostre navi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"And you were the one who brought it to them," Torza responds.|1130|0
units.english: "And you were the one who brought it to them," Torza responds.
units.italian: "E sei stato tu a portarglielo," risponde Torza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Yes, but what I do with your technology after buying it is none of your concern."|1135|0
units.english: "Yes, but what I do with your technology after buying it is none of your concern."
units.italian: "Sì, ma quello che faccio della vostra tecnologia dopo averla comprata non è affar vostro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No, they obtain it by other means."|1137|0
units.english: "No, they obtain it by other means."
units.italian: "No, la ottengono per altre vie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Yes, but it is no different than me bringing technology from the Republic to you."|1142|0
units.english: "Yes, but it is no different than me bringing technology from the Republic to you."
units.italian: "Sì, ma non è diverso dal portare a voi tecnologia dalla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No, they obtained it by other means."|1143|0
units.english: "No, they obtained it by other means."
units.italian: "No, l'hanno ottenuta per altre vie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza scowls in response to this, but doesn't say anything.|1146|0
units.english: Torza scowls in response to this, but doesn't say anything.
units.italian: Torza fa una smorfia in risposta, ma non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"What you do with our technology is very much a concern to us!" Torza yells.|1150|0
units.english: "What you do with our technology is very much a concern to us!" Torza yells.
units.italian: "Quello che fai della nostra tecnologia è molto affar nostro!" urla Torza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza grits his teeth. "There are no reports of missing ships or outfits, and the only visitor capable of delivering our technology is you."|1156|0
units.english: Torza grits his teeth. "There are no reports of missing ships or outfits, and the only visitor capable of delivering our technology is you."
units.italian: Torza digrigna i denti. "Non ci sono segnalazioni di navi o equipaggiamenti scomparsi, e l'unico visitatore in grado di consegnare la nostra tecnologia sei tu."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"How are they doing this?" Torza asks.|1162|0
units.english: "How are they doing this?" Torza asks.
units.italian: "Come fanno?" chiede Torza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Surveillance devices have been placed in each of your spaceports."|1164|0
units.english: "Surveillance devices have been placed in each of your spaceports."
units.italian: "Hanno piazzato dispositivi di sorveglianza in ciascuno dei vostri spazioporti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I don't know. I only know that they are."|1165|0
units.english: "I don't know. I only know that they are."
units.italian: "Non lo so. So solo che lo fanno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza punches a wall in anger, then relaxes. "Thank you for telling us this. We will search for and remove these devices immediately."|1170|0
units.english: Torza punches a wall in anger, then relaxes. "Thank you for telling us this. We will search for and remove these devices immediately."
units.italian: Torza prende a pugni un muro per la rabbia, poi si calma. "Grazie per avercelo detto. Cercheremo e rimuoveremo subito questi dispositivi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Whatever methods they are using, we will discover them in due time," Torza says.|1174|0
units.english: "Whatever methods they are using, we will discover them in due time," Torza says.
units.italian: "Qualunque metodo usino, lo scopriremo a tempo debito," dice Torza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza begins tapping on a data pad. "We must act to rectify this situation," he says calmly.|1177|0
units.english: Torza begins tapping on a data pad. "We must act to rectify this situation," he says calmly.
units.italian: Torza comincia a digitare su un datapad. "Dobbiamo agire per rimediare a questa situazione," dice con calma.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I presume that you know of the whereabouts of these scientists. Would you be able to get us a copy of their findings?"|1181|0
units.english: "I presume that you know of the whereabouts of these scientists. Would you be able to get us a copy of their findings?"
units.italian: "Presumo che tu sappia dove si trovano questi scienziati. Riusciresti a procurarci una copia dei loro risultati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'll try. The lead scientist told me where his office is."|1183|0
units.english: "I'll try. The lead scientist told me where his office is."
units.italian: "Ci proverò. Lo scienziato capo mi ha detto dove si trova il suo ufficio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."|1185|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo che riuscirò."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"You have brought us the information that these scientists had before. I ask that you do so again."|1189|0
units.english: "You have brought us the information that these scientists had before. I ask that you do so again."
units.italian: "Ci hai già portato le informazioni che questi scienziati avevano. Ti chiedo di farlo di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'll return with their information as quickly as I can."|1191|0
units.english: "I'll return with their information as quickly as I can."
units.italian: "Tornerò con le loro informazioni il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."|1193|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't believe I'll be able to."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non credo che riuscirò."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves deeper into the Ember Waste." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "May the Embers burn bright for you."|1203|0
units.english: "This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves deeper into the Ember Waste." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: "È spiacevole," risponde Torza. "Ma grazie per averci informato. Saremo in allerta per vedere se questi scienziati faranno altri passi nella Distesa di Braci." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves deeper into the Ember Waste." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "We may also be keeping a closer eye on you going forward to avoid another situation like this one."|1207|0
units.english: "This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "But thank you for informing us about this. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves deeper into the Ember Waste." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "We may also be keeping a closer eye on you going forward to avoid another situation like this one."
units.italian: "È spiacevole," risponde Torza. "Ma grazie per averci informato. Saremo in allerta per vedere se questi scienziati faranno altri passi nella Distesa di Braci." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Potremmo anche tenerti più sotto controllo d'ora in poi, per evitare un'altra situazione come questa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "Very unfortunate. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves. I at least commend you for giving what information you have to us." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.|1216|0
units.english: "This is unfortunate," Torza responds. "Very unfortunate. We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves. I at least commend you for giving what information you have to us." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.
units.italian: "È spiacevole," risponde Torza. "Molto spiacevole. Saremo in allerta per vedere se questi scienziati faranno altri passi. Almeno ti riconosco il merito di averci dato le informazioni che hai." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita senza un'altra parola.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Then perhaps the Remnant should reassess their trust placed in you," Torza responds. "We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves. I at least commend you for giving what information you have to us, but know that you will be watched closely by us from now on." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.|1222|0
units.english: "Then perhaps the Remnant should reassess their trust placed in you," Torza responds. "We will be on high alert to see if these scientists make any moves. I at least commend you for giving what information you have to us, but know that you will be watched closely by us from now on." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.
units.italian: "Allora forse i Remnant dovrebbero riconsiderare la fiducia che ti hanno dato," risponde Torza. "Saremo in allerta per vedere se questi scienziati faranno altri passi. Almeno ti riconosco il merito di averci dato le informazioni che hai, ma sappi che d'ora in poi sarai tenuto sotto stretta osservazione." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita senza un'altra parola.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1232|0
units.english: "This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: "È un bene," risponde Torza. "Una volta che avrai i risultati, torna allo spazioporto qui e consegnali al banco informazioni. Li esamineremo poco dopo." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Buon viaggio, capitano. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. But know that we may be keeping a closer eye on you going forward to avoid another situation like this."|1236|0
units.english: "This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Have a safe journey, Captain. But know that we may be keeping a closer eye on you going forward to avoid another situation like this."
units.italian: "È un bene," risponde Torza. "Una volta che avrai i risultati, torna allo spazioporto qui e consegnali al banco informazioni. Li esamineremo poco dopo." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Buon viaggio, capitano. Ma sappi che potremmo tenerti più sotto controllo d'ora in poi, per evitare un'altra situazione come questa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.|1245|0
units.english: "This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out without another word.
units.italian: "È un bene," risponde Torza. "Una volta che avrai i risultati, torna allo spazioporto qui e consegnali al banco informazioni. Li esamineremo poco dopo." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita senza un'altra parola.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Know that you will be watched closely by us from now on, Captain. I commend you for agreeing to bring us this information, but we cannot allow another situation like this one to occur."|1251|0
units.english: "This is good," Torza responds. "Once you have the findings, simply return to the spaceport here and give them to the information desk. We will look over them shortly thereafter." Torza gets up from the bench and shows you out. "Know that you will be watched closely by us from now on, Captain. I commend you for agreeing to bring us this information, but we cannot allow another situation like this one to occur."
units.italian: "È un bene," risponde Torza. "Una volta che avrai i risultati, torna allo spazioporto qui e consegnali al banco informazioni. Li esamineremo poco dopo." Torza si alza dalla panchina e ti accompagna all'uscita. "Sappi che d'ora in poi sarai tenuto sotto stretta osservazione, capitano. Ti riconosco il merito di aver accettato di portarci queste informazioni, ma non possiamo permettere che si ripeta un'altra situazione come questa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You look up the location of Ivan's office that he gave you back when you helped him save the science drone in Terminus and find that it is in a building just outside the spaceport, just one room among many in a massive office complex. <compared> to architecture you've seen elsewhere in the Deep, it's rather brutalistic.|1260|0
units.english: You look up the location of Ivan's office that he gave you back when you helped him save the science drone in Terminus and find that it is in a building just outside the spaceport, just one room among many in a massive office complex. <compared> to architecture you've seen elsewhere in the Deep, it's rather brutalistic.
units.italian: Cerchi la posizione dell'ufficio di Ivan, che ti aveva dato quando lo hai aiutato a salvare il drone scientifico a Terminus, e scopri che si trova in un edificio appena fuori dallo spazioporto, una sola stanza tra molte in un enorme complesso di uffici. <compared>: rispetto all'architettura che hai visto altrove nel Deep, è piuttosto brutalista.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You ask a receptionist what Ivan's room number is, and he points you to a room on the twentieth floor. After taking an elevator up, you knock on the door to Ivan's office.|1264|0
units.english: You ask a receptionist what Ivan's room number is, and he points you to a room on the twentieth floor. After taking an elevator up, you knock on the door to Ivan's office.
units.italian: Chiedi alla reception qual è il numero della stanza di Ivan, e ti indica una stanza al ventesimo piano. Dopo essere salito in ascensore, bussi alla porta dell'ufficio di Ivan.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Who is it?" Ivan says before peeking out the blinds. "Oh! Captain <last>! Please, come in."|1265|0
units.english: "Who is it?" Ivan says before peeking out the blinds. "Oh! Captain <last>! Please, come in."
units.italian: "Chi è?" dice Ivan prima di sbirciare dalle veneziane. "Oh! Capitano <last>! Prego, entri."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan opens the door and lets you inside. The office is cramped, the walls almost entirely obscured by filing cabinets. Ivan walks over to a desk that he barely has space to get behind, picking up a collection of papers and shoving them into the nearest cabinet. "Sorry about the mess," he says nervously. "I didn't know you were coming. Is there something I can help you with?"|1266|0
units.english: Ivan opens the door and lets you inside. The office is cramped, the walls almost entirely obscured by filing cabinets. Ivan walks over to a desk that he barely has space to get behind, picking up a collection of papers and shoving them into the nearest cabinet. "Sorry about the mess," he says nervously. "I didn't know you were coming. Is there something I can help you with?"
units.italian: Ivan apre la porta e ti fa entrare. L'ufficio è angusto, le pareti quasi del tutto occultate da schedari. Ivan va verso una scrivania dietro la quale riesce a malapena a infilarsi, prende una pila di carte e le ficca nell'armadio più vicino. "Scusi il disordine," dice nervoso. "Non sapevo che sarebbe venuto. Posso aiutarla in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I was wondering if you'd found out anything new about the anomaly in Terminus."|1268|0
units.english: "I was wondering if you'd found out anything new about the anomaly in Terminus."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo se avesse scoperto qualcosa di nuovo sull'anomalia di Terminus."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do you think I could get a copy of your research on the anomaly in Terminus?"|1269|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get a copy of your research on the anomaly in Terminus?"
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia della sua ricerca sull'anomalia di Terminus?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Oh, yes. We haven't been able to do too much with what funding we have left, but we have made one important discovery." Ivan turns to one of his filing cabinets and pulls out some sort of graphic that you would guess is depicting the anomaly, but you can't make any sense of it.|1272|0
units.english: "Oh, yes. We haven't been able to do too much with what funding we have left, but we have made one important discovery." Ivan turns to one of his filing cabinets and pulls out some sort of graphic that you would guess is depicting the anomaly, but you can't make any sense of it.
units.italian: "Oh, sì. Con i fondi che ci restano non abbiamo potuto fare molto, ma abbiamo fatto una scoperta importante." Ivan si volta verso uno dei suoi schedari e tira fuori una specie di grafico che immagini raffiguri l'anomalia, ma non ci capisci nulla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"One of our ideas has been that the anomaly is some sort of unstable wormhole. Reports of its existence go back to at least the times of the first Alpha War, with rumors that ships have left for Terminus to never return, presumably having entered the anomaly somehow. Now I'm not one to go off of rumors, but they certainly have to come from somewhere, so the idea was at least worth investigating.|1273|0
units.english: "One of our ideas has been that the anomaly is some sort of unstable wormhole. Reports of its existence go back to at least the times of the first Alpha War, with rumors that ships have left for Terminus to never return, presumably having entered the anomaly somehow. Now I'm not one to go off of rumors, but they certainly have to come from somewhere, so the idea was at least worth investigating.
units.italian: "Una delle nostre ipotesi è che l'anomalia sia una specie di cunicolo instabile. Le notizie della sua esistenza risalgono almeno ai tempi della prima guerra contro gli Alpha, con voci di navi partite per Terminus e mai tornate, presumibilmente entrate nell'anomalia in qualche modo. Non sono tipo da fidarmi delle voci, ma di certo da qualche parte devono pur venire, quindi l'idea meritava almeno di essere studiata.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Going under the assumption that it is a wormhole that is simply too unstable to allow a ship to pass through, we wanted to see if we could get anything at all to pass through it. What we've discovered is that given a small and smooth enough object, we can get it to disappear within the anomaly without a trace." He then pulls out a small metallic sphere about the size of a ping pong ball from one of the cabinets and dangles it from an attached wire.|1274|0
units.english: "Going under the assumption that it is a wormhole that is simply too unstable to allow a ship to pass through, we wanted to see if we could get anything at all to pass through it. What we've discovered is that given a small and smooth enough object, we can get it to disappear within the anomaly without a trace." He then pulls out a small metallic sphere about the size of a ping pong ball from one of the cabinets and dangles it from an attached wire.
units.italian: "Partendo dal presupposto che sia un cunicolo semplicemente troppo instabile perché una nave lo attraversi, volevamo vedere se riuscivamo a farci passare qualcosa. Quello che abbiamo scoperto è che, dato un oggetto abbastanza piccolo e liscio, riusciamo a farlo sparire nell'anomalia senza lasciare traccia." Poi tira fuori da uno degli armadi una piccola sfera metallica grande più o meno come una pallina da ping pong e la fa dondolare da un filo attaccato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Now this is only a model, but we created a number of small sensors about this size and sent them through the anomaly. We'd hoped that we could take some readings from whatever is on the other side of the anomaly, as it clearly goes somewhere, but we only ever get static coming back through the wire, followed by nothing a few minutes later. And unfortunately, whatever we send in we can't seem to pull back. The wire always snaps.|1275|0
units.english: "Now this is only a model, but we created a number of small sensors about this size and sent them through the anomaly. We'd hoped that we could take some readings from whatever is on the other side of the anomaly, as it clearly goes somewhere, but we only ever get static coming back through the wire, followed by nothing a few minutes later. And unfortunately, whatever we send in we can't seem to pull back. The wire always snaps.
units.italian: "Ora, questo è solo un modello, ma abbiamo creato diversi piccoli sensori di questa dimensione e li abbiamo mandati attraverso l'anomalia. Speravamo di poter raccogliere qualche misura da quello che c'è dall'altra parte dell'anomalia, dato che chiaramente porta da qualche parte, ma dal filo torna sempre solo fruscio, seguito dal nulla dopo qualche minuto. E purtroppo quello che mandiamo dentro non riusciamo a tirarlo fuori. Il filo si spezza sempre.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"So the anomaly is clearly a wormhole. Now we just need to figure out how to get whatever we send into it to come back and how to get something the size of a ship to enter it."|1276|0
units.english: "So the anomaly is clearly a wormhole. Now we just need to figure out how to get whatever we send into it to come back and how to get something the size of a ship to enter it."
units.italian: "Quindi l'anomalia è chiaramente un cunicolo. Ora dobbiamo solo capire come far tornare indietro quello che ci mandiamo dentro e come farci entrare qualcosa delle dimensioni di una nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Sounds like you're making good progress," you respond. "Do you think I could get a copy of your research so far?"|1277|0
units.english: "Sounds like you're making good progress," you respond. "Do you think I could get a copy of your research so far?"
units.italian: "Sembra che stiate facendo buoni progressi," rispondi. "Potrei avere una copia della vostra ricerca fino a qui?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|label|1279|0
units.english: terminus copy
units.italian: terminus copy

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped save us from losing valuable equipment, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."|1280|0
units.english: "A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped save us from losing valuable equipment, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."
units.italian: "Una copia?" Ivan fissa il vuoto per un momento. "Beh, suppongo che, visto che ci hai aiutato a non perdere attrezzatura preziosa, potrei fare un'eccezione per te. Di solito non condivido i risultati con chi non fa parte del mio gruppo di ricerca finché non sono definitivi. Mi sono scottato troppe volte per questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan moves to another filing cabinet and pulls out a number of folders. "This will be for your eyes only. Promise you won't share this with anyone."|1281|0
units.english: Ivan moves to another filing cabinet and pulls out a number of folders. "This will be for your eyes only. Promise you won't share this with anyone."
units.italian: Ivan va verso un altro schedario e tira fuori diverse cartelle. "Questo sarà solo per i tuoi occhi. Promettimi che non lo condividerai con nessuno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I promise."|1283|0
units.english: "I promise."
units.italian: "Lo prometto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'll try."|1285|0
units.english: "I'll try."
units.italian: "Ci proverò."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Funny," Ivan says with a blank expression.|1286|0
units.english: "Funny," Ivan says with a blank expression.
units.italian: "Divertente," dice Ivan con un'espressione vuota.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Let me just get these folders digitized for you, then I can hand you a data chip with everything on it. It'll only be a few minutes."|1288|0
units.english: "Let me just get these folders digitized for you, then I can hand you a data chip with everything on it. It'll only be a few minutes."
units.italian: "Fammi solo digitalizzare queste cartelle, poi ti do un chip dati con tutto dentro. Ci vorranno pochi minuti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan leaves the room with the folders, and when he returns, he hands you a data chip before shoving all the folders back into the filing cabinet. "Well, anything else you need?"|1291|0
units.english: Ivan leaves the room with the folders, and when he returns, he hands you a data chip before shoving all the folders back into the filing cabinet. "Well, anything else you need?"
units.italian: Ivan esce dalla stanza con le cartelle, e quando torna ti porge un chip dati prima di ficcare di nuovo tutte le cartelle nello schedario. "Bene, le serve altro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No. That's all I was here for," you respond. "Good luck on the rest of your work."|1292|0
units.english: "No. That's all I was here for," you respond. "Good luck on the rest of your work."
units.italian: "No. Era tutto," rispondi. "Buona fortuna con il resto del suo lavoro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Thank you," Ivan says. "We might be in touch in the future. I might need your help again for this project, hopefully during a less dire situation than last time."|1293|0
units.english: "Thank you," Ivan says. "We might be in touch in the future. I might need your help again for this project, hopefully during a less dire situation than last time."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice Ivan. "Forse ci risentiremo in futuro. Potrebbe servirmi di nuovo il suo aiuto per questo progetto, speriamo in una situazione meno disperata dell'ultima volta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|label|1296|0
units.english: retrieved before
units.italian: retrieved before

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You return to the office complex where Ivan's office is and ask the receptionist if Ivan is available, and he looks at you with confusion.|1297|0
units.english: You return to the office complex where Ivan's office is and ask the receptionist if Ivan is available, and he looks at you with confusion.
units.italian: Torni al complesso di uffici dove si trova quello di Ivan e chiedi alla reception se Ivan è disponibile, e lui ti guarda confuso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You ask a receptionist what Ivan's room number is, and he looks at you with confusion.|1301|0
units.english: You ask a receptionist what Ivan's room number is, and he looks at you with confusion.
units.italian: Chiedi alla reception qual è il numero della stanza di Ivan, e lui ti guarda confuso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Ivan Haataja? He moved out weeks ago. Said something about 'moving up in this world' while dragging a pallet of filing cabinets out of the building. I can look up where he is now if you need me to."|1304|0
units.english: "Ivan Haataja? He moved out weeks ago. Said something about 'moving up in this world' while dragging a pallet of filing cabinets out of the building. I can look up where he is now if you need me to."
units.italian: "Ivan Haataja? Si è trasferito settimane fa. Ha detto qualcosa tipo 'salire di livello in questo mondo' mentre trascinava un bancale di schedari fuori dall'edificio. Posso cercare dove sia ora, se vuole."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'd appreciate that," you say.|1305|0
units.english: "I'd appreciate that," you say.
units.italian: "Le sarei grato," dici.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	The receptionist spends a few minutes tapping away at a keyboard. "Looks like he had his office moved to... the Deep Polytechnic Institute of Valhalla?" he says with a surprised look. "Oh wow, must have gotten someone's attention in the government to be moved there. Do you need directions?"|1306|0
units.english: The receptionist spends a few minutes tapping away at a keyboard. "Looks like he had his office moved to... the Deep Polytechnic Institute of Valhalla?" he says with a surprised look. "Oh wow, must have gotten someone's attention in the government to be moved there. Do you need directions?"
units.italian: L'impiegato passa qualche minuto a battere su una tastiera. "Sembra che abbia fatto trasferire il suo ufficio a... l'Istituto Politecnico del Deep di Valhalla?" dice con un'aria sorpresa. "Caspita, deve aver attirato l'attenzione di qualcuno nel governo per essere spostato lì. Le servono indicazioni?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Yes, please."|1308|0
units.english: "Yes, please."
units.italian: "Sì, per favore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Whose attention would he have gotten, exactly?"|1310|0
units.english: "Whose attention would he have gotten, exactly?"
units.italian: "L'attenzione di chi, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"There are a number of officials in his line of work here, so it would be hard to say."|1311|0
units.english: "There are a number of officials in his line of work here, so it would be hard to say."
units.italian: "Ci sono diversi funzionari nel suo campo, quindi è difficile dirlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You get directions from the receptionist and thank him for his time. It turns out that this Institute is in the heart of the university district of the spaceport city. Several planets in the Deep, Paradise Worlds, and even many near Earth have a similar university district, but the one on Valhalla is the largest of its kind in the entire Republic.|1313|0
units.english: You get directions from the receptionist and thank him for his time. It turns out that this Institute is in the heart of the university district of the spaceport city. Several planets in the Deep, Paradise Worlds, and even many near Earth have a similar university district, but the one on Valhalla is the largest of its kind in the entire Republic.
units.italian: Ottieni le indicazioni dall'impiegato e lo ringrazi per il tempo. Scopri che l'Istituto è nel cuore del distretto universitario della città-spazioporto. Diversi pianeti del Deep, dei Mondi Paradisiaci e persino molti vicini alla Terra hanno un distretto universitario simile, ma quello su Valhalla è il più grande del suo genere in tutta la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	As you enter the district, you note that the architecture here is much more appealing than the brutalistic style of Ivan's old office building. Each edifice consists of more curves than right angles, with a textured metallic sheen decorating its surface. Brilliant facades scatter sunlight to give the area a warm glow, as opposed to directing it right into your eyes if you happen to be standing in the wrong spot. Even among all the metallic structures, there is still a good amount of greenery: well-trimmed bushes and trees line the streets, and many of the buildings are topped with gardens.|1314|0
units.english: As you enter the district, you note that the architecture here is much more appealing than the brutalistic style of Ivan's old office building. Each edifice consists of more curves than right angles, with a textured metallic sheen decorating its surface. Brilliant facades scatter sunlight to give the area a warm glow, as opposed to directing it right into your eyes if you happen to be standing in the wrong spot. Even among all the metallic structures, there is still a good amount of greenery: well-trimmed bushes and trees line the streets, and many of the buildings are topped with gardens.
units.italian: Entrando nel distretto noti che l'architettura qui è molto più attraente dello stile brutalista del vecchio edificio di Ivan. Ogni edificio ha più curve che angoli retti, con una lucentezza metallica testurizzata a decorarne la superficie. Le facciate brillanti diffondono la luce del sole per dare alla zona un bagliore caldo, invece di indirizzarla dritta negli occhi di chi si trovi nel punto sbagliato. Anche tra tutte le strutture metalliche c'è parecchio verde: cespugli e alberi ben potati costeggiano le strade, e molti edifici hanno giardini sul tetto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You ascend the stairs of the Institute, the massive building looming over you as you approach. Its more ancient design makes the building stand out from the rest of the district; the entrance is guarded by massive marble pillars that manage to not clash with the metallic sheen of the rest of the structures nearby. The interior is similarly lavish, with a sprawling lobby area peppered with reception areas and centered by a massive fountain.|1315|0
units.english: You ascend the stairs of the Institute, the massive building looming over you as you approach. Its more ancient design makes the building stand out from the rest of the district; the entrance is guarded by massive marble pillars that manage to not clash with the metallic sheen of the rest of the structures nearby. The interior is similarly lavish, with a sprawling lobby area peppered with reception areas and centered by a massive fountain.
units.italian: Sali le scale dell'Istituto, l'edificio imponente che ti sovrasta mentre ti avvicini. Il suo stile più antico lo distingue dal resto del distretto; l'ingresso è custodito da enormi colonne di marmo che riescono a non stonare con la lucentezza metallica delle altre strutture vicine. L'interno è altrettanto sfarzoso, con un atrio immenso punteggiato di zone di accoglienza e con al centro una grande fontana.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	(Approach one of the receptionist desks and ask to see Ivan Haataja.)|1317|0
units.english: (Approach one of the receptionist desks and ask to see Ivan Haataja.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati a uno dei banchi della reception e chiedi di vedere Ivan Haataja.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	The receptionist acknowledges you with a smile and then taps away at her computer. "It looks like he's available right now," she says. "We'll let him know you're coming and have someone escort you to Doctor Haataja's office shortly."|1318|0
units.english: The receptionist acknowledges you with a smile and then taps away at her computer. "It looks like he's available right now," she says. "We'll let him know you're coming and have someone escort you to Doctor Haataja's office shortly."
units.italian: La reception ti accoglie con un sorriso e poi batte le dita sul computer. "Sembra che sia disponibile adesso," dice. "Gli diremo che sta arrivando e faremo accompagnare lei all'ufficio del dottor Haataja tra poco."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	A staff member beckons you, and you follow him through what seems like endless hallways and stairwells toward your destination. The entire building seems to be as impressively decorated as the lobby, with beautiful furnishings and fine art. After some time, you finally arrive at Ivan's office. You thank the escort for bringing you here, as you surely would have been lost for hours without him, and knock on Ivan's door.|1319|0
units.english: A staff member beckons you, and you follow him through what seems like endless hallways and stairwells toward your destination. The entire building seems to be as impressively decorated as the lobby, with beautiful furnishings and fine art. After some time, you finally arrive at Ivan's office. You thank the escort for bringing you here, as you surely would have been lost for hours without him, and knock on Ivan's door.
units.italian: Un membro del personale ti fa cenno, e lo segui attraverso quelli che sembrano corridoi e scale senza fine verso la tua destinazione. L'intero edificio sembra arredato con la stessa impressionante ricchezza dell'atrio, con mobili bellissimi e opere d'arte. Dopo un po' arrivi finalmente all'ufficio di Ivan. Ringrazi la guida per avertici portato, perché senza di lui ti saresti perso per ore, e bussi alla porta di Ivan.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan opens the door with a big smile on his face. "Captain <last>! So great to see you here. Please, have a seat." He ushers you inside his office, a large room with a window wall overseeing a scenic courtyard. You sit down in a plush chair on the opposite side of a desk, leaning back to get comfortable. "I know the chairs are cozy," Ivan says with a chuckle. "Don't fall asleep on me, though."|1320|0
units.english: Ivan opens the door with a big smile on his face. "Captain <last>! So great to see you here. Please, have a seat." He ushers you inside his office, a large room with a window wall overseeing a scenic courtyard. You sit down in a plush chair on the opposite side of a desk, leaning back to get comfortable. "I know the chairs are cozy," Ivan says with a chuckle. "Don't fall asleep on me, though."
units.italian: Ivan apre la porta con un gran sorriso. "Capitano <last>! Che piacere vederla qui. Prego, si accomodi." Ti fa entrare nel suo ufficio, una stanza grande con una parete di finestre che dà su un cortile panoramico. Ti siedi su una poltrona morbida dall'altra parte di una scrivania e ti appoggi allo schienale per metterti comodo. "So che le poltrone sono accoglienti," dice Ivan con una risatina. "Però non si addormenti, mi raccomando."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He then takes a seat on his own cushioned chair. "Welcome to my office. This is miles above what I'm used to. The discoveries we were making finally attracted the attention of the Deep government, and they immediately had my office moved from the dingy complex it used to be in to here. I have you to thank for much of that work.|1323|0
units.english: He then takes a seat on his own cushioned chair. "Welcome to my office. This is miles above what I'm used to. The discoveries we were making finally attracted the attention of the Deep government, and they immediately had my office moved from the dingy complex it used to be in to here. I have you to thank for much of that work.
units.italian: Poi si siede sulla sua poltrona imbottita. "Benvenuto nel mio ufficio. Questo è molto al di sopra di quello a cui sono abituato. Le scoperte che stavamo facendo hanno finalmente attirato l'attenzione del governo del Deep, che ha subito fatto trasferire il mio ufficio dal complesso squallido di prima a qui. Devo ringraziare in gran parte te per quel lavoro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He then takes a seat on his own cushioned chair. "Welcome to my office. Much better than the old place, isn't it? The discoveries we were making finally attracted the attention of the Deep government, and they immediately had my office moved from the dingy complex it used to be in to here. I have you to thank for much of that work.|1327|0
units.english: He then takes a seat on his own cushioned chair. "Welcome to my office. Much better than the old place, isn't it? The discoveries we were making finally attracted the attention of the Deep government, and they immediately had my office moved from the dingy complex it used to be in to here. I have you to thank for much of that work.
units.italian: Poi si siede sulla sua poltrona imbottita. "Benvenuto nel mio ufficio. Molto meglio del vecchio posto, vero? Le scoperte che stavamo facendo hanno finalmente attirato l'attenzione del governo del Deep, che ha subito fatto trasferire il mio ufficio dal complesso squallido di prima a qui. Devo ringraziare in gran parte te per quel lavoro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"So. What brings you here, Captain?" he asks.|1330|0
units.english: "So. What brings you here, Captain?" he asks.
units.italian: "Allora. Cosa la porta qui, capitano?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I was wondering what your research on the wormholes and alien creatures has brought up."|1334|0
units.english: "I was wondering what your research on the wormholes and alien creatures has brought up."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo cosa abbiano dato le sue ricerche sui cunicoli e sulle creature aliene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Could I get a copy of your research on the wormholes and alien creatures?"|1335|0
units.english: "Could I get a copy of your research on the wormholes and alien creatures?"
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche sui cunicoli e sulle creature aliene?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.|1337|0
units.english: "Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.
units.italian: "Ah. Beh, c'è parecchio da dire." Ivan si appoggia allo schienale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"As far as wormholes go, we're still trying to theorize how the wormholes in this region of space work. A wormhole in the classical sense is some aberration in the fabric of spacetime that allows for instantaneous movement between two points. You can think of it like a tunnel, where you can go one way or the other. But how then does the series of wormholes that you discovered operate? Four different wormholes somehow create a loop of unidirectional travel." Ivan turns his chair and glances out at the courtyard. "We aren't yet sure how they could be functioning this way. Anything we come up with seems to violate some law of physics that we're certain is true."|1338|0
units.english: "As far as wormholes go, we're still trying to theorize how the wormholes in this region of space work.
