A wormhole in the classical sense is some aberration in the fabric of spacetime that allows for instantaneous movement between two points. You can think of it like a tunnel, where you can go one way or the other. But how then does the series of wormholes that you discovered operate? Four different wormholes somehow create a loop of unidirectional travel." Ivan turns his chair and glances out at the courtyard. "We aren't yet sure how they could be functioning this way. Anything we come up with seems to violate some law of physics that we're certain is true."
units.italian: "Quanto ai cunicoli, stiamo ancora cercando di teorizzare come funzionino quelli di questa regione di spazio. Un cunicolo nel senso classico è una qualche aberrazione del tessuto dello spaziotempo che permette uno spostamento istantaneo tra due punti. Puoi pensarlo come un tunnel, dove si va in un senso o nell'altro. Ma allora come funziona la serie di cunicoli che hai scoperto? Quattro cunicoli diversi creano in qualche modo un circuito di viaggio unidirezionale." Ivan gira la sedia e dà un'occhiata al cortile. "Non sappiamo ancora come possano funzionare così. Qualunque spiegazione ci venga in mente sembra violare qualche legge della fisica di cui siamo certi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan turns back to you. "As for those alien creatures, they're similarly intriguing. Humanity has found life on other worlds before, but it has always conformed to our ideas of what life is, given our experience on Earth centuries ago. But these creatures are something else entirely. There are no terrestrial planets in the system you found them in which could be suitable for life, so they must have evolved on the gas giants. How life can even begin in such an environment, let alone evolve to be able to travel the vacuum of space - that is a mystery to us.|1339|0
units.english: Ivan turns back to you. "As for those alien creatures, they're similarly intriguing. Humanity has found life on other worlds before, but it has always conformed to our ideas of what life is, given our experience on Earth centuries ago. But these creatures are something else entirely. There are no terrestrial planets in the system you found them in which could be suitable for life, so they must have evolved on the gas giants. How life can even begin in such an environment, let alone evolve to be able to travel the vacuum of space - that is a mystery to us.
units.italian: Ivan si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Quanto a quelle creature aliene, sono altrettanto intriganti. L'umanità ha già trovato vita su altri mondi, ma è sempre stata conforme alla nostra idea di cosa sia la vita, data la nostra esperienza sulla Terra secoli fa. Ma queste creature sono qualcosa di completamente diverso. Nel sistema in cui le hai trovate non ci sono pianeti terrestri adatti alla vita, quindi devono essersi evolute sui giganti gassosi. Come possa anche solo iniziare la vita in un ambiente simile, figuriamoci evolversi fino a viaggiare nel vuoto dello spazio: questo per noi è un mistero.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"By the way, would you like to have the honor of naming these creatures? My team has some ideas, but we're not particularly convinced by any of them, so I thought I'd ask you."|1340|0
units.english: "By the way, would you like to have the honor of naming these creatures? My team has some ideas, but we're not particularly convinced by any of them, so I thought I'd ask you."
units.italian: "A proposito, le piacerebbe avere l'onore di dare un nome a queste creature? Il mio gruppo ha qualche idea, ma nessuna ci convince davvero, così ho pensato di chiederlo a lei."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"How about 'void sprites'?"|1342|0
units.english: "How about 'void sprites'?"
units.italian: "Che ne dice di 'spettri del vuoto'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"How about 'Floaty McFloat Face'?"|1344|0
units.english: "How about 'Floaty McFloat Face'?"
units.italian: "Che ne dice di 'Floaty McFloat Face'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Sorry, I don't have any ideas."|1346|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have any ideas."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho idee."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"That's unfortunate," Ivan says. "I've been thinking of a name that references the void of space. I'll come up with something eventually."|1348|0
units.english: "That's unfortunate," Ivan says. "I've been thinking of a name that references the void of space. I'll come up with something eventually."
units.italian: "È un peccato," dice Ivan. "Stavo pensando a un nome che facesse riferimento al vuoto dello spazio. Prima o poi me ne verrà uno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"In a joking mood, I see. We're not naming them 'Floaty McFloat Face,'" Ivan says with a blank expression. "I've been thinking of something in relation to the void of space. I'll come up with something eventually."|1352|0
units.english: "In a joking mood, I see. We're not naming them 'Floaty McFloat Face,'" Ivan says with a blank expression. "I've been thinking of something in relation to the void of space. I'll come up with something eventually."
units.italian: "Mi pare di vedere che è in vena di scherzi. Non li chiameremo 'Floaty McFloat Face'," dice Ivan con un'espressione vuota. "Stavo pensando a qualcosa legato al vuoto dello spazio. Prima o poi me ne verrà uno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Void sprites," Ivan says slowly, as if letting the name sit on his tongue. "Void sprites... I like it."|1358|0
units.english: "Void sprites," Ivan says slowly, as if letting the name sit on his tongue. "Void sprites... I like it."
units.italian: "Spettri del vuoto," dice Ivan lentamente, come lasciando che il nome gli si posi sulla lingua. "Spettri del vuoto... mi piace."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.|1361|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|label|1362|0
units.english: sprites copy
units.italian: sprites copy

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped me so much, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."|1366|0
units.english: "A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped me so much, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."
units.italian: "Una copia?" Ivan fissa il vuoto per un momento. "Beh, suppongo che, visto quanto mi hai aiutato, potrei fare un'eccezione per te. Di solito non condivido i risultati con chi non fa parte del mio gruppo di ricerca finché non sono definitivi. Mi sono scottato troppe volte per questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan leans over to his desk. "This will be for your eyes only."|1367|0
units.english: Ivan leans over to his desk. "This will be for your eyes only."
units.italian: Ivan si china sulla scrivania. "Questo sarà solo per i tuoi occhi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Again?" Ivan asks. He leans over to his desk. "I like that you're so interested in my research. I suppose it only makes sense with you helping me, but typically merchant captains aren't this interested in following up on odd jobs they do."|1371|0
units.english: "Again?" Ivan asks. He leans over to his desk. "I like that you're so interested in my research. I suppose it only makes sense with you helping me, but typically merchant captains aren't this interested in following up on odd jobs they do."
units.italian: "Di nuovo?" chiede Ivan. Si china sulla scrivania. "Mi piace che tu sia così interessato alle mie ricerche. Suppongo sia naturale, visto che mi aiuti, ma di solito i capitani mercantili non sono così interessati a seguire i lavori strani che fanno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He presses a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP,' 'WLT-RP,' and 'GGA-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."|1376|0
units.english: He presses a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP,' 'WLT-RP,' and 'GGA-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."
units.italian: Preme un tasto sulla scrivania. "Abigail, potresti fare una copia delle cartelle cifrate 'TAB-RP', 'WLT-RP' e 'GGA-RP' sulla rete dell'Istituto a mio nome e portarmele in ufficio su un chip dati? Grazie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I was wondering what your research on those Remnant ship scans has brought up."|1390|0
units.english: "I was wondering what your research on those Remnant ship scans has brought up."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo cosa abbiano dato le sue ricerche su quelle scansioni delle navi dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Could I get a copy of your research on those Remnant ship scans?"|1391|0
units.english: "Could I get a copy of your research on those Remnant ship scans?"
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche su quelle scansioni delle navi dei Remnant?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.|1395|0
units.english: "Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.
units.italian: "Ah. Beh, c'è parecchio da dire." Ivan si appoggia allo schienale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"The ship scans look like nothing we've ever seen before. The ships seem to have a sort of... organic property to them. Here, let me show you." Ivan pulls up a schematic on his computer of the Remnant ships that you scanned. You're somewhat surprised that he could pull so much information from an outfit scan. "The ships look relatively normal for the most part, but their hulls have an almost organic structure to them." He zooms in on a section of the schematic that highlights the hull structure. "Now, when it comes to ships designed by, say, Betelgeuse, or even the Navy, the hull supports are arranged in triangular or square sections. But these ships have a pseudo-hexagonal design to them, completely non-uniform. It almost looks like the cell structure of some plants.|1396|0
units.english: "The ship scans look like nothing we've ever seen before. The ships seem to have a sort of... organic property to them. Here, let me show you." Ivan pulls up a schematic on his computer of the Remnant ships that you scanned. You're somewhat surprised that he could pull so much information from an outfit scan. "The ships look relatively normal for the most part, but their hulls have an almost organic structure to them." He zooms in on a section of the schematic that highlights the hull structure. "Now, when it comes to ships designed by, say, Betelgeuse, or even the Navy, the hull supports are arranged in triangular or square sections. But these ships have a pseudo-hexagonal design to them, completely non-uniform. It almost looks like the cell structure of some plants.
units.italian: "Le scansioni delle navi non somigliano a nulla che abbiamo mai visto. Le navi sembrano avere una specie di... proprietà organica. Ecco, le faccio vedere." Ivan apre sullo schermo lo schema delle navi dei Remnant che hai scansionato. Ti sorprende un po' che sia riuscito a ricavare così tante informazioni da una scansione dell'equipaggiamento. "Le navi sembrano relativamente normali per la maggior parte, ma i loro scafi hanno una struttura quasi organica." Ingrandisce una sezione dello schema che evidenzia la struttura dello scafo. "Ora, quando si tratta di navi progettate, che so, da Betelgeuse, o anche dalla Marina, i supporti dello scafo sono disposti in sezioni triangolari o quadrate. Ma queste navi hanno un disegno pseudo-esagonale, del tutto irregolare. Sembra quasi la struttura cellulare di certe piante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Aside from the strange hull structure, they also seem to have a considerable amount of equipment integrated directly into the ships themselves. Built-in scanners and ramscoops, for example. Stuff that didn't come up on the surface of the outfit scan but that we can tell is there. The smaller of the two ships you scanned also has some sort of built-in device that we can't make any sense of. It doesn't look like any sort of device that we've seen before, but it takes up a considerable portion of the ship's structure, so it must have some purpose. We'd need to get a closer look to figure out what it is."|1397|0
units.english: "Aside from the strange hull structure, they also seem to have a considerable amount of equipment integrated directly into the ships themselves. Built-in scanners and ramscoops, for example. Stuff that didn't come up on the surface of the outfit scan but that we can tell is there. The smaller of the two ships you scanned also has some sort of built-in device that we can't make any sense of. It doesn't look like any sort of device that we've seen before, but it takes up a considerable portion of the ship's structure, so it must have some purpose. We'd need to get a closer look to figure out what it is."
units.italian: "Oltre alla strana struttura dello scafo, sembrano avere anche una notevole quantità di apparecchiature integrate direttamente nelle navi. Scanner e ramscoop incorporati, per esempio. Cose che non sono emerse dalla superficie della scansione dell'equipaggiamento ma che possiamo dire che ci sono. La più piccola delle due navi che hai scansionato ha anche una specie di dispositivo incorporato di cui non riusciamo a capire nulla. Non somiglia a nessun dispositivo che abbiamo mai visto, ma occupa una porzione considerevole della struttura della nave, quindi deve avere uno scopo. Dovremmo darci un'occhiata più da vicino per capire di cosa si tratta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.|1398|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I was wondering what your research on Remnant technology has brought up."|1403|0
units.english: "I was wondering what your research on Remnant technology has brought up."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo cosa abbiano dato le sue ricerche sulla tecnologia dei Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Could I get a copy of your research on Remnant technology?"|1404|0
units.english: "Could I get a copy of your research on Remnant technology?"
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche sulla tecnologia dei Remnant?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.|1408|0
units.english: "Ah. Well, there's quite a bit to talk about." Ivan reclines in his chair.
units.italian: "Ah. Beh, c'è parecchio da dire." Ivan si appoggia allo schienale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan pulls out a schematic showing the engines you brought. "The engines you brought us are very interesting. We already mentioned to you how they're rather powerful for their size, more so than even atomic engines of a similar size, while not producing very much heat at all. Their major downside, though, seems to be the immense amount of energy they draw. The energy drain is not surprising given that they seem to be improved ion engines, but the fact that ion engines could ever become more powerful for their size than atomic engines is something spectacular. The thrusters also seem to have the ability to provide reverse thrust, making any ship with them rather maneuverable."|1409|0
units.english: Ivan pulls out a schematic showing the engines you brought. "The engines you brought us are very interesting. We already mentioned to you how they're rather powerful for their size, more so than even atomic engines of a similar size, while not producing very much heat at all. Their major downside, though, seems to be the immense amount of energy they draw. The energy drain is not surprising given that they seem to be improved ion engines, but the fact that ion engines could ever become more powerful for their size than atomic engines is something spectacular. The thrusters also seem to have the ability to provide reverse thrust, making any ship with them rather maneuverable."
units.italian: Ivan tira fuori uno schema che mostra i motori che gli hai portato. "I motori che ci hai portato sono molto interessanti. Ti abbiamo già detto quanto siano potenti per le loro dimensioni, più persino dei motori atomici di dimensioni simili, senza produrre quasi calore. Il loro grosso difetto, però, sembra essere l'enorme quantità di energia che assorbono. Il consumo non sorprende, visto che sembrano motori a ioni migliorati, ma il fatto che dei motori a ioni possano diventare più potenti per dimensioni dei motori atomici è qualcosa di spettacolare. Anche i propulsori sembrano poter fornire spinta inversa, rendendo molto maneggevole qualsiasi nave che li monti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He pulls out a schematic showing the generator. "The generator, on the other hand, wasn't all too interesting. Little more than an improved generator of the type you might find down in the Rim. Somewhat interesting in that it doesn't produce much energy when compared to something like a fusion reactor, given the energy requirement of their engines, but I suppose these people are concerned more with keeping their ships running cool than with having extra power output. Another interesting characteristic we discovered is that the generator seemed to ameliorate the effects of ionization, like that which the Hai Ion Cannons apply, much better than normal. It seemed to be an intentional aspect of the generator's design."|1413|0
units.english: He pulls out a schematic showing the generator. "The generator, on the other hand, wasn't all too interesting. Little more than an improved generator of the type you might find down in the Rim. Somewhat interesting in that it doesn't produce much energy when compared to something like a fusion reactor, given the energy requirement of their engines, but I suppose these people are concerned more with keeping their ships running cool than with having extra power output. Another interesting characteristic we discovered is that the generator seemed to ameliorate the effects of ionization, like that which the Hai Ion Cannons apply, much better than normal. It seemed to be an intentional aspect of the generator's design."
units.italian: Tira fuori uno schema che mostra il generatore. "Il generatore, invece, non era poi così interessante. Poco più di un generatore migliorato del tipo che si trova nel Rim. Un po' interessante il fatto che non produca molta energia rispetto a un reattore a fusione, considerato il fabbisogno dei loro motori, ma suppongo che questa gente si preoccupi più di mantenere le navi fresche che di avere potenza in eccesso. Un'altra caratteristica interessante che abbiamo scoperto è che il generatore sembra mitigare gli effetti della ionizzazione, come quella applicata dai Cannoni Ionici degli Hai, molto meglio del normale. Sembrava un aspetto intenzionale del progetto del generatore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He then pulls out a schematic showing the weapon. "And finally, the weapon you brought us. The Inhibitor Cannon is quite the technological marvel, having properties we've never seen before. Imagine a Particle Cannon, but half the size and with more range. Two Inhibitor Cannons would take up about the same amount of space as a single Particle Cannon, yet the Inhibitor Cannons would deal more damage. On top of that, the projectiles of the Inhibitor Cannons have the strange ability to slow down any ship they hit. Ships that we tested them on were unable to turn and accelerate at their normal rates."|1417|0
units.english: He then pulls out a schematic showing the weapon. "And finally, the weapon you brought us. The Inhibitor Cannon is quite the technological marvel, having properties we've never seen before. Imagine a Particle Cannon, but half the size and with more range. Two Inhibitor Cannons would take up about the same amount of space as a single Particle Cannon, yet the Inhibitor Cannons would deal more damage. On top of that, the projectiles of the Inhibitor Cannons have the strange ability to slow down any ship they hit. Ships that we tested them on were unable to turn and accelerate at their normal rates."
units.italian: Poi tira fuori uno schema che mostra l'arma. "E infine l'arma che ci hai portato. Il Cannone Inibitore è davvero una meraviglia tecnologica, con proprietà che non abbiamo mai visto. Immagina un Cannone a Particelle, ma grande la metà e con più gittata. Due Cannoni Inibitori occuperebbero più o meno lo stesso spazio di un singolo Cannone a Particelle, eppure farebbero più danni. In più, i proiettili dei Cannoni Inibitori hanno la strana capacità di rallentare qualsiasi nave colpiscano. Le navi su cui li abbiamo provati non riuscivano a girare e accelerare ai loro ritmi normali."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.|1420|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped me so much, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."|1428|0
units.english: "A copy?" Ivan looks off into space for a moment. "Well, I suppose since you helped me so much, I could make an exception for you. I typically don't share findings with those not on my research team until they're finalized. I've been burned one too many times because of that."
units.italian: "Una copia?" Ivan fissa il vuoto per un momento. "Beh, suppongo che, visto quanto mi hai aiutato, potrei fare un'eccezione per te. Di solito non condivido i risultati con chi non fa parte del mio gruppo di ricerca finché non sono definitivi. Mi sono scottato troppe volte per questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan leans over to his desk. "This will be for your eyes only."|1429|0
units.english: Ivan leans over to his desk. "This will be for your eyes only."
units.italian: Ivan si china sulla scrivania. "Questo sarà solo per i tuoi occhi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Understood."|1431|0
units.english: "Understood."
units.italian: "Capito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Actually, I was hoping to show it to someone else who's interested."|1433|0
units.english: "Actually, I was hoping to show it to someone else who's interested."
units.italian: "In realtà speravo di mostrarla a qualcun altro che è interessato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan stares at you for a moment. "I... see. Thanks for your honesty, but I can't give you a copy. That research is classified."|1436|0
units.english: Ivan stares at you for a moment. "I... see. Thanks for your honesty, but I can't give you a copy. That research is classified."
units.italian: Ivan ti fissa per un momento. "Vedo. Grazie per la sincerità, ma non posso darti una copia. Quella ricerca è riservata."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Again?" Ivan asks. He leans over to his desk. "I like that you're so interested in my research. I suppose it only makes sense with you helping me, but typically merchant captains aren't this interested in following up on odd jobs they do."|1440|0
units.english: "Again?" Ivan asks. He leans over to his desk. "I like that you're so interested in my research. I suppose it only makes sense with you helping me, but typically merchant captains aren't this interested in following up on odd jobs they do."
units.italian: "Di nuovo?" chiede Ivan. Si china sulla scrivania. "Mi piace che tu sia così interessato alle mie ricerche. Suppongo sia naturale, visto che mi aiuti, ma di solito i capitani mercantili non sono così interessati a seguire i lavori strani che fanno."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He presses a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP' and 'RTS-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."|1458|0
units.english: He presses a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP' and 'RTS-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."
units.italian: Preme un tasto sulla scrivania. "Abigail, potresti fare una copia delle cartelle cifrate 'TAB-RP' e 'RTS-RP' sulla rete dell'Istituto a mio nome e portarmele in ufficio su un chip dati? Grazie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He hesitates for a moment before pressing a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP' and 'RTS-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you.|1464|0
units.english: He hesitates for a moment before pressing a button on the desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders 'TAB-RP' and 'RTS-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you.
units.italian: Esita un momento prima di premere un tasto sulla scrivania. "Abigail, potresti fare una copia delle cartelle cifrate 'TAB-RP' e 'RTS-RP' sulla rete dell'Istituto a mio nome e portarmele in ufficio su un chip dati? Grazie.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"So, not handing this off to anyone, are we?" he asks you.|1465|0
units.english: "So, not handing this off to anyone, are we?" he asks you.
units.italian: "Quindi non la passiamo a nessuno, vero?" ti chiede.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Of course not."|1467|0
units.english: "Of course not."
units.italian: "Certamente no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No. Why do you ask?"|1469|0
units.english: "No. Why do you ask?"
units.italian: "No. Perché me lo chiedi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Just curious," he responds.|1470|0
units.english: "Just curious," he responds.
units.italian: "Solo curiosità," risponde.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Good," he responds.|1473|0
units.english: "Good," he responds.
units.italian: "Bene," risponde.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He hesitates for a moment, looks up at you, then presses a button on the desk while still looking into your eyes. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders... 'TAI-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."|1479|0
units.english: He hesitates for a moment, looks up at you, then presses a button on the desk while still looking into your eyes. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of the encrypted folders... 'TAI-RP' on the Institute network under my name and bring them to my office in a data chip? Thank you."
units.italian: Esita un momento, alza lo sguardo su di te, poi preme un tasto sulla scrivania continuando a guardarti negli occhi. "Abigail, potresti fare una copia delle cartelle cifrate... 'TAI-RP' sulla rete dell'Istituto a mio nome e portarmele in ufficio su un chip dati? Grazie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"So, you said you knew of the Remnant before working with me, right?" he asks you.|1480|0
units.english: "So, you said you knew of the Remnant before working with me, right?" he asks you.
units.italian: "Quindi, hai detto che conoscevi i Remnant prima di lavorare con me, giusto?" ti chiede.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Yeah. Why do you ask?"|1482|0
units.english: "Yeah. Why do you ask?"
units.italian: "Sì. Perché me lo chiedi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Not that I recall."|1483|0
units.english: "Not that I recall."
units.italian: "Non che io ricordi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Just curious. Do you care to tell me what your relationship with them is like?"|1485|0
units.english: "Just curious. Do you care to tell me what your relationship with them is like?"
units.italian: "Solo curiosità. Ti va di raccontarmi che tipo di rapporto hai con loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Well I seem to recall that being what you told me. Do you care to tell me what your relationship with them is like?"|1488|0
units.english: "Well I seem to recall that being what you told me. Do you care to tell me what your relationship with them is like?"
units.italian: "Beh, mi sembra di ricordare che sia quello che mi hai detto. Ti va di raccontarmi che tipo di rapporto hai con loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I just do odd jobs for them. Nothing official."|1491|0
units.english: "I just do odd jobs for them. Nothing official."
units.italian: "Faccio qualche lavoro per loro. Niente di ufficiale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I'd rather not disclose that."|1492|0
units.english: "I'd rather not disclose that."
units.italian: "Preferirei non dirlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Interesting," he says.|1493|0
units.english: "Interesting," he says.
units.italian: "Interessante," dice.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He reaches for a button on his desk, then pulls away from it and turns his chair toward the courtyard. "Never mind. I can't give you a copy. That research is classified."|1499|0
units.english: He reaches for a button on his desk, then pulls away from it and turns his chair toward the courtyard. "Never mind. I can't give you a copy. That research is classified."
units.italian: Allunga la mano verso un tasto sulla scrivania, poi la ritrae e gira la sedia verso il cortile. "Lascia perdere. Non posso darti una copia. Quella ricerca è riservata."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Okay. I'll just head out then."|1501|0
units.english: "Okay. I'll just head out then."
units.italian: "Va bene. Me ne vado, allora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"But I helped you with it. I really can't see it?"|1503|0
units.english: "But I helped you with it. I really can't see it?"
units.italian: "Ma ti ho aiutato con quella ricerca. Davvero non posso vederla?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No, you can't see it. Is there a problem with that?"|1505|0
units.english: "No, you can't see it. Is there a problem with that?"
units.italian: "No, non puoi vederla. C'è qualche problema?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Yes. I need that research."|1507|0
units.english: "Yes. I need that research."
units.italian: "Sì. Mi serve quella ricerca."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No, there's no problem. I'll just see myself out."|1508|0
units.english: "No, there's no problem. I'll just see myself out."
units.italian: "No, nessun problema. Me ne vado da solo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He turns his chair back to you and stands up. "News flash, pal. I'm on to you. You asked for the research I had back before we had entered the wormhole in Terminus, and then you later told me that you'd already been through there and met these Remnant. Then, when I asked you to help me learn more about them, you said no. I think you're covering for them in some way and giving them information on what I know. Why you're doing that, I don't know, but that's what my gut says, and I've learned to trust my gut on feelings like these. Now get out of my office."|1511|0
units.english: He turns his chair back to you and stands up. "News flash, pal. I'm on to you. You asked for the research I had back before we had entered the wormhole in Terminus, and then you later told me that you'd already been through there and met these Remnant. Then, when I asked you to help me learn more about them, you said no. I think you're covering for them in some way and giving them information on what I know. Why you're doing that, I don't know, but that's what my gut says, and I've learned to trust my gut on feelings like these. Now get out of my office."
units.italian: Gira di nuovo la sedia verso di te e si alza. "Novità, amico. Ti ho sgamato. Mi hai chiesto la ricerca che avevo prima che entrassimo nel cunicolo a Terminus, e poi mi hai detto che ci eri già passato e che avevi incontrato questi Remnant. Poi, quando ti ho chiesto di aiutarmi a saperne di più su di loro, hai detto no. Penso che tu li stia coprendo in qualche modo e che gli stia passando informazioni su quello che so. Perché lo fai non lo so, ma è quello che mi dice l'istinto, e ho imparato a fidarmi dell'istinto su sensazioni così. Ora esci dal mio ufficio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"You've got me. I'll leave."|1513|0
units.english: "You've got me. I'll leave."
units.italian: "Mi hai beccato. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"You have it all wrong, Ivan."|1515|0
units.english: "You have it all wrong, Ivan."
units.italian: "Hai capito tutto male, Ivan."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I said get out of my office. Or do I need to call security?" Ivan hovers his finger over the button on the desk.|1516|0
units.english: "I said get out of my office. Or do I need to call security?" Ivan hovers his finger over the button on the desk.
units.italian: "Ho detto esci dal mio ufficio. O devo chiamare la sicurezza?" Ivan tiene il dito sospeso sopra il tasto della scrivania.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Okay, okay. I'll leave."|1518|0
units.english: "Okay, okay. I'll leave."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I think you do need to call security. I'm not leaving without that research."|1520|0
units.english: "I think you do need to call security. I'm not leaving without that research."
units.italian: "Credo che tu debba davvero chiamare la sicurezza. Non me ne vado senza quella ricerca."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan presses down on the button. "Security. I have a guest in my office who is no longer welcome."|1521|0
units.english: Ivan presses down on the button. "Security. I have a guest in my office who is no longer welcome."
units.italian: Ivan preme il tasto. "Sicurezza. Ho un ospite nel mio ufficio che non è più gradito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Not even thirty seconds later, a group of security guards enter the office. "<first> <last>, you're going to need to come with us," one of them says.|1522|0
units.english: Not even thirty seconds later, a group of security guards enter the office. "<first> <last>, you're going to need to come with us," one of them says.
units.italian: Nemmeno trenta secondi dopo, un gruppo di guardie di sicurezza entra nell'ufficio. "<first> <last>, devi venire con noi," dice una di loro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Okay, okay. I'll leave."|1524|0
units.english: "Okay, okay. I'll leave."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I don't think so."|1526|0
units.english: "I don't think so."
units.italian: "Non credo proprio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Well I think so," the security guard quips back, pulling a taser from his holster. The other security guards equip various equipment of their own, some of it looking lethal. "I'm going to give you one more chance to leave."|1530|0
units.english: "Well I think so," the security guard quips back, pulling a taser from his holster. The other security guards equip various equipment of their own, some of it looking lethal. "I'm going to give you one more chance to leave."
units.italian: "Beh, io credo di sì," ribatte la guardia, tirando fuori un taser dalla fondina. Le altre guardie prendono le loro attrezzature, alcune delle quali sembrano letali. "Ti do un'altra possibilità di andartene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Okay, okay. I'll leave."|1532|0
units.english: "Okay, okay. I'll leave."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene. Me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Well you're going to need to make me leave."|1534|0
units.english: "Well you're going to need to make me leave."
units.italian: "Beh, dovrai farmi andare via."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Before you can even finish your sentence, you can already feel your muscles tensing up from the taser. You collapse, hitting your head on Ivan's desk as you go down. Before you lose consciousness from the impact, you hear Ivan yell, "Come on! Now I'm going to need to get a new desk."|1536|0
units.english: Before you can even finish your sentence, you can already feel your muscles tensing up from the taser. You collapse, hitting your head on Ivan's desk as you go down. Before you lose consciousness from the impact, you hear Ivan yell, "Come on! Now I'm going to need to get a new desk."
units.italian: Prima che tu possa finire la frase, senti già i muscoli irrigidirsi per il taser. Cadi, battendo la testa sulla scrivania di Ivan mentre vai giù. Prima di perdere i sensi per il colpo, senti Ivan gridare: "Dai! Ora mi servirà una scrivania nuova."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You eventually wake up in a cell with handcuffs on. You look around and see a security guard looking at you from outside of the cell. "Ah, you're finally awake." The guard opens the cell. "Doctor Haataja says he isn't going to be pressing charges. Right this way, please."|1537|0
units.english: You eventually wake up in a cell with handcuffs on. You look around and see a security guard looking at you from outside of the cell. "Ah, you're finally awake." The guard opens the cell. "Doctor Haataja says he isn't going to be pressing charges. Right this way, please."
units.italian: Alla fine ti svegli in una cella con le manette ai polsi. Ti guardi intorno e vedi una guardia di sicurezza che ti osserva dall'esterno della cella. "Ah, finalmente sveglio." La guardia apre la cella. "Il dottor Haataja dice che non sporgerà denuncia. Da questa parte, prego."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	The guard escorts you out of the cell, which was inside the security office of the Institute, near the lobby. You get some puzzled looks from those in the lobby as you're escorted by the security guard in cuffs. After bringing you outside, the guard unlocks the cuffs. "Don't cause any more trouble, now," he says.|1538|0
units.english: The guard escorts you out of the cell, which was inside the security office of the Institute, near the lobby. You get some puzzled looks from those in the lobby as you're escorted by the security guard in cuffs. After bringing you outside, the guard unlocks the cuffs. "Don't cause any more trouble, now," he says.
units.italian: La guardia ti accompagna fuori dalla cella, che si trovava nell'ufficio di sicurezza dell'Istituto, vicino all'atrio. Ricevi qualche sguardo perplesso da chi è nell'atrio mentre vieni scortato ammanettato dalla guardia. Dopo averti portato fuori, la guardia ti toglie le manette. "Non causare altri guai, adesso," dice.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	The security guards escort you out of Ivan's office, and then out of the building. Looks like the Remnant won't be getting what they were hoping for.|1542|0
units.english: The security guards escort you out of Ivan's office, and then out of the building. Looks like the Remnant won't be getting what they were hoping for.
units.italian: Le guardie ti scortano fuori dall'ufficio di Ivan, e poi fuori dall'edificio. Sembra che i Remnant non otterranno quello che speravano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You back out of Ivan's office with him looking at you the entire time. Looks like the Remnant won't be getting what they were hoping for.|1546|0
units.english: You back out of Ivan's office with him looking at you the entire time. Looks like the Remnant won't be getting what they were hoping for.
units.italian: Indietreggi fuori dall'ufficio di Ivan mentre lui ti guarda per tutto il tempo. Sembra che i Remnant non otterranno quello che speravano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan smiles, but it looks forced. "Come back any time you want. You're free to roam the Institute whenever you desire. Most of the building is closed to the public, but I can always mark you as my guest whenever you're interested in looking around."|1550|0
units.english: Ivan smiles, but it looks forced. "Come back any time you want. You're free to roam the Institute whenever you desire. Most of the building is closed to the public, but I can always mark you as my guest whenever you're interested in looking around."
units.italian: Ivan sorride, ma sembra forzato. "Torna quando vuoi. Sei libero di girare per l'Istituto quando desideri. La maggior parte dell'edificio è chiusa al pubblico, ma posso sempre segnarti come mio ospite quando ti interessa dare un'occhiata in giro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan laughs as he reclines in his chair. "Screw that. You should see what I've been able to recover from those sensor cubes you placed.|1554|0
units.english: Ivan laughs as he reclines in his chair. "Screw that. You should see what I've been able to recover from those sensor cubes you placed.
units.italian: Ivan ride appoggiandosi allo schienale. "Ma figurati. Dovresti vedere cosa sono riuscito a recuperare da quei cubi sensore che hai piazzato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I was wondering what came of those sensor cubes I placed."|1559|0
units.english: "I was wondering what came of those sensor cubes I placed."
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo che fine avessero fatto quei cubi sensore che ho piazzato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Could I get a copy of what you've found from those sensor cubes?"|1560|0
units.english: "Could I get a copy of what you've found from those sensor cubes?"
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia di quello che ha trovato con quei cubi sensore?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Ivan laughs as he reclines in his chair. "Oh, it's absolutely fascinating what I've been able to find.|1562|0
units.english: Ivan laughs as he reclines in his chair. "Oh, it's absolutely fascinating what I've been able to find.
units.italian: Ivan ride appoggiandosi allo schienale. "Oh, è assolutamente affascinante quello che sono riuscito a trovare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"With a cube in each of the Remnant systems, I was able to track all of their fleet movements, and I've discovered some interesting things. For one, ships either make trips between the three systems, or they leave the cluster entirely for significant amounts of time, often for at least a month. There weren't very many ships or fleets that took shorter trips out of the cluster, say only one or two weeks in length. Seems they're sending people on rather lengthy missions.|1564|0
units.english: "With a cube in each of the Remnant systems, I was able to track all of their fleet movements, and I've discovered some interesting things. For one, ships either make trips between the three systems, or they leave the cluster entirely for significant amounts of time, often for at least a month. There weren't very many ships or fleets that took shorter trips out of the cluster, say only one or two weeks in length. Seems they're sending people on rather lengthy missions.
units.italian: "Con un cubo in ciascuno dei sistemi dei Remnant sono riuscito a tracciare tutti i movimenti della loro flotta, e ho scoperto cose interessanti. Per cominciare, le navi o fanno viaggi tra i tre sistemi, o lasciano del tutto l'ammasso per periodi significativi, spesso almeno un mese. Non c'erano molte navi o flotte che facessero viaggi più brevi fuori dall'ammasso, diciamo di una o due settimane. Sembra che mandino gente in missioni piuttosto lunghe.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Aside from fleet movements, the number of ships was also of note. The cubes track the number of unique ships seen, and they rarely tracked the same ship more than a handful of times. The Remnant seem to have an incredible number of ships, more than perhaps Deep Security and the Navy combined. Certainly impressive for a group consisting of only three star systems. The cubes are also able to make low quality scans of any ships in the system. While each individual scan provides less than what an outfit scan would render, given enough scans, one can get a clearer picture of the ship's composition. These ship scan results were... interesting, though. There seemed to be very few ships like the ones you scanned. Perhaps those were their most advanced ships, but the rest of what I was able to see didn't seem more powerful than your average merchant ship."|1565|0
units.english: "Aside from fleet movements, the number of ships was also of note. The cubes track the number of unique ships seen, and they rarely tracked the same ship more than a handful of times. The Remnant seem to have an incredible number of ships, more than perhaps Deep Security and the Navy combined. Certainly impressive for a group consisting of only three star systems. The cubes are also able to make low quality scans of any ships in the system. While each individual scan provides less than what an outfit scan would render, given enough scans, one can get a clearer picture of the ship's composition. These ship scan results were... interesting, though. There seemed to be very few ships like the ones you scanned. Perhaps those were their most advanced ships, but the rest of what I was able to see didn't seem more powerful than your average merchant ship."
units.italian: "Oltre ai movimenti della flotta, anche il numero di navi era degno di nota. I cubi tracciano il numero di navi distinte viste, e raramente hanno tracciato la stessa nave più di una manciata di volte. I Remnant sembrano avere un numero incredibile di navi, forse più della Sicurezza del Deep e della Marina messe insieme. Davvero impressionante per un gruppo che consiste di soli tre sistemi stellari. I cubi sono anche in grado di fare scansioni di bassa qualità delle navi nel sistema. Anche se ogni singola scansione fornisce meno di una scansione dell'equipaggiamento, con abbastanza scansioni si può avere un quadro più chiaro della composizione della nave. I risultati di queste scansioni però erano... interessanti. Sembravano esserci pochissime navi come quelle che hai scansionato. Forse erano le loro navi più avanzate, ma il resto di quello che ho potuto vedere non sembrava più potente di un normale mercantile."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"I actually lost connection to the cubes a few weeks ago now, but I'd gathered enough information already."|1566|0
units.english: "I actually lost connection to the cubes a few weeks ago now, but I'd gathered enough information already."
units.italian: "In realtà ho perso la connessione ai cubi qualche settimana fa, ma avevo già raccolto abbastanza informazioni."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.|1567|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get a copy of your research?" you ask.
units.italian: "Potrei avere una copia delle sue ricerche?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|label|1568|0
units.english: surveillance copy
units.italian: surveillance copy

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"A copy? Of course! Of course! You're the reason I have any of this information in the first place, so you have every right to it." Ivan presses a button on his desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of everything on the Institute network under my name and bring it to my office in a data chip? Thank you."|1569|0
units.english: "A copy? Of course! Of course! You're the reason I have any of this information in the first place, so you have every right to it." Ivan presses a button on his desk. "Abigail, could you please make a copy of everything on the Institute network under my name and bring it to my office in a data chip? Thank you."
units.italian: "Una copia? Ma certo! Ma certo! Sei tu la ragione per cui ho tutte queste informazioni, quindi ne hai pieno diritto." Ivan preme un tasto sulla scrivania. "Abigail, potresti fare una copia di tutto quello che c'è sulla rete dell'Istituto a mio nome e portarmela in ufficio su un chip dati? Grazie."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Only a few minutes later, there is a knock at the door. Ivan retrieves the data chip from the person who brought it, then plugs it into a computer on his desk. "Let me reencrypt these then leave the new key in the chip for you. Leaving the key right next to the lock isn't exactly the most secure thing to do, but I take it you'll be smart enough to remedy that whenever you use this. Aaaand... done." He pulls the chip from his computer and hands it to you.|1574|0
units.english: Only a few minutes later, there is a knock at the door. Ivan retrieves the data chip from the person who brought it, then plugs it into a computer on his desk. "Let me reencrypt these then leave the new key in the chip for you. Leaving the key right next to the lock isn't exactly the most secure thing to do, but I take it you'll be smart enough to remedy that whenever you use this. Aaaand... done." He pulls the chip from his computer and hands it to you.
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo bussano alla porta. Ivan ritira il chip dati dalla persona che l'ha portato, poi lo collega a un computer sulla scrivania. "Fammi ricifrare questi, poi ti lascio la chiave nuova nel chip. Lasciare la chiave accanto alla serratura non è esattamente la cosa più sicura da fare, ma immagino che sarai abbastanza furbo da rimediare ogni volta che lo usi. Eee... fatto." Estrae il chip dal computer e te lo porge.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Anything else?" he asks.|1575|0
units.english: "Anything else?" he asks.
units.italian: "Altro?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No. That's all I was here for," you respond. "Good luck on the rest of your work."|1576|0
units.english: "No. That's all I was here for," you respond. "Good luck on the rest of your work."
units.italian: "No. Era tutto," rispondi. "Buona fortuna con il resto del suo lavoro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Thank you," Ivan says. "Come back any time you want. You're free to roam the Institute whenever you desire. Most of the building is closed to the public, but I can always mark you as my guest whenever you're interested in looking around."|1577|0
units.english: "Thank you," Ivan says. "Come back any time you want. You're free to roam the Institute whenever you desire. Most of the building is closed to the public, but I can always mark you as my guest whenever you're interested in looking around."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice Ivan. "Torna quando vuoi. Sei libero di girare per l'Istituto quando desideri. La maggior parte dell'edificio è chiusa al pubblico, ma posso sempre segnarti come mio ospite quando ti interessa dare un'occhiata in giro."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	When you return to <origin>, you approach the information desk that Torza told you to go to. You tell the person at the desk that you're here to meet Torza. They have you wait on a bench nearby, and Torza arrives some time later. "Hello, Captain. I take it you have a copy of the findings."|1583|0
units.english: When you return to <origin>, you approach the information desk that Torza told you to go to. You tell the person at the desk that you're here to meet Torza. They have you wait on a bench nearby, and Torza arrives some time later. "Hello, Captain. I take it you have a copy of the findings."
units.italian: Quando torni su <origin>, ti avvicini al banco informazioni a cui Torza ti ha detto di andare. Dici alla persona al banco che sei lì per incontrare Torza. Ti fanno aspettare su una panchina lì vicino, e Torza arriva qualche tempo dopo. "Salve, capitano. Immagino che abbia una copia dei risultati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "Interesting research they have done," he says. "So they understand that it is a wormhole, but still have no means of passing through to the other side." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. "We will keep hold of this information. For the time being we have little to fear, but I ask that you inform us if they make any further progress. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1613|0
units.english: You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "Interesting research they have done," he says. "So they understand that it is a wormhole, but still have no means of passing through to the other side." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. "We will keep hold of this information. For the time being we have little to fear, but I ask that you inform us if they make any further progress. May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: Porgi a Torza il chip dati che ti ha dato Ivan. Torza lo prende e lo collega a un terminale dietro il banco. Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta, annuendo e grattandosi il mento in vari punti. "Interessante la ricerca che hanno fatto," dice. "Quindi hanno capito che è un cunicolo, ma non hanno ancora modo di passare dall'altra parte." Torza rimuove il chip dal terminale e se lo mette in tasca. "Terremo noi queste informazioni. Per il momento abbiamo poco da temere, ma ti chiedo di informarci se faranno altri progressi. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "They seem to have taken a liking to the void sprites," he says. "It is human nature to be curious, and they will be kept curious by the void sprites for a while. This buys us time." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. "We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture further into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1617|0
units.english: You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "They seem to have taken a liking to the void sprites," he says. "It is human nature to be curious, and they will be kept curious by the void sprites for a while. This buys us time." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. "We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture further into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: Porgi a Torza il chip dati che ti ha dato Ivan. Torza lo prende e lo collega a un terminale dietro il banco. Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta, annuendo e grattandosi il mento in vari punti. "Sembrano aver preso simpatia per gli spettri del vuoto," dice. "È nella natura umana essere curiosi, e gli spettri del vuoto li terranno curiosi per un po'. Questo ci fa guadagnare tempo." Torza rimuove il chip dal terminale e se lo mette in tasca. "Terremo noi queste informazioni e terremo d'occhio il Threshold nel caso decidano di avventurarsi più a fondo nella Distesa di Braci. Se dovesse accadere, ci rivolgeremo a te. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "Impressive that you've brought us so much," he says. "This appears to be absolutely everything they know about us. While the situation is not ideal, at the very least we now know what they know and can use that to our advantage." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. He then pulls out what you recognize as the sensor cubes you placed on the Remnant worlds and puts them on the table. "We disabled these some time ago, but not before feeding them some junk data. And judging by this information, it worked. We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1621|0
units.english: You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "Impressive that you've brought us so much," he says. "This appears to be absolutely everything they know about us. While the situation is not ideal, at the very least we now know what they know and can use that to our advantage." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. He then pulls out what you recognize as the sensor cubes you placed on the Remnant worlds and puts them on the table. "We disabled these some time ago, but not before feeding them some junk data. And judging by this information, it worked. We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."
units.italian: Porgi a Torza il chip dati che ti ha dato Ivan. Torza lo prende e lo collega a un terminale dietro il banco. Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta, annuendo e grattandosi il mento in vari punti. "Impressionante che ci abbia portato così tanto," dice. "Sembra essere assolutamente tutto quello che sanno di noi. La situazione non è ideale, ma almeno ora sappiamo cosa sanno e possiamo usarlo a nostro vantaggio." Torza rimuove il chip dal terminale e se lo mette in tasca. Poi tira fuori quelli che riconosci come i cubi sensore che hai piazzato sui mondi dei Remnant e li mette sul tavolo. "Li abbiamo disattivati qualche tempo fa, ma non prima di avergli dato in pasto dati inutili. E a giudicare da queste informazioni, ha funzionato. Terremo noi queste informazioni e terremo d'occhio il Threshold nel caso decidano di avventurarsi nella Distesa di Braci. Se dovesse accadere, ci rivolgeremo a te. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "So, they know of some, but not all, of our technological capabilities," he says. "We can use this fog of war to our advantage, should we need to." Torza removes the data chip from the terminal and pockets it. "We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture further into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."|1625|0

He appears to read through the research rather quickly, nodding and scratching his chin at various points. "So, they know of some, but not all, of our technological capabilities," he says. "We will keep hold of this information and keep an eye on the Threshold in case they decide to venture further into the Ember Waste. Should that occur, we will call on you. May the Embers burn bright for you."
