Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta, annuendo e grattandosi il mento in vari punti. "Quindi conoscono alcune, ma non tutte, delle nostre capacità tecnologiche," dice. "Possiamo usare questa nebbia di guerra a nostro vantaggio, se dovesse servire." Torza rimuove il chip dal terminale e se lo mette in tasca. "Terremo noi queste informazioni e terremo d'occhio il Threshold nel caso decidano di avventurarsi più a fondo nella Distesa di Braci. Se dovesse accadere, ci rivolgeremo a te. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly with a puzzled look on his face. "There is nothing here like what you mentioned that the Deep knows. Are you sure you received the correct information?"|1629|0
units.english: You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly with a puzzled look on his face. "There is nothing here like what you mentioned that the Deep knows. Are you sure you received the correct information?"
units.italian: Porgi a Torza il chip dati che ti ha dato Ivan. Torza lo prende e lo collega a un terminale dietro il banco. Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta con un'espressione perplessa. "Qui non c'è niente di simile a quello che hai detto che il Deep sa. Sei sicuro di aver ricevuto le informazioni giuste?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly with a puzzled look on his face. "This is the same information as what you brought us last time. Are you sure you received the correct information?"|1633|0
units.english: You hand Torza the data chip that Ivan gave you. Torza takes it and plugs it into a terminal behind the desk. He appears to read through the research rather quickly with a puzzled look on his face. "This is the same information as what you brought us last time. Are you sure you received the correct information?"
units.italian: Porgi a Torza il chip dati che ti ha dato Ivan. Torza lo prende e lo collega a un terminale dietro il banco. Sembra leggere la ricerca piuttosto in fretta con un'espressione perplessa. "Queste sono le stesse informazioni che ci hai portato l'altra volta. Sei sicuro di aver ricevuto le informazioni giuste?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza turns the terminal to face you. You read through it and see that all the data is on the wormhole in Terminus, but it says that they are still looking for a way to pass through it. "This isn't what I asked for," you say. "He must have purposefully given me the wrong information."|1636|0
units.english: Torza turns the terminal to face you. You read through it and see that all the data is on the wormhole in Terminus, but it says that they are still looking for a way to pass through it. "This isn't what I asked for," you say. "He must have purposefully given me the wrong information."
units.italian: Torza gira il terminale verso di te. Lo leggi e vedi che tutti i dati riguardano il cunicolo a Terminus, ma dice che stanno ancora cercando un modo per attraversarlo. "Non è quello che avevo chiesto," dici. "Deve avermi dato apposta le informazioni sbagliate."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Then he understands why you asked for it," Torza responds as he turns the terminal back and pockets the data chip.|1637|0
units.english: "Then he understands why you asked for it," Torza responds as he turns the terminal back and pockets the data chip.
units.italian: "Allora ha capito perché gliele hai chieste," risponde Torza girando di nuovo il terminale e mettendosi il chip in tasca.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No," you respond. "The lead scientist was unwilling to give me a copy of his research except on the understanding that I would keep it to myself. When I told him I wanted to be able to share it, he sent me away."|1641|0
units.english: "No," you respond. "The lead scientist was unwilling to give me a copy of his research except on the understanding that I would keep it to myself. When I told him I wanted to be able to share it, he sent me away."
units.italian: "No," rispondi. "Lo scienziato capo non voleva darmi una copia della sua ricerca se non con la promessa che l'avrei tenuta per me. Quando gli ho detto che volevo poterla condividere, mi ha mandato via."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza raises an eyebrow. "And you couldn't simply have lied to him?"|1642|0
units.english: Torza raises an eyebrow. "And you couldn't simply have lied to him?"
units.italian: Torza alza un sopracciglio. "E non potevi semplicemente mentirgli?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"Would you want me to make a habit of lying to the people I'm working with?" you ask.|1643|0
units.english: "Would you want me to make a habit of lying to the people I'm working with?" you ask.
units.italian: "Vorrebbe che mi abituassi a mentire alle persone con cui lavoro?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	He says nothing for a moment, then sighs. "I suppose that is fair enough."|1644|0
units.english: He says nothing for a moment, then sighs. "I suppose that is fair enough."
units.italian: Non dice nulla per un momento, poi sospira. "Suppongo che sia giusto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	"No," you respond. "The lead scientist guessed correctly that I was asking for his research to give to you."|1648|0
units.english: "No," you respond. "The lead scientist guessed correctly that I was asking for his research to give to you."
units.italian: "No," rispondi. "Lo scienziato capo ha capito correttamente che chiedevo la sua ricerca per darla a voi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Deep Surveillance|	Torza scratches his chin. "This is... disappointing. You've helped to place us in a scenario where a potential adversary knows much about us, but we know little about them." Torza stares at you, but doesn't appear to be angry. "Perhaps espionage is in order. But given your connections to the Deep, we will pursue such actions on our own. Should something arise in the future where we need you, we'll contact you. Until then, do not compromise our position any further. We will not take it so lightly a second time."|1651|0
units.english: Torza scratches his chin. "This is... disappointing. You've helped to place us in a scenario where a potential adversary knows much about us, but we know little about them." Torza stares at you, but doesn't appear to be angry. "Perhaps espionage is in order. But given your connections to the Deep, we will pursue such actions on our own. Should something arise in the future where we need you, we'll contact you. Until then, do not compromise our position any further. We will not take it so lightly a second time."
units.italian: Torza si gratta il mento. "Questo è... deludente. Hai contribuito a metterci in una situazione in cui un potenziale avversario sa molto di noi, mentre noi sappiamo poco di lui." Torza ti fissa, ma non sembra arrabbiato. "Forse è il caso di fare spionaggio. Ma viste le tue connessioni con il Deep, perseguiremo queste azioni per conto nostro. Se in futuro dovesse sorgere qualcosa in cui abbiamo bisogno di te, ti contatteremo. Fino ad allora, non compromettere ulteriormente la nostra posizione. Non la prenderemo alla leggera una seconda volta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|name|1657|0
units.english: Remnant Human Tech Retrieval
units.italian: Recupero di tecnologia umana per i Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|description|1658|0
units.english: The Remnant are interested in learning what advances humanity has made over the past centuries. Bring them samples of advanced technology, such as newly developed ramscoops, weapons, or shields.
units.italian: Ai Remnant interessa sapere quali progressi l'umanità ha fatto negli ultimi secoli. Porta loro campioni di tecnologia avanzata, come ramscoop, armi o scudi di nuovo sviluppo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|As you enter the spaceport, you notice someone across the plaza appears to have been waiting for you. A tall, solidly built woman in short-sleeved coveralls stands up from where she was sitting near the information desk. With a few quick gestures at the person behind the counter, she heads towards you with a confident stride. As she approaches, you note that the crowds of people moving around the plaza seem to be staying out of her way as if she were someone important.|1668|0
units.english: As you enter the spaceport, you notice someone across the plaza appears to have been waiting for you. A tall, solidly built woman in short-sleeved coveralls stands up from where she was sitting near the information desk. With a few quick gestures at the person behind the counter, she heads towards you with a confident stride. As she approaches, you note that the crowds of people moving around the plaza seem to be staying out of her way as if she were someone important.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto noti che qualcuno dall'altra parte della piazza sembra averti aspettato. Una donna alta e robusta, in tuta da lavoro a maniche corte, si alza da dove era seduta vicino al banco informazioni. Con qualche gesto rapido verso la persona al banco, si dirige verso di te con passo deciso. Mentre si avvicina noti che la folla che si muove nella piazza sembra scansarla, come se fosse una persona importante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	In contrast, she reminds you of the mechanics who maintained the textile factories back on <home planet>. In particular, the tools at her belt and the wear marks on her clothing suggest someone who is more comfortable inside a ship access duct than behind a desk.|1669|0
units.english: In contrast, she reminds you of the mechanics who maintained the textile factories back on <home planet>. In particular, the tools at her belt and the wear marks on her clothing suggest someone who is more comfortable inside a ship access duct than behind a desk.
units.italian: Al contrario, ti ricorda i meccanici che tenevano in funzione le fabbriche tessili su <home planet>. In particolare gli attrezzi alla cintura e i segni di usura sui vestiti suggeriscono qualcuno più a suo agio in un condotto di accesso di una nave che dietro una scrivania.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	Before you can decide if you want to avoid this person or not, she is standing in front of you, clearing her throat. "You are captain <first> <last> of the <ship>?" She asks in a lyrical chant.|1672|0
units.english: Before you can decide if you want to avoid this person or not, she is standing in front of you, clearing her throat. "You are captain <first> <last> of the <ship>?" She asks in a lyrical chant.
units.italian: Prima che tu decida se evitarla o no, è già davanti a te che si schiarisce la voce. "Sei il capitano <first> <last> della <ship>?" chiede in un canto lirico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"That's me."|1674|0
units.english: "That's me."
units.italian: "Sono io."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"I don't know who that is."|1676|0
units.english: "I don't know who that is."
units.italian: "Non so chi sia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	She looks at you with an inscrutable expression for a moment. "Trying to be inconspicuous is admirable. Being oblivious to the fact that you stand out like a star in empty space is not."|1677|0
units.english: She looks at you with an inscrutable expression for a moment. "Trying to be inconspicuous is admirable. Being oblivious to the fact that you stand out like a star in empty space is not."
units.italian: Ti guarda con un'espressione imperscrutabile per un momento. "Cercare di passare inosservato è ammirevole. Essere ignaro del fatto che risalti come una stella nello spazio vuoto, no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"I have an opportunity for you, if you are interested in being helpful to the Remnant." When you express your interest she leads you over to a balcony overlooking the primary shipyards. As she leans on the railing a cold breeze makes you shiver, but she seems oblivious to it. "I am known as Taely. As a prefect among the Remnant, I am responsible for this." She gestures at the shipyards, where you can see a myriad of the Remnant's alien-looking ships in various stages of construction or repair. "The ships we have serve us well, but they are old designs. Only the Ibis is comparatively new. We need new ideas, new inspiration." She pauses, focusing briefly on a small bay where several people appear to be pulling what looks like a supercapacitor out of a Puffin.|1679|0
units.english: "I have an opportunity for you, if you are interested in being helpful to the Remnant." When you express your interest she leads you over to a balcony overlooking the primary shipyards. As she leans on the railing a cold breeze makes you shiver, but she seems oblivious to it. "I am known as Taely. As a prefect among the Remnant, I am responsible for this." She gestures at the shipyards, where you can see a myriad of the Remnant's alien-looking ships in various stages of construction or repair. "The ships we have serve us well, but they are old designs. Only the Ibis is comparatively new. We need new ideas, new inspiration." She pauses, focusing briefly on a small bay where several people appear to be pulling what looks like a supercapacitor out of a Puffin.
units.italian: "Ho un'opportunità per te, se ti interessa essere utile ai Remnant." Quando esprimi interesse ti conduce su un balcone che dà sui cantieri principali. Mentre si appoggia alla ringhiera una brezza fredda ti fa rabbrividire, ma lei sembra non accorgersene. "Mi chiamo Taely. In quanto prefetto tra i Remnant, sono responsabile di questo." Fa un gesto verso i cantieri, dove puoi vedere una miriade di navi dall'aspetto alieno dei Remnant in varie fasi di costruzione o riparazione. "Le navi che abbiamo ci servono bene, ma sono progetti vecchi. Solo l'Ibis è relativamente nuovo. Ci servono idee nuove, nuova ispirazione." Si interrompe, fissando per un momento un piccolo bacino dove diverse persone sembrano tirare fuori un supercondensatore da un Puffin.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|As you enter the spaceport, you notice Taely across the plaza. She begins approaching you immediately, appearing to have been waiting for you. "Greetings, <first>. I hope you are not too busy as I have an opportunity for you." When you express interest, she leads you to a balcony overlooking the primary shipyards. She seems oblivious to the chilling breeze as she leans on the railing. "As you may have noticed in your time with us, many of our ships, while they do serve us well, are old designs. While we have recently made significant progress with a new concept, we still need new ideas and inspiration." She pauses, focusing briefly on a small bay where several people appear to be pulling what looks like a supercapacitor out of a Puffin.|1682|0
units.english: As you enter the spaceport, you notice Taely across the plaza. She begins approaching you immediately, appearing to have been waiting for you. "Greetings, <first>. I hope you are not too busy as I have an opportunity for you." When you express interest, she leads you to a balcony overlooking the primary shipyards. She seems oblivious to the chilling breeze as she leans on the railing. "As you may have noticed in your time with us, many of our ships, while they do serve us well, are old designs. While we have recently made significant progress with a new concept, we still need new ideas and inspiration." She pauses, focusing briefly on a small bay where several people appear to be pulling what looks like a supercapacitor out of a Puffin.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto noti Taely dall'altra parte della piazza. Comincia subito ad avvicinarsi, come se ti stesse aspettando. "Salve, <first>. Spero che tu non sia troppo impegnato, perché ho un'opportunità per te." Quando esprimi interesse ti conduce su un balcone che dà sui cantieri principali. Sembra non accorgersi della brezza gelida mentre si appoggia alla ringhiera. "Come forse avrai notato nel tuo tempo con noi, molte delle nostre navi, anche se ci servono bene, sono progetti vecchi. Anche se di recente abbiamo fatto progressi significativi con un nuovo concetto, ci servono ancora idee nuove e ispirazione." Si interrompe, fissando per un momento un piccolo bacino dove diverse persone sembrano tirare fuori un supercondensatore da un Puffin.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"So, what are you asking?"|1685|0
units.english: "So, what are you asking?"
units.italian: "Allora, cosa stai chiedendo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"What are they doing?"|1687|0
units.english: "What are they doing?"
units.italian: "Che cosa stanno facendo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"Oh, those are apprentices," she trills with a touch of amusement. "They need to learn how to handle unusual tech. One of the first steps is to deal with old tech. Like salvaging an obsolete supercapacitor out of that Puffin so it can be reprocessed into something useful, and replacing it with newer integrated energy storage." She glances at you in amusement. "You've flown the Puffin, you know how old that ship is: primitive energy systems, antique 'hard-shell' shields that have to be manually raised and lowered..." She trails off into momentary silence. "Be glad that you got one that had already been refurbished prior to your visit to Nenia. At least it had modern engines and an updated sensor array."|1688|0
units.english: "Oh, those are apprentices," she trills with a touch of amusement. "They need to learn how to handle unusual tech. One of the first steps is to deal with old tech. Like salvaging an obsolete supercapacitor out of that Puffin so it can be reprocessed into something useful, and replacing it with newer integrated energy storage." She glances at you in amusement. "You've flown the Puffin, you know how old that ship is: primitive energy systems, antique 'hard-shell' shields that have to be manually raised and lowered..." She trails off into momentary silence. "Be glad that you got one that had already been refurbished prior to your visit to Nenia. At least it had modern engines and an updated sensor array."
units.italian: "Oh, quelli sono apprendisti," trilla con un tocco di divertimento. "Devono imparare a maneggiare tecnologia insolita. Uno dei primi passi è occuparsi di tecnologia vecchia. Come recuperare un supercondensatore obsoleto da quel Puffin perché possa essere riprocessato in qualcosa di utile, e sostituirlo con un accumulo di energia integrato più nuovo." Ti guarda divertita. "Hai pilotato il Puffin, sai quanto è vecchia quella nave: sistemi energetici primitivi, scudi antichi 'a guscio duro' che vanno alzati e abbassati a mano..." Si interrompe in un silenzio momentaneo. "Ringrazia di averne avuto uno già rimesso a nuovo prima della tua visita a Nenia. Almeno aveva motori moderni e un array di sensori aggiornato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"To the point," her tone shifts to a more martial cadence. "We want to know how humanity has advanced in the past five and a half centuries. If you found us, I am sure it is only a matter of time until the Alphas, their servants, or others intent on galactic domination discover us. We need to know what sort of weapons they will be wielding, how their ships will be protected, and how fast they can travel in deep space."|1690|0
units.english: "To the point," her tone shifts to a more martial cadence. "We want to know how humanity has advanced in the past five and a half centuries. If you found us, I am sure it is only a matter of time until the Alphas, their servants, or others intent on galactic domination discover us. We need to know what sort of weapons they will be wielding, how their ships will be protected, and how fast they can travel in deep space."
units.italian: "Al punto," il suo tono passa a una cadenza più marziale. "Vogliamo sapere come l'umanità sia progredita negli ultimi cinque secoli e mezzo. Se hai trovato noi, sono certa che sia solo questione di tempo prima che gli Alpha, i loro servi o altri intenzionati al dominio galattico ci scoprano. Dobbiamo sapere che tipo di armi useranno, come saranno protette le loro navi e quanto veloci possano viaggiare nello spazio profondo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"Okay, I will see what I can find."|1692|0
units.english: "Okay, I will see what I can find."
units.italian: "Va bene, vedrò cosa posso trovare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"Could you elaborate on 'how fast they can travel in deep space'?"|1694|0
units.english: "Could you elaborate on 'how fast they can travel in deep space'?"
units.italian: "Potresti spiegarti meglio su 'quanto veloci possano viaggiare nello spazio profondo'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"No, I don't want to get involved in this."|1695|0
units.english: "No, I don't want to get involved in this."
units.italian: "No, non voglio essere coinvolto in questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	She considers her thoughts briefly, then chants, "How fast a ship can move through an area of deep space basically depends on how fast they can collect fuel. Ramscoops were common at the time of the exodus, and if humanity has developed better ramscoops or other means of generating fuel, these would significantly improve their speed at exploring or crossing large volumes of space."|1697|0
units.english: She considers her thoughts briefly, then chants, "How fast a ship can move through an area of deep space basically depends on how fast they can collect fuel. Ramscoops were common at the time of the exodus, and if humanity has developed better ramscoops or other means of generating fuel, these would significantly improve their speed at exploring or crossing large volumes of space."
units.italian: Riflette un momento, poi intona: "Quanto velocemente una nave può muoversi in un'area di spazio profondo dipende fondamentalmente da quanto velocemente riesce a raccogliere carburante. I ramscoop erano comuni al tempo dell'esodo, e se l'umanità ha sviluppato ramscoop migliori o altri mezzi per generare carburante, questo migliorerebbe significativamente la loro velocità nell'esplorare o attraversare grandi volumi di spazio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"Okay, I will see what I can find."|1699|0
units.english: "Okay, I will see what I can find."
units.italian: "Va bene, vedrò cosa posso trovare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	"No, I don't want to get involved in this."|1700|0
units.english: "No, I don't want to get involved in this."
units.italian: "No, non voglio essere coinvolto in questo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	Taely nods "I will look forward to seeing what you find. In the meantime, I should get back to work." With that, she swings over the railing and climbs quickly down the wall in the direction of the shipyard, seemingly unconcerned about the height.|1703|0
units.english: Taely nods "I will look forward to seeing what you find. In the meantime, I should get back to work." With that, she swings over the railing and climbs quickly down the wall in the direction of the shipyard, seemingly unconcerned about the height.
units.italian: Taely annuisce. "Non vedo l'ora di vedere cosa troverai. Nel frattempo, dovrei tornare al lavoro." Detto questo, scavalca la ringhiera e scende rapidamente lungo il muro in direzione del cantiere, apparentemente incurante dell'altezza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|label|1705|0
units.english: not help
units.italian: not help

units.id: mission:Remnant: Tech Retrieval|	Taely looks at you with a blank expression, then chants in a monotone voice. "If that is your choice, you are unlikely to find much of interest to do among us." With that, she vaults over the edge of the railing and drops from view. As you quickly peer over the railing, you discover that she must have caught a handhold somehow, as she is rapidly moving down the wall in a controlled fashion with ease of a spider.|1706|0
units.english: Taely looks at you with a blank expression, then chants in a monotone voice. "If that is your choice, you are unlikely to find much of interest to do among us." With that, she vaults over the edge of the railing and drops from view. As you quickly peer over the railing, you discover that she must have caught a handhold somehow, as she is rapidly moving down the wall in a controlled fashion with ease of a spider.
units.italian: Taely ti guarda con un'espressione vuota, poi intona con voce monotona. "Se è questa la tua scelta, è improbabile che tu trovi qualcosa di interessante da fare tra noi." Detto questo, scavalca il bordo della ringhiera e cade fuori dalla vista. Quando ti affacci rapidamente oltre la ringhiera, scopri che deve essersi aggrappata in qualche modo, perché sta scendendo rapidamente lungo il muro in modo controllato, con l'agilità di un ragno.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|name|1727|0
units.english: Retrieve Heavy Lasers
units.italian: Recupero di cannoni laser pesanti

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|description|1728|0
units.english: A Remnant engineer has asked you for a delivery of two Heavy Lasers to <planet> for them to study.
units.italian: Un ingegnere dei Remnant ti ha chiesto di consegnare due Cannoni Laser Pesanti su <planet> perché li studino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|You remember that Taely was interested in seeing examples of technology from human space. Would you like to show her your Heavy Laser?|1742|0
units.english: You remember that Taely was interested in seeing examples of technology from human space. Would you like to show her your Heavy Laser?
units.italian: Ricordi che Taely era interessata a vedere esempi di tecnologia dello spazio umano. Vuoi mostrarle il tuo Cannone Laser Pesante?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	(Not now.)|1744|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	(Yes.)|1746|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	After asking a few people, you finally get directed to a bay in the shipyard where you find Taely just finishing the installation of a Thrasher Cannon in a Starling. "Greetings, <first>. I will be down in a minute." She does a few more things inside a panel, reseals the hatch, and slides down a fin to land next to you. "So, do you have something for me?"|1749|0
units.english: After asking a few people, you finally get directed to a bay in the shipyard where you find Taely just finishing the installation of a Thrasher Cannon in a Starling. "Greetings, <first>. I will be down in a minute." She does a few more things inside a panel, reseals the hatch, and slides down a fin to land next to you. "So, do you have something for me?"
units.italian: Dopo aver chiesto a diverse persone, vieni finalmente indirizzato a un bacino del cantiere dove trovi Taely che sta appena finendo di installare un Cannone Thrasher su uno Starling. "Salve, <first>. Sarò da te tra un minuto." Fa ancora qualche cosa dentro un pannello, richiude il portello e scende lungo un'ala per atterrarti accanto. "Allora, hai qualcosa per me?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	You recall that Taely is responsible for the shipyards, so you head straight there and ask the nearest mechanic. They direct you to a large hangar tucked into a cliff face, where you find her working at a terminal filled with schematics. Behind her, the room fades quickly into darkness where you can faintly make out what appears to be a large tank and a lot of whirring machinery. As you approach she looks up from her work and turns to face you. "Ah, you have returned. Do you have something new for me?"|1752|0
units.english: You recall that Taely is responsible for the shipyards, so you head straight there and ask the nearest mechanic. They direct you to a large hangar tucked into a cliff face, where you find her working at a terminal filled with schematics. Behind her, the room fades quickly into darkness where you can faintly make out what appears to be a large tank and a lot of whirring machinery. As you approach she looks up from her work and turns to face you. "Ah, you have returned. Do you have something new for me?"
units.italian: Ricordi che Taely è responsabile dei cantieri, quindi vai dritto là e chiedi al meccanico più vicino. Ti indirizzano a un grande hangar incassato nella parete di una scogliera, dove la trovi al lavoro a un terminale pieno di schemi. Dietro di lei la stanza si perde rapidamente nel buio, dove riesci a distinguere a malapena quello che sembra un grande serbatoio e un sacco di macchinari che ronzano. Mentre ti avvicini alza lo sguardo dal lavoro e si volta verso di te. "Ah, sei tornato. Hai qualcosa di nuovo per me?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	You lead her back to your ship, where you show her the Heavy Laser. "A laser cannon?" she asks. "Our records indicate that humanity had primitive laser technology at the time of the Exodus, but nothing that would be considered useful as weapons." She pauses to look down at her scanner. "And yet my scans indicate that they are capable of significant power output." She pauses for a moment before continuing, "These could be quite useful to examine more thoroughly. Please deliver two of these Heavy Lasers to a research team on <planet>."|1754|0
units.english: You lead her back to your ship, where you show her the Heavy Laser. "A laser cannon?" she asks. "Our records indicate that humanity had primitive laser technology at the time of the Exodus, but nothing that would be considered useful as weapons." She pauses to look down at her scanner. "And yet my scans indicate that they are capable of significant power output." She pauses for a moment before continuing, "These could be quite useful to examine more thoroughly. Please deliver two of these Heavy Lasers to a research team on <planet>."
units.italian: La conduci alla tua nave, dove le mostri il Cannone Laser Pesante. "Un cannone laser?" chiede. "I nostri archivi indicano che l'umanità aveva una tecnologia laser primitiva al tempo dell'Esodo, ma niente che potesse essere considerato utile come arma." Si interrompe per guardare il suo scanner. "Eppure le mie scansioni indicano che sono capaci di una notevole potenza in uscita." Si ferma un momento prima di continuare: "Potrebbe essere molto utile esaminarli a fondo. Ti prego di consegnare due di questi Cannoni Laser Pesanti a una squadra di ricerca su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|dialog|1757|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't have the two Heavy Lasers that Taely requested. Go buy two Heavy Lasers before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai i due Cannoni Laser Pesanti che Taely ti ha chiesto. Compra due Cannoni Laser Pesanti prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|As you land on a pad adjacent to the research center, a group of researchers mount some kind of weapon on a platform aimed down a firing range. The researchers retreat behind a thick barrier and press a button to activate the weapon. A flash of light erupts from the muzzle as the target downrange is cut in half. The barrel of the weapon raises into the air, and the researchers rush out onto the range with tools and devices to inspect the damage.|1763|0
units.english: As you land on a pad adjacent to the research center, a group of researchers mount some kind of weapon on a platform aimed down a firing range. The researchers retreat behind a thick barrier and press a button to activate the weapon. A flash of light erupts from the muzzle as the target downrange is cut in half. The barrel of the weapon raises into the air, and the researchers rush out onto the range with tools and devices to inspect the damage.
units.italian: Mentre atterri su una piazzola adiacente al centro di ricerca, un gruppo di ricercatori monta una specie di arma su una piattaforma puntata verso un poligono di tiro. I ricercatori si ritirano dietro una spessa barriera e premono un pulsante per attivare l'arma. Un lampo di luce erompe dalla bocca da fuoco mentre il bersaglio in fondo al poligono viene tagliato in due. La canna dell'arma si alza in aria, e i ricercatori corrono sul poligono con attrezzi e strumenti per ispezionare i danni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	Noticing your arrival, one of the researchers veers off and heads towards you. "So, you are the one with the samples of humanity's laser weapons?" chants the researcher. "Always interesting to see new things." He turns and waves at a Remnant standing near the edge of the landing pad with a camel hitched to a wagon.|1764|0
units.english: Noticing your arrival, one of the researchers veers off and heads towards you. "So, you are the one with the samples of humanity's laser weapons?" chants the researcher. "Always interesting to see new things." He turns and waves at a Remnant standing near the edge of the landing pad with a camel hitched to a wagon.
units.italian: Notando il tuo arrivo, uno dei ricercatori devia e si dirige verso di te. "Quindi sei tu quello con i campioni delle armi laser dell'umanità?" intona il ricercatore. "È sempre interessante vedere cose nuove." Si volta e fa un cenno a un Remnant in piedi vicino al bordo della piazzola con un cammello aggiogato a un carro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Heavy Laser|	The researchers quickly unload the Heavy Lasers from your ship, and hand you a credstick with <payment>. "Thank you for bringing us something new to examine. We appreciate the breath of fresh air." With that, they quickly head off into a nearby lab, escorting their cargo of weaponry on the oddly archaic transportation.|1765|0
units.english: The researchers quickly unload the Heavy Lasers from your ship, and hand you a credstick with <payment>. "Thank you for bringing us something new to examine. We appreciate the breath of fresh air." With that, they quickly head off into a nearby lab, escorting their cargo of weaponry on the oddly archaic transportation.
units.italian: I ricercatori scaricano rapidamente i Cannoni Laser Pesanti dalla tua nave e ti consegnano un credstick con <payment>. "Grazie per averci portato qualcosa di nuovo da esaminare. Apprezziamo la ventata d'aria fresca." Detto questo, si avviano in fretta verso un laboratorio vicino, scortando il loro carico di armi su quel trasporto curiosamente arcaico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Plasma Cannon|	Aware that Taely's main area of responsibility is in the shipyards, you head straight there and have almost arrived when you are approached by another Remnant who introduces herself as one of Taely's aides. "Greetings, Captain" she trills. "Our scans picked up indications of uncatalogued human weaponry. Were you bringing it to show us?"
units.italian: Sapendo che l'area di responsabilità principale di Taely sono i cantieri, vai dritto là e sei quasi arrivato quando ti si avvicina un altro Remnant che si presenta come uno degli assistenti di Taely. "Salve, capitano," trilla. "Le nostre scansioni hanno rilevato tracce di armamento umano non catalogato. Ce lo stavi portando per mostrarci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Plasma Cannon|	You lead her back to your ship, where you show her the Plasma Cannon. "I have never seen weapons designed to handle such a high heat output! Is this some kind of plasma based weapon?" she asks, gesturing at a cannon. You nod, and she continues, "Intriguing. We have noticed that the Korath ships seem to run particularly hot, and have speculated that overheating them might be an effective means of disabling them. I would enjoy researching these a bit more. If you could deliver two to <planet> for us you would be well compensated."|1797|0
units.english: You lead her back to your ship, where you show her the Plasma Cannon. "I have never seen weapons designed to handle such a high heat output! Is this some kind of plasma based weapon?" she asks, gesturing at a cannon. You nod, and she continues, "Intriguing. We have noticed that the Korath ships seem to run particularly hot, and have speculated that overheating them might be an effective means of disabling them. I would enjoy researching these a bit more. If you could deliver two to <planet> for us you would be well compensated."
units.italian: La conduci alla tua nave, dove le mostri il Cannone al Plasma. "Non ho mai visto armi progettate per sopportare un calore in uscita così alto! È una specie di arma basata sul plasma?" chiede, indicando un cannone. Annuisci, e lei continua: "Intrigante. Abbiamo notato che le navi Korath sembrano scaldarsi particolarmente, e abbiamo ipotizzato che surriscaldarle potrebbe essere un modo efficace di metterle fuori uso. Mi piacerebbe studiare questi un po' più a fondo. Se potessi consegnarne due su <planet> per noi, saresti ben ricompensato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Plasma Cannon|dialog|1800|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't have the two Plasma Cannons that Taely requested. Go buy two Plasma Cannons before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai i due Cannoni al Plasma che Taely ti ha chiesto. Compra due Cannoni al Plasma prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Plasma Cannon|As the <ship> settles onto the pad closest to the research facility, you can see a weapons specialist checking over a large cannon on a platform beneath a nearby Albatross. When he sees you starting to unload the two Plasma Cannons, he snaps the casing closed and gestures to someone out of sight. Within moments both him and an empty flatbed are there to pick up the weapons.|1806|0
units.english: As the <ship> settles onto the pad closest to the research facility, you can see a weapons specialist checking over a large cannon on a platform beneath a nearby Albatross. When he sees you starting to unload the two Plasma Cannons, he snaps the casing closed and gestures to someone out of sight. Within moments both him and an empty flatbed are there to pick up the weapons.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> si posa sulla piazzola più vicina alla struttura di ricerca, vedi uno specialista di armi che controlla un grande cannone su una piattaforma sotto un Albatross lì vicino. Quando ti vede iniziare a scaricare i due Cannoni al Plasma, chiude di scatto l'involucro e fa un cenno a qualcuno fuori dalla vista. In pochi istanti sia lui che un pianale vuoto sono lì a ritirare le armi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Plasma Cannon|	"Thank you for your help," he says. "Our Inhibitors provide us with something of a mobility advantage against the Korath, but they aren't particularly effective at disabling them. These Plasma Cannons will open new avenues of research for us." He pauses, then continues. "I also included a bonus for you. It is a 'finder's fee,' as we always appreciate new tech."|1807|0
units.english: "Thank you for your help," he says. "Our Inhibitors provide us with something of a mobility advantage against the Korath, but they aren't particularly effective at disabling them. These Plasma Cannons will open new avenues of research for us." He pauses, then continues. "I also included a bonus for you. It is a 'finder's fee,' as we always appreciate new tech."
units.italian: "Grazie per il suo aiuto," dice. "I nostri Inibitori ci danno una specie di vantaggio di mobilità contro i Korath, ma non sono particolarmente efficaci nel metterli fuori uso. Questi Cannoni al Plasma ci apriranno nuove vie di ricerca." Si interrompe, poi continua. "Ho anche incluso un bonus per lei. È una 'commissione di ritrovamento', perché apprezziamo sempre la nuova tecnologia."

units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|	(Never.)|1963|0
units.english: (Never.)
units.italian: (Mai.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|	After asking a few people, you finally get directed to a bay in the shipyard where you find Taely adjusting something on the hull that you can't quite see. "Greetings, <first>. What brings you here today?" She taps something, then hangs her tools on her belt and drops to the ground on a tether. "Did you bring us something?"|1969|0
units.english: After asking a few people, you finally get directed to a bay in the shipyard where you find Taely adjusting something on the hull that you can't quite see. "Greetings, <first>. What brings you here today?" She taps something, then hangs her tools on her belt and drops to the ground on a tether. "Did you bring us something?"
units.italian: Dopo aver chiesto a diverse persone, vieni finalmente indirizzato a un bacino del cantiere dove trovi Taely che regola qualcosa sullo scafo che non riesci a vedere bene. "Salve, <first>. Cosa ti porta qui oggi?" Dà un colpo su qualcosa, poi appende gli attrezzi alla cintura e scende a terra con una corda. "Ci hai portato qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|	Taely seems like the sort of person who spends most of their time working directly on ships, so finding people repairing ships seems the most likely place to find her. As you enter the maintenance section, you spot an engineer waiting for you. She quickly introduces herself as an engineer who works with Taely. "She was not able to be here, so she sent me to see what you have brought" chants the engineer.|1972|0
units.english: Taely seems like the sort of person who spends most of their time working directly on ships, so finding people repairing ships seems the most likely place to find her. As you enter the maintenance section, you spot an engineer waiting for you. She quickly introduces herself as an engineer who works with Taely. "She was not able to be here, so she sent me to see what you have brought" chants the engineer.
units.italian: Taely sembra il tipo che passa la maggior parte del tempo a lavorare direttamente sulle navi, quindi cercare gente che ripara navi sembra il posto più probabile per trovarla. Entrando nella sezione di manutenzione, scorgi un ingegnere che ti aspetta. Si presenta subito come un ingegnere che lavora con Taely. "Non è potuta venire, quindi mi ha mandato a vedere cosa hai portato," intona l'ingegnere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|	You nod in the agreement and lead her back to your ship, where she does a cursory scan of the S-970 Regenerator. "Hmm," she murmurs as she peers at the readings on her instrument as she waves it up and down the regenerator. "This looks like they may have found a few techniques that would be beneficial for us to study. If you could deliver two of these to a lab on <planet> we could compensate you with <payment>."|1974|0
units.english: You nod in the agreement and lead her back to your ship, where she does a cursory scan of the S-970 Regenerator. "Hmm," she murmurs as she peers at the readings on her instrument as she waves it up and down the regenerator. "This looks like they may have found a few techniques that would be beneficial for us to study. If you could deliver two of these to a lab on <planet> we could compensate you with <payment>."
units.italian: Annuisci e la conduci alla tua nave, dove fa una scansione sommaria del Rigeneratore S-970. "Hmm," mormora guardando le letture dello strumento mentre lo passa su e giù lungo il rigeneratore. "Sembra che abbiano trovato qualche tecnica che ci sarebbe utile studiare. Se potessi consegnarne due a un laboratorio su <planet>, potremmo ricompensarti con <payment>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|dialog|1977|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but you don't have the two S-970 Regenerator that Taely requested. Go buy the two shield regenerators before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai i due Rigeneratori S-970 che Taely ti ha chiesto. Compra i due rigeneratori di scudi prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: S-970 Regenerator|On <planet> you follow the landing instructions to arrive at a pad set next to a substantial facility with a large equipment bay. As you complete your shutdown routine the doors to the bay slide open and a crawler emerges, accompanied by several Remnant. They carefully unload the S-970 Regenerators and strap them down. As they start heading back into the bay, one of them comes over to hand you <payment>. "Thank you for the new outfits to study. Our team is quite interested to see what humanity has achieved since our exodus."|1983|0
units.english: On <planet> you follow the landing instructions to arrive at a pad set next to a substantial facility with a large equipment bay. As you complete your shutdown routine the doors to the bay slide open and a crawler emerges, accompanied by several Remnant. They carefully unload the S-970 Regenerators and strap them down. As they start heading back into the bay, one of them comes over to hand you <payment>. "Thank you for the new outfits to study. Our team is quite interested to see what humanity has achieved since our exodus."
units.italian: Su <planet> segui le istruzioni di atterraggio per arrivare a una piazzola accanto a una struttura imponente con un grande vano attrezzature. Mentre completi le procedure di spegnimento le porte del vano scorrono e ne esce un cingolato, accompagnato da diversi Remnant. Scaricano con cura i Rigeneratori S-970 e li fissano. Mentre iniziano a tornare nel vano, uno di loro viene a consegnarti <payment>. "Grazie per i nuovi equipaggiamenti da studiare. La nostra squadra è molto interessata a vedere cosa l'umanità ha ottenuto dal nostro esodo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Taely Intro Log|log|2014|0
units.english: As an engineering prefect, Taely is the foremost authority among the Remnant on salvaged technology and a senior leader in their reverse engineering program.
units.italian: In quanto prefetto dell'ingegneria, Taely è la massima autorità tra i Remnant sulla tecnologia recuperata e una delle guide del loro programma di reverse engineering.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Taely Penguin Log|log|2026|0
units.english: One of Taely's main priorities is improving the maneuverability characteristics of Remnant ships. To this end she has been working on building a new prototype ship based on the void sprites.
units.italian: Una delle priorità principali di Taely è migliorare le caratteristiche di manovrabilità delle navi dei Remnant. A questo scopo sta lavorando a un nuovo prototipo di nave basato sugli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Chilia Intro Log|log|2039|0
units.english: As a military prefect, Chilia is responsible for the defense of Remnant space. He can usually be found on the front lines of combat unless required to work on tactics for the Remnant as a whole.
units.italian: In quanto prefetto militare, Chilia è responsabile della difesa dello spazio dei Remnant. Di solito lo si trova in prima linea nel combattimento, a meno che non debba lavorare a tattiche per l'intero popolo dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Chilia Intro Log 2|log|2052|0
units.english: Despite being quite young, Chilia is highly respected among Remnant society.
units.italian: Nonostante sia piuttosto giovane, Chilia è molto rispettato nella società dei Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Chilia Intro Log 3|log|2065|0
units.english: Prefect Chilia is an unusual person compared to most military leaders: He is inclined to do things himself and rarely stands on protocol.
units.italian: Il prefetto Chilia è una persona insolita rispetto alla maggior parte dei capi militari: è incline a fare le cose di persona e raramente bada al protocollo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|name|2071|0
units.english: Return the Samples
units.italian: Restituire i campioni

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|description|2072|0
units.english: A researcher on <planet> has asked you to return void sprite eggs to Nasqueron that the Remnant stole many years ago.
units.italian: Un ricercatore su <planet> ti ha chiesto di riportare su Nasqueron delle uova di spettro del vuoto che i Remnant rubarono molti anni fa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|As you are walking through the spaceport, the researcher you previously assisted with the studies on the void sprites approaches you in a hustle. "We have made some new discoveries!" he exclaims in a trill. "Some of the samples that we took all those years ago are actually eggs of some kind. So the Archon must view our previous research as being disruptive to the void sprites' lifecycles.|2081|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, the researcher you previously assisted with the studies on the void sprites approaches you in a hustle. "We have made some new discoveries!" he exclaims in a trill. "Some of the samples that we took all those years ago are actually eggs of some kind. So the Archon must view our previous research as being disruptive to the void sprites' lifecycles.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, il ricercatore che avevi assistito in precedenza negli studi sugli spettri del vuoto ti si avvicina in fretta. "Abbiamo fatto nuove scoperte!" esclama in un trillo. "Alcuni dei campioni che prendemmo tutti quegli anni fa sono in realtà delle uova, di qualche tipo. Quindi l'Archon deve considerare la nostra ricerca precedente come un'intrusione nei cicli di vita degli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"We have been storing these eggs in a cryogenic stasis tank, so they should still be viable and intact. Well, most of them, anyway." His notes trail off on a mournful tone.|2082|0
units.english: "We have been storing these eggs in a cryogenic stasis tank, so they should still be viable and intact. Well, most of them, anyway." His notes trail off on a mournful tone.
units.italian: "Abbiamo conservato queste uova in un serbatoio di stasi criogenica, quindi dovrebbero essere ancora vitali e intatte. Beh, la maggior parte, comunque." Le sue note si perdono su un tono mesto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"Could you return some of them to Nasqueron? According to our logs, they were found floating in the lower levels of the atmosphere, where their natural buoyancy should keep them afloat."|2083|0
units.english: "Could you return some of them to Nasqueron? According to our logs, they were found floating in the lower levels of the atmosphere, where their natural buoyancy should keep them afloat."
units.italian: "Potresti riportarne alcune su Nasqueron? Secondo i nostri registri, sono state trovate a galleggiare nei livelli più bassi dell'atmosfera, dove la loro spinta naturale dovrebbe tenerle a galla."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"Sure, I would be glad to return them."|2085|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to return them."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò felice di riportarle."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"Sorry, I'm really not interested in dodging the Archon again."|2086|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm really not interested in dodging the Archon again."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho davvero voglia di sfuggire di nuovo all'Archon."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"Thank you. Since we are continuing to work together, I would like to introduce myself again." He takes a breath, thinks for a second, and speaks a short verse about plumage with a complex chord that sounds at once grandiose and self-deprecating. The best you can make out is that his name is "Plume."|2089|0
units.english: "Thank you. Since we are continuing to work together, I would like to introduce myself again." He takes a breath, thinks for a second, and speaks a short verse about plumage with a complex chord that sounds at once grandiose and self-deprecating. The best you can make out is that his name is "Plume."
units.italian: "Grazie. Dato che continuiamo a lavorare insieme, vorrei presentarmi di nuovo." Prende fiato, pensa un secondo e recita un breve verso sul piumaggio con un accordo complesso che suona al tempo stesso grandioso e autoironico. Quello che riesci a capire meglio è che il suo nome è "Plume".

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	"Just remember: you will need to use a Puffin to make this delivery. If you don't still have one, there are a few in storage in Viminal." He taps on his commlink, and an assistant emerges from a nearby building with a flatbed truck. Onboard is a large collection of cocoon-like pods cradling large eggs, as well as a big spacesuit that looks more reminiscent of an ancient deep-sea diving suit than anything carried on a modern ship. "Now, remember, you need to remove the eggs from the cocoons and release them gently. Please make sure they don't hit anything on the way out."|2090|0
units.english: "Just remember: you will need to use a Puffin to make this delivery. If you don't still have one, there are a few in storage in Viminal." He taps on his commlink, and an assistant emerges from a nearby building with a flatbed truck. Onboard is a large collection of cocoon-like pods cradling large eggs, as well as a big spacesuit that looks more reminiscent of an ancient deep-sea diving suit than anything carried on a modern ship. "Now, remember, you need to remove the eggs from the cocoons and release them gently. Please make sure they don't hit anything on the way out."
units.italian: "Ricorda solo: per questa consegna dovrai usare un Puffin. Se non ne hai ancora uno, ce ne sono alcuni in deposito a Viminal." Batte sul suo commlink, e da un edificio vicino esce un assistente con un camion a pianale. A bordo c'è una grande collezione di capsule simili a bozzoli che custodiscono grandi uova, oltre a una tuta spaziale enorme che ricorda più una tuta da immersione profonda antica che qualsiasi cosa si porti su una nave moderna. "Ora, ricorda, devi togliere le uova dai bozzoli e rilasciarle delicatamente. Assicurati che non urtino nulla mentre escono."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|log|2098|0
units.english: A Remnant researcher specializing in xenobiology, Plume is at the forefront of recent efforts to restart research on the void sprites and a leading expert in non-carbon based lifeforms.
units.italian: Ricercatore dei Remnant specializzato in xenobiologia, Plume è in prima linea nei recenti sforzi per riavviare la ricerca sugli spettri del vuoto e un esperto di spicco di forme di vita non a base di carbonio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|Once again you have successfully dodged the Archon to land on Nasqueron. Somehow, knowing it was going to be there was both better and worse than the surprise of the first time.|2101|0
units.english: Once again you have successfully dodged the Archon to land on Nasqueron. Somehow, knowing it was going to be there was both better and worse than the surprise of the first time.
units.italian: Ancora una volta sei riuscito a sfuggire all'Archon e ad atterrare su Nasqueron. In qualche modo, sapere che ci sarebbe stato è stato al tempo stesso meglio e peggio della sorpresa della prima volta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	As the <ship> sinks through the cloud layers, you gently activate the repulsors to slow your descent to avoid startling the void sprites. A few nearby sprites descend with you, seeming to match your velocity. You slow down as you reach the altitude listed in the log of where the eggs are to be released.|2102|0
units.english: As the <ship> sinks through the cloud layers, you gently activate the repulsors to slow your descent to avoid startling the void sprites. A few nearby sprites descend with you, seeming to match your velocity. You slow down as you reach the altitude listed in the log of where the eggs are to be released.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> sprofonda tra gli strati di nuvole, attivi delicatamente i repulsori per rallentare la discesa e non spaventare gli spettri del vuoto. Alcuni spettri vicini scendono con te, sembrando adeguarsi alla tua velocità. Rallenti quando raggiungi l'altitudine indicata nel registro come punto di rilascio delle uova.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	Setting the ship on autopilot, you walk to the back and struggle into the pressure suit. Readying the eggs in the cargo hold, you equalize pressure in the main cargo hold to the swirling clouds outside, and open the bay doors. As predicted, at this pressure level, the eggs are almost weightless, and are fairly easy to carry to the door of the ship and release.|2103|0
units.english: Setting the ship on autopilot, you walk to the back and struggle into the pressure suit. Readying the eggs in the cargo hold, you equalize pressure in the main cargo hold to the swirling clouds outside, and open the bay doors. As predicted, at this pressure level, the eggs are almost weightless, and are fairly easy to carry to the door of the ship and release.
units.italian: Mettendo la nave in pilota automatico, vai verso il retro e ti infili a fatica nella tuta pressurizzata. Preparando le uova nella stiva, porti la pressione della stiva principale a quella delle nuvole vorticose fuori, e apri le porte del vano. Come previsto, a questo livello di pressione le uova sono quasi senza peso e sono piuttosto facili da portare alla porta della nave e rilasciare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|	By the time you finish releasing the eggs back into the clouds, several void sprites have converged on your ship and appear to be herding the eggs away from you with gentle buffets of their wings. You take a moment to appreciate the alien beauty of these creatures before closing the hatch and purging the ship with fresh air.|2104|0
units.english: By the time you finish releasing the eggs back into the clouds, several void sprites have converged on your ship and appear to be herding the eggs away from you with gentle buffets of their wings. You take a moment to appreciate the alien beauty of these creatures before closing the hatch and purging the ship with fresh air.
units.italian: Quando hai finito di rilasciare le uova nelle nuvole, diversi spettri del vuoto si sono radunati intorno alla tua nave e sembrano spingere le uova lontano da te con leggeri colpi d'ala. Ti prendi un momento per apprezzare la bellezza aliena di queste creature prima di chiudere il portello e purificare la nave con aria fresca.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples|Back on the ground, you report on how the release went. The researcher is pleased to hear that the void sprites responded to their presence. "We will give them a few weeks, then try sending another ship to monitor them. Hopefully the Archon will be pacified by this. Meet me in the alien environments lab just off the spaceport if you are interested in pursuing this."|2109|0
units.english: Back on the ground, you report on how the release went. The researcher is pleased to hear that the void sprites responded to their presence. "We will give them a few weeks, then try sending another ship to monitor them. Hopefully the Archon will be pacified by this. Meet me in the alien environments lab just off the spaceport if you are interested in pursuing this."
units.italian: Tornato a terra, riferisci com'è andato il rilascio. Il ricercatore è contento di sentire che gli spettri del vuoto hanno reagito alla loro presenza. "Daremo loro qualche settimana, poi proveremo a mandare un'altra nave a monitorarli. Speriamo che questo plachi l'Archon. Se ti interessa portare avanti la cosa, incontrami nel laboratorio degli ambienti alieni appena fuori dallo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|name|2114|0
units.english: Return the Samples
units.italian: Restituire i campioni

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|description|2115|0
units.english: Plume has asked you to return more stolen eggs, this time to Slylandro. Then return to <planet> with footage of the void sprites.
units.italian: Plume ti ha chiesto di restituire altre uova rubate, questa volta su Slylandro. Poi torna su <planet> con le riprese degli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|Following Plume's directions, you find a lab tucked behind the main area of the spaceport, where a short walkway leads into an underground structure. Stepping inside the door you note a rack of camouflage netting positioned easily at hand. Given what you have learned of their history, it is probably a last-ditch preparation in case they need to hide the entrance from a raid.|2123|0
units.english: Following Plume's directions, you find a lab tucked behind the main area of the spaceport, where a short walkway leads into an underground structure. Stepping inside the door you note a rack of camouflage netting positioned easily at hand. Given what you have learned of their history, it is probably a last-ditch preparation in case they need to hide the entrance from a raid.
units.italian: Seguendo le indicazioni di Plume, trovi un laboratorio nascosto dietro l'area principale dello spazioporto, dove una breve passerella conduce a una struttura sotterranea. Entrando dalla porta noti un rack di reti mimetiche a portata di mano. Date le cose che hai imparato sulla loro storia, è probabilmente un preparativo di ultima istanza nel caso debbano nascondere l'ingresso a un'incursione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	The lab itself is a microcosm of Remnant development. The structure appears to be some strange semi-organic material, and you can see an eclectic mix of familiar and unfamiliar shapes cluttering the tables. If you had to guess, you would say that this lab was the result of several different families of technology, only one of which was human.|2124|0
units.english: The lab itself is a microcosm of Remnant development. The structure appears to be some strange semi-organic material, and you can see an eclectic mix of familiar and unfamiliar shapes cluttering the tables. If you had to guess, you would say that this lab was the result of several different families of technology, only one of which was human.
units.italian: Il laboratorio stesso è un microcosmo dello sviluppo dei Remnant. La struttura sembra fatta di uno strano materiale semi-organico, e puoi vedere un misto eclettico di forme familiari e non che ingombrano i tavoli. Se dovessi indovinare, diresti che questo laboratorio è il risultato di diverse famiglie di tecnologia, solo una delle quali è umana.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	Plume and several other Remnant are at the back of the room inspecting a bunch of cocoon-like containers, similar to the ones that carried the last batch of eggs back to Nasqueron. After checking a screen he looks up and seems momentarily startled to see you.|2125|0
units.english: Plume and several other Remnant are at the back of the room inspecting a bunch of cocoon-like containers, similar to the ones that carried the last batch of eggs back to Nasqueron. After checking a screen he looks up and seems momentarily startled to see you.
units.italian: Plume e altri Remnant sono in fondo alla stanza a ispezionare una serie di contenitori simili a bozzoli, simili a quelli che hanno riportato l'ultimo lotto di uova su Nasqueron. Dopo aver controllato uno schermo alza lo sguardo e sembra per un momento sorpreso di vederti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	"Ah, <first>! You are just in time," Plume chants quickly, his hands unconsciously dancing in a quick series of gestures. "These eggs are ready to be delivered, this time to Slylandro. Could you drop them off like you did before?"|2126|0
units.english: "Ah, <first>! You are just in time," Plume chants quickly, his hands unconsciously dancing in a quick series of gestures. "These eggs are ready to be delivered, this time to Slylandro. Could you drop them off like you did before?"
units.italian: "Ah, <first>! Arrivi giusto in tempo," intona in fretta Plume, le mani che danzano inconsapevolmente in una rapida serie di gesti. "Queste uova sono pronte per la consegna, questa volta su Slylandro. Potresti lasciarle lì come hai fatto prima?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	"Yes, I would be happy to bring them home."|2128|0
units.english: "Yes, I would be happy to bring them home."
units.italian: "Sì, sarò felice di riportarle a casa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	"Sorry, I'm really not interested in risking the Archon a third time."|2129|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm really not interested in risking the Archon a third time."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho davvero voglia di rischiare con l'Archon una terza volta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	"Thank you. Like last time, we can't pay you for this. But we are still hopeful that the Archon might let us resume our studies." He follows you out to the <ship> and helps you load the cocoons holding the eggs. Just before parting ways he asks, "Oh, could you record the void sprites this time? We would like to see the behaviors you mentioned last time."|2132|0
units.english: "Thank you. Like last time, we can't pay you for this. But we are still hopeful that the Archon might let us resume our studies." He follows you out to the <ship> and helps you load the cocoons holding the eggs. Just before parting ways he asks, "Oh, could you record the void sprites this time? We would like to see the behaviors you mentioned last time."
units.italian: "Grazie. Come l'altra volta, non possiamo pagarti per questo. Ma speriamo ancora che l'Archon ci lasci riprendere i nostri studi." Ti segue fino alla <ship> e ti aiuta a caricare i bozzoli con le uova. Poco prima di separarvi chiede: "Oh, potresti filmare gli spettri del vuoto questa volta? Vorremmo vedere i comportamenti che hai citato l'altra volta."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|As you approach Slylandro you watch the Archon like a hawk, but this time it doesn't attempt to drive you off with tridents of white energy. Cautiously you make your way to Slylandro and begin your descent.|2141|0
units.english: As you approach Slylandro you watch the Archon like a hawk, but this time it doesn't attempt to drive you off with tridents of white energy. Cautiously you make your way to Slylandro and begin your descent.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a Slylandro tieni d'occhio l'Archon come un falco, ma questa volta non tenta di scacciarti con tridenti di energia bianca. Cauto ti fai strada verso Slylandro e cominci la discesa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	As the <ship> sinks through the cloud layers, you notice the void sprites seem to be tailing you. A few drop past you with startling speed, only to reappear from below as you approach the designated altitude. At the last minute you remember Plume's request to record them, and hit the switch to activate the recorder for the exterior cameras.|2142|0
units.english: As the <ship> sinks through the cloud layers, you notice the void sprites seem to be tailing you. A few drop past you with startling speed, only to reappear from below as you approach the designated altitude. At the last minute you remember Plume's request to record them, and hit the switch to activate the recorder for the exterior cameras.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> sprofonda tra gli strati di nuvole, noti che gli spettri del vuoto sembrano seguirti. Alcuni ti passano accanto con velocità sorprendente, per poi riapparire dal basso mentre ti avvicini all'altitudine stabilita. All'ultimo momento ricordi la richiesta di Plume di filmarli, e premi l'interruttore per attivare la registrazione delle camere esterne.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	Setting the ship on autopilot, you head back and suit up in the bulky pressure suit once again. Readying the eggs in the cargo hold, you equalize pressure and open the bay doors. As before, the eggs are already floating as you open the cocoons and gently carry them to the door.|2143|0
units.english: Setting the ship on autopilot, you head back and suit up in the bulky pressure suit once again. Readying the eggs in the cargo hold, you equalize pressure and open the bay doors. As before, the eggs are already floating as you open the cocoons and gently carry them to the door.
units.italian: Mettendo la nave in pilota automatico, torni indietro e ti infili di nuovo nella tuta pressurizzata ingombrante. Preparando le uova nella stiva, equilibri la pressione e apri le porte del vano. Come prima, le uova fluttuano già quando apri i bozzoli e le porti delicatamente alla porta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	Almost as soon as you release the first egg, a void sprite is there, brushing against the ship to scoop the egg away into the swirling mists. By the time you return with the next one, another sprite is already waiting at the door, undulating in the eerie light. By the time the last egg is released you can see dozens of the strange creatures swarming around the collection of eggs. It occurs to you that very few humans would ever have the chance to see anything like this.|2144|0
units.english: Almost as soon as you release the first egg, a void sprite is there, brushing against the ship to scoop the egg away into the swirling mists. By the time you return with the next one, another sprite is already waiting at the door, undulating in the eerie light. By the time the last egg is released you can see dozens of the strange creatures swarming around the collection of eggs. It occurs to you that very few humans would ever have the chance to see anything like this.
units.italian: Quasi appena rilasci il primo uovo, uno spettro del vuoto è lì, che sfiora la nave per portare via l'uovo nelle nebbie vorticose. Quando torni con il successivo, un altro spettro è già in attesa alla porta, ondulando nella luce inquietante. Quando viene rilasciato l'ultimo uovo puoi vedere dozzine di queste strane creature brulicare intorno alla raccolta. Ti viene in mente che pochissimi umani avrebbero mai la possibilità di vedere qualcosa del genere.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|	After taking a moment to enjoy the view, you shut the door as gently as you can, purge the ship with fresh air, and begin the journey back to Aventine.|2145|0
units.english: After taking a moment to enjoy the view, you shut the door as gently as you can, purge the ship with fresh air, and begin the journey back to Aventine.
units.italian: Dopo esserti preso un momento per goderti la vista, chiudi la porta con la massima delicatezza possibile, purifichi la nave con aria fresca e cominci il viaggio di ritorno verso Aventine.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 2|Back on Aventine, you share the recording of the void sprite's behavior with Plume. "These Sprites demonstrate considerably more communication than we originally thought. And obviously they must have communicated what you did on Nasqueron. Interesting..." Plume's excited staccato exclamations trail off as he begins to make notes on a data pad he has on hand. "Thank you for your help, we will let you know what we find out."|2153|0
units.english: Back on Aventine, you share the recording of the void sprite's behavior with Plume. "These Sprites demonstrate considerably more communication than we originally thought. And obviously they must have communicated what you did on Nasqueron. Interesting..." Plume's excited staccato exclamations trail off as he begins to make notes on a data pad he has on hand. "Thank you for your help, we will let you know what we find out."
units.italian: Tornato su Aventine, condividi con Plume la registrazione del comportamento degli spettri del vuoto. "Questi spettri dimostrano molta più comunicazione di quanto pensassimo all'inizio. E ovviamente devono aver comunicato quello che hai fatto su Nasqueron. Interessante..." Le esclamazioni eccitate e staccate di Plume si perdono mentre comincia a prendere appunti su un data pad che ha a portata di mano. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, ti faremo sapere cosa scopriamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 3 Exploration Hint|As you disembark from <ship> you almost run into Plume as he strides across the landing area. "Captain <first>, I didn't see you there!" You glance back at the bulk of your ship that you just stepped out of and look at him curiously, wondering how he could have missed seeing a spaceship land in front of him. His chant takes on a slightly apologetic tone. "I've been lost in thought thinking about everything we have discovered lately, especially the most recent recordings you made. I still have a lot to analyze, though." He pauses, looking thoughtful. "That being said, I will probably have more work for you in a week or two."|2190|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 3 Exploration Hint
units.english: As you disembark from <ship> you almost run into Plume as he strides across the landing area. "Captain <first>, I didn't see you there!" You glance back at the bulk of your ship that you just stepped out of and look at him curiously, wondering how he could have missed seeing a spaceship land in front of him. His chant takes on a slightly apologetic tone. "I've been lost in thought thinking about everything we have discovered lately, especially the most recent recordings you made. I still have a lot to analyze, though." He pauses, looking thoughtful. "That being said, I will probably have more work for you in a week or two."
units.italian: Mentre scendi dalla <ship> per poco non vai addosso a Plume, che attraversa a grandi passi l'area di atterraggio. "Capitano <first>, non ti avevo visto!" Ti volti verso la mole della tua nave da cui sei appena uscito e lo guardi incuriosito, chiedendoti come abbia potuto non vedere un'astronave atterrare davanti a lui. Il suo canto assume un tono leggermente di scusa. "Ero perso nei pensieri a riflettere su tutto quello che abbiamo scoperto di recente, soprattutto le registrazioni più recenti che hai fatto. Però ho ancora molto da analizzare." Si interrompe, pensieroso. "Detto questo, probabilmente avrò altro lavoro per te tra una o due settimane."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 3 Exploration Hint|	Plume asks a few more questions about what you have been doing, then politely excuses himself to continue his research. "Please let me know if you uncover anything else about Nenia!" he trills to you as he departs.|2191|0
units.context: mission:Remnant: Return the Samples 3 Exploration Hint
units.english: Plume asks a few more questions about what you have been doing, then politely excuses himself to continue his research. "Please let me know if you uncover anything else about Nenia!" he trills to you as he departs.
units.italian: Plume ti fa qualche altra domanda su cosa hai fatto, poi si congeda cortesemente per continuare la ricerca. "Fammi sapere se scopri qualcos'altro su Nenia!" ti trilla mentre si allontana.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|As you step out into the icy chill of Viminal, you get a message from Taely, the engineering prefect, asking if you could meet her in the cafeteria.|2199|0
units.english: As you step out into the icy chill of Viminal, you get a message from Taely, the engineering prefect, asking if you could meet her in the cafeteria.
units.italian: Mentre esci nel freddo gelido di Viminal, ricevi un messaggio da Taely, il prefetto dell'ingegneria, che ti chiede se puoi incontrarla in mensa.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	(Accept her invitation.)|2201|0
units.english: (Accept her invitation.)
units.italian: (Accetta il suo invito.)

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	(Not right now.)|2202|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	Replying that you can, you make your way through the crowds and find an empty table. Moments later Taely appears and grabs two trays from the dispenser before heading towards you. She settles down in the opposite chair with a look of exhaustion.|2204|0
units.english: Replying that you can, you make your way through the crowds and find an empty table. Moments later Taely appears and grabs two trays from the dispenser before heading towards you. She settles down in the opposite chair with a look of exhaustion.
units.italian: Rispondendo che puoi, ti fai strada tra la folla e trovi un tavolo libero. Pochi istanti dopo Taely compare e prende due vassoi dal distributore prima di dirigersi verso di te. Si siede sulla sedia di fronte con un'aria esausta.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"It is good to see you again, <first>," she sings softly. When you sign a reply she sits up, smiles, and switches to sign. "My, you are a quick learner. This is much faster." Her quick gestures are hard to follow, but the language videos seem to have focused on a practical vocabulary that has most of the words she uses.|2205|0
units.english: "It is good to see you again, <first>," she sings softly. When you sign a reply she sits up, smiles, and switches to sign. "My, you are a quick learner. This is much faster." Her quick gestures are hard to follow, but the language videos seem to have focused on a practical vocabulary that has most of the words she uses.
units.italian: "È bello rivederti, <first>," canta piano. Quando rispondi a segni si raddrizza, sorride e passa ai segni. "Accidenti, impari in fretta. Così è molto più veloce." I suoi gesti rapidi sono difficili da seguire, ma i video di lingua sembrano essersi concentrati su un vocabolario pratico che copre la maggior parte delle parole che usa.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"I have not fully..." (She makes a sign that you don't understand, but seems similar to the signs for "break" and "understand.") "... the technology you retrieved for us, but we are learning much from what we have already found. Could you help us catch up with what has happened in ancestral space since our Exodus?"|2206|0
units.english: "I have not fully..." (She makes a sign that you don't understand, but seems similar to the signs for "break" and "understand.") "... the technology you retrieved for us, but we are learning much from what we have already found. Could you help us catch up with what has happened in ancestral space since our Exodus?"
units.italian: "Non ho ancora..." (Fa un segno che non capisci, ma che sembra simile ai segni per "pausa" e "capire".) "... del tutto la tecnologia che ci hai recuperato, ma stiamo imparando molto da quello che abbiamo già trovato. Potresti aiutarci a metterci al passo con quello che è successo nello spazio ancestrale dal nostro Esodo?"

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"Yes. What can I do to help?"|2208|0
units.english: "Yes. What can I do to help?"
units.italian: "Sì. Cosa posso fare per aiutare?"

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"Sorry, not interested."|2209|0
units.english: "Sorry, not interested."
units.italian: "Mi spiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"Excellent! According to a friend of mine who is versed in history from the war, there were rumors that a grand library was being built in the Deep to house all of human knowledge. If it exists, that would likely be where to go."|2213|0
units.english: "Excellent! According to a friend of mine who is versed in history from the war, there were rumors that a grand library was being built in the Deep to house all of human knowledge. If it exists, that would likely be where to go."
