units.italian: "Eccellente! Secondo un mio amico esperto di storia della guerra, c'erano voci che nel Deep si stesse costruendo una grande biblioteca per raccogliere tutta la conoscenza umana. Se esiste, probabilmente è lì che bisogna andare."

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"Excellent! According to a friend of mine who is versed in history from the war, there were rumors that a grand library was being built in the Deep to house all of human knowledge. If it exists..." She stops when she notices you nodding with a knowing expression. "You have already been there? Well, you certainly get around, Captain <last>. I suppose that makes things rather straightforward."|2216|0
units.english: "Excellent! According to a friend of mine who is versed in history from the war, there were rumors that a grand library was being built in the Deep to house all of human knowledge. If it exists..." She stops when she notices you nodding with a knowing expression. "You have already been there? Well, you certainly get around, Captain <last>. I suppose that makes things rather straightforward."
units.italian: "Eccellente! Secondo un mio amico esperto di storia della guerra, c'erano voci che nel Deep si stesse costruendo una grande biblioteca per raccogliere tutta la conoscenza umana. Se esiste..." Si ferma quando ti nota annuire con un'espressione di chi sa. "Ci sei già stato? Beh, viaggi decisamente molto, capitano <last>. Suppongo che questo renda le cose piuttosto semplici."

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"I actually already have a copy of the library's data in my ship," you respond.|2217|0
units.english: "I actually already have a copy of the library's data in my ship," you respond.
units.italian: "In realtà ho già una copia dei dati della biblioteca sulla mia nave," rispondi.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	"Oh, that's even better," Taely trills. "Go ahead and get it."|2218|0
units.english: "Oh, that's even better," Taely trills. "Go ahead and get it."
units.italian: "Oh, ancora meglio," trilla Taely. "Vai a prenderla."

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	You return to your ship to get the data chip, but when you glance out the cockpit you notice that the spaceport is more animated than usual. Remnant look to be running to their ships as fast as they can when you notice that Taely is halfway up the side of your ship securing a refueling hose and charging cable. As you reach for the commlink she scrambles up to the bridge windows and quickly rattles off a series of signs at you. All you can make out is "Keep it hot, incoming!" Before you can frame a reply she has raced across your wing and leapt to the Albatross parked next to you.|2219|0
units.english: You return to your ship to get the data chip, but when you glance out the cockpit you notice that the spaceport is more animated than usual. Remnant look to be running to their ships as fast as they can when you notice that Taely is halfway up the side of your ship securing a refueling hose and charging cable. As you reach for the commlink she scrambles up to the bridge windows and quickly rattles off a series of signs at you. All you can make out is "Keep it hot, incoming!" Before you can frame a reply she has raced across your wing and leapt to the Albatross parked next to you.
units.italian: Torni alla nave per prendere il chip dati, ma quando dai un'occhiata fuori dall'abitacolo noti che lo spazioporto è più animato del solito. I Remnant sembrano correre alle loro navi il più velocemente possibile quando noti che Taely è a metà della fiancata della tua nave, che fissa un tubo di rifornimento e un cavo di ricarica. Mentre allunghi la mano verso il commlink lei si arrampica fino alle finestre della plancia e ti snocciola rapidamente una serie di segni. Quello che riesci a capire è: "Tienila calda, stanno arrivando!" Prima che tu possa formulare una risposta ha già attraversato la tua ala ed è saltata sull'Albatross parcheggiato accanto a te.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|Having acquired a copy of the archive, you gently set your ship down on Viminal hoping that this information is helpful. The port seems unusually busy, but the comm channels are quiet beyond the bare minimum to keep traffic organized.|2223|0
units.english: Having acquired a copy of the archive, you gently set your ship down on Viminal hoping that this information is helpful. The port seems unusually busy, but the comm channels are quiet beyond the bare minimum to keep traffic organized.
units.italian: Avendo ottenuto una copia dell'archivio, posi delicatamente la nave su Viminal sperando che queste informazioni siano utili. Il porto sembra insolitamente trafficato, ma i canali di comunicazione sono silenziosi oltre il minimo indispensabile per organizzare il traffico.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	Before you have even taken the time to shut down the engines Taely is halfway up the side of your ship securing a refueling hose and charging cable. As you reach for the commlink she scrambles up to the bridge windows and quickly rattles off a series of signs at you. All you can make out is "Keep it hot, incoming!" Before you can frame a reply she has raced across your wing and leapt to the Albatross parked next to you.|2224|0
units.english: Before you have even taken the time to shut down the engines Taely is halfway up the side of your ship securing a refueling hose and charging cable. As you reach for the commlink she scrambles up to the bridge windows and quickly rattles off a series of signs at you. All you can make out is "Keep it hot, incoming!" Before you can frame a reply she has raced across your wing and leapt to the Albatross parked next to you.
units.italian: Prima ancora che tu ti prenda il tempo di spegnere i motori, Taely è a metà della fiancata della tua nave, che fissa un tubo di rifornimento e un cavo di ricarica. Mentre allunghi la mano verso il commlink lei si arrampica fino alle finestre della plancia e ti snocciola rapidamente una serie di segni. Quello che riesci a capire è: "Tienila calda, stanno arrivando!" Prima che tu possa formulare una risposta ha già attraversato la tua ala ed è saltata sull'Albatross parcheggiato accanto a te.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	Looking around more carefully, you note that every ship in the port is idling with fuel lines still connected. If this were some Republic port the safety inspectors would be having a nightmare. One Starling is getting holes in its wings patched even as the crew appear to be running prep-for-flight checklists. It also looks like every ship has a guard. Something tells you that right now would be a bad time to take a walk around town.|2227|0
units.english: Looking around more carefully, you note that every ship in the port is idling with fuel lines still connected. If this were some Republic port the safety inspectors would be having a nightmare. One Starling is getting holes in its wings patched even as the crew appear to be running prep-for-flight checklists. It also looks like every ship has a guard. Something tells you that right now would be a bad time to take a walk around town.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno con più attenzione, noti che ogni nave nel porto è in moto minimo con i tubi del carburante ancora collegati. Se questo fosse un porto della Repubblica, gli ispettori di sicurezza avrebbero un incubo. A uno Starling stanno rattoppando i fori nelle ali mentre l'equipaggio sembra già correre attraverso le liste di controllo pre-volo. Sembra anche che ogni nave abbia una guardia. Qualcosa ti dice che adesso sarebbe un brutto momento per fare una passeggiata in città.

units.id: conversation:taely cultural data|	After some tense minutes of waiting, the planetary defense sirens start and the idling ships begin to ascend one by one. You quickly figure out where you are in the launch sequence and follow the stream of craft heading for orbit.|2228|0
units.english: After some tense minutes of waiting, the planetary defense sirens start and the idling ships begin to ascend one by one. You quickly figure out where you are in the launch sequence and follow the stream of craft heading for orbit.
units.italian: Dopo alcuni minuti di attesa tesa, partono le sirene della difesa planetaria e le navi in attesa cominciano a salire una per una. Capisci in fretta a che punto sei nella sequenza di lancio e segui il flusso di mezzi diretti in orbita.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1|name|2234|0
units.english: Remnant History Updates
units.italian: Aggiornamenti storici dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1|description|2235|0
units.english: The Remnant are interested in learning about what has happened in human space since they left. Find a copy of human history on <destination>.
units.italian: I Remnant sono interessati a sapere cosa è successo nello spazio umano da quando se ne sono andati. Trova una copia della storia umana su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1|The station has a small museum gift shop that sells a copy of the entire archive on a data card. It only costs 40 credits, but because you have done a horrible job at managing your finances you do not have even that much cash on hand right now.|2248|0
units.english: The station has a small museum gift shop that sells a copy of the entire archive on a data card. It only costs 40 credits, but because you have done a horrible job at managing your finances you do not have even that much cash on hand right now.
units.italian: La stazione ha un piccolo negozio di souvenir del museo che vende una copia dell'intero archivio su una scheda dati. Costa solo 40 crediti, ma siccome hai fatto un lavoro orribile nel gestire le tue finanze al momento non hai in contanti nemmeno quella cifra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1|	Go earn some money, then return here.|2249|0
units.english: Go earn some money, then return here.
units.italian: Vai a guadagnare un po' di soldi, poi torna qui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1B|name|2257|0
units.english: Remnant History Updates
units.italian: Aggiornamenti storici dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1B|description|2258|0
units.english: Return the copy of human history to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta la copia della storia umana su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 1B|After having traveled clear across the galaxy, you finally arrive at the archives of human history. Upon asking a librarian where you could get a copy of the station's archives, you're surprised to have them point you to a gift shop. There you find a copy of the archives on a data card. ("The perfect gift for the budding historian in your family! Hold all of human history in the palm of your hand. On sale now for only 39.99!") Given that a cheap data card costs a fraction of a credit, it's a bit of a rip-off, but you gladly buy one to take back to Taely.|2266|0
units.english: After having traveled clear across the galaxy, you finally arrive at the archives of human history. Upon asking a librarian where you could get a copy of the station's archives, you're surprised to have them point you to a gift shop. There you find a copy of the archives on a data card. ("The perfect gift for the budding historian in your family! Hold all of human history in the palm of your hand. On sale now for only 39.99!") Given that a cheap data card costs a fraction of a credit, it's a bit of a rip-off, but you gladly buy one to take back to Taely.
units.italian: Dopo aver attraversato tutta la galassia, arrivi finalmente agli archivi della storia umana. Dopo aver chiesto a una bibliotecaria dove poter ottenere una copia degli archivi della stazione, resti sorpreso quando ti indicano un negozio di souvenir. Lì trovi una copia degli archivi su una scheda dati. ("Il regalo perfetto per lo storico in erba della tua famiglia! Tieni tutta la storia umana nel palmo della mano. In offerta ora a soli 39,99!") Dato che una scheda dati economica costa una frazione di credito, è un po' una truffa, ma la compri volentieri per portarla a Taely.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|name|2273|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|description|2274|0
units.english: Assist in defending <planet> from a Korath raid, then return to the planet.
units.italian: Aiuta a difendere <planet> da un'incursione Korath, poi torna sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|dialog|2303|0
units.english: There are still Korath raiders circling overhead. You should take off and help the Remnant ships to fight them.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora predoni Korath che volteggiano sopra la tua testa. Dovresti decollare e aiutare le navi dei Remnant a combatterli.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|As some ships maintain orbital sentry positions, most ships return to their berths. Mechanics are soon swarming over the ships, and what you suppose are ambulances are waiting at the ramps to collect the injured. Farther back, flatbed tractor units wait to pick up any salvage that has been collected.|2307|0
units.english: As some ships maintain orbital sentry positions, most ships return to their berths. Mechanics are soon swarming over the ships, and what you suppose are ambulances are waiting at the ramps to collect the injured. Farther back, flatbed tractor units wait to pick up any salvage that has been collected.
units.italian: Mentre alcune navi mantengono posizioni di sentinella orbitale, la maggior parte delle navi torna agli ormeggi. Presto i meccanici brulicano sulle navi, e quelle che supponi siano ambulanze aspettano alle rampe per raccogliere i feriti. Più indietro, trattori a pianale aspettano di prendere in carico il recupero raccolto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|	Eventually a tired but pleased-looking prefect stops by your ship. He starts chanting, "Do you understand our language, or do I need to sing?" He looks relieved when you reply that you can understand most of what is said so long as he signs slowly. "Thank you for your assistance during the raid. The sensors you placed in Parca picked up the fleet coming in and gave us sufficient warning to get everyone ready."|2308|0
units.english: Eventually a tired but pleased-looking prefect stops by your ship. He starts chanting, "Do you understand our language, or do I need to sing?" He looks relieved when you reply that you can understand most of what is said so long as he signs slowly. "Thank you for your assistance during the raid. The sensors you placed in Parca picked up the fleet coming in and gave us sufficient warning to get everyone ready."
units.italian: Alla fine un prefetto stanco ma soddisfatto si ferma alla tua nave. Comincia a intonare: "Capisci la nostra lingua, o devo cantare?" Sembra sollevato quando rispondi che riesci a capire la maggior parte di quello che viene detto, purché faccia i segni lentamente. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto durante l'incursione. I sensori che hai piazzato a Parca hanno individuato la flotta in arrivo e ci hanno dato un preavviso sufficiente per preparare tutti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 2|	He is silent for a moment, with the air of someone who is enjoying not having to run for the first time in a while. "Oh, Taely said that you might have some historical records for us?" You hand over the copy of the archive in response, telling him that it is probably the best available. He copies the archive onto a data pad, then returns it to you alongside a credit chip with <payment> on it. "Thank you, I will make sure this gets where it needs to go. In the meantime, we could use your help in the spaceport."|2309|0
units.english: He is silent for a moment, with the air of someone who is enjoying not having to run for the first time in a while. "Oh, Taely said that you might have some historical records for us?" You hand over the copy of the archive in response, telling him that it is probably the best available. He copies the archive onto a data pad, then returns it to you alongside a credit chip with <payment> on it. "Thank you, I will make sure this gets where it needs to go. In the meantime, we could use your help in the spaceport."
units.italian: Resta in silenzio per un momento, con l'aria di chi si gode il fatto di non dover correre per la prima volta da un po'. "Oh, Taely ha detto che potresti avere dei documenti storici per noi?" Gli consegni la copia dell'archivio in risposta, dicendogli che è probabilmente la migliore disponibile. Copia l'archivio su un data pad, poi te lo restituisce insieme a un chip di credito con <payment>. "Grazie, farò in modo che arrivi dove deve andare. Nel frattempo, potremmo usare il tuo aiuto allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|name|2314|0
units.english: Transport injured Remnant
units.italian: Trasportare Remnant feriti

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|description|2315|0
units.english: Some injured Remnant need to be transported away from the front lines to Aventine.
units.italian: Alcuni Remnant feriti devono essere trasportati via dalla prima linea ad Aventine.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|blocked|2319|0
units.english: A prefect informs you that they need to evacuate some injured to a hospital on Aventine, but you will need 8 free bunks and 5 tons of cargo space in order to handle the injured.
units.italian: Un prefetto ti informa che devono evacuare alcuni feriti in un ospedale su Aventine, ma ti servono 8 cuccette libere e 5 tonnellate di spazio cargo per gestire i feriti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|After watching the mechanics start repairs on the <ship>, you make the short trek to the spaceport common area. People are still rushing around as ships continue to land. No wrecks so far, and judging by the scrolling arrivals displays there are still quite a few ships on approach. Looking around for someone to talk to, you spot the prefect who had just visited your ship. He notices you and comes over. "No ships lost yet," he signs harshly, "but there are a few ships that have not checked in."|2325|0
units.english: After watching the mechanics start repairs on the <ship>, you make the short trek to the spaceport common area. People are still rushing around as ships continue to land. No wrecks so far, and judging by the scrolling arrivals displays there are still quite a few ships on approach. Looking around for someone to talk to, you spot the prefect who had just visited your ship. He notices you and comes over. "No ships lost yet," he signs harshly, "but there are a few ships that have not checked in."
units.italian: Dopo aver visto i meccanici iniziare le riparazioni sulla <ship>, fai la breve camminata verso l'area comune dello spazioporto. La gente continua a correre mentre le navi continuano ad atterrare. Nessun relitto finora, e a giudicare dai display degli arrivi che scorrono ci sono ancora parecchie navi in avvicinamento. Cercando qualcuno con cui parlare, scorgi il prefetto che era appena passato dalla tua nave. Ti nota e si avvicina. "Nessuna nave perduta finora," segna con durezza, "ma ci sono alcune navi che non si sono fatte sentire."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	He shakes his head and continues, "We need to keep our medical facilities as free as possible. Could you take some of our injured to Aventine? They are stable and healthy enough for an unattended transport, and it would free up medics and space here."|2326|0
units.english: He shakes his head and continues, "We need to keep our medical facilities as free as possible. Could you take some of our injured to Aventine? They are stable and healthy enough for an unattended transport, and it would free up medics and space here."
units.italian: Scuote la testa e continua: "Dobbiamo tenere le nostre strutture mediche il più libere possibile. Potresti portare alcuni dei nostri feriti su Aventine? Sono stabili e abbastanza in salute per un trasporto senza assistenza, e libererebbe medici e spazio qui."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	"Of course."|2328|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	"I'd rather not."|2329|0
units.english: "I'd rather not."
units.italian: "Preferirei di no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	He looks relieved. "Thanks. I was going to have to divert one of our sentries to take them." He pauses and consults his commlink. "The medical team will have the injured settled onboard shortly, along with everything they need to ensure they arrive safely. They will probably have some fresh crew to send back with you."|2331|0
units.english: He looks relieved. "Thanks. I was going to have to divert one of our sentries to take them." He pauses and consults his commlink. "The medical team will have the injured settled onboard shortly, along with everything they need to ensure they arrive safely. They will probably have some fresh crew to send back with you."
units.italian: Sembra sollevato. "Grazie. Avrei dovuto distogliere una delle nostre sentinelle per portarli." Si interrompe e consulta il suo commlink. "La squadra medica sistemerà i feriti a bordo a breve, insieme a tutto ciò che serve per assicurare che arrivino in salvo. Probabilmente avranno anche un equipaggio fresco da rimandare indietro con te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|The injured crew made for an eerily quiet jaunt from Viminal to Aventine. They didn't sing, and rarely signed. Some spent the trip mellowed out on powerful painkillers, while the few that left their rooms seem to be mostly intent on doing prescribed stretches and movements to help damaged muscles heal. Others that you check on appear to be meditating while an intravenous system feeds into their gloves. A few are interested in visiting with someone from outside the Ember Waste, but they lacked the energy to do so for long.|2335|0
units.english: The injured crew made for an eerily quiet jaunt from Viminal to Aventine. They didn't sing, and rarely signed. Some spent the trip mellowed out on powerful painkillers, while the few that left their rooms seem to be mostly intent on doing prescribed stretches and movements to help damaged muscles heal. Others that you check on appear to be meditating while an intravenous system feeds into their gloves. A few are interested in visiting with someone from outside the Ember Waste, but they lacked the energy to do so for long.
units.italian: L'equipaggio ferito ha reso la traversata da Viminal ad Aventine stranamente silenziosa. Non cantavano e raramente facevano segni. Alcuni hanno passato il viaggio rintontiti da potenti antidolorifici, mentre i pochi che hanno lasciato le loro stanze sembrano intenzionati soprattutto a fare gli allungamenti e i movimenti prescritti per aiutare i muscoli danneggiati a guarire. Altri che vai a trovare sembrano meditare mentre un sistema endovenoso alimenta le loro mani. Alcuni sono interessati a parlare con qualcuno da fuori della Distesa di Braci, ma non avevano l'energia per farlo a lungo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	On Aventine there are ambulances and medical staff waiting to transport the injured to longer-term medical facilities. As they depart, a fresh crew arrives to take their places.|2336|0
units.english: On Aventine there are ambulances and medical staff waiting to transport the injured to longer-term medical facilities. As they depart, a fresh crew arrives to take their places.
units.italian: Su Aventine ci sono ambulanze e personale medico che aspettano di trasportare i feriti in strutture mediche di lungo periodo. Mentre partono, arriva un equipaggio fresco a prendere il loro posto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|When you return to Viminal, the Remnant crew members leave your ship and disperse across the tarmac to the ships they have been assigned to, each one of them signing their thanks as they leave. A few minutes after they leave your commlink beeps, notifying you that a message from the prefect has arrived:|2343|0
units.english: When you return to Viminal, the Remnant crew members leave your ship and disperse across the tarmac to the ships they have been assigned to, each one of them signing their thanks as they leave. A few minutes after they leave your commlink beeps, notifying you that a message from the prefect has arrived:
units.italian: Quando torni su Viminal, i membri dell'equipaggio Remnant lasciano la tua nave e si disperdono per la pista verso le navi a cui sono assegnati, ognuno di loro che segna il proprio ringraziamento mentre se ne va. Qualche minuto dopo il tuo commlink suona, avvisandoti che è arrivato un messaggio dal prefetto:

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 3|	"Captain <last>! Thank you for your help in defending Viminal and transporting those wounded. I have transferred a small token of our gratitude to you. That being said, perhaps you would appreciate this a bit more: the other prefects and I have agreed to grant you access to a wider range of ships. Our capital class ships will now be available to you, including the Albatross and the Pelican. At the rate these raids are going, it is in everyone's best interests that you have access to a better warship. Please, meet us in the spaceport to further discuss the situation."|2344|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! Thank you for your help in defending Viminal and transporting those wounded. I have transferred a small token of our gratitude to you. That being said, perhaps you would appreciate this a bit more: the other prefects and I have agreed to grant you access to a wider range of ships. Our capital class ships will now be available to you, including the Albatross and the Pelican. At the rate these raids are going, it is in everyone's best interests that you have access to a better warship. Please, meet us in the spaceport to further discuss the situation."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Grazie per il tuo aiuto nel difendere Viminal e nel trasportare quei feriti. Ti ho trasferito un piccolo segno della nostra gratitudine. Detto questo, forse apprezzerai di più questo: gli altri prefetti e io abbiamo deciso di concederti l'accesso a una gamma più ampia di navi. Le nostre navi di classe capitale ora saranno disponibili per te, compresi l'Albatross e il Pelican. Al ritmo di queste incursioni, è nell'interesse di tutti che tu abbia accesso a una nave da guerra migliore. Ti prego, incontraci allo spazioporto per discutere ulteriormente della situazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|name|2349|0
units.english: Track down the <npc>
units.italian: Trova il <npc>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|description|2350|0
units.english: Track down and disable a Korath ship that escaped the raid on Viminal so that the Remnant may salvage it for technology.
units.italian: Trova e metti fuori uso una nave Korath fuggita dall'incursione su Viminal, così che i Remnant possano recuperarla per la tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|Walking into the cafeteria you immediately sense the buoyant mood. According to a report on the video screen, very few Remnant ships were actually lost. Furthermore, of the ships that were lost, their escape pods worked perfectly, ensuring none of the crew were killed. Groups of crew members are gathered around tables covered in food, intermingled with the ground teams that keep their ships operational. Based on the snippets you can catch, they seem to be trading stories of crack shots and clever improvisations.|2356|0
units.english: Walking into the cafeteria you immediately sense the buoyant mood. According to a report on the video screen, very few Remnant ships were actually lost. Furthermore, of the ships that were lost, their escape pods worked perfectly, ensuring none of the crew were killed. Groups of crew members are gathered around tables covered in food, intermingled with the ground teams that keep their ships operational. Based on the snippets you can catch, they seem to be trading stories of crack shots and clever improvisations.
units.italian: Entrando in mensa percepisci subito l'umore euforico. Secondo un servizio sullo schermo video, pochissime navi dei Remnant sono state davvero perdute. Inoltre, delle navi perdute, le capsule di salvataggio hanno funzionato perfettamente, garantendo che nessuno dell'equipaggio morisse. Gruppi di membri dell'equipaggio sono riuniti intorno a tavoli coperti di cibo, mescolati alle squadre di terra che tengono operative le navi. Dai frammenti che riesci a cogliere, sembrano scambiarsi storie di tiri infallibili e improvvisazioni ingegnose.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	Taely sits over at a corner booth with the prefect who met you at the dock and a couple other mechanics, and she waves you over. "Captain <last>! So, how do you like fighting with our fleet?" asks one of the mechanics.|2357|0
units.english: Taely sits over at a corner booth with the prefect who met you at the dock and a couple other mechanics, and she waves you over. "Captain <last>! So, how do you like fighting with our fleet?" asks one of the mechanics.
units.italian: Taely è seduta in un angolo a un tavolo a nicchia con il prefetto che ti ha incontrato alla banchina e un paio di altri meccanici, e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. "Capitano <last>! Allora, come ti sembra combattere con la nostra flotta?" chiede uno dei meccanici.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"It seems odd to have a planetary defense fleet plundering."|2359|0
units.english: "It seems odd to have a planetary defense fleet plundering."
units.italian: "Sembra strano che una flotta di difesa planetaria si dedichi al saccheggio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"It was a tough battle."|2360|0
units.english: "It was a tough battle."
units.italian: "È stata una battaglia dura."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"I suppose it would," chants one of them. "We need access to their tech, though. Otherwise we'll fall behind." Judging by the finality of his statement, this is held to be common knowledge among the Remnant.|2363|0
units.english: "I suppose it would," chants one of them. "We need access to their tech, though. Otherwise we'll fall behind." Judging by the finality of his statement, this is held to be common knowledge among the Remnant.
units.italian: "Immagino di sì," intona uno di loro. "Però ci serve accesso alla loro tecnologia. Altrimenti resteremo indietro." A giudicare dalla perentorietà della sua affermazione, questo è considerato sapere condiviso tra i Remnant.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	While you're conversing with the group, the prefect suddenly glances down at his commlink, reads a message, then looks up at you. "It appears that a Korath ship survived the raid and has destroyed a few ships without taking cargo. Could you deal with it?"|2367|0
units.english: While you're conversing with the group, the prefect suddenly glances down at his commlink, reads a message, then looks up at you. "It appears that a Korath ship survived the raid and has destroyed a few ships without taking cargo. Could you deal with it?"
units.italian: Mentre conversi con il gruppo, il prefetto abbassa improvvisamente lo sguardo sul commlink, legge un messaggio, poi alza gli occhi su di te. "Sembra che una nave Korath sia sopravvissuta all'incursione e abbia distrutto alcune navi senza prendere carico. Potresti occupartene?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"Sure."|2369|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"Sorry, I don't have time to help you out."|2370|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to help you out."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho tempo per aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|	"Thank you," he signs. "It is acting oddly, jumping around destroying ships instead of looting and running. If it simply looted and left we would be pleased, but now it is learning about us instead, so it has reached the end of its usefulness. Please disable it so that we can salvage parts from it." He pauses, then continues, "I doubt we'll be able to salvage the ship itself - they pack those things with soldiers - and we do not want it to be captured, even if that is possible for you. The ship and crew should remain intact, and we will salvage what we can after you have it disabled. If you salvage anything we will happily compensate you for it in the outfitter, but do not feel obliged to do so. Destroying the ship should be a last resort."|2373|0
units.english: "Thank you," he signs. "It is acting oddly, jumping around destroying ships instead of looting and running. If it simply looted and left we would be pleased, but now it is learning about us instead, so it has reached the end of its usefulness. Please disable it so that we can salvage parts from it." He pauses, then continues, "I doubt we'll be able to salvage the ship itself - they pack those things with soldiers - and we do not want it to be captured, even if that is possible for you. The ship and crew should remain intact, and we will salvage what we can after you have it disabled. If you salvage anything we will happily compensate you for it in the outfitter, but do not feel obliged to do so. Destroying the ship should be a last resort."
units.italian: "Grazie," segna. "Si sta comportando in modo strano, salta in giro distruggendo navi invece di saccheggiare e fuggire. Se si limitasse a saccheggiare e andarsene saremmo contenti, ma adesso sta imparando qualcosa su di noi, quindi ha esaurito la sua utilità. Ti prego di metterla fuori uso così possiamo recuperarne dei pezzi." Si interrompe, poi continua: "Dubito che riusciremo a recuperare la nave stessa, la riempiono di soldati, e non vogliamo che venga catturata, anche se per te fosse possibile. La nave e l'equipaggio devono restare intatti, e recupereremo quello che possiamo dopo che l'avrai messa fuori uso. Se recuperi qualcosa ti ricompenseremo volentieri al fornitore di equipaggiamento, ma non sentirti obbligato. Distruggere la nave dovrebbe essere l'ultima risorsa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|dialog|2385|0
units.english: You have disabled the Korath ship that was left over from the raid on <planet>. You can now return there to collect your payment.
units.italian: Hai messo fuori uso la nave Korath rimasta dall'incursione su <planet>. Ora puoi tornarci per ritirare il tuo pagamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|dialog|2390|0
units.english: You are met by a prefect who looks upset. "The ship was supposed to be disabled so its contents could be salvaged!" he signs angrily. Nonetheless, he shoves a credit chip worth <payment> into your hand. "That's half what you would have earned if the ship had been disabled." He pauses and shakes his head. "I think Taely might have some more work for you in the spaceport, but in the meantime, why don't you go find some Korath to practice disabling? It is a valuable skill among the Remnant."
units.italian: Ti accoglie un prefetto che sembra contrariato. "La nave doveva essere messa fuori uso perché il suo contenuto potesse essere recuperato!" segna con rabbia. Ciononostante, ti ficca in mano un chip di credito del valore di <payment>. "È la metà di quello che avresti guadagnato se la nave fosse stata messa fuori uso." Si interrompe e scuote la testa. "Credo che Taely potrebbe avere altro lavoro per te allo spazioporto, ma nel frattempo, perché non vai a cercare qualche Korath con cui esercitarti a metterli fuori uso? Tra i Remnant è un'abilità preziosa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 4|dialog|2393|0
units.english: You are met by a prefect who thanks you for disabling it and hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "I think Taely might have some more work for you in the spaceport, but in the meantime, don't forget to drop off any salvaged outfits in the outfitters so the researchers can look at them."
units.italian: Ti accoglie un prefetto che ti ringrazia per averla messa fuori uso e ti consegna un chip di credito per <payment>. "Credo che Taely potrebbe avere altro lavoro per te allo spazioporto, ma nel frattempo non dimenticare di depositare gli equipaggiamenti recuperati ai fornitori, così i ricercatori possono esaminarli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|name|2398|0
units.english: Salvage Delivery
units.italian: Consegna del recupero

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|description|2399|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to Caelian.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> su Caelian.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|blocked|2403|0
units.english: Taely would like you to deliver some valuable Korath equipment to Caelian, but you will need 20 tons of space to carry it.
units.italian: Taely vorrebbe che consegnassi dell'equipaggiamento Korath di valore su Caelian, ma ti servono 20 tonnellate di spazio per trasportarlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|As you stroll across the tarmac under the great dome you spot Taely heading your way with a flatbed tractor filled with components in tow.|2412|0
units.english: As you stroll across the tarmac under the great dome you spot Taely heading your way with a flatbed tractor filled with components in tow.
units.italian: Mentre passeggi per la pista sotto la grande cupola vedi Taely che si dirige verso di te trainando un trattore a pianale pieno di componenti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|	"<first>! I'm glad I ran into you. The last raid gave us some particularly good pieces of equipment to study. Could you take these to the weapons laboratory on Caelian?"|2413|0
units.english: "<first>! I'm glad I ran into you. The last raid gave us some particularly good pieces of equipment to study. Could you take these to the weapons laboratory on Caelian?"
units.italian: "<first>! Sono contenta di averti incontrato. L'ultima incursione ci ha dato alcuni pezzi di equipaggiamento particolarmente buoni da studiare. Potresti portarli al laboratorio delle armi su Caelian?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|	"I could do that."|2415|0
units.english: "I could do that."
units.italian: "Potrei farlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|	"I'm not interested."|2416|0
units.english: "I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|	Taely quickly helps load the cargo onboard your ship. It doesn't appear to be actual whole items anymore, but rather pieces thereof. "They will be expecting you, but you might have to pry them out of their lab to get some help unloading. They can be a bit single-minded when they have something interesting to work on."|2418|0
units.english: Taely quickly helps load the cargo onboard your ship. It doesn't appear to be actual whole items anymore, but rather pieces thereof. "They will be expecting you, but you might have to pry them out of their lab to get some help unloading. They can be a bit single-minded when they have something interesting to work on."
units.italian: Taely ti aiuta rapidamente a caricare il carico sulla nave. Non sembrano più essere oggetti interi, ma piuttosto pezzi di essi. "Ti staranno aspettando, ma potresti doverli tirar fuori dal laboratorio per avere aiuto a scaricare. Sanno essere un po' fissati quando hanno qualcosa di interessante su cui lavorare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 5|dialog|2425|0
units.english: On Caelian, you are able to find the appropriate research warehouse just off the main landing pad. After a few minutes, a lab technician disentangles herself from a project and brings a wagon and camel team out to the ship to unload the salvage. It strikes you as a bit incongruous that a lab technician is using a graviton repulsion lifter to load cargo from your ship into a wagon pulled by a camel. "If you can, I should have some things to send back to Taely if you could meet me in the cafeteria this afternoon."
units.italian: Su Caelian riesci a trovare il magazzino di ricerca giusto appena fuori dalla piazzola di atterraggio principale. Dopo qualche minuto, una tecnica di laboratorio si districa da un progetto e porta un carro e una squadra di cammelli fino alla nave per scaricare il recupero. Ti colpisce come un po' incoerente che una tecnica di laboratorio usi un sollevatore a repulsione gravitonica per caricare il carico dalla tua nave su un carro trainato da un cammello. "Se puoi, avrei delle cose da mandare a Taely, se potessi incontrarmi in mensa oggi pomeriggio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|name|2430|0
units.english: Transport outfits to Taely
units.italian: Trasportare equipaggiamenti a Taely

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|description|2431|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to Viminal.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> su Viminal.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|blocked|2435|0
units.english: The technician you delivered Taely's salvaged parts to would like you to take some finished parts back to Taely, but you will need 20 tons of space to do so.
units.italian: La tecnica a cui hai consegnato i pezzi recuperati da Taely vorrebbe che tu riportassi alcuni pezzi finiti a Taely, ma ti servono 20 tonnellate di spazio per farlo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|You spot the laboratory technician entering the cafeteria, and she approaches you.|2441|0
units.english: You spot the laboratory technician entering the cafeteria, and she approaches you.
units.italian: Vedi la tecnica di laboratorio entrare in mensa, e lei si avvicina a te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Thank you for waiting. I have a shipment of parts ready for Taely, and with the recent increase in attacks she needs them sooner rather than later. Please take them to her."|2442|0
units.english: "Thank you for waiting. I have a shipment of parts ready for Taely, and with the recent increase in attacks she needs them sooner rather than later. Please take them to her."
units.italian: "Grazie per aver aspettato. Ho una spedizione di pezzi pronta per Taely, e con il recente aumento degli attacchi le servono prima piuttosto che dopo. Ti prego di portarglieli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	Outside you find a camel pulling a wagon filled with ship parts to be loaded on board the <ship>.|2443|0
units.english: Outside you find a camel pulling a wagon filled with ship parts to be loaded on board the <ship>.
units.italian: Fuori trovi un cammello che tira un carro pieno di pezzi di nave da caricare a bordo della <ship>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|Taely meets you at the dock with a flatbed ready to offload the shipment. As you run through your shutdown routine you hit the switch for the cargo bay doors, and by the time you have gone down to the hold, Taely has half the shipment already unloaded.|2451|0
units.english: Taely meets you at the dock with a flatbed ready to offload the shipment. As you run through your shutdown routine you hit the switch for the cargo bay doors, and by the time you have gone down to the hold, Taely has half the shipment already unloaded.
units.italian: Taely ti aspetta alla banchina con un pianale pronto a scaricare la spedizione. Mentre completi le procedure di spegnimento premi l'interruttore delle porte della stiva, e quando sei sceso nella stiva Taely ha già scaricato metà della spedizione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	Her signs flick at you with a gentleness that you are slowly deciding equates to a cheerful tone. "Thank you for all the help you've provided in recovering this salvage," she says as she hands you <payment>. "I have discussed it with the other engineers, and we have decided to give you access to our salvage."|2452|0
units.english: Her signs flick at you with a gentleness that you are slowly deciding equates to a cheerful tone. "Thank you for all the help you've provided in recovering this salvage," she says as she hands you <payment>. "I have discussed it with the other engineers, and we have decided to give you access to our salvage."
units.italian: I suoi segni ti sfiorano con una delicatezza che piano piano stai imparando a considerare equivalente a un tono allegro. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto che hai dato nel recuperare questo bottino," dice mentre ti consegna <payment>. "Ne ho parlato con gli altri ingegneri, e abbiamo deciso di darti accesso al nostro recupero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	She leads you over to the warehouse, scans her ID on the console, and taps a few commands. Then she scans your ID card. "There you go, I have updated your access codes," she signs cheerfully. She hands you your ID and pulls you to a door on the far side of the outfitting shop. Beyond the door is a vast room filled with outfits and weapons that clearly don't fit the same style as the other Remnant technology. You have seen most of the things here on scans and when salvaging equipment from other ships, but rarely up close.|2453|0
units.english: She leads you over to the warehouse, scans her ID on the console, and taps a few commands. Then she scans your ID card. "There you go, I have updated your access codes," she signs cheerfully. She hands you your ID and pulls you to a door on the far side of the outfitting shop. Beyond the door is a vast room filled with outfits and weapons that clearly don't fit the same style as the other Remnant technology. You have seen most of the things here on scans and when salvaging equipment from other ships, but rarely up close.
units.italian: Ti conduce al magazzino, scansiona il suo ID sulla console e tocca qualche comando. Poi scansiona la tua carta d'identità. "Ecco fatto, ho aggiornato i tuoi codici di accesso," segna allegramente. Ti restituisce l'ID e ti tira verso una porta dall'altra parte del negozio di equipaggiamento. Oltre la porta c'è una vasta sala piena di equipaggiamenti e armi che chiaramente non si adattano allo stile del resto della tecnologia dei Remnant. La maggior parte di queste cose le hai viste nelle scansioni e recuperando equipaggiamento da altre navi, ma raramente da vicino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"This section of our warehouse is the salvage area. Everything in here, we have collected in sufficient quantities that it is available for general use." She nods at a rack of Korath Heat Shunts while she explains, then turns back to you.|2454|0
units.english: "This section of our warehouse is the salvage area. Everything in here, we have collected in sufficient quantities that it is available for general use." She nods at a rack of Korath Heat Shunts while she explains, then turns back to you.
units.italian: "Questa sezione del nostro magazzino è l'area del recupero. Tutto quello che c'è qui lo abbiamo raccolto in quantità sufficienti perché sia disponibile per l'uso generale." Annuisce verso uno scaffale di Derivatori Termici Korath mentre spiega, poi torna a voltarsi verso di te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Of course the really advanced and rare stuff is still going to the labs first, and will not be available until we have learned all we can from it." She looks around proudly. "We do not have the industrial capacity or the number of researchers to keep up with the Alphas, the Korath, and whoever else might be out there. But we are very good at figuring out what others have built and learning from it.|2455|0
units.english: "Of course the really advanced and rare stuff is still going to the labs first, and will not be available until we have learned all we can from it." She looks around proudly. "We do not have the industrial capacity or the number of researchers to keep up with the Alphas, the Korath, and whoever else might be out there. But we are very good at figuring out what others have built and learning from it.
units.italian: "Naturalmente le cose davvero avanzate e rare continuano ad andare prima ai laboratori, e non saranno disponibili finché non avremo imparato tutto quello che possiamo da loro." Guarda intorno con orgoglio. "Non abbiamo la capacità industriale né il numero di ricercatori per stare al passo con gli Alpha, i Korath e chiunque altro ci sia là fuori. Ma siamo molto bravi a capire cosa hanno costruito gli altri e a imparare da questo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Any salvage or unrecognized technology gets scanned in our quarantine area for threats, then looked over to figure out if there is anything new in it. If there is, it is shipped to a lab for our researchers to dissect. Anything we have already figured out ends up in here, where a select few captains are welcome to use it as they see fit."|2456|0
units.english: "Any salvage or unrecognized technology gets scanned in our quarantine area for threats, then looked over to figure out if there is anything new in it. If there is, it is shipped to a lab for our researchers to dissect. Anything we have already figured out ends up in here, where a select few captains are welcome to use it as they see fit."
units.italian: "Qualsiasi recupero o tecnologia non riconosciuta viene scansionata nella nostra area di quarantena per cercare minacce, poi esaminata per capire se c'è qualcosa di nuovo. Se c'è, viene spedita a un laboratorio perché i nostri ricercatori la sezionino. Tutto quello che abbiamo già capito finisce qui, dove alcuni capitani selezionati sono benvenuti a usarlo come meglio credono."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Threats?"|2458|0
units.english: "Threats?"
units.italian: "Minacce?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Interesting."|2460|0
units.english: "Interesting."
units.italian: "Interessante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Yes, it is, isn't it? So many new things out there to discover and learn about.|2461|0
units.english: "Yes, it is, isn't it? So many new things out there to discover and learn about.
units.italian: "Sì, vero? Così tante cose nuove da scoprire e imparare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Yes, sometimes salvage that is brought in is dangerous. A Systems Core comes with fleets of micro-bots, for instance. If they aren't de-activated properly, they keep trying to rebuild their surroundings in the form of the last ship they were configured to serve. And while it hasn't happened yet, we are worried that someday we might run into someone who builds traps into their equipment, or uses nanobots that have run amok. We have not seen any of that yet, but our science-fiction stories are filled with tales of nanotech apocalypses and things like that.|2464|0
units.english: "Yes, sometimes salvage that is brought in is dangerous. A Systems Core comes with fleets of micro-bots, for instance. If they aren't de-activated properly, they keep trying to rebuild their surroundings in the form of the last ship they were configured to serve. And while it hasn't happened yet, we are worried that someday we might run into someone who builds traps into their equipment, or uses nanobots that have run amok. We have not seen any of that yet, but our science-fiction stories are filled with tales of nanotech apocalypses and things like that.
units.italian: "Sì, a volte i recuperi che arrivano sono pericolosi. Un Nucleo di Sistema, per esempio, arriva con flotte di micro-bot. Se non vengono disattivati correttamente, continuano a cercare di ricostruire l'ambiente circostante nella forma dell'ultima nave che erano configurati per servire. E anche se non è ancora successo, temiamo che un giorno potremmo incontrare qualcuno che costruisce trappole nei propri equipaggiamenti, o che usa nanobot impazziti. Non abbiamo ancora visto niente del genere, ma le nostre storie di fantascienza sono piene di racconti di apocalissi nanotecnologiche e cose simili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Salvage 6|	"Well, I need to get back to work. That last battle put us behind schedule on our repairs. Have a good day!" With a final flourish that you think is the equivalent of an exclamation mark, Taely strides out of the outfitters, heading towards another landing bay.|2466|0
units.english: "Well, I need to get back to work. That last battle put us behind schedule on our repairs. Have a good day!" With a final flourish that you think is the equivalent of an exclamation mark, Taely strides out of the outfitters, heading towards another landing bay.
units.italian: "Beh, devo tornare al lavoro. Quell'ultima battaglia ci ha messo in ritardo sulle riparazioni. Buona giornata!" Con un ultimo volteggio che credi equivalga a un punto esclamativo, Taely esce a grandi passi dal negozio di equipaggiamento, diretta verso un altro bacino di atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|name|2472|0
units.english: Deliver Data to <planet>
units.italian: Consegna dati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|description|2473|0
units.english: Deliver data crystal to a Remnant named Torza on <destination>.
units.italian: Consegna il cristallo di dati a un Remnant di nome Torza su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|You were just in the process of disembarking from the <ship> when a young Remnant jogs up to you. "Good day, Captain <first>. Sorry to interrupt, but we have an urgent delivery that needs to go to Torza on <destination>. Could you deliver this please?"|2489|0
units.english: You were just in the process of disembarking from the <ship> when a young Remnant jogs up to you. "Good day, Captain <first>. Sorry to interrupt, but we have an urgent delivery that needs to go to Torza on <destination>. Could you deliver this please?"
units.italian: Stavi appena scendendo dalla <ship> quando un giovane Remnant ti si avvicina di corsa. "Buongiorno, capitano <first>. Scusa se ti interrompo, ma abbiamo una consegna urgente che deve arrivare a Torza su <destination>. Potresti consegnarla tu?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Yes, I can."|2491|0
units.english: "Yes, I can."
units.italian: "Sì, posso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"What is it?"|2493|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Di cosa si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Sorry, not right now."|2495|0
units.english: "Sorry, not right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non adesso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"A data archive with the latest briefings and analyses. Heavily shielded and encrypted, of course, so no need to worry about it showing up on a scan. It has to get there by <date>. So, could you do it?" They hold out a small case with a data crystal visible through the window.|2498|0
units.english: "A data archive with the latest briefings and analyses. Heavily shielded and encrypted, of course, so no need to worry about it showing up on a scan. It has to get there by <date>. So, could you do it?" They hold out a small case with a data crystal visible through the window.
units.italian: "Un archivio di dati con i briefing e le analisi più recenti. Pesantemente schermato e cifrato, naturalmente, quindi non devi preoccuparti che compaia in una scansione. Deve arrivare entro <date>. Allora, puoi farlo?" Ti porge una piccola custodia con un cristallo di dati visibile attraverso la finestrella.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Yes, I can."|2500|0
units.english: "Yes, I can."
units.italian: "Sì, posso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Sorry, not right now."|2502|0
units.english: "Sorry, not right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non adesso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Thank you." They hand you the case. "Take it to <destination> by <date>. Torza will meet you there."|2505|0
units.english: "Thank you." They hand you the case. "Take it to <destination> by <date>. Torza will meet you there."
units.italian: "Grazie." Ti consegna la custodia. "Portala su <destination> entro <date>. Torza ti incontrerà lì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|You step out of the <ship> to see a non-descript Remnant standing attentively next to the landing pad. "Captain <first>! We have been waiting for you." They lead you into a nearby bunker. Inside, a single Remnant is standing over a hologram displaying fortifications and what appear to be troops and ships moving around.|2510|0
units.english: You step out of the <ship> to see a non-descript Remnant standing attentively next to the landing pad. "Captain <first>! We have been waiting for you." They lead you into a nearby bunker. Inside, a single Remnant is standing over a hologram displaying fortifications and what appear to be troops and ships moving around.
units.italian: Scendi dalla <ship> e vedi un Remnant anonimo in piedi, attento, accanto alla piazzola di atterraggio. "Capitano <first>! Ti stavamo aspettando." Ti conducono in un bunker vicino. All'interno, un solo Remnant è in piedi davanti a un ologramma che mostra fortificazioni e quelle che sembrano truppe e navi che si muovono.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Torza, Captain <first> is here." The Remnant's gestures convey a deep sense of respect.|2511|0
units.english: "Torza, Captain <first> is here." The Remnant's gestures convey a deep sense of respect.
units.italian: "Torza, il capitano <first> è qui." I gesti del Remnant trasmettono un profondo senso di rispetto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	The Remnant steps forward and accepts the case from you. The case pops open, and he slots the crystal into a spot on the display. He nods as the display pops up several confirmations of data integrity. "Well, you have certainly made many ripples since you arrived in our little corner of the galaxy." He gestures and the large display zooms in on a spot to show you walking through a spaceport outfitter. The display shifts to show you helping wounded onto your ship. The scene shifts again to show you launching the small stealth surveillance satellite. Then the table shifts back to the display of troop movements.|2512|0
units.english: The Remnant steps forward and accepts the case from you. The case pops open, and he slots the crystal into a spot on the display. He nods as the display pops up several confirmations of data integrity. "Well, you have certainly made many ripples since you arrived in our little corner of the galaxy." He gestures and the large display zooms in on a spot to show you walking through a spaceport outfitter. The display shifts to show you helping wounded onto your ship. The scene shifts again to show you launching the small stealth surveillance satellite. Then the table shifts back to the display of troop movements.
units.italian: Il Remnant fa un passo avanti e accetta la custodia da te. La custodia si apre di scatto, e lui inserisce il cristallo in un alloggiamento del display. Annuisce mentre il display mostra diverse conferme di integrità dei dati. "Beh, hai decisamente creato molte increspature da quando sei arrivato nel nostro piccolo angolo di galassia." Fa un gesto e il grande display si avvicina su un punto per mostrarti che cammini in un fornitore di equipaggiamento dello spazioporto. Il display passa a mostrarti mentre aiuti i feriti a salire sulla tua nave. La scena cambia ancora per mostrarti che lanci il piccolo satellite di sorveglianza stealth. Poi il tavolo torna al display dei movimenti delle truppe.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"You have not been with us too long, but you have shown yourself to be trustworthy and eager to help." He gestures at the display. "As you can see, your actions have not gone unobserved. We have decided to amend your IFF registration as a result." He points to a set of slots next to the table similar to the ones that are installed on your ship. "Please place both your licenses in those slots, and I will confirm your side of the change."|2513|0
units.english: "You have not been with us too long, but you have shown yourself to be trustworthy and eager to help." He gestures at the display. "As you can see, your actions have not gone unobserved. We have decided to amend your IFF registration as a result." He points to a set of slots next to the table similar to the ones that are installed on your ship. "Please place both your licenses in those slots, and I will confirm your side of the change."
units.italian: "Non sei con noi da molto, ma hai dimostrato di essere affidabile e desideroso di aiutare." Fa un gesto verso il display. "Come vedi, le tue azioni non sono passate inosservate. Di conseguenza abbiamo deciso di modificare la tua registrazione IFF." Indica una serie di alloggiamenti accanto al tavolo, simili a quelli installati sulla tua nave. "Ti prego di mettere entrambe le tue licenze in quegli alloggiamenti, e confermerò la tua parte del cambiamento."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	(Place my licenses in the designated spots.)|2515|0
units.english: (Place my licenses in the designated spots.)
units.italian: (Metti le mie licenze negli alloggiamenti indicati.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"You have been watching me?"|2517|0
units.english: "You have been watching me?"
units.italian: "Mi stavate osservando?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Yes. There is very little that goes on in our worlds that is not observed by someone, and sometimes these events garner more attention than others." He looks at you. "You are one such. As a stranger among us, you were subject to much attention, although you probably did not notice most of it. Some felt it was too risky to trust you as far as we did, but the consensus was that you are worth the trust. Now," he gestures towards the console again, "place your licenses there, please."|2518|0
units.english: "Yes. There is very little that goes on in our worlds that is not observed by someone, and sometimes these events garner more attention than others." He looks at you. "You are one such. As a stranger among us, you were subject to much attention, although you probably did not notice most of it. Some felt it was too risky to trust you as far as we did, but the consensus was that you are worth the trust. Now," he gestures towards the console again, "place your licenses there, please."
units.italian: "Sì. Molto poco di quello che accade nei nostri mondi sfugge all'osservazione di qualcuno, e a volte questi eventi attirano più attenzione di altri." Ti guarda. "Tu sei uno di questi. Come straniero tra noi, sei stato oggetto di molta attenzione, anche se probabilmente non te ne sei accorto. Alcuni ritenevano troppo rischioso fidarsi di te fino a questo punto, ma il consenso è stato che vali la fiducia. Ora," fa di nuovo un gesto verso la console, "metti le tue licenze lì, per favore."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	Once you do as you are told, he inserts several unique objects, which share similarities with your licenses, into slots on his side of the table and taps several controls. "You are not yet one of us, but this brings you one step closer. Your IFF signature has been updated, and our ships' databases will be updated within a day." He removes the licenses and hands yours back to you with a relieved expression. "We are a curious people, and we fully understand the search for knowledge and to learn more about one's surroundings. But we also know how important it is to maintain our secrets.|2520|0
units.english: Once you do as you are told, he inserts several unique objects, which share similarities with your licenses, into slots on his side of the table and taps several controls. "You are not yet one of us, but this brings you one step closer. Your IFF signature has been updated, and our ships' databases will be updated within a day." He removes the licenses and hands yours back to you with a relieved expression. "We are a curious people, and we fully understand the search for knowledge and to learn more about one's surroundings. But we also know how important it is to maintain our secrets.
units.italian: Una volta che fai come ti è stato detto, inserisce diversi oggetti unici, che condividono somiglianze con le tue licenze, negli alloggiamenti dal suo lato del tavolo e tocca diversi comandi. "Non sei ancora uno di noi, ma questo ti avvicina di un passo. La tua firma IFF è stata aggiornata, e i database delle nostre navi saranno aggiornati entro un giorno." Rimuove le licenze e ti restituisce la tua con un'espressione sollevata. "Siamo un popolo curioso, e comprendiamo pienamente la ricerca della conoscenza e il desiderio di saperne di più su ciò che ci circonda. Ma sappiamo anche quanto sia importante mantenere i nostri segreti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	"Going forward, you are now authorized to scan Remnant ships, and we encourage you to do so, although you should wait a day or two for the update to propagate through our fleet." He looks amused by something, but his serious expression returns. "Scanning each other is, after all, a valuable form of security that gives us opportunities to spot infiltrators and unknown contaminants on returning ships. Scans are uploaded to our databases for signature matching via the Quantum Entangled Communicator built into the IFF mechanism onboard your ship, and we will return information such as alien outfit identification and tactical scan readouts whenever possible to help you."|2521|0
units.english: "Going forward, you are now authorized to scan Remnant ships, and we encourage you to do so, although you should wait a day or two for the update to propagate through our fleet." He looks amused by something, but his serious expression returns. "Scanning each other is, after all, a valuable form of security that gives us opportunities to spot infiltrators and unknown contaminants on returning ships. Scans are uploaded to our databases for signature matching via the Quantum Entangled Communicator built into the IFF mechanism onboard your ship, and we will return information such as alien outfit identification and tactical scan readouts whenever possible to help you."
units.italian: "D'ora in poi sei autorizzato a scansionare le navi dei Remnant, e ti incoraggiamo a farlo, anche se dovresti aspettare un giorno o due perché l'aggiornamento si propaghi nella nostra flotta." Sembra divertito da qualcosa, ma la sua espressione seria torna. "Scansionarci a vicenda è, dopotutto, una preziosa forma di sicurezza che ci dà l'opportunità di individuare infiltrati e contaminanti sconosciuti sulle navi di ritorno. Le scansioni vengono caricate sui nostri database per il confronto delle firme tramite il Comunicatore a Entanglement Quantistico integrato nel meccanismo IFF della tua nave, e ti restituiremo informazioni come l'identificazione degli equipaggiamenti alieni e le letture delle scansioni tattiche ogni volta che sarà possibile, per aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Scanning Tolerances|	He gives a tired sigh. "While I would enjoy answering a few of your questions, I should get back to supervising the operation." He gestures at the display, which has resumed showing the tactical movements of troops. "Thanks again for all your help, <first>."|2522|0
units.english: He gives a tired sigh. "While I would enjoy answering a few of your questions, I should get back to supervising the operation." He gestures at the display, which has resumed showing the tactical movements of troops. "Thanks again for all your help, <first>."
units.italian: Emette un sospiro stanco. "Anche se mi piacerebbe rispondere a qualcuna delle tue domande, dovrei tornare a sovrintendere l'operazione." Fa un gesto verso il display, che ha ripreso a mostrare i movimenti tattici delle truppe. "Grazie ancora per tutto il tuo aiuto, <first>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|name|2528|0
units.english: Visiting the Quarg
units.italian: Visitare i Quarg

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|description|2529|0
units.english: Take Remnant researchers to <destination> to see the Quarg.
units.italian: Porta dei ricercatori Remnant su <destination> per vedere i Quarg.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|As you relax in the cafeteria on <origin> you are approached by a young Remnant. Judging by the hand-held sensors and tools hanging off her belt, you suppose she is a researcher or an engineer.|2542|0
units.english: As you relax in the cafeteria on <origin> you are approached by a young Remnant. Judging by the hand-held sensors and tools hanging off her belt, you suppose she is a researcher or an engineer.
units.italian: Mentre ti rilassi in mensa su <origin>, ti si avvicina un giovane Remnant. A giudicare dai sensori e dagli attrezzi portatili che le pendono dalla cintura, supponi che sia una ricercatrice o un'ingegnera.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	"Hello Captain <last>. My name is Dawn, and I have been spending the past few days skimming the archive you retrieved. I wanted to ask you a few questions. May I?"|2543|0
units.english: "Hello Captain <last>. My name is Dawn, and I have been spending the past few days skimming the archive you retrieved. I wanted to ask you a few questions. May I?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <last>. Mi chiamo Dawn e ho passato gli ultimi giorni a sfogliare l'archivio che hai recuperato. Volevo farti qualche domanda. Posso?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	She slides into the chair opposite you without waiting for your reply, and pulls out a data pad. "Firstly, our histories mention how humanity met a race called the 'Quarg' and had some ongoing dialogs with them, but not much beyond that. Now here in this history that you brought us, it says that humanity has started exchanging technology with them! Is this true?" She looks at you intently. You sign negatively, and she dejectedly continues. "Could you explain about them, then?" You reply that the Quarg have allowed humanity to live near them, and that the Quarg are usually willing to answer questions, including scientific ones. You continue, elaborating that while the Quarg don't seem to mind having an innovative shipyard studying them as best it can, they don't actually share their technology with anyone.|2544|0
units.english: She slides into the chair opposite you without waiting for your reply, and pulls out a data pad. "Firstly, our histories mention how humanity met a race called the 'Quarg' and had some ongoing dialogs with them, but not much beyond that. Now here in this history that you brought us, it says that humanity has started exchanging technology with them! Is this true?" She looks at you intently. You sign negatively, and she dejectedly continues. "Could you explain about them, then?" You reply that the Quarg have allowed humanity to live near them, and that the Quarg are usually willing to answer questions, including scientific ones. You continue, elaborating that while the Quarg don't seem to mind having an innovative shipyard studying them as best it can, they don't actually share their technology with anyone.
units.italian: Si infila sulla sedia di fronte a te senza aspettare la risposta, e tira fuori un data pad. "Primo: le nostre storie raccontano di come l'umanità abbia incontrato una specie chiamata 'Quarg' e abbia avuto con loro alcuni dialoghi in corso, ma non molto di più. Ora in questa storia che ci hai portato c'è scritto che l'umanità ha iniziato a scambiare tecnologia con loro! È vero?" Ti guarda intensamente. Fai un segno negativo, e lei continua delusa: "Potresti spiegarmi qualcosa su di loro, allora?" Rispondi che i Quarg hanno permesso all'umanità di vivere vicino a loro, e che di solito sono disposti a rispondere alle domande, anche quelle scientifiche. Continui, spiegando che i Quarg non sembrano dispiaciuti di avere un cantiere innovativo che li studia come può, ma che in realtà non condividono la loro tecnologia con nessuno.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	After several hours of telling her about meeting the Quarg and visiting their worlds, it finally occurs to you that it would be easy enough to take her to visit the Tarazed system.|2545|0
units.english: After several hours of telling her about meeting the Quarg and visiting their worlds, it finally occurs to you that it would be easy enough to take her to visit the Tarazed system.
units.italian: Dopo diverse ore passate a raccontarle dell'incontro con i Quarg e delle visite ai loro mondi, ti viene finalmente in mente che sarebbe abbastanza facile portarla a visitare il sistema di Tarazed.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	(Offer to take her there.)|2547|0
units.english: (Offer to take her there.)
units.italian: (Offriti di portarla lì.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	(Don't offer.)|2548|0
units.english: (Don't offer.)
units.italian: (Non offrirti.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	You offer to take her and a couple of her colleagues to see the Quarg. She eagerly accepts, although she expresses a preference for landing on the human world, so they can observe the Quarg ships from a distance, as they would rather not draw any attention to themselves. She runs out of the cafeteria after telling you they will meet you at your ship in half an hour.|2550|0
units.english: You offer to take her and a couple of her colleagues to see the Quarg. She eagerly accepts, although she expresses a preference for landing on the human world, so they can observe the Quarg ships from a distance, as they would rather not draw any attention to themselves. She runs out of the cafeteria after telling you they will meet you at your ship in half an hour.
units.italian: Ti offri di portarla lì con un paio dei suoi colleghi a vedere i Quarg. Accetta con entusiasmo, anche se esprime la preferenza di atterrare sul mondo umano, così possono osservare le navi Quarg da lontano, dato che preferirebbero non attirare l'attenzione su di sé. Corre fuori dalla mensa dopo averti detto che ti incontreranno alla tua nave tra mezz'ora.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|dialog|2553|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that you left Dawn and her colleagues on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto di aver lasciato Dawn e i suoi colleghi su una delle tue scorte che non è entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|log|2555|0
units.english: Dawn is a young Remnant researcher with a strong interest in engineering. She has yet to pick a specialty, but appears to have a talent for exo-engineering.
units.italian: Dawn è una giovane ricercatrice Remnant con un forte interesse per l'ingegneria. Non ha ancora scelto una specialità, ma sembra avere talento per l'exo-ingegneria.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|Dawn and her colleagues are thrilled with the trip. While they had each served on Remnant ships exploring the Ember Waste or patrolling their territory, none had ever been more than a handful of jumps away from their own space. They explain that their ships were always cautious to stay far away from human space to avoid leading anyone back.|2557|0
units.english: Dawn and her colleagues are thrilled with the trip. While they had each served on Remnant ships exploring the Ember Waste or patrolling their territory, none had ever been more than a handful of jumps away from their own space. They explain that their ships were always cautious to stay far away from human space to avoid leading anyone back.
units.italian: Dawn e i suoi colleghi sono entusiasti del viaggio. Anche se ognuno di loro aveva prestato servizio su navi dei Remnant esplorando la Distesa di Braci o pattugliando il loro territorio, nessuno si era mai allontanato più di una manciata di salti dal proprio spazio. Spiegano che le loro navi sono sempre state attente a restare lontane dallo spazio umano per non condurre qualcuno fino a loro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	It occurs to you that Dawn and her colleagues seem much less reserved than most Remnant. You aren't sure if it is because they are younger, less secretive, or if the Remnant have been holding back from you. It is also possible that you just have better opportunities to figure it out now that you can understand their signs.|2558|0
units.english: It occurs to you that Dawn and her colleagues seem much less reserved than most Remnant. You aren't sure if it is because they are younger, less secretive, or if the Remnant have been holding back from you. It is also possible that you just have better opportunities to figure it out now that you can understand their signs.
units.italian: Ti viene in mente che Dawn e i suoi colleghi sembrano molto meno riservati della maggior parte dei Remnant. Non sei sicuro se sia perché sono più giovani, meno riservati, o se i Remnant ti abbiano trattenuto qualcosa. È anche possibile che tu abbia semplicemente occasioni migliori per capirlo ora che sai leggere i loro segni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	Upon arriving at Wayfarer they spend a considerable amount of time watching the few Quarg in evidence. However, it is easy to see that the real draw of their attention is the ships. You wave your ID across the scanner for the shipyard and take them inside to see what Tarazed Shipyards has on display.|2559|0
units.english: Upon arriving at Wayfarer they spend a considerable amount of time watching the few Quarg in evidence. However, it is easy to see that the real draw of their attention is the ships. You wave your ID across the scanner for the shipyard and take them inside to see what Tarazed Shipyards has on display.
units.italian: Arrivando a Wayfarer passano molto tempo a osservare i pochi Quarg presenti. Tuttavia è facile vedere che il vero richiamo della loro attenzione sono le navi. Passi il tuo ID sullo scanner del cantiere e li porti dentro a vedere cosa ha in mostra il Cantiere di Tarazed.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	After a few minutes a sales agent meanders over to ask if there's anything he can do to help. You ask a few questions about the different ships for Dawn's benefit, listen to the sales agent repeat a few lines from the display, then politely tell him you'll just browse on your own.|2562|0
units.english: After a few minutes a sales agent meanders over to ask if there's anything he can do to help. You ask a few questions about the different ships for Dawn's benefit, listen to the sales agent repeat a few lines from the display, then politely tell him you'll just browse on your own.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto un venditore si avvicina per chiedere se può fare qualcosa. Fai qualche domanda sulle diverse navi a beneficio di Dawn, ascolti il venditore ripetere qualche frase dal display, poi gli dici cortesemente che darai un'occhiata da solo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	Almost before you are in the main hall a sales manager is at your side, inquiring as to how he can help. You can almost see the credit signs in his eyes and you suspect that scanning your license may have done a quick check of your net worth too.|2565|0
units.english: Almost before you are in the main hall a sales manager is at your side, inquiring as to how he can help. You can almost see the credit signs in his eyes and you suspect that scanning your license may have done a quick check of your net worth too.
units.italian: Quasi prima che tu sia nella sala principale un responsabile delle vendite è al tuo fianco, che chiede come può aiutare. Riesci quasi a vedere i segni dei crediti nei suoi occhi e sospetti che scansionare la tua licenza abbia fatto anche un rapido controllo del tuo patrimonio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	You ask a few leading questions about new designs and play the part of a captain with more money than brains, and the manager eagerly directs you to the large hangars near the end that house their largest and fanciest ships.
