After it becomes clear that he doesn't have any experience flying them you politely disentangle yourselves from him to look at the ships in peace.|2566|0
units.english: You ask a few leading questions about new designs and play the part of a captain with more money than brains, and the manager eagerly directs you to the large hangars near the end that house their largest and fanciest ships. After it becomes clear that he doesn't have any experience flying them you politely disentangle yourselves from him to look at the ships in peace.
units.italian: Fai qualche domanda tendenziosa sui nuovi progetti e reciti la parte del capitano con più soldi che cervello, e il responsabile ti indirizza con entusiasmo ai grandi hangar in fondo che ospitano le loro navi più grandi e sfarzose. Dopo che è chiaro che non ha esperienza nel pilotarle, vi liberate cortesemente di lui per guardare le navi in pace.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 1|	After an hour of browsing, the young Remnant agree to meet you back at the spaceport in an hour and take off to the outfitters.|2568|0
units.english: After an hour of browsing, the young Remnant agree to meet you back at the spaceport in an hour and take off to the outfitters.
units.italian: Dopo un'ora di giri, i giovani Remnant accettano di incontrarti allo spazioporto tra un'ora e decollano verso i fornitori di equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|name|2573|0
units.english: Quarg Scanning
units.italian: Scansione dei Quarg

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|description|2574|0
units.english: Perform an outfit scan on the Quarg ship <npc>, then land again on <destination>.
units.italian: Esegui una scansione dell'equipaggiamento sulla nave Quarg <npc>, poi atterra di nuovo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|Dawn and her fellow researchers show up a few minutes after you do, excitedly talking about the various things they have seen. "<first>, there is a Quarg ship taking off shortly, and we were hoping you might be able to get scans of it while it is in flight. It would be really helpful for our understanding of how they work."|2580|0
units.english: Dawn and her fellow researchers show up a few minutes after you do, excitedly talking about the various things they have seen. "<first>, there is a Quarg ship taking off shortly, and we were hoping you might be able to get scans of it while it is in flight. It would be really helpful for our understanding of how they work."
units.italian: Dawn e le sue colleghe ricercatrici arrivano qualche minuto dopo di te, parlando eccitate delle varie cose che hanno visto. "<first>, una nave Quarg decollerà a breve, e speravamo che tu potessi ottenerne le scansioni mentre è in volo. Ci sarebbe davvero utile per capire come funzionano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|log|2584|0
units.english: Volunteered to show Dawn and some of her fellow researchers the world where humans and Quarg co-exist.
units.italian: Ti sei offerto di mostrare a Dawn e ad alcuni suoi colleghi ricercatori il mondo in cui umani e Quarg convivono.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|Dawn and her compatriots eagerly pore over the readouts as they come in, then ask if you could land again to compare their scans to ones taken on the ground.|2599|0
units.english: Dawn and her compatriots eagerly pore over the readouts as they come in, then ask if you could land again to compare their scans to ones taken on the ground.
units.italian: Dawn e i suoi compagni si chinano avidamente sulle letture man mano che arrivano, poi chiedono se puoi atterrare di nuovo per confrontare le loro scansioni con quelle prese a terra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|dialog|2602|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you have not yet scanned the <npc>'s. Depart and use an outfit scanner to scan the ship.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora scansionato la nave <npc>. Decolla e usa uno scanner di equipaggiamento per scansionare la nave.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|The Remnant researchers' attention to detail is impressive. They carefully quantify every aspect of the scans, including notes about the ship's behaviors. By the time you are on the ground again, they have amassed quite a collection of data crystals filled with analysis. You note that they are careful to ensure everything they collect is backed up in multiple places, including what appears to be a small lead lined box.|2605|0
units.english: The Remnant researchers' attention to detail is impressive. They carefully quantify every aspect of the scans, including notes about the ship's behaviors. By the time you are on the ground again, they have amassed quite a collection of data crystals filled with analysis. You note that they are careful to ensure everything they collect is backed up in multiple places, including what appears to be a small lead lined box.
units.italian: L'attenzione ai dettagli dei ricercatori Remnant è impressionante. Quantificano con cura ogni aspetto delle scansioni, comprese note sul comportamento della nave. Quando sei di nuovo a terra, hanno accumulato una discreta collezione di cristalli di dati pieni di analisi. Noti che sono attenti ad assicurarsi che tutto quello che raccolgono sia copiato in più posti, compresa quella che sembra una piccola scatola foderata di piombo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 2|	Dawn does some follow-up scans of idle Quarg ships, and her fellow researchers take some time to make sure all their pictures are crisp and detailed. They let you know that they will meet you back in the spaceport bar once they are done.|2606|0
units.english: Dawn does some follow-up scans of idle Quarg ships, and her fellow researchers take some time to make sure all their pictures are crisp and detailed. They let you know that they will meet you back in the spaceport bar once they are done.
units.italian: Dawn fa qualche scansione di follow-up di navi Quarg inattive, e i suoi colleghi ricercatori si prendono un po' di tempo per assicurarsi che tutte le loro immagini siano nitide e dettagliate. Ti fanno sapere che ti incontreranno al bar dello spazioporto quando hanno finito.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|name|2611|0
units.english: Expanded Horizons Return
units.italian: Ritorno di Expanded Horizons

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|description|2612|0
units.english: Return the Remnant researchers to <planet>.
units.italian: Riporta i ricercatori Remnant su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|blocked|2618|0
units.english: This mission requires bunks for three passengers.
units.italian: Questa missione richiede cuccette per tre passeggeri.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|Back in the spaceport bar you wait around for a couple hours. Just when you were about to go find them, the trio walk in looking like they had spent all day on the move, but otherwise unreadable.|2623|0
units.english: Back in the spaceport bar you wait around for a couple hours. Just when you were about to go find them, the trio walk in looking like they had spent all day on the move, but otherwise unreadable.
units.italian: Tornato al bar dello spazioporto, aspetti un paio d'ore. Proprio quando stavi per andarli a cercare, i tre entrano con l'aria di aver passato tutta la giornata in movimento, ma per il resto imperscrutabili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|	"Okay, I think we are ready to go. Can you take us to <planet>?"|2624|0
units.english: "Okay, I think we are ready to go. Can you take us to <planet>?"
units.italian: "Bene, credo che siamo pronti a partire. Puoi portarci su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|dialog|2627|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that you left Dawn and her colleagues on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto di aver lasciato Dawn e i suoi colleghi su una delle tue scorte che non è entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|Once you are back in the privacy of the <ship>, the stony reserve fades to cheerfulness as the trio are a blur of motion, chattering back and forth with their signs. Apparently this will be one of the biggest boosts to their research since the first time they salvaged the gear off a Korath raider.|2631|0
units.english: Once you are back in the privacy of the <ship>, the stony reserve fades to cheerfulness as the trio are a blur of motion, chattering back and forth with their signs. Apparently this will be one of the biggest boosts to their research since the first time they salvaged the gear off a Korath raider.
units.italian: Una volta che siete di nuovo nella privacy della <ship>, la riservatezza di pietra svanisce in allegria mentre i tre sono un turbinio di movimento, chiacchierando tra loro a segni. A quanto pare questo sarà uno dei maggiori impulsi alla loro ricerca da quando hanno recuperato per la prima volta l'attrezzatura da un predone Korath.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|	They eventually slow down their signs a bit and explain that up until the time the Remnant departed from ancestral space, human scanners had been unable to penetrate the outer layers of Quarg ships. One of Dawn's fellow researchers continues with the explanation.|2632|0
units.english: They eventually slow down their signs a bit and explain that up until the time the Remnant departed from ancestral space, human scanners had been unable to penetrate the outer layers of Quarg ships. One of Dawn's fellow researchers continues with the explanation.
units.italian: Alla fine rallentano un po' i segni e spiegano che fino al momento in cui i Remnant sono partiti dallo spazio ancestrale, gli scanner umani non erano riusciti a penetrare gli strati esterni delle navi Quarg. Uno dei colleghi di Dawn continua la spiegazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|	"Our historical records just have a few pictures and videos of Quarg ships, along with a basic scan that doesn't provide more than the general outline of the ship. These scans," he says while tapping the databanks, "actually picked up detailed structural layouts and even identified a number of key components. It isn't nearly enough information to be able to duplicate them, but it is enough that we can start trying to figure out how they work."|2633|0
units.english: "Our historical records just have a few pictures and videos of Quarg ships, along with a basic scan that doesn't provide more than the general outline of the ship. These scans," he says while tapping the databanks, "actually picked up detailed structural layouts and even identified a number of key components. It isn't nearly enough information to be able to duplicate them, but it is enough that we can start trying to figure out how they work."
units.italian: "I nostri archivi storici hanno solo qualche foto e video di navi Quarg, insieme a una scansione di base che non fornisce più dell'aspetto generale della nave. Queste scansioni," dice battendo sulle banche dati, "hanno effettivamente rilevato layout strutturali dettagliati e persino identificato diversi componenti chiave. Non è affatto abbastanza informazione per poterli duplicare, ma basta per poter iniziare a capire come funzionano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Quarg 3|	Upon arriving at <planet> they quickly thank you, hand you <payment>, and run back to their offices to finish prepping their material to publish and distribute.|2634|0
units.english: Upon arriving at <planet> they quickly thank you, hand you <payment>, and run back to their offices to finish prepping their material to publish and distribute.
units.italian: Arrivando su <planet> ti ringraziano rapidamente, ti consegnano <payment> e corrono nei loro uffici a finire di preparare il loro materiale per la pubblicazione e la distribuzione.

units.id: phrase:broken jump drive on visit|You've landed on <planet>, but you don't have a broken jump drive to give to the Remnant. You may need to steal one from Palavrets or Rano'ereks found through Remnant jobs, or depart and wait for an escort carrying one to enter the system.|2640|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you don't have a broken jump drive to give to the Remnant. You may need to steal one from Palavrets or Rano'ereks found through Remnant jobs, or depart and wait for an escort carrying one to enter the system.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai un motore di salto rotto da dare ai Remnant. Potrebbe servirti rubarne uno ai Palavrets o ai Rano'ereks trovati tramite i lavori dei Remnant, oppure partire e aspettare che una scorta che ne trasporta uno entri nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|name|2646|0
units.english: Broken Jump Drive Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di un motore di salto rotto

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|description|2647|0
units.english: You have been asked to deliver a broken jump drive to the researchers on <planet>.
units.italian: Ti è stato chiesto di consegnare un motore di salto rotto ai ricercatori su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|As the <ship> settles onto its designated landing pad, you see someone emerge from the nearby outfitter and quickly make their way to you. The man waits a safe distance before approaching once you cycle the hatch and disembark. "Greetings, Captain <last>," trills the Remnant, "we saw the news that the newcomer among us was tracking down an erratic Korath ship. When you came in to land, we saw on the scans that you salvaged its malfunctioning jump drive. Could we take it to study?"|2666|0
units.english: As the <ship> settles onto its designated landing pad, you see someone emerge from the nearby outfitter and quickly make their way to you. The man waits a safe distance before approaching once you cycle the hatch and disembark. "Greetings, Captain <last>," trills the Remnant, "we saw the news that the newcomer among us was tracking down an erratic Korath ship. When you came in to land, we saw on the scans that you salvaged its malfunctioning jump drive. Could we take it to study?"
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> si posa sulla piazzola assegnata, vedi qualcuno uscire dal fornitore di equipaggiamento lì vicino e dirigersi rapidamente verso di te. L'uomo aspetta a distanza di sicurezza prima di avvicinarsi, una volta che hai aperto il portello e sei sceso. "Salve, capitano <last>," trilla il Remnant, "abbiamo visto la notizia che il nuovo arrivato tra noi stava dando la caccia a una nave Korath irregolare. Quando sei venuto ad atterrare, abbiamo visto dalle scansioni che hai recuperato il suo motore di salto malfunzionante. Potremmo prenderlo per studiarlo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"Maybe later."|2668|0
units.english: "Maybe later."
units.italian: "Forse dopo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"That would be a good use for it."|2670|0
units.english: "That would be a good use for it."
units.italian: "Sarebbe un buon impiego."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|You have a broken jump drive that the Remnant might be interested in. Do you want to seek out someone to give it to?|2674|0
units.english: You have a broken jump drive that the Remnant might be interested in. Do you want to seek out someone to give it to?
units.italian: Hai un motore di salto rotto che potrebbe interessare ai Remnant. Vuoi cercare qualcuno a cui darlo?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	(Maybe later.)|2676|0
units.english: (Maybe later.)
units.italian: (Forse dopo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	(Yes.)|2678|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	You find a Remnant director and inform them about the broken jump drive that you have.|2679|0
units.english: You find a Remnant director and inform them about the broken jump drive that you have.
units.italian: Trovi un direttore Remnant e lo informi del motore di salto rotto che hai.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"Excellent!" he glances at his data pad. "There are several teams working on aspects of the jump drive, and the team with the highest priority for this one is on <planet>. I will notify them to expect you."|2682|0
units.english: "Excellent!" he glances at his data pad. "There are several teams working on aspects of the jump drive, and the team with the highest priority for this one is on <planet>. I will notify them to expect you."
units.italian: "Eccellente!" Dà un'occhiata al suo data pad. "Ci sono diverse squadre che lavorano ad aspetti del motore di salto, e la squadra con la priorità più alta per questo è su <planet>. Li avviserò di aspettarti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	He considers this, and sings, "If you wish. Our offer stands, whenever you choose to return."|2685|0
units.english: He considers this, and sings, "If you wish. Our offer stands, whenever you choose to return."
units.italian: Lo considera, e canta: "Se vuoi. La nostra offerta resta valida, ogni volta che scegli di tornare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|When you arrive on <planet> there is a team of engineers and mechanics waiting for you, along with a flatbed freight truck. Once you open the cargo doors they quickly free the broken jump drive from its moorings and load it delicately onto their truck. The lead engineer comes over to hand you <payment>. "Thank you for salvaging this. I suspect my compatriot who spoke to you never mentioned this, but we have a fund set aside for rewarding captains who bring in rare pieces of alien technology. If you find any more of these drives, there is sure to be a research team somewhere that is willing to reward you for it."|2695|0
units.english: When you arrive on <planet> there is a team of engineers and mechanics waiting for you, along with a flatbed freight truck. Once you open the cargo doors they quickly free the broken jump drive from its moorings and load it delicately onto their truck. The lead engineer comes over to hand you <payment>. "Thank you for salvaging this. I suspect my compatriot who spoke to you never mentioned this, but we have a fund set aside for rewarding captains who bring in rare pieces of alien technology. If you find any more of these drives, there is sure to be a research team somewhere that is willing to reward you for it."
units.italian: Quando arrivi su <planet> c'è una squadra di ingegneri e meccanici che ti aspetta, insieme a un camion a pianale. Appena apri le porte del vano cargo liberano rapidamente il motore di salto rotto dai suoi ancoraggi e lo caricano con delicatezza sul camion. L'ingegnere capo viene a consegnarti <payment>. "Grazie per averlo recuperato. Sospetto che il mio compatriota che ti ha parlato non lo abbia mai menzionato, ma abbiamo un fondo messo da parte per ricompensare i capitani che portano pezzi rari di tecnologia aliena. Se trovi altri motori di questo tipo, di sicuro da qualche parte c'è una squadra di ricerca disposta a ricompensarti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"I will keep a lookout for more."|2697|0
units.english: "I will keep a lookout for more."
units.italian: "Terrò gli occhi aperti per altri."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"Aren't you going to replace it with a hyperdrive?"|2699|0
units.english: "Aren't you going to replace it with a hyperdrive?"
units.italian: "Non lo sostituirete con un motore iperspaziale?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	The engineer looks at you incredulously. "You mean you were actually trying to use this drive?" He shakes his head in disbelief. "You are lucky you managed to get this far, then. It is surprising that they exist at all, so it is too much to expect them to work too. If you need a replacement drive, there are plenty available in the outfitter.|2700|0
units.english: The engineer looks at you incredulously. "You mean you were actually trying to use this drive?" He shakes his head in disbelief. "You are lucky you managed to get this far, then. It is surprising that they exist at all, so it is too much to expect them to work too. If you need a replacement drive, there are plenty available in the outfitter.
units.italian: L'ingegnere ti guarda incredulo. "Intendi dire che stavi davvero cercando di usare questo motore?" Scuote la testa per la meraviglia. "Allora sei fortunato ad essere arrivato fin qui. È già sorprendente che esistano, quindi è troppo pretendere che funzionino anche. Se ti serve un motore di ricambio, ce ne sono in abbondanza al fornitore di equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 1|	"Next time you find one of these drives, just check with a starport director. They will know where it will need to go. A word of warning though; I strongly recommend not trying to use these drives - they may disappear at the most inconvenient of times, and there will not always be an outfitter on hand." He turns and heads off with the rest of the team, turning briefly to give you friendly wave as they disembark.|2702|0
units.english: "Next time you find one of these drives, just check with a starport director. They will know where it will need to go. A word of warning though; I strongly recommend not trying to use these drives - they may disappear at the most inconvenient of times, and there will not always be an outfitter on hand." He turns and heads off with the rest of the team, turning briefly to give you friendly wave as they disembark.
units.italian: "La prossima volta che trovi uno di questi motori, chiedi a un direttore dello spazioporto. Saprà dove deve andare. Un avvertimento però: ti raccomando caldamente di non provare a usare questi motori, potrebbero sparire nei momenti più scomodi, e non ci sarà sempre un fornitore di equipaggiamento a portata di mano." Si volta e se ne va con il resto della squadra, voltandosi brevemente per farti un cenno amichevole mentre sbarcano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|name|2707|0
units.english: Broken Jump Drive Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di un motore di salto rotto

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	Information must flow quickly amongst the Remnant, because by the time you arrive at the director's desk she already has the information ready for you.|2727|0
units.english: Information must flow quickly amongst the Remnant, because by the time you arrive at the director's desk she already has the information ready for you.
units.italian: L'informazione deve circolare in fretta tra i Remnant, perché quando arrivi alla scrivania della direttrice lei ha già le informazioni pronte per te.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"Greetings, newcomer," she chants. "Are you interested in turning in the broken jump drive you salvaged to our researchers?"|2728|0
units.english: "Greetings, newcomer," she chants. "Are you interested in turning in the broken jump drive you salvaged to our researchers?"
units.italian: "Salve, nuovo arrivato," intona. "Ti interessa consegnare ai nostri ricercatori il motore di salto rotto che hai recuperato?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	You nod.|2729|0
units.english: You nod.
units.italian: Annuisci.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"They will definitely appreciate new material to research. The team is located on <planet>. I will send a notification ahead so they will be expecting you."|2730|0
units.english: "They will definitely appreciate new material to research. The team is located on <planet>. I will send a notification ahead so they will be expecting you."
units.italian: "Apprezzeranno decisamente nuovo materiale da studiare. La squadra si trova su <planet>. Manderò un avviso in anticipo così ti staranno aspettando."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|As promised, there is a team of researchers waiting when you settle onto the designated landing pad. One comes over to hand you <payment> while the rest carefully unload the broken drive and start hauling it back to their lab.|2740|0
units.english: As promised, there is a team of researchers waiting when you settle onto the designated landing pad. One comes over to hand you <payment> while the rest carefully unload the broken drive and start hauling it back to their lab.
units.italian: Come promesso, c'è una squadra di ricercatori che aspetta quando ti posi sulla piazzola designata. Uno viene a consegnarti <payment> mentre gli altri scaricano con cura il motore rotto e iniziano a trasportarlo al loro laboratorio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"Our thanks, Captain <last>. Having the remains of a drive like this will be very beneficial to our efforts." His voice cracks a bit, as if unused to being used much.|2741|0
units.english: "Our thanks, Captain <last>. Having the remains of a drive like this will be very beneficial to our efforts." His voice cracks a bit, as if unused to being used much.
units.italian: "I nostri ringraziamenti, capitano <last>. Avere i resti di un motore come questo sarà molto utile ai nostri sforzi." La sua voce si incrina un po', come se non fosse abituata a essere usata molto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"Great! I will find more."|2743|0
units.english: "Great! I will find more."
units.italian: "Ottimo! Ne troverò altri."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"What are you studying?"|2745|0
units.english: "What are you studying?"
units.italian: "Cosa state studiando?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"Our previous research into jump drives determined that these drives are unsurprisingly multi-part systems. We know the outer part that we can see and handle is mostly the machinery for generating some kind of containment field or pocket. As to how it works or why it is needed..." his chant trails off and he makes a gesture you suspect may be the equivalent of a shrug. "Anyway, our team is focused on the nature of this outer system. It is our hope that, damaged as it is, its continued existence might allow us to look a little farther inside its inner workings to figure out exactly what that field does and how it is used.|2746|0
units.english: "Our previous research into jump drives determined that these drives are unsurprisingly multi-part systems. We know the outer part that we can see and handle is mostly the machinery for generating some kind of containment field or pocket. As to how it works or why it is needed..." his chant trails off and he makes a gesture you suspect may be the equivalent of a shrug. "Anyway, our team is focused on the nature of this outer system. It is our hope that, damaged as it is, its continued existence might allow us to look a little farther inside its inner workings to figure out exactly what that field does and how it is used.
units.italian: "La nostra ricerca precedente sui motori di salto ha stabilito che questi motori sono, senza sorpresa, sistemi a più parti. Sappiamo che la parte esterna che possiamo vedere e maneggiare è per lo più il macchinario per generare una specie di campo o tasca di contenimento. Quanto a come funzioni o perché serva..." il suo canto si perde e fa un gesto che sospetti possa equivalere a un'alzata di spalle. "Comunque, la nostra squadra si concentra sulla natura di questo sistema esterno. Speriamo che, danneggiato com'è, la sua esistenza continuata ci permetta di guardare un po' più a fondo nel suo funzionamento interno per capire esattamente cosa faccia quel campo e come venga usato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 2|	"Well, my compatriots finished unloading rather quickly, so I should be off. For all our sakes, I hope you find more of these for us."|2748|0
units.english: "Well, my compatriots finished unloading rather quickly, so I should be off. For all our sakes, I hope you find more of these for us."
units.italian: "Beh, i miei colleghi hanno finito di scaricare piuttosto in fretta, quindi devo andare. Per il bene di tutti noi, spero che ne troverai altri per noi."

units.english: The researchers on <planet> need a broken jump drive for testing.
units.italian: I ricercatori su <planet> hanno bisogno di un motore di salto rotto per i test.

units.english: You've plundered another broken jump drive. Do you want to seek out a director to give it to?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	As you approach the director in the spaceport concourse, he looks up and waves at you. "Good timing, Captain <first>," he sings. "We have a team of researchers on <planet> who have requested a broken jump drive. Could you deliver one to them?"|2773|0
units.english: As you approach the director in the spaceport concourse, he looks up and waves at you. "Good timing, Captain <first>," he sings. "We have a team of researchers on <planet> who have requested a broken jump drive. Could you deliver one to them?"
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al direttore nel concorso dello spazioporto, alza lo sguardo e ti saluta con la mano. "Arrivi al momento giusto, capitano <first>," canta. "Abbiamo una squadra di ricercatori su <planet> che ha richiesto un motore di salto rotto. Potresti consegnarglielo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"I can," you respond.|2774|0
units.english: "I can," you respond.
units.italian: "Posso," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"Excellent. The recent discovery of these broken drives has spurred discussion and excitement in various quarters. We have had teams researching jump drives for at least a century now without a lot of success. I'm told they are rather intricate, but your finds are opening new avenues of investigation. That being said, I will notify the team on <planet> to expect you."|2775|0
units.english: "Excellent. The recent discovery of these broken drives has spurred discussion and excitement in various quarters. We have had teams researching jump drives for at least a century now without a lot of success. I'm told they are rather intricate, but your finds are opening new avenues of investigation. That being said, I will notify the team on <planet> to expect you."
units.italian: "Eccellente. La recente scoperta di questi motori rotti ha suscitato discussioni ed eccitazione in vari ambienti. Da almeno un secolo abbiamo squadre che studiano i motori di salto senza grandi successi. Mi dicono che sono piuttosto intricati, ma i tuoi ritrovamenti stanno aprendo nuove vie di indagine. Detto questo, avviserò la squadra su <planet> di aspettarti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|The team waiting for you on <planet> is definitely eager to begin. You barely have the hatch open before they are chivying their camel-pulled wagon up the ramp. They load the broken jump drive surprisingly quickly despite their delicate movements.|2785|0
units.english: The team waiting for you on <planet> is definitely eager to begin. You barely have the hatch open before they are chivying their camel-pulled wagon up the ramp. They load the broken jump drive surprisingly quickly despite their delicate movements.
units.italian: La squadra che ti aspetta su <planet> è decisamente impaziente di cominciare. Hai appena aperto il portello che già spingono il loro carro trainato da cammelli su per la rampa. Caricano il motore di salto rotto sorprendentemente in fretta, nonostante i movimenti delicati.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"This is an exciting day, Captain <first>! Countless theories may be proven or put back into the fires of refinement based on the testing we can do with this!"|2786|0
units.english: "This is an exciting day, Captain <first>! Countless theories may be proven or put back into the fires of refinement based on the testing we can do with this!"
units.italian: "È un giorno emozionante, capitano <first>! Teorie innumerevoli potranno essere dimostrate o rimandate nella fornace del perfezionamento grazie ai test che potremo fare con questo!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"Great! I will find more."|2788|0
units.english: "Great! I will find more."
units.italian: "Ottimo! Ne troverò altri."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"Any theories of note?"|2790|0
units.english: "Any theories of note?"
units.italian: "Qualche teoria degna di nota?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	He looks thoughtful for a moment, then warbles, "As you may know, standard hyperdrives work by generating a fusion reaction and folding it into the fabric of space/time, and these folds naturally fall along the known hyperlanes. I suppose one could view those lanes as the 'crease lines' of the universe. My favorite theory is that jump drives have some additional machinery to guide the fold. That way they can dictate where the fold occurs instead of just aligning with the nearest crease. Given their increased fuel draw, it makes sense that it would take more fuel to generate a fresh fold than to reuse an existing crease.|2791|0
units.english: He looks thoughtful for a moment, then warbles, "As you may know, standard hyperdrives work by generating a fusion reaction and folding it into the fabric of space/time, and these folds naturally fall along the known hyperlanes. I suppose one could view those lanes as the 'crease lines' of the universe. My favorite theory is that jump drives have some additional machinery to guide the fold. That way they can dictate where the fold occurs instead of just aligning with the nearest crease. Given their increased fuel draw, it makes sense that it would take more fuel to generate a fresh fold than to reuse an existing crease.
units.italian: Resta pensieroso per un momento, poi gorgheggia: "Come forse saprai, gli iperguidi standard funzionano generando una reazione di fusione e piegandola nel tessuto dello spazio-tempo, e queste pieghe cadono naturalmente lungo le ipervie conosciute. Si potrebbe considerare quelle vie come le linee di piega dell'universo. La mia teoria preferita è che i motori di salto abbiano qualche macchinario aggiuntivo per guidare la piega. Così possono decidere dove avviene la piega invece di limitarsi ad allinearsi alla piega più vicina. Dato il loro maggior consumo di carburante, ha senso che serva più carburante per generare una piega nuova che per riusare una piega esistente.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 3|	"Oh, before I forget..." he hands you <payment>. "Off to start setting up the tests." He sings half to himself as he trundles off after the wagon.|2793|0
units.english: "Oh, before I forget..." he hands you <payment>. "Off to start setting up the tests." He sings half to himself as he trundles off after the wagon.
units.italian: "Oh, prima che me ne dimentichi..." ti consegna <payment>. "Ora vado a iniziare a preparare i test." Canta a mezza voce tra sé mentre si allontana a passo pesante dietro il carro.

units.english: You have been asked to deliver a broken jump drive to the researchers on <planet>.
units.italian: Ti è stato chiesto di consegnare un motore di salto rotto ai ricercatori su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|You've plundered another broken jump drive. Do you want to seek out a director to give it to?|2813|0
units.english: You've plundered another broken jump drive. Do you want to seek out a director to give it to?
units.italian: Hai saccheggiato un altro motore di salto rotto. Vuoi cercare un direttore a cui darlo?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|You head over to the director's desk to see who is in need of the next broken jump drive. The director smiles at you, looks over several messages on her screen, then clears her throat.|2818|0
units.english: You head over to the director's desk to see who is in need of the next broken jump drive. The director smiles at you, looks over several messages on her screen, then clears her throat.
units.italian: Ti dirigi alla scrivania della direttrice per vedere chi ha bisogno del prossimo motore di salto rotto. La direttrice ti sorride, scorre diversi messaggi sul suo schermo, poi si schiarisce la voce.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"Your finds are very much in demand," she sings. "Could you bring this one to a team working on <planet>?"|2819|0
units.english: "Your finds are very much in demand," she sings. "Could you bring this one to a team working on <planet>?"
units.italian: "I tuoi ritrovamenti sono molto richiesti," canta. "Potresti portare questo a una squadra che lavora su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	You nod in response.|2820|0
units.english: You nod in response.
units.italian: Annuisci in risposta.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"Thank you. We are looking forward to seeing what comes from this."|2821|0
units.english: "Thank you. We are looking forward to seeing what comes from this."
units.italian: "Grazie. Non vediamo l'ora di vedere cosa ne verrà fuori."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|As you approach your designated pad, you spot a team of researchers with unloading equipment hustling out of a nearby entrance. Once you have completed your shutdown sequence they quickly set to work unloading the drive. Once the task is complete, they pause for a moment to hand you <payment>. "Thanks for finding this," they sing in unison. "Our labs are eager to begin work on your most recent find, Captain <first>. Our thanks!"|2831|0
units.english: As you approach your designated pad, you spot a team of researchers with unloading equipment hustling out of a nearby entrance. Once you have completed your shutdown sequence they quickly set to work unloading the drive. Once the task is complete, they pause for a moment to hand you <payment>. "Thanks for finding this," they sing in unison. "Our labs are eager to begin work on your most recent find, Captain <first>. Our thanks!"
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini alla piazzola designata, scorgi una squadra di ricercatori con attrezzatura da scarico che esce di corsa da un ingresso vicino. Una volta completata la sequenza di spegnimento si mettono subito al lavoro per scaricare il motore. Completato il compito, si fermano un momento per consegnarti <payment>. "Grazie per averlo trovato," cantano all'unisono. "I nostri laboratori sono impazienti di iniziare a lavorare sul tuo ultimo ritrovamento, capitano <first>. Grazie a te!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"Good luck with that."|2833|0
units.english: "Good luck with that."
units.italian: "Buona fortuna con quello."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"How is your research going?"|2835|0
units.english: "How is your research going?"
units.italian: "Come vanno le vostre ricerche?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"Good, and about to get better," they sing. "We are working on various aspects of a theory that the jump drive actually disregards traditional jumping entirely, and uses the folding mechanism to put the ship itself into a pocket, while somehow triggering an opening to said pocket in the target system." One of them continues, "If this is true, it could be fairly dangerous to try activating these anywhere close to fragile things like cities or mountains, which is why they put our lab on the far side of the planet from all such things.|2836|0
units.english: "Good, and about to get better," they sing. "We are working on various aspects of a theory that the jump drive actually disregards traditional jumping entirely, and uses the folding mechanism to put the ship itself into a pocket, while somehow triggering an opening to said pocket in the target system." One of them continues, "If this is true, it could be fairly dangerous to try activating these anywhere close to fragile things like cities or mountains, which is why they put our lab on the far side of the planet from all such things.
units.italian: "Bene, e sta per migliorare," cantano. "Stiamo lavorando a vari aspetti di una teoria secondo cui il motore di salto in realtà ignora del tutto il salto tradizionale, e usa il meccanismo di piegatura per mettere la nave stessa in una tasca, mentre in qualche modo provoca un'apertura verso quella tasca nel sistema di destinazione." Uno di loro continua: "Se è vero, potrebbe essere piuttosto pericoloso provare ad attivarli vicino a cose fragili come città o montagne, ed è per questo che hanno messo il nostro laboratorio dall'altra parte del pianeta rispetto a tutte queste cose.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 4|	"Well, we have a bit of a trip to get to our lab, but it should be exciting once we get there. Fare well!" With that, they head off towards a large vehicle nearby.|2838|0
units.english: "Well, we have a bit of a trip to get to our lab, but it should be exciting once we get there. Fare well!" With that, they head off towards a large vehicle nearby.
units.italian: "Beh, abbiamo un bel po' di strada per arrivare al laboratorio, ma dovrebbe essere emozionante una volta arrivati. Buon viaggio!" Detto questo, si avviano verso un grande veicolo lì vicino.

units.english: Broken Jump Drive Delivery

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|description|2844|0
units.english: A team of engineers on <planet> would like a broken jump drive to study.
units.italian: Una squadra di ingegneri su <planet> vorrebbe un motore di salto rotto da studiare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|You've plundered another broken jump drive. Do you want to seek out a director to give it to?|2858|0
units.english: You've plundered another broken jump drive. Do you want to seek out a director to give it to?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	You stop by the director's desk to report having salvaged another broken jump drive for one of their research teams. The director nods in appreciation and checks his list. "There is a new team starting a project on <planet>. Could you take it there please?"|2863|0
units.english: You stop by the director's desk to report having salvaged another broken jump drive for one of their research teams. The director nods in appreciation and checks his list. "There is a new team starting a project on <planet>. Could you take it there please?"
units.italian: Passi alla scrivania della direttrice per riferire di aver recuperato un altro motore di salto rotto per una delle loro squadre di ricerca. La direttrice annuisce in segno di apprezzamento e controlla la sua lista. "C'è una nuova squadra che inizia un progetto su <planet>. Potresti portarglielo lì, per favore?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"Sure," you respond.|2864|0
units.english: "Sure," you respond.
units.italian: "Certo," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"Much appreciated. The sooner they get it, the sooner they can start on their project. That being said, I have spoken with the other directors, and we have decided that we are getting so many requests that we will put these into the job board for you. Any time the landing scans detect one of these broken jump drives, the system will display a message on the job board listing where the next one needs to be delivered."|2865|0
units.english: "Much appreciated. The sooner they get it, the sooner they can start on their project. That being said, I have spoken with the other directors, and we have decided that we are getting so many requests that we will put these into the job board for you. Any time the landing scans detect one of these broken jump drives, the system will display a message on the job board listing where the next one needs to be delivered."
units.italian: "Molto apprezzato. Prima lo ricevono, prima possono iniziare il loro progetto. Detto questo, ho parlato con gli altri direttori, e abbiamo deciso che riceviamo così tante richieste che li metteremo nella bacheca degli incarichi per te. Ogni volta che le scansioni di atterraggio rilevano uno di questi motori di salto rotti, il sistema mostrerà un messaggio sulla bacheca degli incarichi che indica dove deve essere consegnato il prossimo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|The landing pad on <planet> is tucked away just behind the spaceport. A handful of engineers have a conveyor belt already set up to offload the drive from your ship when you arrive. When you open the hatch they extend it right up the ramp, and quickly load the drive onto it. The machinery quickly whisks the drive into a nearby structure along with its escort. A couple of the engineers stop by to talk with you and hand you <payment>.|2876|0
units.english: The landing pad on <planet> is tucked away just behind the spaceport. A handful of engineers have a conveyor belt already set up to offload the drive from your ship when you arrive. When you open the hatch they extend it right up the ramp, and quickly load the drive onto it. The machinery quickly whisks the drive into a nearby structure along with its escort. A couple of the engineers stop by to talk with you and hand you <payment>.
units.italian: La piazzola di atterraggio su <planet> è nascosta appena dietro lo spazioporto. Un gruppo di ingegneri ha già preparato un nastro trasportatore per scaricare il motore dalla tua nave quando arrivi. Quando apri il portello lo estendono fino alla rampa, e caricano rapidamente il motore. I macchinari portano via in fretta il motore in una struttura vicina insieme alla sua scorta. Un paio degli ingegneri si fermano a parlare con te e ti consegnano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"Thanks for bringing us this drive. It is a rare piece of technology for us to get our hands on."|2877|0
units.english: "Thanks for bringing us this drive. It is a rare piece of technology for us to get our hands on."
units.italian: "Grazie per averci portato questo motore. È un pezzo di tecnologia raro da avere tra le mani."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"I will leave you to it."|2879|0
units.english: "I will leave you to it."
units.italian: "Vi lascio lavorare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"What are you studying?"|2881|0
units.english: "What are you studying?"
units.italian: "Cosa state studiando?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	With a pleased expression they break into song about mining the deeps for the mysteries of the sky. As best you can tell, they are trying to figure out the materials that the drive is made with, followed by experiments to replicate those materials.|2882|0
units.english: With a pleased expression they break into song about mining the deeps for the mysteries of the sky. As best you can tell, they are trying to figure out the materials that the drive is made with, followed by experiments to replicate those materials.
units.italian: Con un'espressione soddisfatta scoppiano a cantare di scavare negli abissi per i misteri del cielo. Per quanto riesci a capire, stanno cercando di capire i materiali con cui è fatto il motore, seguiti da esperimenti per replicare quei materiali.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Broken Jump Drive 5|	"Our experiments await. May your search be fruitful!" they trill as they head off.|2884|0
units.english: "Our experiments await. May your search be fruitful!" they trill as they head off.
units.italian: "I nostri esperimenti ci aspettano. Che la tua ricerca sia fruttuosa!" trillano mentre si allontanano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|name|2903|0
units.english: Talk to Plume about the void sprites
units.italian: Parla con Plume degli spettri del vuoto

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|description|2904|0
units.english: Plume would be very interested in a report on what happened with the void sprites.
units.italian: Plume sarebbe molto interessato a un resoconto di quello che è successo con gli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|As the swirls of gas close over the <ship> you wonder idly what brought you back here. This time, there is no apologetic researcher asking you to risk your life for research, or to return eggs from where they were stolen. You catch a glimpse of the Archon materializing above the clouds as it decloaks, letting you know that you're being watched, but saying nothing; for now, it is nothing more than a silent, brooding presence in the skies of Nenia. The silent depths of an alien world fold over you, gradually erasing the rest of the galaxy from sight.|2916|0
units.english: As the swirls of gas close over the <ship> you wonder idly what brought you back here. This time, there is no apologetic researcher asking you to risk your life for research, or to return eggs from where they were stolen. You catch a glimpse of the Archon materializing above the clouds as it decloaks, letting you know that you're being watched, but saying nothing; for now, it is nothing more than a silent, brooding presence in the skies of Nenia. The silent depths of an alien world fold over you, gradually erasing the rest of the galaxy from sight.
units.italian: Mentre i vortici di gas si chiudono sulla <ship> ti chiedi oziosamente cosa ti abbia riportato qui. Questa volta non c'è nessun ricercatore pieno di scuse che ti chiede di rischiare la vita per la ricerca, o di restituire uova da dove sono state rubate. Scorgi l'Archon che si materializza sopra le nuvole mentre esce dal camuffamento, facendoti sapere che sei osservato, ma senza dire nulla; per ora è solo una presenza silenziosa e incombente nei cieli di Nenia. Le profondità silenziose di un mondo alieno ti avvolgono, cancellando gradualmente il resto della galassia dalla vista.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	As the <ship> levels off at the designated altitude, you strap yourself into a pressure suit. Stepping into the airlock, you grimace at the antiquity of these "hard-shell" shield systems, and lower the shields so that you can exit onto the hull. Out on the surface, you admire the misty kaleidoscope of colors filtering down through the cloud layers, playing over distant shapes moving in the mists.|2917|0
units.english: As the <ship> levels off at the designated altitude, you strap yourself into a pressure suit. Stepping into the airlock, you grimace at the antiquity of these "hard-shell" shield systems, and lower the shields so that you can exit onto the hull. Out on the surface, you admire the misty kaleidoscope of colors filtering down through the cloud layers, playing over distant shapes moving in the mists.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> si stabilizza all'altitudine stabilita, ti allacci nella tuta pressurizzata. Entrando nella camera di equilibrio, fai una smorfia per l'antichità di questi sistemi di scudi "a guscio duro", e abbassi gli scudi per poter uscire sullo scafo. Sulla superficie ammiri il caleidoscopio nebbioso di colori che filtra attraverso gli strati di nuvole, giocando su forme lontane che si muovono nelle nebbie.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	Before long several void sprites emerge, weaving and dancing among the clouds. They swirl for a few minutes around your cargo bay doors as if waiting for something, then pulse briefly with flickers of light and drop into the clouds below. Another void sprite flutters around the <ship>, poking at the hull and sliding over it with its tentacles. You quickly think to turn on your video recorder to catch the scene. The void sprite notices your brief movement, and turns towards you with a lunge. As it closes on you, your attention is drawn to what you suspect is its mouth: a zig-zagging crack that peels open like a zipper to reveal an opening that resembles an industrial grinder.|2918|0
units.english: Before long several void sprites emerge, weaving and dancing among the clouds. They swirl for a few minutes around your cargo bay doors as if waiting for something, then pulse briefly with flickers of light and drop into the clouds below. Another void sprite flutters around the <ship>, poking at the hull and sliding over it with its tentacles. You quickly think to turn on your video recorder to catch the scene. The void sprite notices your brief movement, and turns towards you with a lunge. As it closes on you, your attention is drawn to what you suspect is its mouth: a zig-zagging crack that peels open like a zipper to reveal an opening that resembles an industrial grinder.
units.italian: Prima che passi molto tempo emergono diversi spettri del vuoto, che si intrecciano e danzano tra le nuvole. Vorticano per qualche minuto intorno alle porte del tuo vano cargo come se aspettassero qualcosa, poi pulsano brevemente con guizzi di luce e calano nelle nuvole sottostanti. Un altro spettro del vuoto svolazza intorno alla <ship>, tastando lo scafo e scivolandoci sopra con i tentacoli. Ti viene subito in mente di accendere la videocamera per riprendere la scena. Lo spettro del vuoto nota il tuo breve movimento, e si volta verso di te con uno scatto. Mentre ti si avvicina, la tua attenzione è attratta da quello che sospetti sia la sua bocca: una fenditura a zig-zag che si apre come una cerniera lampo per rivelare un'apertura che somiglia a una macinatrice industriale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	Up close, the void sprite is massive. Most of its tentacles are easily as thick as your leg, and move with surprising speed and precision. It shifts through the air like a strange deep-sea fish in water. You can make out a low vibration you suspect is from the air whistling over the void sprite as it closes with you. As the giant creature rapidly approaches, you can feel a heavy paralysis weigh down on you. Suddenly, you recall that your shields are keyed to your equipment; you could activate them to protect yourself and they would extend around you. It probably wouldn't be too healthy for the void sprite, though.|2919|0
units.english: Up close, the void sprite is massive. Most of its tentacles are easily as thick as your leg, and move with surprising speed and precision. It shifts through the air like a strange deep-sea fish in water. You can make out a low vibration you suspect is from the air whistling over the void sprite as it closes with you. As the giant creature rapidly approaches, you can feel a heavy paralysis weigh down on you. Suddenly, you recall that your shields are keyed to your equipment; you could activate them to protect yourself and they would extend around you. It probably wouldn't be too healthy for the void sprite, though.
units.italian: Da vicino, lo spettro del vuoto è enorme. La maggior parte dei suoi tentacoli è facilmente spessa come la tua gamba, e si muove con velocità e precisione sorprendenti. Scivola nell'aria come uno strano pesce abissale nell'acqua. Riesci a distinguere una vibrazione bassa che sospetti venga dall'aria che fischia sullo spettro del vuoto mentre ti si avvicina. Mentre la creatura gigantesca si avvicina rapidamente, senti una pesante paralisi gravare su di te. All'improvviso ricordi che i tuoi scudi sono collegati al tuo equipaggiamento; potresti attivarli per proteggerti ed essi si estenderebbero intorno a te. Però probabilmente non sarebbe molto salutare per lo spettro del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	(Activate the shields.)|2921|0
units.english: (Activate the shields.)
units.italian: (Attiva gli scudi.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	(Do not activate the shields.)|2922|0
units.english: (Do not activate the shields.)
units.italian: (Non attivare gli scudi.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	You push against the paralysis and trigger the shields in a rush. The millisecond that follows feels like an eternity. The void sprite is just a few meters away, one tendril reaches out and touches you just as the shield slams into place. The tendril becomes caught on both sides of the shield, cleaving it in two. In the same instant, the pressure on your mind vanishes as if it was simply a dream. You momentarily stare at the immobile void sprite, frozen in shock over what just happened. Then time reasserts itself and the sprite spasms away from the ship with an unearthly crescendo of dissonant tones. It plunges down into the clouds, leaving you standing on your hull with the floating severed piece of tendril.|2926|0
units.english: You push against the paralysis and trigger the shields in a rush. The millisecond that follows feels like an eternity. The void sprite is just a few meters away, one tendril reaches out and touches you just as the shield slams into place. The tendril becomes caught on both sides of the shield, cleaving it in two. In the same instant, the pressure on your mind vanishes as if it was simply a dream. You momentarily stare at the immobile void sprite, frozen in shock over what just happened. Then time reasserts itself and the sprite spasms away from the ship with an unearthly crescendo of dissonant tones. It plunges down into the clouds, leaving you standing on your hull with the floating severed piece of tendril.
units.italian: Spingi contro la paralisi e attivi gli scudi di slancio. Il millisecondo che segue sembra un'eternità. Lo spettro del vuoto è a pochi metri, un tentacolo si allunga e ti tocca proprio mentre lo scudo si chiude in posizione. Il tentacolo resta impigliato da entrambi i lati dello scudo, tagliandolo in due. Nello stesso istante, la pressione sulla tua mente svanisce come se fosse solo un sogno. Fissi per un momento lo spettro del vuoto immobile, congelato dallo shock per quello che è appena successo. Poi il tempo riprende il suo corso e lo spettro si allontana dalla nave con uno spasmo e un crescendo ultraterreno di toni dissonanti. Si tuffa nelle nuvole, lasciandoti in piedi sullo scafo con il pezzo fluttuante del tentacolo reciso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	You carefully scoop up the tendril in a container and seal it. While the attack spoiled the beautiful moment, at least you have a sample and some recordings that might be of interest to Plume.|2927|0
units.english: You carefully scoop up the tendril in a container and seal it. While the attack spoiled the beautiful moment, at least you have a sample and some recordings that might be of interest to Plume.
units.italian: Raccogli con cura il tentacolo in un contenitore e lo sigilli. Anche se l'attacco ha rovinato quel momento bellissimo, almeno hai un campione e qualche registrazione che potrebbero interessare a Plume.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|label|2929|0
units.english: hold ground
units.italian: hold ground

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	The feeling of paralysis leaves your body as the void sprite is only a few meters away, but you resolve yourself to face down the creature without triggering your shields. Time seems to slow down as the sprite rushes up to you and its leading tentacle reaches out to touch you. As you brace for an impact you realize that the sprite has managed to bring itself to a complete stop and the tentacle has telescoped in on itself slightly. You can see that it is touching you, but you didn't even feel the impact. You and the void sprite stand frozen for a moment, and the force trying to paralyze you snaps off, replaced by a feeling of weightlessness. Moments later the void sprite pulls back and pulses skyward with an unearthly fountain of sounds, spiraling around the <ship> before disappearing into the swirling clouds.|2932|0
units.english: The feeling of paralysis leaves your body as the void sprite is only a few meters away, but you resolve yourself to face down the creature without triggering your shields. Time seems to slow down as the sprite rushes up to you and its leading tentacle reaches out to touch you. As you brace for an impact you realize that the sprite has managed to bring itself to a complete stop and the tentacle has telescoped in on itself slightly. You can see that it is touching you, but you didn't even feel the impact. You and the void sprite stand frozen for a moment, and the force trying to paralyze you snaps off, replaced by a feeling of weightlessness. Moments later the void sprite pulls back and pulses skyward with an unearthly fountain of sounds, spiraling around the <ship> before disappearing into the swirling clouds.
units.italian: La sensazione di paralisi lascia il tuo corpo mentre lo spettro del vuoto è a pochi metri, ma decidi di affrontare la creatura senza attivare gli scudi. Il tempo sembra rallentare mentre lo spettro ti si avvicina e il suo tentacolo anteriore si allunga per toccarti. Mentre ti prepari all'impatto ti rendi conto che lo spettro è riuscito a fermarsi completamente e che il tentacolo si è ritratto leggermente su sé stesso. Vedi che ti sta toccando, ma non hai nemmeno sentito l'impatto. Tu e lo spettro del vuoto restate immobili per un momento, e la forza che cercava di paralizzarti si spegne, sostituita da una sensazione di assenza di peso. Pochi istanti dopo lo spettro si ritrae e pulsa verso il cielo con una fontana ultraterrena di suoni, ruotando intorno alla <ship> prima di sparire nelle nuvole vorticose.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	As you re-enter the ship, you notice that your suit is covered in some kind of translucent slime. You scrape off as much as you can into a sealed container, but your pressure suit appears to be permanently stained an iridescent purplish color as a result. You resolve to go find Plume, since he will almost certainly find this interesting.|2933|0
units.english: As you re-enter the ship, you notice that your suit is covered in some kind of translucent slime. You scrape off as much as you can into a sealed container, but your pressure suit appears to be permanently stained an iridescent purplish color as a result. You resolve to go find Plume, since he will almost certainly find this interesting.
units.italian: Mentre rientri nella nave, noti che la tuta è coperta di una specie di melma traslucida. Ne raschi via quanta più puoi in un contenitore sigillato, ma la tuta pressurizzata sembra essersi macchiata permanentemente di un colore violaceo iridescente. Decidi di andare a cercare Plume, visto che quasi certamente lo troverà interessante.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|When you walk into Plume's lab on Aventine, you find him buried in some kind of holographic projection of your egg returning mission. You can see that he appears to be watching the video in slow-motion as he taps out notes on his data pad. After a few minutes he looks up and sees you standing in the entryway. He quickly pulls himself out of the projection and hits what you assume must be the pause button.|2939|0
units.english: When you walk into Plume's lab on Aventine, you find him buried in some kind of holographic projection of your egg returning mission. You can see that he appears to be watching the video in slow-motion as he taps out notes on his data pad. After a few minutes he looks up and sees you standing in the entryway. He quickly pulls himself out of the projection and hits what you assume must be the pause button.
units.italian: Quando entri nel laboratorio di Plume su Aventine, lo trovi immerso in una specie di proiezione olografica della tua missione di restituzione delle uova. Vedi che sembra guardare il video al rallentatore mentre batte appunti sul data pad. Dopo qualche minuto alza lo sguardo e ti vede in piedi sulla soglia. Si tira rapidamente fuori dalla proiezione e preme quello che supponi essere il tasto di pausa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	"Captain <first>! What a pleasant surprise," he trills. "If you are looking for more work, I don't have anything for you right now."|2940|0
units.english: "Captain <first>! What a pleasant surprise," he trills. "If you are looking for more work, I don't have anything for you right now."
units.italian: "Capitano <first>! Che bella sorpresa," trilla. "Se cerchi altro lavoro, al momento non ho niente per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	You tell Plume about how you visited Nenia and had an interesting encounter with a void sprite, and offer him the recording and container of slime. He eagerly accepts the data chip and the container from you. Sliding the container into some kind of machine, it immediately starts to whir as he slots the data chip into his console. Moments later his holographic projection shifts to the new footage. He checks the timestamps, then chants, "These will take me a little while to analyze. I will meet you in the spaceport in a few hours to discuss my preliminary findings."|2943|0
units.english: You tell Plume about how you visited Nenia and had an interesting encounter with a void sprite, and offer him the recording and container of slime. He eagerly accepts the data chip and the container from you. Sliding the container into some kind of machine, it immediately starts to whir as he slots the data chip into his console. Moments later his holographic projection shifts to the new footage. He checks the timestamps, then chants, "These will take me a little while to analyze. I will meet you in the spaceport in a few hours to discuss my preliminary findings."
units.italian: Racconti a Plume di come hai visitato Nenia e hai avuto un incontro interessante con uno spettro del vuoto, e gli offri la registrazione e il contenitore con la melma. Accetta con entusiasmo il chip dati e il contenitore. Infilando il contenitore in una specie di macchina, questa comincia subito a ronzare mentre lui inserisce il chip dati nella console. Pochi istanti dopo la sua proiezione olografica passa al nuovo filmato. Controlla i timestamp, poi intona: "Mi servirà un po' di tempo per analizzarli. Ti incontrerò allo spazioporto tra qualche ora per discutere i miei risultati preliminari."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	You tell Plume about how you visited Nenia and had a threatening encounter with a void sprite, and offer him the recording and container with the tentacle. Plume recoils from you in disgust. "After all our work rebuilding trust with the Archon and the void sprites, you go and risk it for... what, exactly? Sightseeing? Thrill of the hunt?" His chant settles into an angry tone. "Leave the recording on the console. I want no part of that tentacle, though."|2946|0
units.english: You tell Plume about how you visited Nenia and had a threatening encounter with a void sprite, and offer him the recording and container with the tentacle. Plume recoils from you in disgust. "After all our work rebuilding trust with the Archon and the void sprites, you go and risk it for... what, exactly? Sightseeing? Thrill of the hunt?" His chant settles into an angry tone. "Leave the recording on the console. I want no part of that tentacle, though."
units.italian: Racconti a Plume di come hai visitato Nenia e hai avuto un incontro minaccioso con uno spettro del vuoto, e gli offri la registrazione e il contenitore con il tentacolo. Plume si ritrae con disgusto. "Dopo tutto il nostro lavoro per ricostruire la fiducia con l'Archon e gli spettri del vuoto, vai a rischiarla per... cosa, esattamente? Turismo? Brivido della caccia?" Il suo canto si stabilizza su un tono arrabbiato. "Lascia la registrazione sulla console. Di quel tentacolo non voglio saperne nulla, però."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 1|	As you are leaving Plume's lab a technician pulls you aside. "Our records mention that the tentacles had some interesting properties that were useful in combat. If you are interested, meet me in the spaceport in a few hours."|2947|0
units.english: As you are leaving Plume's lab a technician pulls you aside. "Our records mention that the tentacles had some interesting properties that were useful in combat. If you are interested, meet me in the spaceport in a few hours."
units.italian: Mentre stai uscendo dal laboratorio di Plume, un tecnico ti tira da parte. "I nostri registri menzionano che i tentacoli avevano alcune proprietà interessanti utili in combattimento. Se ti interessa, incontrati con me allo spazioporto tra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|name|2952|0
units.english: Bring slime to <planet>
units.italian: Porta la melma su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|description|2953|0
units.english: The void sprite slime has properties of interest to a team of engineers on <planet>.
units.italian: La melma degli spettri del vuoto ha proprietà che interessano a una squadra di ingegneri su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|When Plume finally arrives you can tell from his step that he is excited. He slides onto the bench opposite to you and pulls out a data pad. "I admire your bravery, Captain. I don't think I would have had the courage to hold my ground against a void sprite like that," he chants respectfully, then changes tone to one of wonder. "In that last moment it almost looked like it was sizing you up or examining you." He shakes his head with an amused expression. "I spend so much time studying non-human creatures I sometimes slip and start anthropomorphizing them." His voice takes on a more militant cadence. "That was probably some kind of territorial display, or possibly some kind of dominance challenge. We don't know enough about void sprite behavior to speculate further, though.|2962|0
units.english: When Plume finally arrives you can tell from his step that he is excited. He slides onto the bench opposite to you and pulls out a data pad. "I admire your bravery, Captain. I don't think I would have had the courage to hold my ground against a void sprite like that," he chants respectfully, then changes tone to one of wonder. "In that last moment it almost looked like it was sizing you up or examining you." He shakes his head with an amused expression. "I spend so much time studying non-human creatures I sometimes slip and start anthropomorphizing them." His voice takes on a more militant cadence. "That was probably some kind of territorial display, or possibly some kind of dominance challenge. We don't know enough about void sprite behavior to speculate further, though.
units.italian: Quando Plume arriva finalmente, dal suo passo capisci che è eccitato. Si infila sulla panca di fronte a te e tira fuori un data pad. "Ammiro il tuo coraggio, capitano. Non credo che avrei avuto il coraggio di tenere la posizione contro uno spettro del vuoto così," intona con rispetto, poi cambia tono in uno di meraviglia. "In quell'ultimo momento sembrava quasi che ti stesse misurando o esaminando." Scuote la testa con un'espressione divertita. "Passo così tanto tempo a studiare creature non umane che a volte scivolo e comincio ad antropomorfizzarle." La sua voce assume una cadenza più marziale. "Probabilmente era una specie di esibizione territoriale, o forse una specie di sfida di dominanza. Però non sappiamo abbastanza del comportamento degli spettri del vuoto per fare altre ipotesi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"Be that as it may be, the more immediate reward for your curiosity is in this sample," he trills with excitement. "Several of our labs on Viminal have been working on the development of a new generation of ship technology, and this substance contains some chemicals that could be a key component. I have already transmitted the data to them, but they would like to compare with the original. Could you take this sample to them?"|2963|0
units.english: "Be that as it may be, the more immediate reward for your curiosity is in this sample," he trills with excitement. "Several of our labs on Viminal have been working on the development of a new generation of ship technology, and this substance contains some chemicals that could be a key component. I have already transmitted the data to them, but they would like to compare with the original. Could you take this sample to them?"
units.italian: "Comunque sia, la ricompensa più immediata per la tua curiosità è in questo campione," trilla eccitato. "Diversi dei nostri laboratori su Viminal hanno lavorato allo sviluppo di una nuova generazione di tecnologia per le navi, e questa sostanza contiene alcune sostanze chimiche che potrebbero essere un componente chiave. Ho già trasmesso i dati a loro, ma vorrebbero confrontarli con l'originale. Potresti portare questo campione a loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"Yes, I can."|2965|0
units.english: "Yes, I can."
units.italian: "Sì, posso."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"I would rather not."|2967|0
units.english: "I would rather not."
units.italian: "Preferirei proprio di no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	Plume stoically accepts that with a nod. "That is your choice. I will arrange for another ship to transport it."|2968|0
units.english: Plume stoically accepts that with a nod. "That is your choice. I will arrange for another ship to transport it."
units.italian: Plume lo accetta stoicamente con un cenno. "È una tua scelta. Organizzerò un'altra nave per trasportarlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|When you land on Viminal a solidly built female Remnant in coveralls is waiting for you. "Greetings, Captain <first>. My name is Taely, and I am a Prefect among the Remnant. Above all else, I study motion, and in particular how our starships move."|2978|0
units.english: When you land on Viminal a solidly built female Remnant in coveralls is waiting for you. "Greetings, Captain <first>. My name is Taely, and I am a Prefect among the Remnant. Above all else, I study motion, and in particular how our starships move."
units.italian: Quando atterri su Viminal ti aspetta una Remnant robusta in tuta da lavoro. "Salve, capitano <first>. Mi chiamo Taely, e sono una prefetto tra i Remnant. Studio il movimento sopra ogni altra cosa, e in particolare come si muovono le nostre astronavi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	When you land on Viminal you spot Taely waiting for you. "Greetings, Captain <first>. It is good to see you again."|2981|0
units.english: When you land on Viminal you spot Taely waiting for you. "Greetings, Captain <first>. It is good to see you again."
units.italian: Quando atterri su Viminal scorgi Taely che ti aspetta. "Salve, capitano <first>. È bello rivederti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	She makes a gesture you are starting to recognize as a sign of curiosity. "So, Plume sent us some very interesting data, along with a message to expect you with a sample?" You hand her the container with the slime sample and she holds it up to the light. "Interesting looking substance," she chants. "Let's go back to my workshop."|2983|0
units.english: She makes a gesture you are starting to recognize as a sign of curiosity. "So, Plume sent us some very interesting data, along with a message to expect you with a sample?" You hand her the container with the slime sample and she holds it up to the light. "Interesting looking substance," she chants. "Let's go back to my workshop."
units.italian: Fa un gesto che stai iniziando a riconoscere come segno di curiosità. "Allora, Plume ci ha mandato dei dati molto interessanti, insieme a un messaggio di aspettarti con un campione?" Le consegni il contenitore con il campione di melma e lei lo alza verso la luce. "Sembra una sostanza interessante," intona. "Torniamo alla mia officina."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"Okay, let's go."|2985|0
units.english: "Okay, let's go."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"Could I catch up with you in a minute?"|2987|0
units.english: "Could I catch up with you in a minute?"
units.italian: "Potrei raggiungerti tra un minuto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"Sure, just don't take too long. My project has reached its final stage."|2988|0
units.english: "Sure, just don't take too long. My project has reached its final stage."
units.italian: "Certo, basta che non ci metti troppo. Il mio progetto ha raggiunto la fase finale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	You take your time to get to the workshop, admiring the view along the way. When you finally arrive at the workshop you can hear strange noises coming from inside, accompanied by the smell of a thunderstorm in a swamp. You step into the workshop and come to a stop to stare at the thing in front of you.|2989|0
units.english: You take your time to get to the workshop, admiring the view along the way. When you finally arrive at the workshop you can hear strange noises coming from inside, accompanied by the smell of a thunderstorm in a swamp. You step into the workshop and come to a stop to stare at the thing in front of you.
units.italian: Ti prendi il tuo tempo per arrivare all'officina, ammirando il panorama lungo la strada. Quando finalmente arrivi all'officina senti strani rumori provenire dall'interno, accompagnati dall'odore di un temporale in una palude. Entri nell'officina e ti fermi a fissare la cosa che hai davanti.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	She leads the way through several side passages to an out-of-the-way landing pad connected to a large hangar. Inside, you can see a giant tank filled with a murky fluid, surrounded by equipment and displays. She makes her way over to a large machine with several slots which she slides the container into.|2992|0
units.english: She leads the way through several side passages to an out-of-the-way landing pad connected to a large hangar. Inside, you can see a giant tank filled with a murky fluid, surrounded by equipment and displays. She makes her way over to a large machine with several slots which she slides the container into.
units.italian: Ti guida attraverso diversi passaggi laterali fino a una piazzola di atterraggio isolata collegata a un grande hangar. All'interno vedi un serbatoio gigantesco pieno di un fluido torbido, circondato da attrezzature e display. Si dirige verso una grande macchina con diverse fessure in cui infila il contenitore.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	As the machine starts to work, she turns back to you. "As the primary example of space-faring life, the void sprites have always been of interest to me. They have numerous advantages that we as atmosphere-bound creatures can only dream of, such as being able to experience space in a much more direct manner. I have been working on a side project to build a new generation of ships that melds these ideas with our current technology, but the data we have on the void sprites is centuries old and incomplete." Her chant trails off as she pulls up a display with your original scans on them. "However, your recent explorations provided new data I could use to update my designs. This slime that you retrieved is the final ingredient."|2993|0
units.english: As the machine starts to work, she turns back to you. "As the primary example of space-faring life, the void sprites have always been of interest to me. They have numerous advantages that we as atmosphere-bound creatures can only dream of, such as being able to experience space in a much more direct manner. I have been working on a side project to build a new generation of ships that melds these ideas with our current technology, but the data we have on the void sprites is centuries old and incomplete." Her chant trails off as she pulls up a display with your original scans on them. "However, your recent explorations provided new data I could use to update my designs. This slime that you retrieved is the final ingredient."
units.italian: Mentre la macchina inizia a lavorare, si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Come esempio principale di vita spaziale, gli spettri del vuoto mi hanno sempre interessata.
