Hanno numerosi vantaggi che noi, creature legate all'atmosfera, possiamo solo sognare, come poter vivere lo spazio in modo molto più diretto. Ho lavorato a un progetto collaterale per costruire una nuova generazione di navi che fonda queste idee con la nostra tecnologia attuale, ma i dati che abbiamo sugli spettri del vuoto hanno secoli e sono incompleti." Il suo canto si perde mentre tira su un display con le tue scansioni originali. "Però le tue esplorazioni recenti hanno fornito nuovi dati che ho potuto usare per aggiornare i miei progetti. Questa melma che hai recuperato è l'ingrediente finale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"So my data is helping to develop new technology?"|2995|0
units.english: "So my data is helping to develop new technology?"
units.italian: "Quindi i miei dati stanno aiutando a sviluppare nuova tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	"That's good. Any chance of a bonus for me?"|2996|0
units.english: "That's good. Any chance of a bonus for me?"
units.italian: "Bene. C'è per caso un bonus per me?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	The machine dings, and she looks over the results and then trills excitedly. "Yes, it matches! So it is time to begin the final activation." She strides over to a central console and taps in a series of commands, followed by an iris scan and a blood prick. The industrial hum of the room suddenly ramps up to a crescendo as your nose is assaulted by what you can only describe as the smell of a thunderstorm in a swamp. A few seconds later the noise softens, and the tank starts lowering into the floor as a shape emerges from the liquid.|2997|0
units.english: The machine dings, and she looks over the results and then trills excitedly. "Yes, it matches! So it is time to begin the final activation." She strides over to a central console and taps in a series of commands, followed by an iris scan and a blood prick. The industrial hum of the room suddenly ramps up to a crescendo as your nose is assaulted by what you can only describe as the smell of a thunderstorm in a swamp. A few seconds later the noise softens, and the tank starts lowering into the floor as a shape emerges from the liquid.
units.italian: La macchina emette un ding, e lei esamina i risultati e poi trilla eccitata. "Sì, corrisponde! Quindi è tempo di iniziare l'attivazione finale." Va a grandi passi verso una console centrale e digita una serie di comandi, seguiti da una scansione dell'iride e una puntura per il sangue. Il ronzio industriale della stanza aumenta improvvisamente fino a un crescendo mentre il tuo naso è assalito da quello che puoi solo descrivere come l'odore di un temporale in una palude. Qualche secondo dopo il rumore si attenua, e il serbatoio inizia a calare nel pavimento mentre una forma emerge dal liquido.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	The ship before you has some faint traces of the Puffin you have flown to Nenia, along with other elements of Remnant design, but it is clearly something new. Its antennae swivel around, as if taking in its environment, and the tentacles along the side twitch and reach out to touch its surroundings. Solidly built tendrils underneath it flex as it lifts itself off its supports and begins to move around. You have a momentary vision of what this ship might look like in the skies of Nenia.|2999|0
units.english: The ship before you has some faint traces of the Puffin you have flown to Nenia, along with other elements of Remnant design, but it is clearly something new. Its antennae swivel around, as if taking in its environment, and the tentacles along the side twitch and reach out to touch its surroundings. Solidly built tendrils underneath it flex as it lifts itself off its supports and begins to move around. You have a momentary vision of what this ship might look like in the skies of Nenia.
units.italian: La nave davanti a te ha qualche traccia tenue del Puffin con cui hai volato fino a Nenia, insieme ad altri elementi del design dei Remnant, ma è chiaramente qualcosa di nuovo. Le sue antenne ruotano, come se assorbissero l'ambiente, e i tentacoli lungo i fianchi si contraggono e si allungano per toccare ciò che li circonda. Viticci robusti sotto di essa si flettono mentre si solleva dai suoi supporti e inizia a muoversi. Hai una visione momentanea di come potrebbe apparire questa nave nei cieli di Nenia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2|	Taely's droning chant of technical details finally seeps through your reverie: "... so from a captain's point of view flying the Penguin should be very similar to a normal ship, except she flies herself and doesn't need a crew to run her systems." She pauses, and looks at you. "Your curiosity provided the final ingredients to bring her to life. You should be the first to have one." She pats the nose of the Penguin and it makes a whooshing noise. "I call her the 'Shadow Hope,' but you can rename her whatever you like." After a moment she starts going over the ship with a scanner, leaving you to contemplate in silence.|3001|0
units.english: Taely's droning chant of technical details finally seeps through your reverie: "... so from a captain's point of view flying the Penguin should be very similar to a normal ship, except she flies herself and doesn't need a crew to run her systems." She pauses, and looks at you. "Your curiosity provided the final ingredients to bring her to life. You should be the first to have one." She pats the nose of the Penguin and it makes a whooshing noise. "I call her the 'Shadow Hope,' but you can rename her whatever you like." After a moment she starts going over the ship with a scanner, leaving you to contemplate in silence.
units.italian: Il canto monotono di dettagli tecnici di Taely filtra finalmente nella tua fantasticheria: "... quindi dal punto di vista di un capitano pilotare il Penguin dovrebbe essere molto simile a una nave normale, tranne che vola da sé e non ha bisogno di un equipaggio per far funzionare i sistemi." Si interrompe, e ti guarda. "La tua curiosità ha fornito gli ingredienti finali per darle vita. Dovresti essere il primo ad averne una." Dà un colpetto al muso del Penguin e questo emette un sibilo. "La chiamo 'Speranza d'Ombra', ma puoi rinominarla come preferisci." Dopo un momento comincia a passare la nave con uno scanner, lasciandoti a riflettere in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|name|3006|0
units.english: Bring tentacle to <planet>
units.italian: Porta il tentacolo su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|description|3007|0
units.english: The tentacle has properties that may be put to use by the engineers on <planet>.
units.italian: Il tentacolo ha proprietà che potrebbero essere sfruttate dagli ingegneri su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|When the technician arrives in the spaceport he immediately strides over to you. "I checked the records, and my memory was correct. One of our research teams centuries ago discovered that these tentacles could be used as a devastating weapon in close quarters combat."|3019|0
units.english: When the technician arrives in the spaceport he immediately strides over to you. "I checked the records, and my memory was correct. One of our research teams centuries ago discovered that these tentacles could be used as a devastating weapon in close quarters combat."
units.italian: Quando il tecnico arriva allo spazioporto si dirige subito verso di te. "Ho controllato i registri, e la mia memoria era corretta. Secoli fa una delle nostre squadre di ricerca ha scoperto che questi tentacoli potevano essere usati come arma devastante nel combattimento ravvicinato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	He pulls out an image of a strange-looking rifle and continues to chant, "The personal weapons lab under Prefect Chilia has a few of the old weapon frames. If you go visit it on Aventine, they could turn this tentacle into a potent weapon for you."|3020|0
units.english: He pulls out an image of a strange-looking rifle and continues to chant, "The personal weapons lab under Prefect Chilia has a few of the old weapon frames. If you go visit it on Aventine, they could turn this tentacle into a potent weapon for you."
units.italian: Tira fuori l'immagine di un fucile dall'aspetto strano e continua a intonare: "Il laboratorio delle armi personali sotto il prefetto Chilia ha alcuni dei vecchi telai delle armi. Se vai a visitarlo su Aventine, potrebbero trasformare questo tentacolo in un'arma potente per te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"That sounds good."|3022|0
units.english: "That sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra una buona idea."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"I would rather not."|3024|0
units.english: "I would rather not."
units.italian: "Preferirei proprio di no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	The technician looks disappointed. "Oh well, enjoy your trophy."|3025|0
units.english: The technician looks disappointed. "Oh well, enjoy your trophy."
units.italian: Il tecnico sembra deluso. "Beh, goditi il tuo trofeo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|You follow the directions provided to you and eventually find yourself at a Remnant weapons lab. You enter and are met by security, who asks you to wait. A few minutes later a fit young man emerges from another door. "Greetings, Captain <first>," he sings. "I am Prefect Chilia. I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly. "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are militaristic in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."|3034|0
units.english: You follow the directions provided to you and eventually find yourself at a Remnant weapons lab. You enter and are met by security, who asks you to wait. A few minutes later a fit young man emerges from another door. "Greetings, Captain <first>," he sings. "I am Prefect Chilia. I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly. "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are militaristic in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."
units.italian: Segui le indicazioni che ti sono state date e alla fine ti ritrovi in un laboratorio di armi dei Remnant. Entri e ti accoglie la sicurezza, che ti chiede di aspettare. Qualche minuto dopo da un'altra porta esce un giovane in forma. "Salve, capitano <first>," canta. "Sono il prefetto Chilia. Ho la responsabilità nominale della difesa complessiva dello spazio dei Remnant e delle operazioni militari." Sorride con autosvalutazione. "Dico 'nominale' perché praticamente tutte le nostre attività sono militari in qualche modo, ma di solito rientrano nelle competenze di chi le capisce meglio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|You follow the directions provided to you and eventually find yourself at a Remnant weapons lab. You enter and are met by security, who asks you to wait. A few minutes later a fit young man emerges from another door. "Greetings, captain <first>," he sings. "We meet once again." You immediately recognize the voice as being the man who convinced you to provide the blood sample and get to know the Remnant. "We didn't get a proper introduction last time, but you have probably figured out that I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly, "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are military in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."|3037|0
units.english: You follow the directions provided to you and eventually find yourself at a Remnant weapons lab. You enter and are met by security, who asks you to wait. A few minutes later a fit young man emerges from another door. "Greetings, captain <first>," he sings. "We meet once again." You immediately recognize the voice as being the man who convinced you to provide the blood sample and get to know the Remnant. "We didn't get a proper introduction last time, but you have probably figured out that I have the nominal responsibility for the overall defense of Remnant space and military operations." He smiles deprecatingly, "I say 'nominal' as virtually all our activities are military in some way, but usually fall under the purview of those who better understand them."
units.italian: Segui le indicazioni che ti sono state date e alla fine ti ritrovi in un laboratorio di armi dei Remnant. Entri e ti accoglie la sicurezza, che ti chiede di aspettare. Qualche minuto dopo da un'altra porta esce un giovane in forma. "Salve, capitano <first>," canta. "Ci incontriamo di nuovo." Riconosci subito la voce come quella dell'uomo che ti ha convinto a fornire il campione di sangue e a conoscere i Remnant. "L'ultima volta non ci siamo presentati come si deve, ma probabilmente hai capito che ho la responsabilità nominale della difesa complessiva dello spazio dei Remnant e delle operazioni militari." Sorride con autosvalutazione: "Dico 'nominale' perché praticamente tutte le nostre attività sono militari in qualche modo, ma di solito rientrano nelle competenze di chi le capisce meglio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	He leads you to a room that looks like an armory where a team of technicians is putting the finishing touches on a rifle stock. "The request from the technician on your behalf caught my attention, as we have not had the key resources for making Void Rifles in centuries. Fortunately, we have not really needed them since we resolved the threats that originally plagued our settlements."|3039|0
units.english: He leads you to a room that looks like an armory where a team of technicians is putting the finishing touches on a rifle stock. "The request from the technician on your behalf caught my attention, as we have not had the key resources for making Void Rifles in centuries. Fortunately, we have not really needed them since we resolved the threats that originally plagued our settlements."
units.italian: Ti conduce in una stanza che sembra un'armeria, dove una squadra di tecnici sta dando gli ultimi ritocchi al calcio di un fucile. "La richiesta del tecnico a tuo nome ha attirato la mia attenzione, perché non abbiamo le risorse chiave per fabbricare Fucili del Vuoto da secoli. Per fortuna non ne abbiamo avuto davvero bisogno da quando abbiamo risolto le minacce che affliggevano i nostri insediamenti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"It's called a 'Void Rifle'?"|3041|0
units.english: "It's called a 'Void Rifle'?"
units.italian: "Si chiama 'Fucile del Vuoto'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"I don't need details."|3042|0
units.english: "I don't need details."
units.italian: "Non mi servono i dettagli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"Yes, Void Rifle. I don't know who discovered it, but someone figured out that if a particularly high charge was poured through the tentacle's nervous system in a specific pattern, it emits a paralyzing cone of energy with a reasonably decent range. I'm neither an engineer or a biologist, so I do not really understand the mechanics of it." He pauses to watch as a technician installs the now-caged tentacle on top of the stock. "Suffice it to say, it is useless for sniping, but its ability to shoot through walls and affect areas makes it excellent for sweeping ships and building-to-building clearing operations.|3044|0
units.english: "Yes, Void Rifle. I don't know who discovered it, but someone figured out that if a particularly high charge was poured through the tentacle's nervous system in a specific pattern, it emits a paralyzing cone of energy with a reasonably decent range. I'm neither an engineer or a biologist, so I do not really understand the mechanics of it." He pauses to watch as a technician installs the now-caged tentacle on top of the stock. "Suffice it to say, it is useless for sniping, but its ability to shoot through walls and affect areas makes it excellent for sweeping ships and building-to-building clearing operations.
units.italian: "Sì, Fucile del Vuoto. Non so chi l'abbia scoperto, ma qualcuno ha capito che se si fa passare una carica particolarmente alta nel sistema nervoso del tentacolo secondo uno schema specifico, emette un cono di energia paralizzante con una gittata ragionevolmente decente. Non sono né un ingegnere né un biologo, quindi non capisco davvero il meccanismo. Si interrompe per guardare un tecnico che installa il tentacolo, ora ingabbiato, sopra il calcio. "Basti dire che è inutile per il tiro di precisione, ma la sua capacità di sparare attraverso i muri e di colpire aree lo rende eccellente per rastrellare navi e per operazioni di bonifica edificio per edificio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Face to Maw 2B|	"All right, enough history." He turns to the technicians who are finishing the assembly. "The tentacle has been treated to resist decay and the stock mechanisms will provide basic maintenance routines for as long as you charge it regularly." He strides over, picks up the completed Void Rifle, and then hands it to you. "You are holding a piece of our history, Captain. Use it well!"|3046|0
units.english: "All right, enough history." He turns to the technicians who are finishing the assembly. "The tentacle has been treated to resist decay and the stock mechanisms will provide basic maintenance routines for as long as you charge it regularly." He strides over, picks up the completed Void Rifle, and then hands it to you. "You are holding a piece of our history, Captain. Use it well!"
units.italian: "Va bene, basta con la storia." Si volta verso i tecnici che stanno finendo il montaggio. "Il tentacolo è stato trattato per resistere alla decomposizione e i meccanismi del calcio garantiranno le routine di manutenzione di base finché lo caricherai regolarmente." Si avvicina a grandi passi, prende il Fucile del Vuoto completato e poi te lo porge. "Stai tenendo in mano un pezzo della nostra storia, capitano. Usalo bene!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|name|3053|0
units.english: Retrieve more keystones
units.italian: Recupera altre pietre chiave

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|description|3054|0
units.english: Retrieve quantum keystones from the Hai for the Remnant to study, starting in <destination>.
units.italian: Recupera pietre chiave quantistiche dagli Hai perché i Remnant le studino, iniziando da <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|log|3067|0
units.english: As an outfitter, Aeolus is responsible for managing the logistics that supply the Remnant with materials, equipment, and resources. In contrast to outfitters in what the Remnant term "ancestral space," he is focused on ensuring the efficient optimization of Remnant ships, not making a profit.
units.italian: In quanto fornitore di equipaggiamento, Aeolus è responsabile della gestione della logistica che rifornisce i Remnant di materiali, equipaggiamento e risorse. A differenza dei fornitori di equipaggiamento in quello che i Remnant chiamano "spazio ancestrale", il suo obiettivo è garantire l'ottimizzazione efficiente delle navi dei Remnant, non fare profitto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|In the spaceport cafeteria, you spot the outfitter who asked you to retrieve a shipment of Hai keystones. He notices you and waves you over, gesturing at an empty chair opposite him.|3069|0
units.english: In the spaceport cafeteria, you spot the outfitter who asked you to retrieve a shipment of Hai keystones. He notices you and waves you over, gesturing at an empty chair opposite him.
units.italian: Nella mensa dello spazioporto scorgi il fornitore di equipaggiamento che ti ha chiesto di recuperare una spedizione di pietre chiave degli Hai. Ti nota e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti, indicando una sedia vuota di fronte a lui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Greetings, <first>! I trust you are settling in among us?" he signs using simple gestures. "I picked up a rumor that you are learning our language, too." You sign the affirmative as you sit down. "Good, that is useful." He pauses, then continues, "I never introduced myself before. My name is Aeolus, and I help manage resource logistics for our fleets." He eyes you for a moment, then ventures, "You came in here with the appearance of looking for something. Is there something on your mind?"|3070|0
units.english: "Greetings, <first>! I trust you are settling in among us?" he signs using simple gestures. "I picked up a rumor that you are learning our language, too." You sign the affirmative as you sit down. "Good, that is useful." He pauses, then continues, "I never introduced myself before. My name is Aeolus, and I help manage resource logistics for our fleets." He eyes you for a moment, then ventures, "You came in here with the appearance of looking for something. Is there something on your mind?"
units.italian: "Salve, <first>! Spero che ti stia ambientando tra noi?" segna usando gesti semplici. "Ho sentito una voce che stai imparando anche la nostra lingua." Fai un segno affermativo mentre ti siedi. "Bene, è utile." Si interrompe, poi continua: "Non mi sono mai presentato prima. Mi chiamo Aeolus, e aiuto a gestire la logistica delle risorse per le nostre flotte." Ti scruta per un momento, poi si azzarda: "Sei entrato qui con l'aria di cercare qualcosa. Hai qualcosa per la testa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"How is the outfit business going?"|3072|0
units.english: "How is the outfit business going?"
units.italian: "Come va il commercio degli equipaggiamenti?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"That last job paid rather well. Do you have any more like it?"|3073|0
units.english: "That last job paid rather well. Do you have any more like it?"
units.italian: "Quell'ultimo lavoro ha pagato piuttosto bene. Ne hai altri simili?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Well, fairly well. Stocks are up, there are quite a few new outfits in the current, and some recent supply line disruptions have been resolved," he gestures appreciatively. "I am told that we have you to thank for some of that.|3075|0
units.english: "Well, fairly well. Stocks are up, there are quite a few new outfits in the current, and some recent supply line disruptions have been resolved," he gestures appreciatively. "I am told that we have you to thank for some of that.
units.italian: "Beh, abbastanza bene. Le scorte sono salite, ci sono parecchi nuovi equipaggiamenti in corrente, e alcune recenti interruzioni delle linee di rifornimento sono state risolte," gesticola con apprezzamento. "Mi dicono che dobbiamo ringraziare in parte te per questo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Those 'quantum keystones' you brought back have been quite interesting. The process of dismantling them for analysis yielded some intriguing results." He notices your expression. "Oh, you were expecting me to sell them, weren't you?"|3076|0
units.english: "Those 'quantum keystones' you brought back have been quite interesting. The process of dismantling them for analysis yielded some intriguing results." He notices your expression. "Oh, you were expecting me to sell them, weren't you?"
units.italian: "Quei 'quantum keystones' che hai riportato sono stati piuttosto interessanti. Il processo di smontaggio per l'analisi ha dato risultati intriganti." Nota la tua espressione. "Oh, ti aspettavi che li vendessi, vero?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Nod affirmatively.)|3078|0
units.english: (Nod affirmatively.)
units.italian: (Annuisci.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Shrug noncommittally.)|3080|0
units.english: (Shrug noncommittally.)
units.italian: (Alza le spalle senza impegnarti.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"No, I suspected they would be studied instead."|3082|0
units.english: "No, I suspected they would be studied instead."
units.italian: "No, sospettavo che sarebbero stati studiati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"What does 'outfits in the current' mean?"|3084|0
units.english: "What does 'outfits in the current' mean?"
units.italian: "Cosa significa 'equipaggiamenti in corrente'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Oh, that's just an expression. 'Current' refers to a current of air or water as a metaphor for the development process. It means that there are outfits that are progressing in the development process." He taps at his commlink for a moment. "Back before the Exodus, there was a saying: 'products in the pipeline.' I think that has a comparable meaning to us having 'something in the current.' I am curious, though. Were you expecting me to sell them?"|3085|0
units.english: "Oh, that's just an expression. 'Current' refers to a current of air or water as a metaphor for the development process. It means that there are outfits that are progressing in the development process." He taps at his commlink for a moment. "Back before the Exodus, there was a saying: 'products in the pipeline.' I think that has a comparable meaning to us having 'something in the current.' I am curious, though. Were you expecting me to sell them?"
units.italian: "Oh, è solo un modo di dire. 'Corrente' si riferisce a una corrente d'aria o d'acqua come metafora del processo di sviluppo. Significa che ci sono equipaggiamenti che stanno progredendo nel processo di sviluppo." Batte per un momento sul commlink. "Prima dell'Esodo c'era un modo di dire: 'prodotti in cantiere'. Credo che abbia un significato paragonabile al nostro 'qualcosa in corrente'. Però sono curioso. Ti aspettavi che li vendessi?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Nod affirmatively.)|3087|0
units.english: (Nod affirmatively.)
units.italian: (Annuisci.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Shrug noncommittally.)|3089|0
units.english: (Shrug noncommittally.)
units.italian: (Alza le spalle senza impegnarti.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"No, I suspected they would be studied instead."|3091|0
units.english: "No, I suspected they would be studied instead."
units.italian: "No, sospettavo che sarebbero stati studiati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3092|0
units.english: not really
units.italian: not really

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	Aeolus looks pleased at that. "You are correct. Finding something that does what the Quantum Key Stone does without being identical to it is clearly much more valuable as a subject of research than as a miscellaneous commodity. Add the security implications of slapping an alien device on a ship without thoroughly dismantling it, and the fact that we are not actually concerned with profit in the classical sense, and it is clear that they should not be simply dumped into the outfitting inventory."|3093|0
units.english: Aeolus looks pleased at that. "You are correct. Finding something that does what the Quantum Key Stone does without being identical to it is clearly much more valuable as a subject of research than as a miscellaneous commodity. Add the security implications of slapping an alien device on a ship without thoroughly dismantling it, and the fact that we are not actually concerned with profit in the classical sense, and it is clear that they should not be simply dumped into the outfitting inventory."
units.italian: Aeolus sembra compiaciuto. "Hai ragione. Trovare qualcosa che faccia quello che fa la Pietra Chiave Quantistica senza essere identica a essa è chiaramente molto più prezioso come oggetto di ricerca che come merce qualsiasi. Aggiungi le implicazioni di sicurezza di attaccare un dispositivo alieno su una nave senza smontarlo a fondo, e il fatto che non ci interessi davvero il profitto nel senso classico, ed è chiaro che non dovrebbero semplicemente essere buttati nell'inventario degli equipaggiamenti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3095|0
units.english: not for sale
units.italian: not for sale

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	He looks slightly embarrassed. "Sorry to disappoint you, but none of those outfits were ever going to be used in the form they came in, for several different reasons." He ticks them off on his fingers as he lists them. "First, security: slapping an alien device on every ship without having thoroughly dismantled them would be an invitation to getting tracked. Second, research: something that does what the Quantum Key Stone does without being identical to it? Definitely interesting to our researchers. And third, purpose."|3096|0
units.english: He looks slightly embarrassed. "Sorry to disappoint you, but none of those outfits were ever going to be used in the form they came in, for several different reasons." He ticks them off on his fingers as he lists them. "First, security: slapping an alien device on every ship without having thoroughly dismantled them would be an invitation to getting tracked. Second, research: something that does what the Quantum Key Stone does without being identical to it? Definitely interesting to our researchers. And third, purpose."
units.italian: Sembra leggermente imbarazzato. "Mi dispiace deluderti, ma nessuno di quegli equipaggiamenti sarebbe mai stato usato nella forma in cui è arrivato, per diverse ragioni." Le elenca sulle dita. "Prima, sicurezza: attaccare un dispositivo alieno su ogni nave senza averlo smontato a fondo sarebbe un invito a essere tracciati. Seconda, ricerca: qualcosa che fa quello che fa la Pietra Chiave Quantistica senza essere identica a essa? Decisamente interessante per i nostri ricercatori. E terza, lo scopo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	He pauses to take a drink. "Unlike what you are probably used to from the outfitters you dealt with back in the ancestral worlds, my purpose is not to make money. Instead, I ensure that Remnant captains have the resources they need. What you see listed as the 'price,' Remnant captains see listed instead as a 'logistics adjustment' that indicates the amount of resources needed to supply that component. Every ship has a resource budget allocated to it, determining how much it can utilize for repairs, restocking, and improvements."|3097|0
units.english: He pauses to take a drink. "Unlike what you are probably used to from the outfitters you dealt with back in the ancestral worlds, my purpose is not to make money. Instead, I ensure that Remnant captains have the resources they need. What you see listed as the 'price,' Remnant captains see listed instead as a 'logistics adjustment' that indicates the amount of resources needed to supply that component. Every ship has a resource budget allocated to it, determining how much it can utilize for repairs, restocking, and improvements."
units.italian: Si interrompe per bere un sorso. "A differenza di quello a cui probabilmente sei abituato con i fornitori di equipaggiamento che trattavi nei mondi ancestrali, il mio scopo non è fare soldi. Io mi assicuro invece che i capitani dei Remnant abbiano le risorse di cui hanno bisogno. Quello che tu vedi elencato come 'prezzo', i capitani dei Remnant lo vedono elencato come un 'adeguamento logistico' che indica la quantità di risorse necessarie per fornire quel componente. Ogni nave ha un budget di risorse assegnato, che determina quanto può utilizzarne per riparazioni, rifornimenti e miglioramenti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Wait, you didn't sell any of that?"|3100|0
units.english: "Wait, you didn't sell any of that?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, non ne hai venduto nessuno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Okay, so that shipment you had me get...?"|3101|0
units.english: "Okay, so that shipment you had me get...?"
units.italian: "Va bene, quindi quella spedizione che mi hai fatto prendere...?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3102|0
units.english: crystal jobs
units.italian: crystal jobs

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"I have to apologize for that. We knew from our histories that anyone from the ancestral worlds would be attracted by the opportunity to earn a profit, and we needed to give you both a reason to stay, and a way to gauge your willingness to help. Your shipment was definitely useful, but we had to ensure we framed your job in a way that made sense without revealing what we were actually doing.|3103|0
units.english: "I have to apologize for that. We knew from our histories that anyone from the ancestral worlds would be attracted by the opportunity to earn a profit, and we needed to give you both a reason to stay, and a way to gauge your willingness to help. Your shipment was definitely useful, but we had to ensure we framed your job in a way that made sense without revealing what we were actually doing.
units.italian: "Devo scusarmi per questo. I nostri archivi ci dicevano che chiunque dai mondi ancestrali sarebbe stato attratto dall'opportunità di guadagnare, e ci serviva darti sia una ragione per restare, sia un modo per valutare la tua volontà di aiutare. La tua spedizione è stata decisamente utile, ma abbiamo dovuto inquadrare il tuo lavoro in modo che avesse senso senza rivelare cosa stavamo davvero facendo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"So no, I don't have any jobs 'just like the last one,' but I know our researchers would like another shipment. Are you interested?"|3104|0
units.english: "So no, I don't have any jobs 'just like the last one,' but I know our researchers would like another shipment. Are you interested?"
units.italian: "Quindi no, non ho lavori 'proprio come l'ultimo', ma so che i nostri ricercatori vorrebbero un'altra spedizione. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Yes."|3106|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Sign in the affirmative.)|3107|0
units.english: (Sign in the affirmative.)
units.italian: (Fai un segno affermativo.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Why would you assume that I needed a financial motivation?"|3108|0
units.english: "Why would you assume that I needed a financial motivation?"
units.italian: "Perché dovresti supporre che avessi bisogno di una motivazione economica?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	(Decline.)|3110|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3112|0
units.english: crystal decision
units.italian: crystal decision

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Great. They would like you to pick up another 19 keystones. Two differences this time: first, we would like you to pick them up from several different planets. And second, by the time you reach Hai space, we will have made arrangements so the shipments will be already paid for and waiting for you. Pick up the first stones on Greenwater, then the next set on Allhome. I will have a list sent to you by the time you reach Allhome."|3113|0
units.english: "Great. They would like you to pick up another 19 keystones. Two differences this time: first, we would like you to pick them up from several different planets. And second, by the time you reach Hai space, we will have made arrangements so the shipments will be already paid for and waiting for you. Pick up the first stones on Greenwater, then the next set on Allhome. I will have a list sent to you by the time you reach Allhome."
units.italian: "Ottimo. Vorrebbero che tu prendessi altre 19 pietre chiave. Due differenze questa volta: primo, vorremmo che le prendessi da diversi pianeti. E secondo, quando arriverai nello spazio degli Hai avremo preso accordi perché le spedizioni siano già pagate e ti aspettino. Prendi le prime pietre su Greenwater, poi il gruppo successivo su Allhome. Ti farò avere una lista quando arriverai su Allhome."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"That being said, if you happen to pick up any additional keystones, you can turn them in to the logistics office. They will handle the distribution and compensate you accordingly."|3114|0
units.english: "That being said, if you happen to pick up any additional keystones, you can turn them in to the logistics office. They will handle the distribution and compensate you accordingly."
units.italian: "Detto questo, se ti capita di prendere altre pietre chiave, puoi consegnarle all'ufficio logistico. Si occuperanno della distribuzione e ti ricompenseranno di conseguenza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Wait, how will you get this all set up?"|3116|0
units.english: "Wait, how will you get this all set up?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, come farai a organizzare tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Sounds good."|3117|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	Aeolus looks faintly amused. "While you are certainly adventurous, you are not the only one to have traveled widely. We mapped the Hai systems long ago with cloaked ships, but never landed or contacted any of them. So we never knew anything more than what we could observe from orbit or from scanning ships. But you are known to them, and have a fairly public reputation. By using your transponder codes, we can place and pay for orders through hyperspace relays. All we need is a ship in position to feed the signal into the network."|3121|0
units.english: Aeolus looks faintly amused. "While you are certainly adventurous, you are not the only one to have traveled widely. We mapped the Hai systems long ago with cloaked ships, but never landed or contacted any of them. So we never knew anything more than what we could observe from orbit or from scanning ships. But you are known to them, and have a fairly public reputation. By using your transponder codes, we can place and pay for orders through hyperspace relays. All we need is a ship in position to feed the signal into the network."
units.italian: Aeolus sembra vagamente divertito. "Anche se sei decisamente avventuroso, non sei l'unico ad aver viaggiato molto. Abbiamo mappato i sistemi degli Hai molto tempo fa con navi camuffate, ma non siamo mai atterrati né entrati in contatto con nessuno di loro. Quindi non abbiamo mai saputo altro che quello che potevamo osservare dall'orbita o scansionando le navi. Ma tu sei noto a loro, e hai una reputazione piuttosto pubblica. Usando i tuoi codici transponder possiamo piazzare e pagare ordini attraverso i relè iperspaziali. Ci serve solo una nave in posizione per immettere il segnale nella rete."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3123|0
units.english: remnant untrusted
units.italian: remnant untrusted

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	Aeolus smiles mysteriously at you. "Let's just say that you are not the only resourceful person among the Remnant. We will share more with you once you have demonstrated your loyalty."|3124|0
units.english: Aeolus smiles mysteriously at you. "Let's just say that you are not the only resourceful person among the Remnant. We will share more with you once you have demonstrated your loyalty."
units.italian: Aeolus ti sorride in modo misterioso. "Diciamo solo che non sei l'unica persona piena di risorse tra i Remnant. Ti diremo di più quando avrai dimostrato la tua lealtà."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"While we don't know what is happening on the surface of planets in Ancestral space, we do pick up a fair number of transmissions. Between those and our historical records, it is clear to us that 'making money' is the main motivation for why those in ancestral space do anything. Whether it is ferrying cargo, building a structure, or protecting someone; everything we see says that humanity in ancestral space requires credits for everything it does. And then beyond that, the larger the amount of credits, the more enthusiastic they are to do it." Aeolus shakes his head, looking visibly perturbed. "This is what we see. Tell me, are we wrong? A quote we have seen more than a few times says 'Money makes the world go round,' and everything we have seen supports that attitude."|3127|0
units.english: "While we don't know what is happening on the surface of planets in Ancestral space, we do pick up a fair number of transmissions. Between those and our historical records, it is clear to us that 'making money' is the main motivation for why those in ancestral space do anything. Whether it is ferrying cargo, building a structure, or protecting someone; everything we see says that humanity in ancestral space requires credits for everything it does. And then beyond that, the larger the amount of credits, the more enthusiastic they are to do it." Aeolus shakes his head, looking visibly perturbed. "This is what we see. Tell me, are we wrong? A quote we have seen more than a few times says 'Money makes the world go round,' and everything we have seen supports that attitude."
units.italian: "Anche se non sappiamo cosa succede sulla superficie dei pianeti nello spazio Ancestrale, captiamo un buon numero di trasmissioni. Tra quelle e i nostri archivi storici, ci è chiaro che 'fare soldi' è la motivazione principale di tutto ciò che fanno quelli nello spazio ancestrale. Che si tratti di trasportare carico, costruire una struttura o proteggere qualcuno: tutto quello che vediamo dice che l'umanità nello spazio ancestrale richiede crediti per ogni cosa che fa. E oltre a questo, maggiore è la quantità di crediti, più entusiasti sono di farlo." Aeolus scuote la testa, visibilmente turbato. "Questo è quello che vediamo. Dimmi, ci sbagliamo? Una citazione che abbiamo visto più di qualche volta dice 'I soldi fanno girare il mondo', e tutto quello che abbiamo visto sostiene questo atteggiamento."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"No, you aren't wrong. Money is the reason people work."|3129|0
units.english: "No, you aren't wrong. Money is the reason people work."
units.italian: "No, non vi sbagliate. I soldi sono la ragione per cui la gente lavora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Yes and no. Most people work for money, but it isn't their only motivation."|3131|0
units.english: "Yes and no. Most people work for money, but it isn't their only motivation."
units.italian: "Sì e no. La maggior parte della gente lavora per soldi, ma non è la sua unica motivazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"You are wrong about that. Some people are all about money, but not everyone."|3133|0
units.english: "You are wrong about that. Some people are all about money, but not everyone."
units.italian: "Vi sbagliate su questo. Ad alcuni interessano solo i soldi, ma non a tutti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"This isn't about everyone, this is about me. I'm not here for the money."|3134|0
units.english: "This isn't about everyone, this is about me. I'm not here for the money."
units.italian: "Non si tratta di tutti, si tratta di me. Non sono qui per i soldi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"I am glad that some are willing to act for what is right, necessary or even just curiosity; and not just what they are paid for. It gives me hope for ancestral humanity." His look brightens a bit. "So, are you interested in another job to help us?"|3135|0
units.english: "I am glad that some are willing to act for what is right, necessary or even just curiosity; and not just what they are paid for. It gives me hope for ancestral humanity." His look brightens a bit. "So, are you interested in another job to help us?"
units.italian: "Sono contento che alcuni siano disposti ad agire per ciò che è giusto, necessario o anche solo per curiosità, e non solo per quello che viene pagato. Mi dà speranza per l'umanità ancestrale." Il suo sguardo si illumina un po'. "Allora, ti interessa un altro lavoro per aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3136|0
units.english: greed choice
units.italian: greed choice

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"Yes."|3138|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	"No."|3140|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3142|0
units.english: greed confirmation
units.italian: greed confirmation

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	Aeolus nods sadly. "We appreciate the confirmation, and hope to learn more about those who remained in ancestral lands. It is depressing, however, to think that humanity is so self-centered to put financial wealth as such a high priority. Nonetheless, we do have another job for you. Are you interested?"|3143|0
units.english: Aeolus nods sadly. "We appreciate the confirmation, and hope to learn more about those who remained in ancestral lands. It is depressing, however, to think that humanity is so self-centered to put financial wealth as such a high priority. Nonetheless, we do have another job for you. Are you interested?"
units.italian: Aeolus annuisce con tristezza. "Apprezziamo la conferma, e speriamo di saperne di più su quelli rimasti nelle terre ancestrali. È però deprimente pensare che l'umanità sia così egocentrica da mettere la ricchezza economica tra le priorità più alte. Ciononostante, abbiamo un altro lavoro per te. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|label|3145|0
units.english: greed partial
units.italian: greed partial

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|	Aeolus nods. "So financial wealth is a priority of necessity, but not necessarily what they would prefer to focus on. Interesting. That gives me a bit of hope." He pauses to consider this, then continues. "The economic beliefs of humanity aside, are you interested in helping us out?"|3146|0
units.english: Aeolus nods. "So financial wealth is a priority of necessity, but not necessarily what they would prefer to focus on. Interesting. That gives me a bit of hope." He pauses to consider this, then continues. "The economic beliefs of humanity aside, are you interested in helping us out?"
units.italian: Aeolus annuisce. "Quindi la ricchezza economica è una priorità di necessità, ma non necessariamente ciò su cui preferirebbero concentrarsi. Interessante. Questo mi dà un po' di speranza." Si interrompe per considerarlo, poi continua. "A parte le convinzioni economiche dell'umanità, ti interessa darci una mano?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 1|It takes a few minutes to contact the yardmaster, but once you do, a mixed crew of Hai and human dockworkers have the crates moved promptly from the warehouse to your cargo bay. Hai and humans seem accustomed to working together here.|3150|0
units.english: It takes a few minutes to contact the yardmaster, but once you do, a mixed crew of Hai and human dockworkers have the crates moved promptly from the warehouse to your cargo bay. Hai and humans seem accustomed to working together here.
units.italian: Ci vogliono un paio di minuti per contattare il capo del cantiere, ma una volta fatto, un equipaggio misto di Hai e scaricatori umani fa spostare subito le casse dal magazzino alla tua stiva. Hai e umani sembrano abituati a lavorare insieme qui.

units.italian: Recupera pietre chiave quantistiche da diversi mondi degli Hai, finendo su Newhome.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 3|True to Aeolus' word, there are crates of Hai quantum keystones waiting for you. As you ensure they are securely loaded, your comm system informs you that a message has arrived. It has no indication of provenance, but appears to be a notification that a payment of 250,000 credits marked 'on-assignment allowance' has been made to your account.|3186|0
units.english: True to Aeolus' word, there are crates of Hai quantum keystones waiting for you. As you ensure they are securely loaded, your comm system informs you that a message has arrived. It has no indication of provenance, but appears to be a notification that a payment of 250,000 credits marked 'on-assignment allowance' has been made to your account.
units.italian: Come promesso da Aeolus, ci sono casse di pietre chiave quantistiche degli Hai che ti aspettano. Mentre ti assicuri che siano caricate in sicurezza, il tuo sistema di comunicazione ti informa che è arrivato un messaggio. Non ha indicazioni di provenienza, ma sembra una notifica che un pagamento di 250.000 crediti contrassegnato come 'indennità di incarico' è stato versato sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 3|	The attached message is brief and to the point. "Greetings, Captain <first>. Hopefully the shipments were waiting for you. We have made arrangements for samples to be acquired from Makerplace, Stonebreak, Giverstone, Cloudfire, Snowfeather, Icelake, and Heartvalley. Once you have collected all those, head to Newhome. There are a few other places that we are still working to set up, and we should have those ready by the time you reach Newhome."|3187|0
units.english: The attached message is brief and to the point. "Greetings, Captain <first>. Hopefully the shipments were waiting for you. We have made arrangements for samples to be acquired from Makerplace, Stonebreak, Giverstone, Cloudfire, Snowfeather, Icelake, and Heartvalley. Once you have collected all those, head to Newhome. There are a few other places that we are still working to set up, and we should have those ready by the time you reach Newhome."
units.italian: Il messaggio allegato è breve e diretto. "Salve, capitano <first>. Speriamo che le spedizioni ti stessero aspettando. Abbiamo preso accordi perché dei campioni siano prelevati da Makerplace, Stonebreak, Giverstone, Cloudfire, Snowfeather, Icelake e Heartvalley. Una volta raccolti tutti, dirigiti su Newhome. Ci sono altri posti che stiamo ancora cercando di organizzare, e dovremmo averli pronti quando arriverai su Newhome."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 3|You are just checking in with the port authorities to locate your shipment when your commlink indicates a pair of messages incoming. While you wait for the second one to load, you see the first message is a deposit statement indicating that a payment of <payment> has been deposited from a "Solar Winds Logistics Ltd."|3192|0
units.english: You are just checking in with the port authorities to locate your shipment when your commlink indicates a pair of messages incoming. While you wait for the second one to load, you see the first message is a deposit statement indicating that a payment of <payment> has been deposited from a "Solar Winds Logistics Ltd."
units.italian: Stai giusto facendo il check-in con le autorità portuali per localizzare la tua spedizione quando il commlink ti segnala due messaggi in arrivo. Mentre aspetti che si carichi il secondo, vedi che il primo è un estratto conto che indica che un pagamento di <payment> è stato depositato da "Solar Winds Logistics Ltd."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 3A|You quickly locate and load the shipment of quantum keystones. The packaging comes with brochures and images depicting comfortable-looking Hai relaxing on a spaceship observation deck. "Guaranteed to provide the smoothest flight for your passengers!" reads one of the labels.|3207|0
units.english: You quickly locate and load the shipment of quantum keystones. The packaging comes with brochures and images depicting comfortable-looking Hai relaxing on a spaceship observation deck. "Guaranteed to provide the smoothest flight for your passengers!" reads one of the labels.
units.italian: Localizzi rapidamente e carichi la spedizione di pietre chiave quantistiche. L'imballaggio arriva con opuscoli e immagini che raffigurano Hai dall'aria comoda che si rilassano su una terrazza panoramica di un'astronave. "Garantiamo il volo più morbido per i tuoi passeggeri!" si legge su una delle etichette.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 3B|Sure enough, there is a pair of crates waiting for you. This time the brochure depicts a pair of distinguished elderly Hai relaxing in front of a matte painting.|3223|0
units.english: Sure enough, there is a pair of crates waiting for you. This time the brochure depicts a pair of distinguished elderly Hai relaxing in front of a matte painting.
units.italian: Come previsto, ci sono un paio di casse che ti aspettano. Questa volta l'opuscolo raffigura un paio di anziani Hai distinti che si rilassano davanti a un dipinto opaco.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|name|3295|0
units.english: Retrieve more keystones
units.italian: Recupera altre pietre chiave

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|description|3296|0
units.english: Return the quantum keystones to Viminal.
units.italian: Riporta le pietre chiave quantistiche su Viminal.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|blocked|3297|0
units.english: The cargo is ready to load, however you do not have enough free space. Come back when you have <tons> of free space.
units.italian: Il carico è pronto per essere caricato, ma non hai abbastanza spazio libero. Torna quando avrai <tons> di spazio libero.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|As you were reading the previous message, a freight hauler arrives with the last few crates and starts unloading them. Looking over the assembled stack, you note that each crate bears the logos and advertisements for a different organization, shipper, or enterprise. The second message turns out to be a confirmation that you have picked up 19 keystones. While there are no new instructions, the subtext is clear: Time to head back.|3305|0
units.english: As you were reading the previous message, a freight hauler arrives with the last few crates and starts unloading them. Looking over the assembled stack, you note that each crate bears the logos and advertisements for a different organization, shipper, or enterprise. The second message turns out to be a confirmation that you have picked up 19 keystones. While there are no new instructions, the subtext is clear: Time to head back.
units.italian: Mentre leggevi il messaggio precedente, arriva un trasportatore merci con le ultime casse e comincia a scaricarle. Guardando la pila riunita, noti che ogni cassa porta i loghi e la pubblicità di un'organizzazione, spedizioniere o impresa diversa. Il secondo messaggio si rivela una conferma che hai raccolto 19 pietre chiave. Anche se non ci sono nuove istruzioni, il sottinteso è chiaro: è ora di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|As you descend through the clouds to Viminal, you get the feeling someone is watching you, but your sensors show nothing more than a smattering of Gulls and a patrol squad in the distance. Looking down, you spot an extra battery of anti-air artillery next to the main entrance to the spaceport. You note the weapons tracking you and quickly tap your recognition code into the IFF system. Within seconds, the large guns are swinging back to cover the initial approach.|3310|0
units.english: As you descend through the clouds to Viminal, you get the feeling someone is watching you, but your sensors show nothing more than a smattering of Gulls and a patrol squad in the distance. Looking down, you spot an extra battery of anti-air artillery next to the main entrance to the spaceport. You note the weapons tracking you and quickly tap your recognition code into the IFF system. Within seconds, the large guns are swinging back to cover the initial approach.
units.italian: Mentre scendi tra le nuvole verso Viminal, hai la sensazione che qualcuno ti osservi, ma i sensori non mostrano altro che qualche Gull e una squadra di pattuglia in lontananza. Guardando in basso, scorgi una batteria extra di artiglieria antiaerea accanto all'ingresso principale dello spazioporto. Noti le armi che ti puntano e digiti rapidamente il tuo codice di riconoscimento nel sistema IFF. In pochi secondi i grossi cannoni tornano a coprire l'avvicinamento iniziale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|	Passing through a cavernous opening into the great spaceport dome, there is a shimmer in the air next to you as a Starling fades into view, settling onto the adjacent platform. The pilot signs a quick "Greetings, anticipating talking with you," before heading back toward their lock. Behind them, the Starling continues its shutdown checks without any supervision at all.|3311|0
units.english: Passing through a cavernous opening into the great spaceport dome, there is a shimmer in the air next to you as a Starling fades into view, settling onto the adjacent platform. The pilot signs a quick "Greetings, anticipating talking with you," before heading back toward their lock. Behind them, the Starling continues its shutdown checks without any supervision at all.
units.italian: Passando attraverso un'apertura cavernosa nella grande cupola dello spazioporto, c'è un luccichio nell'aria accanto a te mentre uno Starling emerge alla vista, posandosi sulla piattaforma adiacente. Il pilota fa un rapido segno di "Salve, non vedo l'ora di parlarti", prima di dirigersi verso il suo alloggiamento. Dietro di lui, lo Starling continua i controlli di spegnimento senza alcuna supervisione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 4|	As you finish your own shutdown routine, your commlink informs you that your account has been updated with <payment>.|3312|0
units.english: As you finish your own shutdown routine, your commlink informs you that your account has been updated with <payment>.
units.italian: Mentre completi le tue procedure di spegnimento, il commlink ti informa che il tuo conto è stato aggiornato con <payment>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|name|3336|0
units.english: Scan the <npc>
units.italian: Scansiona il <npc>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|description|3337|0
units.english: Go scan the <npc> in <waypoints> to record the keystone post-wormhole.
units.italian: Vai a scansionare il <npc> in <waypoints> per registrare la pietra chiave dopo il cunicolo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|You exit the ship to find that the pilot is actually Aeolus, who has already marshaled some dock workers with a number of wagons and lifters to unload the cargo.|3344|0
units.english: You exit the ship to find that the pilot is actually Aeolus, who has already marshaled some dock workers with a number of wagons and lifters to unload the cargo.
units.italian: Esci dalla nave e scopri che il pilota è in realtà Aeolus, che ha già radunato alcuni scaricatori con diversi carri e sollevatori per scaricare il carico.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Ah, <first>, thank you for retrieving all these keystones." He sweeps some kind of a device over the crates, then opens one. He pokes at the contents, and pulls out a brochure with a picture of a quantum keystone and a pair of respectable looking Hai. "What's this?" he asks curiously. "Because I bought a keystone, they think I might need more? That seems like a decidedly inefficient way of promoting their product."|3345|0
units.english: "Ah, <first>, thank you for retrieving all these keystones." He sweeps some kind of a device over the crates, then opens one. He pokes at the contents, and pulls out a brochure with a picture of a quantum keystone and a pair of respectable looking Hai. "What's this?" he asks curiously. "Because I bought a keystone, they think I might need more? That seems like a decidedly inefficient way of promoting their product."
units.italian: "Ah, <first>, grazie per aver recuperato tutte queste pietre chiave." Passa una specie di dispositivo sopra le casse, poi ne apre una. Fruga nel contenuto e tira fuori un opuscolo con l'immagine di una pietra chiave quantistica e di un paio di Hai rispettabili. "Cos'è questo?" chiede incuriosito. "Perché ho comprato una pietra chiave, pensano che potrei averne bisogno di altre? Sembra un modo decisamente inefficiente di promuovere il loro prodotto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"I'm not a fan of it either."|3347|0
units.english: "I'm not a fan of it either."
units.italian: "Neanche a me piace."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Those 'inefficient' capitalists did provide a keystone at one twentieth the cost you do."|3348|0
units.english: "Those 'inefficient' capitalists did provide a keystone at one twentieth the cost you do."
units.italian: "Quei capitalisti 'inefficienti' hanno fornito una pietra chiave a un ventesimo del costo che pratichi tu."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"You will probably do well here, then. Keep production and resources focused on the goal, that always made the most sense to me," Aeolus signs with confidence. "But economic theory aside, we have some science to do.|3350|0
units.english: "You will probably do well here, then. Keep production and resources focused on the goal, that always made the most sense to me," Aeolus signs with confidence. "But economic theory aside, we have some science to do.
units.italian: "Allora probabilmente ti troverai bene qui. Tenere la produzione e le risorse concentrate sull'obiettivo è sempre stata la cosa più sensata per me," segna Aeolus con sicurezza. "Ma a parte la teoria economica, abbiamo un po' di scienza da fare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"You've got a point there," signs Aeolus. "Assuming they value a credit the same as we do and they aren't taking a loss, then it appears they do have a significant production and processing cost advantage." He takes on a defensive tone. "But for all we know, the supply of raw materials is much greater in Hai space, or most of these keystones could be simply recycled from older ships. And that is something we want to figure out." He brightens again. "That being said, we already have the first steps set out."|3353|0
units.english: "You've got a point there," signs Aeolus. "Assuming they value a credit the same as we do and they aren't taking a loss, then it appears they do have a significant production and processing cost advantage." He takes on a defensive tone. "But for all we know, the supply of raw materials is much greater in Hai space, or most of these keystones could be simply recycled from older ships. And that is something we want to figure out." He brightens again. "That being said, we already have the first steps set out."
units.italian: "Qui hai ragione," segna Aeolus. "Supponendo che diano a un credito lo stesso valore che gli diamo noi e che non ci stiano rimettendo, allora sembra che abbiano un vantaggio significativo nei costi di produzione e lavorazione." Assume un tono sulla difensiva. "Ma per quanto ne sappiamo, l'offerta di materie prime è molto maggiore nello spazio degli Hai, o la maggior parte di queste pietre chiave potrebbe semplicemente essere riciclata da navi più vecchie. Ed è proprio questo che vogliamo capire." Si illumina di nuovo. "Detto questo, abbiamo già i primi passi pronti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Our researchers have decided that we need to test how a ship performs with one of these keystones compared to a regular Key Stone. My ship has been outfitted with one built from the samples you brought us earlier. We request that you meet us in Peragenor, where you will scan us after going through the wormhole. Then we will return here and swap out the Hai keystone with one of our Key Stones. Then we will go back to Peragenor and perform another scan. By using the same ships for both tests, we should be able to get the best data."|3355|0
units.english: "Our researchers have decided that we need to test how a ship performs with one of these keystones compared to a regular Key Stone. My ship has been outfitted with one built from the samples you brought us earlier. We request that you meet us in Peragenor, where you will scan us after going through the wormhole. Then we will return here and swap out the Hai keystone with one of our Key Stones. Then we will go back to Peragenor and perform another scan. By using the same ships for both tests, we should be able to get the best data."
units.italian: "I nostri ricercatori hanno deciso che dobbiamo testare come si comporta una nave con una di queste pietre chiave rispetto a una normale Pietra Chiave. La mia nave è stata equipaggiata con una costruita dai campioni che ci hai portato prima. Ti chiediamo di incontrarci a Peragenor, dove ci scannerizzerai dopo aver attraversato il cunicolo. Poi torneremo qui e sostituiremo la pietra chiave degli Hai con una delle nostre Pietre Chiave. Poi torneremo a Peragenor e faremo un'altra scansione. Usando le stesse navi per entrambi i test, dovremmo riuscire a ottenere i dati migliori."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Wait, you are a pilot?"|3357|0
units.english: "Wait, you are a pilot?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, sei un pilota?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Okay."|3358|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|	"Oh, yes. It is actually quite common among the Remnant. I am not a particularly good pilot, but it is considered an important skill that is taught to almost everyone as a part of a general education. It is especially worthwhile for those of us who work directly with starships on a daily basis and may be called upon to move or fly one at a moment's notice." His gestures suggest both pride and humility as he talks about his piloting skills. "Anyway, let's go!"|3360|0
units.english: "Oh, yes. It is actually quite common among the Remnant. I am not a particularly good pilot, but it is considered an important skill that is taught to almost everyone as a part of a general education. It is especially worthwhile for those of us who work directly with starships on a daily basis and may be called upon to move or fly one at a moment's notice." His gestures suggest both pride and humility as he talks about his piloting skills. "Anyway, let's go!"
units.italian: "Oh, sì. In realtà è piuttosto comune tra i Remnant. Non sono un pilota particolarmente bravo, ma è considerata un'abilità importante che viene insegnata a quasi tutti come parte dell'istruzione generale. Vale soprattutto per quelli di noi che lavorano direttamente con le astronavi ogni giorno e che possono essere chiamati a spostare o pilotare una nave in qualsiasi momento." I suoi gesti suggeriscono sia orgoglio sia umiltà mentre parla delle sue capacità di pilota. "Comunque, andiamo!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|The scanner chimes softly, informing you that it has completed scanning the Winds of Light and has successfully archived the data.|3368|0
units.english: The scanner chimes softly, informing you that it has completed scanning the Winds of Light and has successfully archived the data.
units.italian: Lo scanner emette un suono delicato, informandoti che ha completato la scansione della Winds of Light e ha archiviato con successo i dati.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 5|dialog|3370|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you have not scanned the Starling in <waypoints>. Make sure you scan the ship before returning.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai scansionato lo Starling in <waypoints>. Assicurati di scansionare la nave prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|name|3378|0
units.english: Scan the <npc>
units.italian: Scansiona il <npc>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|description|3379|0
units.english: Go scan the <npc> in <waypoints> to record the Key Stone post-wormhole.
units.italian: Vai a scansionare il <npc> in <waypoints> per registrare la Pietra Chiave dopo il cunicolo.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|The scanner chimes softly once again, informing you that it has completed scanning the Winds of Light and has successfully archived the data from this second scanning.|3388|0
units.english: The scanner chimes softly once again, informing you that it has completed scanning the Winds of Light and has successfully archived the data from this second scanning.
units.italian: Lo scanner emette di nuovo un suono delicato, informandoti che ha completato la scansione della Winds of Light e ha archiviato con successo i dati di questa seconda scansione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|When you and the <npc> settle back onto the landing pad, there is already a dockworker waiting with a Key Stone. Once the Starling is settled, the dockworker climbs up the outside of the ship, hooks the keystone to a lift and disconnects it from the ship. As the keystone is hauled up to the roof another lift lowers the replacement Key Stone. The dockworker quickly installs it and jumps down, landing gracefully from the several-meter drop.|3393|0
units.english: When you and the <npc> settle back onto the landing pad, there is already a dockworker waiting with a Key Stone. Once the Starling is settled, the dockworker climbs up the outside of the ship, hooks the keystone to a lift and disconnects it from the ship. As the keystone is hauled up to the roof another lift lowers the replacement Key Stone. The dockworker quickly installs it and jumps down, landing gracefully from the several-meter drop.
units.italian: Quando tu e il <npc> vi riposate sulla piazzola, c'è già uno scaricatore che aspetta con una Pietra Chiave. Una volta che lo Starling si è fermato, lo scaricatore sale lungo l'esterno della nave, aggancia la pietra chiave a un sollevatore e la scollega dalla nave. Mentre la pietra chiave viene issata sul tetto, un altro sollevatore cala la Pietra Chiave sostitutiva. Lo scaricatore la installa rapidamente e salta giù, atterrando con grazia dopo un salto di diversi metri.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|	"Ready? Let's go!" Aeolus signs as he fires up his systems and gestures an acknowledgment to the dockworker. You check your cameras and see the worker nimbly step clear of the engine exhausts.|3394|0
units.english: "Ready? Let's go!" Aeolus signs as he fires up his systems and gestures an acknowledgment to the dockworker. You check your cameras and see the worker nimbly step clear of the engine exhausts.
units.italian: "Pronto? Andiamo!" segna Aeolus mentre accende i suoi sistemi e fa un gesto di conferma allo scaricatore. Controlli le tue camere e vedi l'operaio scostarsi agilmente dagli scarichi dei motori.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|dialog|3397|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but you have not scanned the <npc> in <waypoints>. Make sure you scan the ship before returning.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma non hai scansionato il <npc> in <waypoints>. Assicurati di scansionare la nave prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|While in transit, you took the opportunity to examine the preliminary results of the scans: there are a few differences between the two stones, but both appear to have functioned similarly. Upon landing on Viminal, Aeolus comes over to collect a copy of the data for the researchers.|3401|0
units.english: While in transit, you took the opportunity to examine the preliminary results of the scans: there are a few differences between the two stones, but both appear to have functioned similarly. Upon landing on Viminal, Aeolus comes over to collect a copy of the data for the researchers.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio hai colto l'occasione per esaminare i risultati preliminari delle scansioni: ci sono alcune differenze tra le due pietre, ma entrambe sembrano aver funzionato in modo simile. All'atterraggio su Viminal, Aeolus viene a ritirare una copia dei dati per i ricercatori.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|	"Thanks for your help, Captain <first>. This information may be valuable in understanding how the wormholes work." He pauses, then continues thoughtfully. "Perhaps more importantly, it may help us understand how the wormholes of the Ember Waste are different from the wormholes elsewhere that require no such aid."|3402|0
units.english: "Thanks for your help, Captain <first>. This information may be valuable in understanding how the wormholes work." He pauses, then continues thoughtfully. "Perhaps more importantly, it may help us understand how the wormholes of the Ember Waste are different from the wormholes elsewhere that require no such aid."
units.italian: "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, capitano <first>. Queste informazioni potrebbero essere preziose per capire come funzionano i cunicoli." Si interrompe, poi continua pensieroso. "Forse cosa più importante, potrebbero aiutarci a capire in cosa i cunicoli della Distesa di Braci differiscano da quelli altrove che non richiedono un simile aiuto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|	He looks down at the data crystal. "I have one more task to ask of you. Meet me in the cafeteria in an hour to discuss it. May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." He gives a wave that seems vaguely like a salute and heads off.|3403|0
units.english: He looks down at the data crystal. "I have one more task to ask of you. Meet me in the cafeteria in an hour to discuss it. May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." He gives a wave that seems vaguely like a salute and heads off.
units.italian: Abbassa lo sguardo sul cristallo di dati. "Ho ancora un compito da chiederti. Incontrami in mensa tra un'ora per parlarne. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te, capitano." Fa un cenno che sembra vagamente un saluto e si allontana.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 6|	As he disappears from sight you hear a faint chime from your commlink, which displays a message indicating that two payments of <payment> have been allocated to your account. You recall that you didn't get a message after the last mission, so whichever Remnant person or agency is sending you these payments must have combined them. You do find it odd, however, that they always seem to know exactly when you finish a delivery.|3404|0
units.english: As he disappears from sight you hear a faint chime from your commlink, which displays a message indicating that two payments of <payment> have been allocated to your account. You recall that you didn't get a message after the last mission, so whichever Remnant person or agency is sending you these payments must have combined them. You do find it odd, however, that they always seem to know exactly when you finish a delivery.
units.italian: Mentre scompare alla vista senti un trillo leggero dal commlink, che mostra un messaggio che indica che due pagamenti di <payment> sono stati accreditati sul tuo conto. Ricordi di non aver ricevuto un messaggio dopo l'ultima missione, quindi qualunque Remnant o agenzia ti stia mandando questi pagamenti deve averli combinati. Trovi però strano che sembrino sempre sapere esattamente quando finisci una consegna.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|name|3409|0
units.english: Deliver Data to <planet>
units.italian: Consegna dati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|description|3410|0
units.english: A copy of the scanner data needs to be delivered to the researchers on <destination>.
units.italian: Una copia dei dati dello scanner deve essere consegnata ai ricercatori su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|You walk into the cafeteria and spot Aeolus halfway through an impressively large meal. He waves you over, and by the time you are seated a tray with a significantly smaller meal is waiting for you. While you have become accustomed to a few of the dishes, most of them are still very unappetizing.|3419|0
units.english: You walk into the cafeteria and spot Aeolus halfway through an impressively large meal. He waves you over, and by the time you are seated a tray with a significantly smaller meal is waiting for you. While you have become accustomed to a few of the dishes, most of them are still very unappetizing.
units.italian: Entri in mensa e scorgi Aeolus a metà di un pasto di dimensioni impressionanti. Ti fa cenno di avvicinarti, e quando ti sei seduto c'è già ad aspettarti un vassoio con un pasto decisamente più piccolo. Anche se ti sei abituato ad alcuni dei piatti, la maggior parte è ancora poco appetitosa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"The Remnant sure like to eat."|3421|0
units.english: "The Remnant sure like to eat."
units.italian: "Ai Remnant piace proprio mangiare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Why do the Remnant eat so much?"|3422|0
units.english: "Why do the Remnant eat so much?"
units.italian: "Perché i Remnant mangiano così tanto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Maybe I should import some spices."|3426|0
units.english: "Maybe I should import some spices."
units.italian: "Forse dovrei importare qualche spezia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"What is our next step?"|3428|0
units.english: "What is our next step?"
units.italian: "Qual è il nostro prossimo passo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	Aeolus chuckles and makes an amused gesture. "An army lives and dies by its food! A poorly fed soldier is but a short step away from being a deserter, or even a traitor. While we have had lean years in the past, these days we ensure everyone is well fed."|3430|0
units.english: Aeolus chuckles and makes an amused gesture. "An army lives and dies by its food! A poorly fed soldier is but a short step away from being a deserter, or even a traitor. While we have had lean years in the past, these days we ensure everyone is well fed."
units.italian: Aeolus ridacchia e fa un gesto divertito. "Un esercito vive e muore per il suo cibo! Un soldato malnutrito è a un passo dall'essere un disertore, o anche un traditore. Anche se in passato abbiamo avuto anni magri, di questi tempi ci assicuriamo che tutti mangino bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|label|3432|0
units.english: food volume
units.italian: food volume

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	He looks at you appraisingly. "There are some things you cannot learn yet. Ask us again when you have earned more of our trust."|3435|0
units.english: He looks at you appraisingly. "There are some things you cannot learn yet. Ask us again when you have earned more of our trust."
units.italian: Ti guarda valutandoti. "Ci sono cose che non puoi ancora imparare. Chiedicelo di nuovo quando ti sarai guadagnato più della nostra fiducia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|label|3437|0
units.english: capital license
units.italian: capital license

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	He leans forward and holds up his hands, poking at the leather fingerless gloves he is wearing, and you realize that they extend up under his sleeves. You note that the leather does not actually look like any leather you have seen - it has fine scales and rough ridges on it. What stands out the most, however, is that it appears to pulse faintly.|3440|0
units.english: He leans forward and holds up his hands, poking at the leather fingerless gloves he is wearing, and you realize that they extend up under his sleeves. You note that the leather does not actually look like any leather you have seen - it has fine scales and rough ridges on it. What stands out the most, however, is that it appears to pulse faintly.
units.italian: Si sporge in avanti e alza le mani, toccando i guanti di pelle senza dita che indossa, e ti rendi conto che salgono fin sotto le maniche. Noti che la pelle non somiglia davvero a nessuna pelle che tu abbia visto: ha squame fini e creste ruvide. Quello che però salta all'occhio è che sembra pulsare debolmente.
