units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"The truth is, when we eat, we are eating for two. You will have to ask someone else how they came to be or how it works, but suffice it to say that we have developed a symbiotic relationship with a variety of creatures we found here. These ones," He explains while holding up his hands, "have a knack for accuracy and durability. With them, I am more precise than I would otherwise be, and much tougher. In exchange, they feed through us and require regular care and attention. Normally, this causes us no hardship, but if we do not eat enough, we will consume our reserves far faster than we normally would."|3441|0
units.english: "The truth is, when we eat, we are eating for two. You will have to ask someone else how they came to be or how it works, but suffice it to say that we have developed a symbiotic relationship with a variety of creatures we found here. These ones," He explains while holding up his hands, "have a knack for accuracy and durability. With them, I am more precise than I would otherwise be, and much tougher. In exchange, they feed through us and require regular care and attention. Normally, this causes us no hardship, but if we do not eat enough, we will consume our reserves far faster than we normally would."
units.italian: "La verità è che, quando mangiamo, mangiamo per due. Dovrai chiedere a qualcun altro come siano nati o come funzioni, ma basti dire che abbiamo sviluppato una relazione simbiotica con una varietà di creature che abbiamo trovato qui. Queste," spiega alzando le mani, "hanno un talento per la precisione e la resistenza. Con loro sono più preciso di quanto sarei altrimenti, e molto più resistente. In cambio si nutrono attraverso di noi e richiedono cure e attenzione regolari. Normalmente questo non ci causa problemi, ma se non mangiamo abbastanza, consumeremo le nostre riserve molto più in fretta del normale."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"That is quite the revelation."|3443|0
units.english: "That is quite the revelation."
units.italian: "È una bella rivelazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Thanks for the explanation."|3444|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie per la spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Is that why some of the food tastes terrible?"|3445|0
units.english: "Is that why some of the food tastes terrible?"
units.italian: "È per questo che parte del cibo ha un sapore terribile?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Sounds creepy."|3447|0
units.english: "Sounds creepy."
units.italian: "Sembra inquietante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	Aeolus nods. "From what I have heard, the ancestral worlds do not seem to have much in the way of exoskeletons or cybernetics. The living organisms we wear would certainly seem to be the realm of science-fiction." He contemplates his symbiont for a few seconds as he absent-mindedly eats more of his meal. "But education aside, there is work to do."|3449|0
units.english: Aeolus nods. "From what I have heard, the ancestral worlds do not seem to have much in the way of exoskeletons or cybernetics. The living organisms we wear would certainly seem to be the realm of science-fiction." He contemplates his symbiont for a few seconds as he absent-mindedly eats more of his meal. "But education aside, there is work to do."
units.italian: Aeolus annuisce. "Da quello che ho sentito, i mondi ancestrali non sembrano avere molto in fatto di esoscheletri o cibernetica. Gli organismi viventi che indossiamo sembrerebbero decisamente materia da fantascienza." Contempla il suo simbionte per qualche secondo mentre mangia distrattamente ancora un po'. "Ma a parte l'istruzione, c'è lavoro da fare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	He shakes his head. "I will not discourage you doing so - and I am sure some might appreciate them - but most of us like our food the way it is." He chuckles, then continues. "But there is still work to do."|3452|0
units.english: He shakes his head. "I will not discourage you doing so - and I am sure some might appreciate them - but most of us like our food the way it is." He chuckles, then continues. "But there is still work to do."
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Non ti dissuaderò dal farlo, e sono sicuro che alcuni li apprezzerebbero, ma alla maggior parte di noi piace il nostro cibo così com'è." Ridacchia, poi continua. "Ma c'è ancora lavoro da fare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|label|3454|0
units.english: terrible flavor
units.italian: terrible flavor

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"I suppose it might. Our symbionts have different dietary requirements, and such unusual compounds in our food inevitably change the flavor. We are all long since used to it, but it would definitely be different for an outsider." He seems amused by this. "But enough of food - there is work to do!"|3455|0
units.english: "I suppose it might. Our symbionts have different dietary requirements, and such unusual compounds in our food inevitably change the flavor. We are all long since used to it, but it would definitely be different for an outsider." He seems amused by this. "But enough of food - there is work to do!"
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì. I nostri simbionti hanno esigenze alimentari diverse, e composti così insoliti nel nostro cibo ne cambiano inevitabilmente il sapore. Ormai ci siamo tutti abituati, ma per un estraneo sarebbe decisamente diverso." Sembra divertito. "Ma basta con il cibo: c'è lavoro da fare!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Creepy? I do not understand how something so useful and beneficial could be 'creepy,' but I suppose some might equate our symbionts with leeches. To each their own, I suppose." He shrugs, then continues. "But enough. We still have work to do."|3458|0
units.english: "Creepy? I do not understand how something so useful and beneficial could be 'creepy,' but I suppose some might equate our symbionts with leeches. To each their own, I suppose." He shrugs, then continues. "But enough. We still have work to do."
units.italian: "Inquietante? Non capisco come qualcosa di così utile e benefico possa essere 'inquietante', ma suppongo che alcuni possano equiparare i nostri simbionti alle sanguisughe. Ognuno ha i suoi gusti, immagino." Alza le spalle, poi continua. "Ma basta. Abbiamo ancora lavoro da fare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|label|3459|0
units.english: deliver data
units.italian: deliver data

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	He pulls out a small metal briefcase and sets it on the table. "Another delivery mission for you, Captain. A short one, at that. We need you to take this case of data crystals with our preliminary data to some researchers on <destination>. This will allow them to combine the data we have collected with their most recent findings, and perhaps help us take a step forward towards understanding the nature of both these stones and the wormholes. Will you do it?"|3460|0
units.english: He pulls out a small metal briefcase and sets it on the table. "Another delivery mission for you, Captain. A short one, at that. We need you to take this case of data crystals with our preliminary data to some researchers on <destination>. This will allow them to combine the data we have collected with their most recent findings, and perhaps help us take a step forward towards understanding the nature of both these stones and the wormholes. Will you do it?"
units.italian: Tira fuori una piccola valigetta metallica e la mette sul tavolo. "Un'altra missione di consegna per te, capitano. E breve, per giunta. Dobbiamo chiederti di portare questa valigetta di cristalli di dati con i nostri dati preliminari ad alcuni ricercatori su <destination>. Questo permetterà loro di combinare i dati che abbiamo raccolto con i loro ritrovamenti più recenti, e forse ci aiuterà a fare un passo avanti verso la comprensione della natura di entrambe queste pietre e dei cunicoli. Lo farai?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Okay."|3462|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|A young researcher is waiting for you when you exit the <ship>. "Thank you for your assistance, Captain," she signs with one hand as she accepts the briefcase with the other. "There has been a lot of concentrated study on the wormholes over the past several centuries. While we know much about them..." she makes a convoluted gesture that you think translates to "knowing that you don't know."|3467|0
units.english: A young researcher is waiting for you when you exit the <ship>. "Thank you for your assistance, Captain," she signs with one hand as she accepts the briefcase with the other. "There has been a lot of concentrated study on the wormholes over the past several centuries. While we know much about them..." she makes a convoluted gesture that you think translates to "knowing that you don't know."
units.italian: Una giovane ricercatrice ti aspetta quando esci dalla <ship>. "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, capitano," segna con una mano mentre accetta la valigetta con l'altra. "C'è stato molto studio concentrato sui cunicoli negli ultimi secoli. Anche se sappiamo molto su di loro..." fa un gesto contorto che credi si traduca con "sapere di non sapere".

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	"Now, thanks to your acquisitions, we have the opportunity for new insights. We are looking forward to learning more about these anomalies. May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." With that, she turns and heads off towards a lab.|3468|0
units.english: "Now, thanks to your acquisitions, we have the opportunity for new insights. We are looking forward to learning more about these anomalies. May the Embers burn bright for you, Captain." With that, she turns and heads off towards a lab.
units.italian: "Ora, grazie alle tue acquisizioni, abbiamo l'opportunità di nuove intuizioni. Non vediamo l'ora di saperne di più su queste anomalie. Che le Braci brucino luminose per te, capitano." Detto questo, si volta e si avvia verso un laboratorio.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Keystone Research 7|	As you contemplate the implications of the Remnant studying the wormholes, your commlink chimes with a notification of another payment of <payment> being made to your account.|3469|0
units.english: As you contemplate the implications of the Remnant studying the wormholes, your commlink chimes with a notification of another payment of <payment> being made to your account.
units.italian: Mentre rifletti sulle implicazioni dello studio dei cunicoli da parte dei Remnant, il tuo commlink trilla con la notifica di un altro pagamento di <payment> accreditato sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|name|3475|0
units.english: Preparation for expedition
units.italian: Preparativi per la spedizione

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|description|3476|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to prepare for an expedition to Sagittarius A*. Ensure that you have at least six tons of outfit space available.
units.italian: Viaggia su <destination> per preparare una spedizione verso Sagittarius A*. Assicurati di avere almeno sei tonnellate di spazio per gli equipaggiamenti disponibili.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|You glance into the starport cafeteria and see Dawn sitting at a table looking worried. She hasn't noticed you yet. Do you approach her?|3490|0
units.english: You glance into the starport cafeteria and see Dawn sitting at a table looking worried. She hasn't noticed you yet. Do you approach her?
units.italian: Dai un'occhiata nella mensa dello spazioporto e vedi Dawn seduta a un tavolo, preoccupata. Non ti ha ancora notato. Ti avvicini?

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	(Yes.)|3492|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	(Not right now.)|3493|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She smiles when she sees you, and waves you to the seat opposite her. "Back from gallivanting around the galaxy with more tales to share?" she signs.|3495|0
units.english: She smiles when she sees you, and waves you to the seat opposite her. "Back from gallivanting around the galaxy with more tales to share?" she signs.
units.italian: Sorride quando ti vede, e ti fa cenno di sederti di fronte a lei. "Tornato dal gironzolare per la galassia con altre storie da raccontare?" segna.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Yes, as a matter of fact..."|3497|0
units.english: "Yes, as a matter of fact..."
units.italian: "Sì, in effetti..."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"No, just hunting Korath..."|3498|0
units.english: "No, just hunting Korath..."
units.italian: "No, solo a caccia di Korath..."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"No, just testing some stuff..."|3499|0
units.english: "No, just testing some stuff..."
units.italian: "No, solo a provare un po' di cose..."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"You look worried. Is something happening?"|3500|0
units.english: "You look worried. Is something happening?"
units.italian: "Sembri preoccupata. Sta succedendo qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She listens for a minute or two as you tell her about what you've been up to, but it's obvious that she has something else on her mind.|3502|0
units.english: She listens for a minute or two as you tell her about what you've been up to, but it's obvious that she has something else on her mind.
units.italian: Ti ascolta per un minuto o due mentre le racconti cosa hai fatto, ma è evidente che ha altro per la testa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"You look worried. Is everything alright?"|3504|0
units.english: "You look worried. Is everything alright?"
units.italian: "Sembri preoccupata. Va tutto bene?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"You look distracted. Do you want to talk about it?"|3505|0
units.english: "You look distracted. Do you want to talk about it?"
units.italian: "Sembri distratta. Vuoi parlarne?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She makes a gesture of appreciation. "Yes, I am worried, <first>. I keep feeling like there is something I am missing." She frowns, contemplating something unseen. "I should back up a step. Since we last talked, I was assigned to serve with an astrophysics team for a year. My current work is part of the quantum condensate fabric density project, and I have been tasked with reviewing our bulk astrophysical data. It is fairly routine, but I keep getting this prickly feeling that there is a problem that I am missing. Nothing obvious, of course. Our neural networks would pick up something explicit or repetitive very quickly. But the feeling just will not go away."|3507|0
units.english: She makes a gesture of appreciation. "Yes, I am worried, <first>. I keep feeling like there is something I am missing." She frowns, contemplating something unseen. "I should back up a step. Since we last talked, I was assigned to serve with an astrophysics team for a year. My current work is part of the quantum condensate fabric density project, and I have been tasked with reviewing our bulk astrophysical data. It is fairly routine, but I keep getting this prickly feeling that there is a problem that I am missing. Nothing obvious, of course. Our neural networks would pick up something explicit or repetitive very quickly. But the feeling just will not go away."
units.italian: Fa un gesto di apprezzamento. "Sì, sono preoccupata, <first>. Continuo a sentire che c'è qualcosa che mi sfugge." Aggrotta la fronte, contemplando qualcosa che non vede. "Dovrei tornare indietro di un passo. Da quando ci siamo parlati l'ultima volta, sono stata assegnata a una squadra di astrofisica per un anno. Il mio lavoro attuale fa parte del progetto sulla densità del tessuto di condensato quantistico, e mi è stato affidato l'esame dei nostri dati astrofisici di massa. È abbastanza di routine, ma continuo ad avere questa sensazione fastidiosa che ci sia un problema che mi sfugge. Niente di ovvio, certo. Le nostre reti neurali individuerebbero molto in fretta qualcosa di esplicito o ripetitivo. Ma la sensazione non se ne va."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Have you asked someone with more experience for advice?"|3509|0
units.english: "Have you asked someone with more experience for advice?"
units.italian: "Hai chiesto consiglio a qualcuno con più esperienza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Don't worry about it."|3510|0
units.english: "Don't worry about it."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Can I help with something?"|3512|0
units.english: "Can I help with something?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutare in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"What is the quantum condensate fabric density project?"|3514|0
units.english: "What is the quantum condensate fabric density project?"
units.italian: "Cos'è il progetto sulla densità del tessuto di condensato quantistico?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I did. The senior researcher told me that most of the team feels something is not quite right here. They say there are some potential theories, but nothing definitive, so they want me to investigate on my own without contaminating my thoughts with their ideas for now."|3516|0
units.english: "I did. The senior researcher told me that most of the team feels something is not quite right here. They say there are some potential theories, but nothing definitive, so they want me to investigate on my own without contaminating my thoughts with their ideas for now."
units.italian: "L'ho fatto. La ricercatrice senior mi ha detto che la maggior parte della squadra sente che qui c'è qualcosa che non va del tutto. Dicono che ci sono alcune teorie possibili, ma niente di definitivo, quindi per ora vogliono che indaghi da sola senza contaminare i miei pensieri con le loro idee."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3518|0
units.english: quantum condensate
units.italian: quantum condensate

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"It is basically a project examining the density of Bose-Einstein condensates as correlated to the revised relativity paradigm's conceptualization of the fabric of space-time. It has a lot of potential implications, particularly for ramscoop, scanner, and weapons technology. At least, that is the hope. For now, though, I am trying to figure out what is off about this data."|3519|0
units.english: "It is basically a project examining the density of Bose-Einstein condensates as correlated to the revised relativity paradigm's conceptualization of the fabric of space-time. It has a lot of potential implications, particularly for ramscoop, scanner, and weapons technology. At least, that is the hope. For now, though, I am trying to figure out what is off about this data."
units.italian: "In pratica è un progetto che esamina la densità dei condensati di Bose-Einstein in correlazione con la concettualizzazione del tessuto dello spazio-tempo del paradigma della relatività rivisto. Ha molte implicazioni potenziali, in particolare per la tecnologia di ramscoop, scanner e armi. Almeno, questa è la speranza. Per ora, però, sto cercando di capire cosa non va in questi dati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Have you asked someone with more experience for advice?"|3521|0
units.english: "Have you asked someone with more experience for advice?"
units.italian: "Hai chiesto consiglio a qualcuno con più esperienza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Don't worry about it."|3522|0
units.english: "Don't worry about it."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Can I help with something?"|3524|0
units.english: "Can I help with something?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutare in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I did. The senior researcher told me that most of the team feels something is not quite right here. They say there are some potential theories, but nothing definitive, so they want me to investigate on my own without contaminating my thoughts with their ideas for now."|3526|0
units.english: "I did. The senior researcher told me that most of the team feels something is not quite right here. They say there are some potential theories, but nothing definitive, so they want me to investigate on my own without contaminating my thoughts with their ideas for now."
units.italian: "L'ho fatto. La ricercatrice senior mi ha detto che la maggior parte della squadra sente che qui c'è qualcosa che non va del tutto. Dicono che ci sono alcune teorie possibili, ma niente di definitivo, quindi per ora vogliono che indaghi da sola senza contaminare i miei pensieri con le loro idee."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Thanks for the advice, but that is our purpose here - to worry about all the things that humanity either cannot handle or that it turns a blind eye to. No, if there is something in the data to cause worry, we need to find it."|3529|0
units.english: "Thanks for the advice, but that is our purpose here - to worry about all the things that humanity either cannot handle or that it turns a blind eye to. No, if there is something in the data to cause worry, we need to find it."
units.italian: "Grazie per il consiglio, ma il nostro scopo qui è proprio questo: occuparci di tutte le cose che l'umanità non riesce a gestire o a cui volta le spalle. No, se c'è qualcosa nei dati che deve destare preoccupazione, dobbiamo trovarlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"If you would like to help, there is something you can do. I am currently putting together an expedition to Sagittarius A* to collect some fresh data I can use to check our records, and I could use a transport..." She looks at you hopefully.|3531|0
units.english: "If you would like to help, there is something you can do. I am currently putting together an expedition to Sagittarius A* to collect some fresh data I can use to check our records, and I could use a transport..." She looks at you hopefully.
units.italian: "Se vuoi aiutare, c'è qualcosa che puoi fare. Sto mettendo insieme una spedizione verso Sagittarius A* per raccogliere dati nuovi con cui verificare i nostri archivi, e mi servirebbe un trasporto..." Ti guarda con speranza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I don't know where that is."|3533|0
units.english: "I don't know where that is."
units.italian: "Non so dove sia."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Isn't that the center of the galaxy?"|3535|0
units.english: "Isn't that the center of the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Non è il centro della galassia?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I have been there."|3537|0
units.english: "I have been there."
units.italian: "Ci sono già stato."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Really?" She looks surprised. "I have seen sensor logs and recordings from previous visits, but not many people have actually been there." She pauses to take a bite from her neglected meal. "Being able to take part in these fieldwork expeditions is something I have been looking forward to for ages, so of course Sagittarius A* is the first place on my list."|3538|0
units.english: "Really?" She looks surprised. "I have seen sensor logs and recordings from previous visits, but not many people have actually been there." She pauses to take a bite from her neglected meal. "Being able to take part in these fieldwork expeditions is something I have been looking forward to for ages, so of course Sagittarius A* is the first place on my list."
units.italian: "Davvero?" Sembra sorpresa. "Ho visto registrazioni dei sensori e filmati di visite precedenti, ma non molte persone ci sono state davvero." Si interrompe per dare un morso al pasto trascurato. "Poter partecipare a queste spedizioni sul campo è qualcosa che aspetto da sempre, quindi ovviamente Sagittarius A* è il primo posto della mia lista."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3540|0
units.english: center alt
units.italian: center alt

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Yes, that is correct." She signs firmly.|3541|0
units.english: "Yes, that is correct." She signs firmly.
units.italian: "Sì, esatto." Segna con fermezza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	Her signs take on a rhythmic pace as if reciting something. "Sagittarius A* is a strong astronomical radio source and a supermassive black hole that is located at the center of the Milky Way. According to our best measurements, it has a mass of 3F6290 solar masses and is surrounded by a ring of gas and dust that can range from 63 to 24D2 degrees Kelvin."|3543|0
units.english: Her signs take on a rhythmic pace as if reciting something. "Sagittarius A* is a strong astronomical radio source and a supermassive black hole that is located at the center of the Milky Way. According to our best measurements, it has a mass of 3F6290 solar masses and is surrounded by a ring of gas and dust that can range from 63 to 24D2 degrees Kelvin."
units.italian: I suoi segni assumono un ritmo regolare, come se stesse recitando qualcosa. "Sagittarius A* è una forte sorgente radio astronomica e un buco nero supermassiccio situato al centro della Via Lattea. Secondo le nostre migliori misurazioni, ha una massa di 3F6290 masse solari ed è circondato da un anello di gas e polvere che può variare da 63 a 24D2 gradi Kelvin."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She returns to a conversational cadence. "Would you be interested in taking part in this expedition?"|3544|0
units.english: She returns to a conversational cadence. "Would you be interested in taking part in this expedition?"
units.italian: Torna a una cadenza colloquiale. "Ti interesserebbe prendere parte a questa spedizione?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Sure, what do you need?"|3546|0
units.english: "Sure, what do you need?"
units.italian: "Certo, di cosa hai bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"You want me to take you to a black hole?!"|3548|0
units.english: "You want me to take you to a black hole?!"
units.italian: "Vuoi che ti porti in un buco nero?!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in visiting a black hole."|3549|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in visiting a black hole."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa visitare un buco nero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She looks momentarily surprised by your reaction. "Yes, exactly that. Current gravitational repulsor engines can nullify most of the gravitational pull, and an extra Thermoelectric Cooler or two should be sufficient to manage the heat. As such, the risks are manageable so long as you do not try to approach the event horizon.|3551|0
units.english: She looks momentarily surprised by your reaction. "Yes, exactly that. Current gravitational repulsor engines can nullify most of the gravitational pull, and an extra Thermoelectric Cooler or two should be sufficient to manage the heat. As such, the risks are manageable so long as you do not try to approach the event horizon.
units.italian: Sembra momentaneamente sorpresa dalla tua reazione. "Sì, esattamente questo. I motori a repulsione gravitazionale attuali possono annullare la maggior parte dell'attrazione gravitazionale, e uno o due Raffreddatori Termoelettrici extra dovrebbero bastare a gestire il calore. Quindi i rischi sono gestibili, purché tu non provi ad avvicinarti all'orizzonte degli eventi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3552|0
units.english: science equipment
units.italian: science equipment

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"For this particular mission, we will need some additional scientific equipment that is actually hardwired into your ship, not just carried along with us. When we arrive on <planet>, they will have the equipment ready to install. Just be aware that it will require six tons of outfit space and a scientist to run it, so you will need a free bunk for them, too.|3553|0
units.english: "For this particular mission, we will need some additional scientific equipment that is actually hardwired into your ship, not just carried along with us. When we arrive on <planet>, they will have the equipment ready to install. Just be aware that it will require six tons of outfit space and a scientist to run it, so you will need a free bunk for them, too.
units.italian: "Per questa missione in particolare ci servirà dell'attrezzatura scientifica aggiuntiva che sarà cablata direttamente nella tua nave, non solo portata con noi. Quando arriveremo su <planet>, avranno l'attrezzatura pronta da installare. Sappi solo che richiederà sei tonnellate di spazio per equipaggiamenti e uno scienziato per farla funzionare, quindi ti servirà anche una cuccetta libera per lui.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Once the laboratory module is installed, it will simply be a matter of traveling to Sagittarius A*. After our measurements, recordings, and observations are complete, we will return and report on our findings."|3554|0
units.english: "Once the laboratory module is installed, it will simply be a matter of traveling to Sagittarius A*. After our measurements, recordings, and observations are complete, we will return and report on our findings."
units.italian: "Una volta installato il modulo laboratorio, sarà solo questione di viaggiare fino a Sagittarius A*. Dopo che le nostre misurazioni, registrazioni e osservazioni saranno complete, torneremo e riferiremo i nostri risultati."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She glances down at her half-finished meal. "I am already packed and ready to go. I will meet you onboard the <ship> as soon as I am done eating."|3555|0
units.english: She glances down at her half-finished meal. "I am already packed and ready to go. I will meet you onboard the <ship> as soon as I am done eating."
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata al suo pasto a metà. "Ho già fatto i bagagli e sono pronta a partire. Ti incontro a bordo della <ship> appena ho finito di mangiare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Okay, I will meet you onboard the ship."|3559|0
units.english: "Okay, I will meet you onboard the ship."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti incontro a bordo della nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Developed quite the appetite, haven't you?"|3561|0
units.english: "Developed quite the appetite, haven't you?"
units.italian: "Ti è venuto un bell'appetito, eh?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She shrugs. "I burn a lot of calories, and healthy eating is important. Besides, I don't know how good food will be on your ship." She resumes eating with vigor and does not seem inclined to continue the conversation.|3564|0
units.english: She shrugs. "I burn a lot of calories, and healthy eating is important. Besides, I don't know how good food will be on your ship." She resumes eating with vigor and does not seem inclined to continue the conversation.
units.italian: Alza le spalle. "Brucio un sacco di calorie, e mangiare sano è importante. Inoltre non so quanto sarà buono il cibo sulla tua nave." Riprende a mangiare con vigore e non sembra intenzionata a continuare la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3566|0
units.english: dawn license
units.italian: dawn license

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I am not yet used to the nutrient intake required to maintain my symbiont, so I have to consciously make sure that I eat enough to sustain it."|3567|0
units.english: "I am not yet used to the nutrient intake required to maintain my symbiont, so I have to consciously make sure that I eat enough to sustain it."
units.italian: "Non sono ancora abituata all'apporto di nutrienti necessario a mantenere il mio simbionte, quindi devo assicurarmi consapevolmente di mangiare abbastanza per sostenerlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Symbiont? What is that?"|3569|0
units.english: "Symbiont? What is that?"
units.italian: "Simbionte? Cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"What? You're joking, right?"|3571|0
units.english: "What? You're joking, right?"
units.italian: "Cosa? Stai scherzando, vero?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Suit yourself. I will meet you onboard once I'm done." She shrugs, and returns to eating.|3572|0
units.english: "Suit yourself. I will meet you onboard once I'm done." She shrugs, and returns to eating.
units.italian: "Fai come vuoi. Ti incontro a bordo quando ho finito." Alza le spalle e torna a mangiare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3574|0
units.english: what is
units.italian: what is

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Oh, no one has told you about them? I thought once you'd demonstrated your trustworthiness and earned your capital ship license you would have found out." She pauses to take another bite, then continues.|3577|0
units.english: "Oh, no one has told you about them? I thought once you'd demonstrated your trustworthiness and earned your capital ship license you would have found out." She pauses to take another bite, then continues.
units.italian: "Oh, nessuno te ne ha parlato? Pensavo che una volta dimostrata la tua affidabilità e ottenuta la licenza per le navi di classe capitale l'avresti scoperto." Si interrompe per dare un altro morso, poi continua.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3579|0
units.english: dawn symbiont
units.italian: dawn symbiont

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Okay, I will meet you onboard the ship."|3581|0
units.english: "Okay, I will meet you onboard the ship."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti incontro a bordo della nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Developed quite the appetite, haven't you?"|3583|0
units.english: "Developed quite the appetite, haven't you?"
units.italian: "Ti è venuto un bell'appetito, eh?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She nods. "Yes, I am not yet used to the nutrient intake required to maintain my symbiont, so I have to consciously make sure that I eat enough to sustain it."|3584|0
units.english: She nods. "Yes, I am not yet used to the nutrient intake required to maintain my symbiont, so I have to consciously make sure that I eat enough to sustain it."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Sì, non sono ancora abituata all'apporto di nutrienti necessario a mantenere il mio simbionte, quindi devo assicurarmi consapevolmente di mangiare abbastanza per sostenerlo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Interesting. I will see you onboard the <ship>."|3586|0
units.english: "Interesting. I will see you onboard the <ship>."
units.italian: "Interessante. Ci vediamo a bordo della <ship>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Could you tell me more about them?"|3588|0
units.english: "Could you tell me more about them?"
units.italian: "Potresti dirmi di più su di loro?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3589|0
units.english: dawn details
units.italian: dawn details

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"In short, we domesticated some of the creatures found here ages ago and discovered that they could be attached to us to form a symbiotic relationship." She pauses again to eat. "I only recently received mine, so I am not fully adjusted to it yet."|3592|0
units.english: "In short, we domesticated some of the creatures found here ages ago and discovered that they could be attached to us to form a symbiotic relationship." She pauses again to eat. "I only recently received mine, so I am not fully adjusted to it yet."
units.italian: "In breve, molto tempo fa abbiamo addomesticato alcune delle creature trovate qui e abbiamo scoperto che potevano essere attaccate a noi per formare una relazione simbiotica." Si interrompe di nuovo per mangiare. "Ho ricevuto il mio solo di recente, quindi non mi sono ancora del tutto adattata."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Okay, that's as much as I need to know."|3594|0
units.english: "Okay, that's as much as I need to know."
units.italian: "Va bene, è tutto quello che mi serve sapere."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"What is it like to have a symbiont?"|3596|0
units.english: "What is it like to have a symbiont?"
units.italian: "Com'è avere un simbionte?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Oh, it is wonderful. It is very hard to describe. At first it is just slimy, then a lot of tingling. The tingling lasted for several hours, and then it was just like waking up: rising up out of darkness to a brighter world with just so much to see and learn. Suddenly, it was as if everything was moving slower, and I could take a long, hard look at everything..." Dawn is visibly excited, signing so fast you have trouble following.|3597|0
units.english: "Oh, it is wonderful. It is very hard to describe. At first it is just slimy, then a lot of tingling. The tingling lasted for several hours, and then it was just like waking up: rising up out of darkness to a brighter world with just so much to see and learn. Suddenly, it was as if everything was moving slower, and I could take a long, hard look at everything..." Dawn is visibly excited, signing so fast you have trouble following.
units.italian: "Oh, è meraviglioso. È molto difficile da descrivere. All'inizio è solo viscido, poi un formicolio diffuso. Il formicolio è durato diverse ore, e poi è stato come svegliarsi: emergere dal buio verso un mondo più luminoso con così tanto da vedere e imparare. All'improvviso era come se tutto si muovesse più lentamente, e potevo guardare ogni cosa con calma e attenzione..." Dawn è visibilmente eccitata, e segna così in fretta che fai fatica a seguirla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Thanks for the description. I should go prep the <ship> now."|3599|0
units.english: "Thanks for the description. I should go prep the <ship> now."
units.italian: "Grazie per la descrizione. Ora dovrei andare a preparare la <ship>."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Where is your symbiont? Yours does not seem to be obvious."|3601|0
units.english: "Where is your symbiont? Yours does not seem to be obvious."
units.italian: "Dov'è il tuo simbionte? Il tuo non sembra evidente."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Could I see your symbiont?"|3603|0
units.english: "Could I see your symbiont?"
units.italian: "Potrei vedere il tuo simbionte?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	Dawn looks at you with an amused expression. "We do not know each other nearly well enough for that. Better to focus on the expedition. I will catch up to you on the ship."|3604|0
units.english: Dawn looks at you with an amused expression. "We do not know each other nearly well enough for that. Better to focus on the expedition. I will catch up to you on the ship."
units.italian: Dawn ti guarda con un'espressione divertita. "Non ci conosciamo abbastanza per questo. Meglio concentrarsi sulla spedizione. Ti raggiungo sulla nave."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	She nods. "Well, I will finish my meal and meet you on the <ship> shortly." With that, she returns to her meal.|3607|0
units.english: She nods. "Well, I will finish my meal and meet you on the <ship> shortly." With that, she returns to her meal.
units.italian: Annuisce. "Beh, finisco il mio pasto e ti incontro tra poco sulla <ship>." Detto questo, torna al suo pasto.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3609|0
units.english: dawn where
units.italian: dawn where

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	Dawn looks at you with an amused expression. "Just as every human is a unique individual, so every symbiont is also unique. As such, they attach to different areas of the body. We do not know each other well enough for me to tell you more than that.|3610|0
units.english: Dawn looks at you with an amused expression. "Just as every human is a unique individual, so every symbiont is also unique. As such, they attach to different areas of the body. We do not know each other well enough for me to tell you more than that.
units.italian: Dawn ti guarda con un'espressione divertita. "Come ogni umano è un individuo unico, così ogni simbionte è unico. Per questo si attaccano a zone diverse del corpo. Non ci conosciamo abbastanza perché ti dica di più.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"We should probably be focusing on the expedition, though. You go get the <ship> ready for launch, and I will be there shortly."|3611|0
units.english: "We should probably be focusing on the expedition, though. You go get the <ship> ready for launch, and I will be there shortly."
units.italian: "Però probabilmente dovremmo concentrarci sulla spedizione. Vai a preparare la <ship> per il lancio, e io arrivo tra poco."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|You follow the directions of the starport control and settle onto a pad next to the outfitter. You barely have a chance to finish your landing checks before a team of Remnant have a compact pod waiting on your loading ramp. Once you open the cargo bay doors, they pick it up and maneuver it inside. They start securing it to the ship while Dawn and one of the scientists approaches you.|3618|0
units.english: You follow the directions of the starport control and settle onto a pad next to the outfitter. You barely have a chance to finish your landing checks before a team of Remnant have a compact pod waiting on your loading ramp. Once you open the cargo bay doors, they pick it up and maneuver it inside. They start securing it to the ship while Dawn and one of the scientists approaches you.
units.italian: Segui le indicazioni del controllo dello spazioporto e ti posi su una piazzola accanto al fornitore di equipaggiamento. Hai appena il tempo di finire i controlli di atterraggio che una squadra di Remnant ha già una capsula compatta pronta sulla tua rampa di carico. Appena apri le porte del vano cargo, la sollevano e la spostano dentro. Cominciano a fissarla alla nave mentre Dawn e uno degli scienziati ti si avvicinano.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"We have loaded the Research Laboratory onboard. The team will install it if they can find the space, but if they do not, it will be secured in the cargo bay," The Remnant scientist explains. "Before you depart, please verify that the laboratory is installed in the correct location. You know your ship better than we do, after all." She turns back to Dawn and makes a gesture of respect. "Embers guide your path, Seeker." With that, she strides away into the hive of activity that is the outfitting bays.|3619|0
units.english: "We have loaded the Research Laboratory onboard. The team will install it if they can find the space, but if they do not, it will be secured in the cargo bay," The Remnant scientist explains. "Before you depart, please verify that the laboratory is installed in the correct location. You know your ship better than we do, after all." She turns back to Dawn and makes a gesture of respect. "Embers guide your path, Seeker." With that, she strides away into the hive of activity that is the outfitting bays.
units.italian: "Abbiamo caricato il Laboratorio di Ricerca a bordo. La squadra lo installerà se trova lo spazio, altrimenti sarà fissato nel vano cargo," spiega la scienziata Remnant. "Prima di partire, verifica che il laboratorio sia installato nella posizione corretta. Dopotutto, conosci la tua nave meglio di noi." Si volta verso Dawn e fa un gesto di rispetto. "Che le Braci guidino il tuo cammino, Cercatrice." Detto questo, si allontana a grandi passi nell'alveare di attività che sono i bacini di equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"So, what is our next step?"|3621|0
units.english: "So, what is our next step?"
units.italian: "Allora, qual è il nostro prossimo passo?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Seeker?"|3623|0
units.english: "Seeker?"
units.italian: "Cercatrice?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	Dawn looks a little embarrassed. "Seeker is a title of respect for deep space explorers. It is unofficial - just a token of respect - but it is a title that I both aspire to earn and do not feel I deserve yet."|3624|0
units.english: Dawn looks a little embarrassed. "Seeker is a title of respect for deep space explorers. It is unofficial - just a token of respect - but it is a title that I both aspire to earn and do not feel I deserve yet."
units.italian: Dawn sembra un po' imbarazzata. "Cercatrice è un titolo di rispetto per gli esploratori dello spazio profondo. Non è ufficiale, solo un segno di rispetto, ma è un titolo che sia aspiro a guadagnarmi sia sento di non meritare ancora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"I thought all Remnant were spacefarers?"|3626|0
units.english: "I thought all Remnant were spacefarers?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che tutti i Remnant fossero viaggiatori dello spazio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Okay. So what next?"|3627|0
units.english: "Okay. So what next?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Allora cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Oh, we are. Every Remnant has had some experience in space. But there is a big difference between a few weeks of duty in a spacefaring post and spending months or years drifting in the void surrounding distant systems."|3629|0
units.english: "Oh, we are. Every Remnant has had some experience in space. But there is a big difference between a few weeks of duty in a spacefaring post and spending months or years drifting in the void surrounding distant systems."
units.italian: "Oh, lo siamo. Ogni Remnant ha avuto qualche esperienza nello spazio. Ma c'è una bella differenza tra qualche settimana di servizio in un posto spaziale e passare mesi o anni alla deriva nel vuoto intorno ai sistemi lontani."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Years drifting in the void?"|3631|0
units.english: "Years drifting in the void?"
units.italian: "Anni alla deriva nel vuoto?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Okay, let's get on with this."|3632|0
units.english: "Okay, let's get on with this."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo avanti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"If you want good data, you need to spend time to get it. And especially when we are tracking stellar phenomena, you need periods of long observation. Snapshots of the sky are good - that is what we will be collecting on this trip. But for watching the galaxy at large, other civilizations, and things of that ilk... Nothing is better than long-term observation." She looks lost in thought for a moment. "That is neither here nor there, however.|3634|0
units.english: "If you want good data, you need to spend time to get it. And especially when we are tracking stellar phenomena, you need periods of long observation. Snapshots of the sky are good - that is what we will be collecting on this trip. But for watching the galaxy at large, other civilizations, and things of that ilk... Nothing is better than long-term observation." She looks lost in thought for a moment. "That is neither here nor there, however.
units.italian: "Se vuoi dati buoni, devi dedicarci tempo. E soprattutto quando seguiamo fenomeni stellari, hai bisogno di lunghi periodi di osservazione. Le istantanee del cielo vanno bene, è quello che raccoglieremo in questo viaggio. Ma per osservare la galassia nel suo insieme, le altre civiltà e cose del genere... Niente è meglio dell'osservazione a lungo termine." Sembra persa nei pensieri per un momento. "Ma questo è un altro discorso.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|label|3635|0
units.english: lab next
units.italian: lab next

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 1|	"Now that you have the Research Laboratory, you will need to locate a jump drive in order to reach Sagittarius A*." She pauses and checks her commlink. "If you do not already have one, you can salvage one from a Korath raider. Our early warning system indicates that there are several incoming Korath fleets that should be here within the next day or two. Any one of them should have a jump drive you can take. Meet me in the starport once you have a jump drive."|3636|0
units.english: "Now that you have the Research Laboratory, you will need to locate a jump drive in order to reach Sagittarius A*." She pauses and checks her commlink. "If you do not already have one, you can salvage one from a Korath raider. Our early warning system indicates that there are several incoming Korath fleets that should be here within the next day or two. Any one of them should have a jump drive you can take. Meet me in the starport once you have a jump drive."
units.italian: "Ora che hai il Laboratorio di Ricerca, dovrai trovare un motore di salto per raggiungere Sagittarius A*." Si interrompe e controlla il commlink. "Se non ne hai già uno, puoi recuperarne uno da un predone Korath. Il nostro sistema di allarme precoce indica che ci sono diverse flotte Korath in arrivo che dovrebbero essere qui entro un giorno o due. Una qualsiasi di loro dovrebbe avere un motore di salto che puoi prendere. Incontrami allo spazioporto quando hai un motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|name|3641|0
units.english: Research expedition to Sagittarius A*
units.italian: Spedizione di ricerca su Sagittarius A*

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|description|3642|0
units.english: Travel to Sagittarius A* with a Research Laboratory installed in order to make measurements on the supermassive black hole and then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Viaggia fino a Sagittarius A* con un Laboratorio di Ricerca installato per fare misurazioni sul buco nero supermassiccio, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|blocked|3643|0
units.english: You need a jump drive and a research laboratory to take this mission.
units.italian: Ti servono un motore di salto e un laboratorio di ricerca per accettare questa missione.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|Dawn is just finishing her meal when you enter the spaceport cafeteria. She stands up as you approach and deposits the tray in a receptacle next to her table. "Well, ready to go?"|3656|0
units.english: Dawn is just finishing her meal when you enter the spaceport cafeteria. She stands up as you approach and deposits the tray in a receptacle next to her table. "Well, ready to go?"
units.italian: Dawn sta appena finendo il suo pasto quando entri nella mensa dello spazioporto. Si alza quando ti avvicini e deposita il vassoio in un contenitore accanto al suo tavolo. "Bene, pronta a partire?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Yes."|3658|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"I should double check everything."|3660|0
units.english: "I should double check everything."
units.italian: "Dovrei ricontrollare tutto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	She nods. "I am ready, so I will come with you and wait onboard the <ship> while you do your checks."|3662|0
units.english: She nods. "I am ready, so I will come with you and wait onboard the <ship> while you do your checks."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Io sono pronta, quindi vengo con te e aspetto a bordo della <ship> mentre fai i tuoi controlli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|label|3663|0
units.english: astral onwards
units.italian: astral onwards

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	She gestures towards the exit closest to your ship and heads off at a quick pace. Outside, she moves calmly through the hustle and bustle of the starport, stepping around quick-moving freight movers and camel wagons alike. Arriving at the <ship>, she turns and waits for you to catch up.|3664|0
units.english: She gestures towards the exit closest to your ship and heads off at a quick pace. Outside, she moves calmly through the hustle and bustle of the starport, stepping around quick-moving freight movers and camel wagons alike. Arriving at the <ship>, she turns and waits for you to catch up.
units.italian: Fa un gesto verso l'uscita più vicina alla tua nave e si avvia a passo svelto. Fuori, si muove con calma tra il viavai dello spazioporto, scansando sia i trasportatori merci veloci sia i carri trainati da cammelli. Arrivata alla <ship>, si volta e aspetta che la raggiungi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	Just as you arrive and reach for the console to open the airlock, you sense a change in your surroundings. Looking around, you see that a group of Remnant gathered around the two of you, focused on Dawn. A young Remnant - scarcely more than a child - steps forward. "Thank you for your patience," he says, then steps back. An elderly Remnant steps forward. "Thank you for your curiosity," she says, then steps back. A middle-aged Remnant steps forward. "Go with our blessing, Seeker, and know that wherever you go, the Remnant go with you." She says it simply, but you feel the weight of tradition behind them. She turns to you. "And you, stranger who walks the stars... May the Embers guide your steps as you walk among us." She nods respectfully, then steps back.|3665|0
units.english: Just as you arrive and reach for the console to open the airlock, you sense a change in your surroundings. Looking around, you see that a group of Remnant gathered around the two of you, focused on Dawn. A young Remnant - scarcely more than a child - steps forward. "Thank you for your patience," he says, then steps back. An elderly Remnant steps forward. "Thank you for your curiosity," she says, then steps back. A middle-aged Remnant steps forward. "Go with our blessing, Seeker, and know that wherever you go, the Remnant go with you." She says it simply, but you feel the weight of tradition behind them. She turns to you. "And you, stranger who walks the stars... May the Embers guide your steps as you walk among us." She nods respectfully, then steps back.
units.italian: Proprio mentre arrivi e allunghi la mano verso la console per aprire la camera di equilibrio, percepisci un cambiamento intorno a te. Guardandoti intorno, vedi che un gruppo di Remnant si è radunato intorno a voi due, concentrato su Dawn. Un giovane Remnant, a malapena più che un bambino, fa un passo avanti. "Grazie per la tua pazienza," dice, poi torna indietro. Una Remnant anziana fa un passo avanti. "Grazie per la tua curiosità," dice, poi torna indietro. Una Remnant di mezza età fa un passo avanti. "Va' con la nostra benedizione, Cercatrice, e sappi che ovunque andrai, i Remnant andranno con te." Lo dice semplicemente, ma senti il peso della tradizione dietro le sue parole. Si volta verso di te. "E tu, straniero che cammini tra le stelle... Che le Braci guidino i tuoi passi mentre cammini tra noi." Annuisce con rispetto, poi torna indietro.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	As soon as the third steps back there is a flurry of movement as each of the Remnant present quickly step forward, give her a quick hug, and then scurry off into the starport. Before you process what is going on, all the Remnant gathered around you have vanished. You look at Dawn, and her expression is a mixture of awe and humility.|3666|0
units.english: As soon as the third steps back there is a flurry of movement as each of the Remnant present quickly step forward, give her a quick hug, and then scurry off into the starport. Before you process what is going on, all the Remnant gathered around you have vanished. You look at Dawn, and her expression is a mixture of awe and humility.
units.italian: Appena la terza torna indietro c'è un turbine di movimento: ognuno dei Remnant presenti fa un rapido passo avanti, le dà un breve abbraccio, e poi si allontana di corsa nello spazioporto. Prima che tu capisca cosa sta succedendo, tutti i Remnant radunati intorno a voi sono svaniti. Guardi Dawn, e la sua espressione è un misto di timore e umiltà.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"They know you are coming back, right?"|3668|0
units.english: "They know you are coming back, right?"
units.italian: "Sanno che tornerai, vero?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"What was that about?"|3669|0
units.english: "What was that about?"
units.italian: "Di cosa si trattava?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Alright, let's get going."|3670|0
units.english: "Alright, let's get going."
units.italian: "Bene, mettiamoci in cammino."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Well, what we are doing is dangerous. We will be crossing Korath territory, a wide expanse of uninhabited space, and then scanning a black hole. I have confidence that we will return, but nonetheless there is still a chance that we will die in the process.|3672|0
units.english: "Well, what we are doing is dangerous. We will be crossing Korath territory, a wide expanse of uninhabited space, and then scanning a black hole. I have confidence that we will return, but nonetheless there is still a chance that we will die in the process.
units.italian: "Beh, quello che stiamo facendo è pericoloso. Attraverseremo il territorio Korath, una vasta distesa di spazio disabitato, e poi scansioneeremo un buco nero. Ho fiducia che torneremo, ma ciononostante c'è ancora la possibilità che moriamo lungo il cammino.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Long ago we, as a people, decided that we must face the fear of separation, unknown, and danger. One of the ways we do that is by holding these informal ceremonies. When one of us is going to depart on their first long-distance voyage into hostile territory, a group of Remnant gather to bid them farewell. It is a way to strengthen ourselves and remind each other of our connections."|3673|0
units.english: "Long ago we, as a people, decided that we must face the fear of separation, unknown, and danger. One of the ways we do that is by holding these informal ceremonies. When one of us is going to depart on their first long-distance voyage into hostile territory, a group of Remnant gather to bid them farewell. It is a way to strengthen ourselves and remind each other of our connections."
units.italian: "Molto tempo fa noi, come popolo, abbiamo deciso che dobbiamo affrontare la paura della separazione, dell'ignoto e del pericolo. Uno dei modi in cui lo facciamo è tenere queste cerimonie informali. Quando uno di noi sta per partire per il suo primo viaggio a lunga distanza in territorio ostile, un gruppo di Remnant si raduna per salutarlo. È un modo per rafforzare noi stessi e ricordarci a vicenda i nostri legami."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Thanks for the explanation."|3675|0
units.english: "Thanks for the explanation."
units.italian: "Grazie per la spiegazione."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Kind of like a funeral, with friends and family gathering to see you off?"|3677|0
units.english: "Kind of like a funeral, with friends and family gathering to see you off?"
units.italian: "Un po' come un funerale, con amici e familiari riuniti per darti l'addio?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Oh, no. I said my farewells to my friends and relatives before we left. Those who gathered to see me off today were more of a representation of Remnant society. I only recognized a few of them, but they took the time to come down to the <ship> to meet me before I left. They came to see me and wish me well, so that no matter what challenges I face, I will know that the Remnant remember me and appreciate what I am doing." Her gestures fade into contemplative stillness for a moment, then resume motion.|3678|0
units.english: "Oh, no. I said my farewells to my friends and relatives before we left. Those who gathered to see me off today were more of a representation of Remnant society. I only recognized a few of them, but they took the time to come down to the <ship> to meet me before I left. They came to see me and wish me well, so that no matter what challenges I face, I will know that the Remnant remember me and appreciate what I am doing." Her gestures fade into contemplative stillness for a moment, then resume motion.
units.italian: "Oh, no. Ho salutato i miei amici e parenti prima di partire. Quelli che si sono radunati per darmi l'addio oggi erano più una rappresentanza della società dei Remnant. Ne ho riconosciuti solo alcuni, ma si sono presi il tempo di scendere fino alla <ship> per incontrarmi prima che partissi. Sono venuti a vedermi e ad augurarmi il bene, così che qualunque sfida dovrò affrontare, io sappia che i Remnant si ricordano di me e apprezzano quello che sto facendo." I suoi gesti si perdono in un'immobilità pensosa per un momento, poi riprendono il movimento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|label|3679|0
units.english: astral moving
units.italian: astral moving

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	She gestures towards the airlock door. "Lead the way, Captain."|3680|0
units.english: She gestures towards the airlock door. "Lead the way, Captain."
units.italian: Fa un gesto verso la porta della camera di equilibrio. "Apri la strada, capitano."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|As the jump drive's energy ripples fade away, the spectacular void that is Sagittarius A* takes shape before you. Compared to the vast darkness of space that you are accustomed to, reality here feels almost like a color negative: even with the automatic filtering in your windows, space is incredibly bright with the densely packed stars that provide a backdrop for its inky mass. The moment of awe is shattered by alarms warning of your impending doom as the <ship> begins to fall inwards towards the black hole. You quickly activate your repulsor engines, which, although vastly under-powered for dealing with the immense pull of a black hole, does provide a degree of protection so long as you maintain a safe distance from it.|3684|0
units.english: As the jump drive's energy ripples fade away, the spectacular void that is Sagittarius A* takes shape before you. Compared to the vast darkness of space that you are accustomed to, reality here feels almost like a color negative: even with the automatic filtering in your windows, space is incredibly bright with the densely packed stars that provide a backdrop for its inky mass. The moment of awe is shattered by alarms warning of your impending doom as the <ship> begins to fall inwards towards the black hole. You quickly activate your repulsor engines, which, although vastly under-powered for dealing with the immense pull of a black hole, does provide a degree of protection so long as you maintain a safe distance from it.
units.italian: Mentre le increspature di energia del motore di salto svaniscono, lo spettacolare vuoto che è Sagittarius A* prende forma davanti a te. Rispetto alla vasta oscurità dello spazio a cui sei abituato, la realtà qui sembra quasi un negativo fotografico: anche con il filtro automatico dei tuoi oblò, lo spazio è incredibilmente luminoso per le stelle fittamente ammassate che fanno da sfondo alla sua massa d'inchiostro. Il momento di soggezione è infranto dagli allarmi che avvertono della tua rovina imminente mentre la <ship> comincia a cadere verso il buco nero. Attivi in fretta i motori a repulsione che, anche se ampiamente sotto-potenziati rispetto all'enorme attrazione di un buco nero, offrono un certo grado di protezione finché mantieni una distanza di sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	After a few minutes of just absorbing the spectacle before you, Dawn pulls herself away from the cockpit windows and scurries down to the lab. Leaving you to your thoughts, she quickly has the lab set up and running a variety of recordings, tests, and observations. After a few hours of work, she reappears on the bridge.|3685|0
units.english: After a few minutes of just absorbing the spectacle before you, Dawn pulls herself away from the cockpit windows and scurries down to the lab. Leaving you to your thoughts, she quickly has the lab set up and running a variety of recordings, tests, and observations. After a few hours of work, she reappears on the bridge.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto passato solo ad assorbire lo spettacolo davanti a te, Dawn si stacca dagli oblò della plancia e scende di corsa al laboratorio. Lasciandoti ai tuoi pensieri, ha presto il laboratorio pronto e avviato a una serie di registrazioni, test e osservazioni. Dopo qualche ora di lavoro, riappare in plancia.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Things are proceeding smoothly, Captain. All the sensors are working nominally, and we are creating extensive archives of astronomical data as well. Another few hours, and we should have all the data we need."|3686|0
units.english: "Things are proceeding smoothly, Captain. All the sensors are working nominally, and we are creating extensive archives of astronomical data as well. Another few hours, and we should have all the data we need."
units.italian: "Le cose procedono senza intoppi, capitano. Tutti i sensori funzionano nominalmente, e stiamo anche creando archivi estesi di dati astronomici. Ancora qualche ora e dovremmo avere tutti i dati che ci servono."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Good work. What kind of data are you recording?"|3688|0
units.english: "Good work. What kind of data are you recording?"
units.italian: "Bel lavoro. Che tipo di dati stai registrando?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Sounds good. Just let me know when you are ready to leave."|3689|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Just let me know when you are ready to leave."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Fammi sapere quando sei pronta a partire."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	She smiles, and replies. "It might be easier to ask what we are leaving out. The data we are collecting broadly falls into three sets: data on Sagittarius A* itself, data on its environment, and observations of the surrounding galaxy from here. Obviously, we cannot go take samples of Sagittarius A* itself, nor can we take direct measurements of most of its properties, but we can get data from increasingly minute distances from the event horizon. We can then add this data to that gathered by previous expeditions, note the differences, and use it in our modeling."|3691|0
units.english: She smiles, and replies. "It might be easier to ask what we are leaving out. The data we are collecting broadly falls into three sets: data on Sagittarius A* itself, data on its environment, and observations of the surrounding galaxy from here. Obviously, we cannot go take samples of Sagittarius A* itself, nor can we take direct measurements of most of its properties, but we can get data from increasingly minute distances from the event horizon. We can then add this data to that gathered by previous expeditions, note the differences, and use it in our modeling."
units.italian: Sorride e risponde. "Forse sarebbe più facile chiedere cosa stiamo lasciando fuori. I dati che stiamo raccogliendo ricadono in tre gruppi: dati su Sagittarius A* stesso, dati sul suo ambiente, e osservazioni della galassia circostante da qui. Ovviamente non possiamo prelevare campioni di Sagittarius A* stesso, né possiamo misurare direttamente la maggior parte delle sue proprietà, ma possiamo ottenere dati da distanze sempre più ridotte dall'orizzonte degli eventi. Possiamo poi aggiungere questi dati a quelli raccolti dalle spedizioni precedenti, annotare le differenze e usarli nei nostri modelli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"So this is not the first expedition here?"|3693|0
units.english: "So this is not the first expedition here?"
units.italian: "Quindi questa non è la prima spedizione qui?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Anything unusual in the data?"|3694|0
units.english: "Anything unusual in the data?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa di insolito nei dati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"How much longer does the equipment need?"|3696|0
units.english: "How much longer does the equipment need?"
units.italian: "Quanto tempo serve ancora all'attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"No, this is the forty-third such expedition. Sagittarius A* was one of the first places our explorers sought to visit after we acquired jump drives, and we have been coming back regularly ever since. I know some of our reconnaissance pilots consider visiting here a pilgrimage of sorts. It is humbling to be here myself after reviewing so many data sets of past expeditions." She looks thoughtful, staring out the window at the hub of the galaxy, as if her thoughts are jumping from idea to idea.|3698|0
units.english: "No, this is the forty-third such expedition. Sagittarius A* was one of the first places our explorers sought to visit after we acquired jump drives, and we have been coming back regularly ever since. I know some of our reconnaissance pilots consider visiting here a pilgrimage of sorts. It is humbling to be here myself after reviewing so many data sets of past expeditions." She looks thoughtful, staring out the window at the hub of the galaxy, as if her thoughts are jumping from idea to idea.
units.italian: "No, questa è la quarantatreesima spedizione del genere. Sagittarius A* è stato uno dei primi posti che i nostri esploratori hanno cercato di visitare dopo aver ottenuto i motori di salto, e da allora siamo tornati regolarmente. So che alcuni dei nostri piloti da ricognizione considerano una visita qui una specie di pellegrinaggio. È un'esperienza che ti mette in soggezione, trovarsi qui di persona dopo aver esaminato così tanti insiemi di dati delle spedizioni passate." Sembra pensierosa, fissando fuori dall'oblò il centro della galassia, come se i suoi pensieri saltassero da un'idea all'altra.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Anything unusual in the data?"|3700|0
units.english: "Anything unusual in the data?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa di insolito nei dati?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"How much longer does the equipment need?"|3701|0
units.english: "How much longer does the equipment need?"
units.italian: "Quanto tempo serve ancora all'attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|label|3703|0
units.english: astral data
units.italian: astral data

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"There are many oddities about this place. Every visit helps revise our physics models a little closer. But they also reveal problems." She frowns, her gestures taking on a curious tone. "For instance, you will note that your ramscoops are not picking up anything. According to standard astronomical theory, this system should be a veritable river of suitable material, and yet there is nothing. Not even the normal background trace amounts we find in deep space. We have visited other black holes, and they conform to the standard models in this respect. But not Sagittarius A*." She pauses, thinking about it for a moment.|3704|0
units.english: "There are many oddities about this place. Every visit helps revise our physics models a little closer. But they also reveal problems." She frowns, her gestures taking on a curious tone. "For instance, you will note that your ramscoops are not picking up anything. According to standard astronomical theory, this system should be a veritable river of suitable material, and yet there is nothing. Not even the normal background trace amounts we find in deep space. We have visited other black holes, and they conform to the standard models in this respect. But not Sagittarius A*." She pauses, thinking about it for a moment.
units.italian: "Ci sono molte stranezze in questo posto. Ogni visita aiuta a correggere un po' i nostri modelli fisici. Ma rivelano anche problemi." Aggrotta la fronte, e i suoi gesti assumono un tono curioso. "Per esempio, noterai che i tuoi ramscoop non raccolgono nulla. Secondo la teoria astronomica standard, questo sistema dovrebbe essere un vero fiume di materiale adatto, eppure non c'è niente. Nemmeno le normali tracce di fondo che troviamo nello spazio profondo. Abbiamo visitato altri buchi neri, e in questo senso rispettano i modelli standard. Ma non Sagittarius A*." Si interrompe, pensandoci su per un momento.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Is the equipment finished?"|3706|0
units.english: "Is the equipment finished?"
units.italian: "L'attrezzatura ha finito?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"How much longer does the equipment need?"|3707|0
units.english: "How much longer does the equipment need?"
units.italian: "Quanto tempo serve ancora all'attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|label|3708|0
units.english: astral finish
units.italian: astral finish

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"The equipment will be finished shortly, Captain <first>. I just need to make a few observations, and then we will be able to depart. In the meantime, I would recommend against maintaining an active cloak or engaging any systems that consume fuel. For whatever reason, Sagittarius A* continues to be the one place that the stellar wind is utterly devoid of anything to collect as fuel."|3709|0
units.english: "The equipment will be finished shortly, Captain <first>. I just need to make a few observations, and then we will be able to depart. In the meantime, I would recommend against maintaining an active cloak or engaging any systems that consume fuel. For whatever reason, Sagittarius A* continues to be the one place that the stellar wind is utterly devoid of anything to collect as fuel."
units.italian: "L'attrezzatura sarà pronta a breve, capitano <first>. Mi servono solo un paio di osservazioni, e poi potremo partire. Nel frattempo, ti consiglio di non mantenere un camuffamento attivo né di impegnare sistemi che consumano carburante. Per qualche ragione, Sagittarius A* continua a essere l'unico posto in cui il vento stellare è del tutto privo di qualcosa da raccogliere come carburante."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"I will be going outside for a few minutes," Dawn declares. "I shall just be on the hull."|3710|0
units.english: "I will be going outside for a few minutes," Dawn declares. "I shall just be on the hull."
units.italian: "Esco fuori qualche minuto," dichiara Dawn. "Sarò solo sullo scafo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Let me know when you are done."|3712|0
units.english: "Let me know when you are done."
units.italian: "Fammi sapere quando hai finito."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Would you mind if I came too?"|3714|0
units.english: "Would you mind if I came too?"
units.italian: "Ti dispiace se vengo anch'io?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	"Not at all, Captain. The view should be remarkable, and so long as we stay inside the shields, the radiation will not pose a problem." You quickly don your spacesuit and join Dawn outside on the hull. As promised, the view is indeed magnificent. Dawn signs occasionally, pointing out various features, and you appreciate that out here, sound would just be incongruous with the natural splendor.|3715|0
units.english: "Not at all, Captain. The view should be remarkable, and so long as we stay inside the shields, the radiation will not pose a problem." You quickly don your spacesuit and join Dawn outside on the hull. As promised, the view is indeed magnificent. Dawn signs occasionally, pointing out various features, and you appreciate that out here, sound would just be incongruous with the natural splendor.
units.italian: "Per niente, capitano. La vista dovrebbe essere notevole, e finché restiamo dentro gli scudi, le radiazioni non saranno un problema." Ti infili rapidamente nella tuta spaziale e raggiungi Dawn fuori, sullo scafo. Come promesso, la vista è davvero magnifica. Dawn segna di tanto in tanto, indicando vari dettagli, e apprezzi il fatto che qui fuori il suono sarebbe semplicemente fuori luogo rispetto allo splendore naturale.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|label|3717|0
units.english: astral done
units.italian: astral done

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|	After what feels like hours, the equipment notifies you that it has finished taking its readings, and Dawn packs up the data in carefully shielded data crystals. Everything is ready to return to <destination>.|3718|0
units.english: After what feels like hours, the equipment notifies you that it has finished taking its readings, and Dawn packs up the data in carefully shielded data crystals. Everything is ready to return to <destination>.
units.italian: Dopo quella che sembra un'eternità, l'attrezzatura ti avvisa che ha finito di prendere le sue letture, e Dawn ripone i dati in cristalli di dati accuratamente schermati. Tutto è pronto per tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|The journey back to <planet> was a lesson in galactic formation as the <ship> jumped through a steady stream of systems. Gradually, the brilliant density of stars that make up the inner core faded into the ominous and yet comfortingly familiar red glow of the Ember Waste. Finally, you slide into the approach patterns of <planet>, quickly tapping out your code into the IFF system and watching as the protective gaze of the anti-air emplacements sweep the skies around you for shadowing craft.|3722|0
units.english: The journey back to <planet> was a lesson in galactic formation as the <ship> jumped through a steady stream of systems. Gradually, the brilliant density of stars that make up the inner core faded into the ominous and yet comfortingly familiar red glow of the Ember Waste. Finally, you slide into the approach patterns of <planet>, quickly tapping out your code into the IFF system and watching as the protective gaze of the anti-air emplacements sweep the skies around you for shadowing craft.
units.italian: Il viaggio di ritorno su <planet> è stata una lezione di formazione galattica mentre la <ship> saltava attraverso un flusso costante di sistemi. A poco a poco, la brillante densità di stelle che compone il nucleo interno è svanita nel bagliore rosso sinistro eppure rassicurante della Distesa di Braci.
