Alla fine ti inserisci nei corridoi di avvicinamento di <planet>, digitando rapidamente il tuo codice nel sistema IFF e guardando lo sguardo protettivo delle postazioni antiaeree che spazza i cieli intorno a te in cerca di velivoli in agguato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Astral 2|You settle onto your assigned pad, and within seconds Remnant technicians have resupply cables hooked up while a cheerful group greets Dawn before helping her unload her luggage and data crystals. "Well, <first>, it has been a good trip." She taps at her commlink. "I have transferred our expedition's logistics allotment of <payment> to you. And in case you're wondering what to do with your Research Laboratory, you can keep it. We always need fresh data, and if you are interested, you can check up on places designated in the job board. While I handled the science on this expedition, if you keep it installed your ship systems will automatically hire a scientist to run it." She nods her head in respect to you. "Thank you, and may the Embers watch over you." She turns and heads off into the flows of people.|3723|0
units.english: You settle onto your assigned pad, and within seconds Remnant technicians have resupply cables hooked up while a cheerful group greets Dawn before helping her unload her luggage and data crystals. "Well, <first>, it has been a good trip." She taps at her commlink. "I have transferred our expedition's logistics allotment of <payment> to you. And in case you're wondering what to do with your Research Laboratory, you can keep it. We always need fresh data, and if you are interested, you can check up on places designated in the job board. While I handled the science on this expedition, if you keep it installed your ship systems will automatically hire a scientist to run it." She nods her head in respect to you. "Thank you, and may the Embers watch over you." She turns and heads off into the flows of people.
units.italian: Ti posi sulla piazzola assegnata, e in pochi secondi i tecnici Remnant hanno già collegato i cavi di rifornimento mentre un gruppo allegro saluta Dawn e la aiuta a scaricare i bagagli e i cristalli di dati. "Beh, <first>, è stato un buon viaggio." Batte sul commlink. "Ti ho trasferito l'assegnazione logistica della nostra spedizione, <payment>. E se ti stai chiedendo cosa fare del tuo Laboratorio di Ricerca, puoi tenerlo. Abbiamo sempre bisogno di dati freschi, e se ti interessa puoi controllare i luoghi indicati nella bacheca degli incarichi. Anche se questa volta ho gestito io la parte scientifica, se lo tieni installato i sistemi della tua nave assumeranno automaticamente uno scienziato per farlo funzionare." Ti fa un cenno del capo in segno di rispetto. "Grazie, e che le Braci veglino su di te." Si volta e si allontana nel flusso di persone.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|name|3756|0
units.english: Ember Waste Storm Scanning
units.italian: Scansione delle tempeste della Distesa di Braci

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|description|3757|0
units.english: Dawn has asked that you scan one of the Ember Waste's storms at <waypoints> and return with the data to <planet>.
units.italian: Dawn ti ha chiesto di scansionare una delle tempeste della Distesa di Braci a <waypoints> e di tornare con i dati su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|As you cross the starport, you are suddenly ambushed by Dawn appearing out of a side hallway. "Captain <first>! I have been hoping to catch you. I need some help." She hurries up, waving a datapad full of charts. "I have some additional leads for my research project, and I need a pilot who can take me out to Aescolanus." She looks at you hopefully.|3770|0
units.english: As you cross the starport, you are suddenly ambushed by Dawn appearing out of a side hallway. "Captain <first>! I have been hoping to catch you. I need some help." She hurries up, waving a datapad full of charts. "I have some additional leads for my research project, and I need a pilot who can take me out to Aescolanus." She looks at you hopefully.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, vieni improvvisamente intercettato da Dawn che sbuca da un corridoio laterale. "Capitano <first>! Speravo di incontrarti. Ho bisogno di aiuto." Si affretta, agitando un datapad pieno di grafici. "Ho altre piste per il mio progetto di ricerca, e mi serve un pilota che mi porti ad Aescolanus." Ti guarda con speranza.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Sure, I am always willing to help."|3772|0
units.english: "Sure, I am always willing to help."
units.italian: "Certo, sono sempre disposto ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Not today, sorry."|3773|0
units.english: "Not today, sorry."
units.italian: "Non oggi, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Excellent! You already have a Research Laboratory onboard, and it has all the equipment I need. Now, before we head out, you should know that the goal of this mission is to do some analysis on the leading edge of a storm that will be breaking on the system shortly. We do not need to weather the entire storm, but we will have to be there for at least the first part."|3775|0
units.english: "Excellent! You already have a Research Laboratory onboard, and it has all the equipment I need. Now, before we head out, you should know that the goal of this mission is to do some analysis on the leading edge of a storm that will be breaking on the system shortly. We do not need to weather the entire storm, but we will have to be there for at least the first part."
units.italian: "Eccellente! Hai già a bordo un Laboratorio di Ricerca, e ha tutta l'attrezzatura che mi serve. Ora, prima di partire, devi sapere che lo scopo di questa missione è fare qualche analisi sul bordo d'avanzata di una tempesta che si abbatterà sul sistema a breve. Non dobbiamo resistere all'intera tempesta, ma dovremo restare lì almeno per la prima parte."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Are there any special adjustments needed?"|3777|0
units.english: "Are there any special adjustments needed?"
units.italian: "Servono aggiustamenti particolari?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"The <ship> is ready to go."|3778|0
units.english: "The <ship> is ready to go."
units.italian: "La <ship> è pronta a partire."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Well, I expect you are already set up to handle the normal Ember Waste heat, correct?" She continues without waiting for you to reply. "The Ember Waste storms are primarily a danger to electrical systems - typically by draining your power. So you can compensate by ensuring that you have some excess available for use. I know some captains carry extra generators to ensure they always have extra power, but others instead carry extra Crystal Capacitors so they can outlast the storm. In theory, you could just accept that your ship will be shut down during the height of the storm, and simply reboot everything afterwards. So long as no threats are present, it is safe but somewhat nerve-wracking. Which strategy fits the <ship> is up to you."|3780|0
units.english: "Well, I expect you are already set up to handle the normal Ember Waste heat, correct?" She continues without waiting for you to reply. "The Ember Waste storms are primarily a danger to electrical systems - typically by draining your power. So you can compensate by ensuring that you have some excess available for use. I know some captains carry extra generators to ensure they always have extra power, but others instead carry extra Crystal Capacitors so they can outlast the storm. In theory, you could just accept that your ship will be shut down during the height of the storm, and simply reboot everything afterwards. So long as no threats are present, it is safe but somewhat nerve-wracking. Which strategy fits the <ship> is up to you."
units.italian: "Beh, immagino che tu sia già attrezzato per sopportare il calore normale della Distesa di Braci, giusto?" Continua senza aspettare la risposta. "Le tempeste della Distesa di Braci sono pericolose soprattutto per i sistemi elettrici, di solito prosciugando la tua energia. Quindi puoi compensare assicurandoti di averne un po' in eccesso a disposizione. So che alcuni capitani portano generatori extra per avere sempre energia in più, altri invece portano Condensatori di Cristallo extra per resistere più a lungo della tempesta. In teoria potresti anche accettare che la nave si spenga nel pieno della tempesta e limitarti a riavviare tutto dopo. Finché non ci sono minacce, è sicuro ma un po' snervante. Quale strategia si adatti alla <ship> spetta a te."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|label|3781|0
units.english: ready for storms
units.italian: ready for storms

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"I will settle into a bunk to do some pre-calculations. Please let me know when we arrive in Aescolanus."|3782|0
units.english: "I will settle into a bunk to do some pre-calculations. Please let me know when we arrive in Aescolanus."
units.italian: "Mi sistemo in una cuccetta per fare qualche precalcolo. Ti prego di avvisarmi quando arriviamo ad Aescolanus."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|dialog|3785|0
units.english: Dawn quickly sets to work expanding the laboratory and setting up her instruments. After a few minutes, she returns to the cockpit and settles into a chair by the window. "Everything is ready, Captain. Now we just wait for the storm to arrive. I will let you know when we are ready to leave."
units.italian: Dawn si mette subito al lavoro per ampliare il laboratorio e sistemare i suoi strumenti. Dopo qualche minuto torna in cabina di pilotaggio e si siede su una poltrona accanto alla finestra. "È tutto pronto, capitano. Ora dobbiamo solo aspettare che arrivi la tempesta. Ti avviserò quando siamo pronti a partire."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|dialog|3791|0
units.english: As the storm starts to swell around you, the instrumentation chimes to indicate that it has collected all the data it needs. Dawn quickly begins the shutdown routine to protect the equipment against potential damage, giving you the OK to return back to <planet>.
units.italian: Mentre la tempesta comincia a gonfiarsi intorno a voi, la strumentazione suona per indicare che ha raccolto tutti i dati necessari. Dawn avvia rapidamente la procedura di spegnimento per proteggere l'attrezzatura da possibili danni, dandoti il via libera per tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|"Thank you for your help, <first>. Sometimes I have to wait a while before we have a ship available to do missions like these." units.english: "Thank you for your help, <first>. Sometimes I have to wait a while before we have a ship available to do missions like these." She pauses, then taps her commlink. "Speaking of which, I have confirmed the transfer of the logistics fee of <payment> to your account."
units.italian: "Grazie per il tuo aiuto, <first>. A volte devo aspettare un bel po' prima che ci sia una nave disponibile per missioni come questa." Si interrompe, poi batte sul commlink. "A proposito, ho confermato il trasferimento della quota logistica di <payment> sul tuo conto."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"I am always happy to help. What are you working on now, anyway?"|3797|0
units.english: "I am always happy to help. What are you working on now, anyway?"
units.italian: "Sono sempre felice di aiutare. A cosa stai lavorando adesso, comunque?"

units.english: "I am always happy to help. See you around!"
units.italian: "Sono sempre felice di aiutare. Ci vediamo in giro!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"How familiar are you with the nature of space?"|3800|0
units.english: "How familiar are you with the nature of space?"
units.italian: "Quanto conosci la natura dello spazio?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Not very, to be honest."|3802|0
units.english: "Not very, to be honest."
units.italian: "Non molto, a dire il vero."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"I know space is a vacuum, and can be either extremely hot or extremely cold depending on circumstances..."|3803|0
units.english: "I know space is a vacuum, and can be either extremely hot or extremely cold depending on circumstances..."
units.italian: "So che lo spazio è un vuoto, e che può essere estremamente caldo o estremamente freddo a seconda delle circostanze..."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She nods "Honesty is good. It is hard to learn when we are not willing to admit that we do not know something."|3805|0
units.english: She nods "Honesty is good. It is hard to learn when we are not willing to admit that we do not know something."
units.italian: Annuisce. "L'onestà è una buona cosa. È difficile imparare quando non siamo disposti ad ammettere di non sapere qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She nods "Those are the basics, a good starting point."|3808|0
units.english: She nods "Those are the basics, a good starting point."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Quelle sono le basi, un buon punto di partenza."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	A hologram of the Ember Waste appears over her commlink. "As you have no doubt picked up on, the Ember Waste does not conform to humanity's commonly understood rules about space. For instance, the standard background temperature is 2.B1 degrees, and the average density of the interstellar medium is F4240 particles per cubic meter. Here in the Ember Waste, the average background temperature is an order of magnitude greater and has an average density of E8D4A51000 particles per cubic meter."|3810|0
units.english: A hologram of the Ember Waste appears over her commlink. "As you have no doubt picked up on, the Ember Waste does not conform to humanity's commonly understood rules about space. For instance, the standard background temperature is 2.B1 degrees, and the average density of the interstellar medium is F4240 particles per cubic meter. Here in the Ember Waste, the average background temperature is an order of magnitude greater and has an average density of E8D4A51000 particles per cubic meter."
units.italian: Un ologramma della Distesa di Braci appare sopra il suo commlink. "Come avrai senza dubbio notato, la Distesa di Braci non si conforma alle regole dello spazio comunemente note all'umanità. Per esempio, la temperatura di fondo standard è di 2.B1 gradi, e la densità media del mezzo interstellare è di F4240 particelle per metro cubo. Qui nella Distesa di Braci la temperatura di fondo media è di un ordine di grandezza superiore e ha una densità media di E8D4A51000 particelle per metro cubo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	The display changes as an overlay of haze appears, pulsing in intensity. "Most interestingly, though, is that this area is significantly more variable than the rest of the galaxy. The haze shown here represents the heat hazard schematic we produce for our captains. It combines the local density with the measured heat values to estimate how much heat ships will be exposed to in the area."|3811|0
units.english: The display changes as an overlay of haze appears, pulsing in intensity. "Most interestingly, though, is that this area is significantly more variable than the rest of the galaxy. The haze shown here represents the heat hazard schematic we produce for our captains. It combines the local density with the measured heat values to estimate how much heat ships will be exposed to in the area."
units.italian: Il display cambia mentre appare una sovrapposizione di foschia che pulsa di intensità. "La cosa più interessante, però, è che quest'area è molto più variabile del resto della galassia. La foschia mostrata qui rappresenta lo schema del rischio termico che produciamo per i nostri capitani. Combina la densità locale con i valori di calore misurati per stimare quanto calore le navi saranno esposte nella zona."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Interesting! Is that what causes the red glow?"|3813|0
units.english: "Interesting! Is that what causes the red glow?"
units.italian: "Interessante! È questo che causa il bagliore rosso?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Wait a second. Why are there letters in your numbers?"|3814|0
units.english: "Wait a second. Why are there letters in your numbers?"
units.italian: "Un momento. Perché nei tuoi numeri ci sono delle lettere?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Thanks! I think that is all the details I can handle right now."|3816|0
units.english: "Thanks! I think that is all the details I can handle right now."
units.italian: "Grazie! Credo che questi siano tutti i dettagli che riesco a gestire per ora."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|label|3818|0
units.english: storm resume
units.italian: storm resume

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Not really, although it does contribute to it. Most of the red glow seems to be the result of clouds of hydrogen gases at approximately 2710 degrees, rather like the process documented by early Earth astronomers investigating nebulae. Except for most of these clouds, there is no obvious source of energy to keep the hydrogen excited. Obviously there is still energy being added to the system, but..." She trails off and gestures deprecatingly. "One more mystery to keep us alert and attentive."|3819|0
units.english: "Not really, although it does contribute to it. Most of the red glow seems to be the result of clouds of hydrogen gases at approximately 2710 degrees, rather like the process documented by early Earth astronomers investigating nebulae. Except for most of these clouds, there is no obvious source of energy to keep the hydrogen excited. Obviously there is still energy being added to the system, but..." She trails off and gestures deprecatingly. "One more mystery to keep us alert and attentive."
units.italian: "Non proprio, anche se contribuisce. La maggior parte del bagliore rosso sembra essere il risultato di nubi di idrogeno gassoso a circa 2710 gradi, più o meno come il processo documentato dagli antichi astronomi terrestri che studiavano le nebulose. Solo che per la maggior parte di queste nubi non c'è una fonte di energia evidente che tenga eccitato l'idrogeno. Ovviamente nel sistema viene ancora aggiunta energia, ma..." Si interrompe e fa un gesto di scusa. "Un altro mistero che ci tiene allerta e attenti."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She smiles thoughtfully, and the display changes with the red haze vanishing and a silvery haze replacing it. "But that is where today's research comes in. We have been measuring these storms since we arrived in the Ember Waste. The human eye can only pick out a few of them on the display, but our algorithms have identified a significant number of ripples of energy." She appears thoughtful.|3820|0
units.english: She smiles thoughtfully, and the display changes with the red haze vanishing and a silvery haze replacing it. "But that is where today's research comes in. We have been measuring these storms since we arrived in the Ember Waste. The human eye can only pick out a few of them on the display, but our algorithms have identified a significant number of ripples of energy." She appears thoughtful.
units.italian: Sorride pensierosa, e il display cambia: la foschia rossa svanisce e una foschia argentea la sostituisce. "Ma è qui che entra la ricerca di oggi. Misuriamo queste tempeste da quando siamo arrivati nella Distesa di Braci. L'occhio umano riesce a distinguerne solo alcune sul display, ma i nostri algoritmi hanno identificato un numero significativo di increspature di energia." Sembra pensierosa.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"It is almost like watching the surface of a pond during a rainstorm: The surface appears to be chaotic, but with detailed enough instrumentation, one can pick out individual ripples and trace their paths backwards... except we have yet to find an actual source for any of them. We can trace every ripple on a pond in a storm and find its origin, but we have yet to learn the dance that we have lived in for half a millennium."|3821|0
units.english: "It is almost like watching the surface of a pond during a rainstorm: The surface appears to be chaotic, but with detailed enough instrumentation, one can pick out individual ripples and trace their paths backwards... except we have yet to find an actual source for any of them. We can trace every ripple on a pond in a storm and find its origin, but we have yet to learn the dance that we have lived in for half a millennium."
units.italian: "È quasi come guardare la superficie di uno stagno durante un temporale: la superficie sembra caotica, ma con una strumentazione abbastanza dettagliata si possono distinguere le singole increspature e tracciarne i percorsi all'indietro... solo che non abbiamo ancora trovato una vera fonte per nessuna di esse. Possiamo tracciare ogni increspatura di uno stagno durante un temporale e trovarne l'origine, ma dobbiamo ancora imparare la danza in cui viviamo da mezzo millennio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"What do the storms have to do with the heat?"|3823|0
units.english: "What do the storms have to do with the heat?"
units.italian: "Cosa c'entrano le tempeste con il calore?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"What units do you use for temperature?"|3824|0
units.english: "What units do you use for temperature?"
units.italian: "Che unità usate per la temperatura?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"I think that is all the technical detail I can take."|3826|0
units.english: "I think that is all the technical detail I can take."
units.italian: "Credo che questo sia tutto il dettaglio tecnico che riesco a sopportare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She looks mischievous. "I cannot tell you where or how we got it, but look at this." Her display shifts again with the hazes vanishing, and shows the galaxy map with one key difference. "Yes, the Ember Waste is violet. Actually, it is off the visual spectrum into the ultraviolets, but this downshifts it so we can see it. This is what the Ember Waste looked like a very long time ago."|3828|0
units.english: She looks mischievous. "I cannot tell you where or how we got it, but look at this." Her display shifts again with the hazes vanishing, and shows the galaxy map with one key difference. "Yes, the Ember Waste is violet. Actually, it is off the visual spectrum into the ultraviolets, but this downshifts it so we can see it. This is what the Ember Waste looked like a very long time ago."
units.italian: Sembra maliziosa. "Non posso dirti dove o come l'abbiamo ottenuto, ma guarda questo." Il suo display cambia di nuovo, le foschie svaniscono e mostra la mappa della galassia con una differenza chiave. "Sì, la Distesa di Braci è viola. In realtà è fuori dallo spettro visibile, negli ultravioletti, ma questo lo trasla verso il basso così possiamo vederlo. Ecco come appariva la Distesa di Braci molto tempo fa."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She takes on a serious tone. "This data suggests there is enough energy in the area to maintain the hydrogen at somewhere in excess of 61A8 degrees. It does not tell us the source of that energy, but based on patterns and some other data we have collected, the two appear to be intertwined. At the very least, the ion storms are one of the means by which energy is being transferred into the clouds." Her display vanishes, and she slings her backpack over her shoulder.|3829|0
units.english: She takes on a serious tone. "This data suggests there is enough energy in the area to maintain the hydrogen at somewhere in excess of 61A8 degrees. It does not tell us the source of that energy, but based on patterns and some other data we have collected, the two appear to be intertwined. At the very least, the ion storms are one of the means by which energy is being transferred into the clouds." Her display vanishes, and she slings her backpack over her shoulder.
units.italian: Assume un tono serio. "Questi dati suggeriscono che nella zona c'è abbastanza energia per mantenere l'idrogeno a una temperatura superiore a 61A8 gradi. Non ci dicono la fonte di quell'energia, ma in base agli schemi e ad altri dati che abbiamo raccolto, le due cose sembrano intrecciate. Come minimo, le tempeste ioniche sono uno dei mezzi con cui l'energia viene trasferita nelle nubi." Il suo display svanisce, e si mette lo zaino in spalla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|label|3831|0
units.english: numeric system
units.italian: numeric system

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She looks confused for a moment before responding. "It is called hexadecimal. It is a base 16 numeric system." She pauses to look at you. "Based on your reaction, I assume that base 10 is still the standard in human space?"|3832|0
units.english: She looks confused for a moment before responding. "It is called hexadecimal. It is a base 16 numeric system." She pauses to look at you. "Based on your reaction, I assume that base 10 is still the standard in human space?"
units.italian: Sembra confusa per un momento prima di rispondere. "Si chiama esadecimale. È un sistema numerico in base 16." Si interrompe per guardarti. "Dalla tua reazione suppongo che la base 10 sia ancora lo standard nello spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Yes."|3834|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"How does that work?"|3836|0
units.english: "How does that work?"
units.italian: "Come funziona?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Quite simply: We have added some extra characters. When counting, instead of a single digit position restarting at 0 every 10, they cycle every 16. So when we count, we start at 1, but when we reach 9, the next number will be A. Then B, C, D, E and F. Then, it is at that point that we add an extra digit and restart at 0 with 10. So in hexadecimal F would be equal to 15 in base 10. One of the advantages of using a numeric system with a higher base is that we can handle larger numbers with fewer digits. For example, with two digits we can communicate any integer up to what would be 255 in base 10. Or with three digits we can reach 4095. Saving an extra digit here or there is fairly meaningless in written formats, nor is it much of a difference in oral communication. However, when one communicates by gestures, it is helpful to shorten the numbers where we can."|3837|0
units.english: "Quite simply: We have added some extra characters. When counting, instead of a single digit position restarting at 0 every 10, they cycle every 16. So when we count, we start at 1, but when we reach 9, the next number will be A. Then B, C, D, E and F. Then, it is at that point that we add an extra digit and restart at 0 with 10. So in hexadecimal F would be equal to 15 in base 10. One of the advantages of using a numeric system with a higher base is that we can handle larger numbers with fewer digits. For example, with two digits we can communicate any integer up to what would be 255 in base 10. Or with three digits we can reach 4095. Saving an extra digit here or there is fairly meaningless in written formats, nor is it much of a difference in oral communication. However, when one communicates by gestures, it is helpful to shorten the numbers where we can."
units.italian: "Molto semplicemente: abbiamo aggiunto qualche carattere in più. Contando, invece di far ricominciare una singola posizione da 0 ogni 10, si ricomincia ogni 16. Quindi quando contiamo partiamo da 1, ma quando arriviamo a 9 il numero successivo sarà A. Poi B, C, D, E e F. Ed è a quel punto che aggiungiamo una cifra in più e ricominciamo da 0 con 10. Quindi in esadecimale F sarebbe uguale a 15 in base 10. Uno dei vantaggi di usare un sistema numerico con una base più alta è poter gestire numeri più grandi con meno cifre. Per esempio, con due cifre possiamo comunicare qualsiasi intero fino a quello che in base 10 sarebbe 255. Oppure con tre cifre arriviamo a 4095. Risparmiare una cifra qui o lì è abbastanza irrilevante per iscritto, né fa molta differenza nella comunicazione orale. Però, quando si comunica a gesti, è utile accorciare i numeri dove possiamo."

units.english: storm continue
units.italian: storm continue

units.italian: "Ora che capisci un po' meglio i nostri numeri, potrai riconoscere che là fuori viene trasferita molta energia inspiegata."

units.italian: temperature units

units.italian: Ti guarda incuriosita. "Gradi Kelvin corretti, naturalmente. Perché?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"What are 'Corrected degrees Kelvin'?"|3849|0
units.english: "What are 'Corrected degrees Kelvin'?"
units.italian: "Cosa sono i 'gradi Kelvin corretti'?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Just clarifying. I prefer to use degrees Centigrade."|3850|0
units.english: "Just clarifying. I prefer to use degrees Centigrade."
units.italian: "Solo per chiarire. Preferisco usare i gradi centigradi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Just clarifying. I prefer to use degrees Fahrenheit."|3852|0
units.english: "Just clarifying. I prefer to use degrees Fahrenheit."
units.italian: "Solo per chiarire. Preferisco usare i gradi Fahrenheit."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Corrected degrees Kelvin are basically the standard Kelvin scale developed millennia ago, but with a slight correction factor to account for the adjustments determined by the conjunction of 2730. It is a rather minuscule change to the scale that is mostly only applicable to experiments or industrial applications that require micro-degree temperature precision, but can be significant at the larger scales." The display and its field of stars vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.|3854|0
units.english: "Corrected degrees Kelvin are basically the standard Kelvin scale developed millennia ago, but with a slight correction factor to account for the adjustments determined by the conjunction of 2730. It is a rather minuscule change to the scale that is mostly only applicable to experiments or industrial applications that require micro-degree temperature precision, but can be significant at the larger scales." The display and its field of stars vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.
units.italian: "I gradi Kelvin corretti sono sostanzialmente la scala Kelvin standard sviluppata millenni fa, ma con un piccolo fattore di correzione per tenere conto degli aggiustamenti determinati dalla congiunzione del 2730. È un cambiamento piuttosto minuscolo della scala, che si applica soprattutto a esperimenti o applicazioni industriali che richiedono una precisione di microgradi, ma può essere significativo su scale più grandi." Il display e il suo campo di stelle svaniscono mentre si mette lo zaino in spalla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"People still use that? We learned about it in our studies, mostly in case we came across references to it our library. I have seen it a few times, but it is rarely used among us." The display and its field of stars vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.|3857|0
units.english: "People still use that? We learned about it in our studies, mostly in case we came across references to it our library. I have seen it a few times, but it is rarely used among us." The display and its field of stars vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.
units.italian: "La gente la usa ancora? L'abbiamo studiata, soprattutto nel caso in cui trovassimo riferimenti nella nostra biblioteca. L'ho vista un paio di volte, ma tra noi è usata raramente." Il display e il suo campo di stelle svaniscono mentre si mette lo zaino in spalla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	She looks at you quizzically for a moment, and then her display shifts to a mass of symbols. She skims briefly. "I have never even heard of such a unit. Apparently it is a very old one, though. Our records say that it had largely stopped being used by early in the 21st century. Well, I learned something new today." The display and its field of symbols vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.|3860|0
units.english: She looks at you quizzically for a moment, and then her display shifts to a mass of symbols. She skims briefly. "I have never even heard of such a unit. Apparently it is a very old one, though. Our records say that it had largely stopped being used by early in the 21st century. Well, I learned something new today." The display and its field of symbols vanishes as she slings her backpack over her shoulder.
units.italian: Ti guarda perplessa per un momento, poi il suo display passa a una massa di simboli. Dà una scorsa veloce. "Non ho mai nemmeno sentito parlare di un'unità del genere. A quanto pare però è molto antica. I nostri registri dicono che aveva smesso in gran parte di essere usata all'inizio del XXI secolo. Beh, oggi ho imparato qualcosa di nuovo." Il display e il suo campo di simboli svaniscono mentre si mette lo zaino in spalla.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|label|3861|0
units.english: storm end
units.italian: storm end

units.id: mission:Remnant: Expanded Horizons Storms 1|	"Thanks for the ride, Captain. I have to get working on this data, but if you are interested in helping some more, I hope to have more research expeditions planned soon."|3862|0
units.english: "Thanks for the ride, Captain. I have to get working on this data, but if you are interested in helping some more, I hope to have more research expeditions planned soon."
units.italian: "Grazie per il passaggio, capitano. Devo mettermi al lavoro su questi dati, ma se ti interessa aiutare ancora, spero di avere presto in programma altre spedizioni di ricerca."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|name|3867|0
units.english: Rush delivery to <planet>
units.italian: Consegna urgente su <planet>

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|description|3868|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|You step into the strange sight of the <origin> spaceport. The structures that surround the landing pads look as much grown as built, and they seem to merge into the landing pads themselves. As usual, the dock entrance is busy. When your commlink vibrates, you have to find a place where the traffic eddies so you can step aside. When you do, you learn you need to check in with the information desk.|3878|0
units.english: You step into the strange sight of the <origin> spaceport. The structures that surround the landing pads look as much grown as built, and they seem to merge into the landing pads themselves. As usual, the dock entrance is busy. When your commlink vibrates, you have to find a place where the traffic eddies so you can step aside. When you do, you learn you need to check in with the information desk.
units.italian: Entri nella strana vista dello spazioporto di <origin>. Le strutture che circondano le piazzole di atterraggio sembrano tanto coltivate quanto costruite, e sembrano fondersi con le piazzole stesse. Come sempre, l'ingresso della banchina è affollato. Quando il commlink vibra, devi trovare un punto dove il traffico si calma per poterti scostare. Quando lo trovi, scopri che devi registrarti al banco informazioni.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	The woman working the desk seems startled to see you when you walk up. You can see the realization dawn on her as she looks you over with a practiced eye. "Ah," she sings, "you are the ancestral sojourner among us."|3879|0
units.english: The woman working the desk seems startled to see you when you walk up. You can see the realization dawn on her as she looks you over with a practiced eye. "Ah," she sings, "you are the ancestral sojourner among us."
units.italian: La donna al banco sembra sorpresa di vederti quando ti avvicini. Vedi la consapevolezza accendersi in lei mentre ti esamina con occhio esperto. "Ah," canta, "sei tu il viaggiatore ancestrale tra noi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	It is typical for people to gawk at you, so you respond by singing, "I've been guided to friends I didn't know, and your message invited me to meet a new one."|3880|0
units.english: It is typical for people to gawk at you, so you respond by singing, "I've been guided to friends I didn't know, and your message invited me to meet a new one."
units.italian: È tipico che la gente ti fissi, quindi rispondi cantando: "Sono stato guidato verso amici che non conoscevo, e il tuo messaggio mi ha invitato a incontrarne uno nuovo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	Her hands make a short series of shakes and a moment later she remembers to laugh for you. The delayed response makes her laugh again, spontaneously this time, and you both join in. When she recovers herself, she sings, "Logistics have requested that we find someone who can carry <tons> of cargo to <planet>. Is the <ship> available immediately?"|3881|0
units.english: Her hands make a short series of shakes and a moment later she remembers to laugh for you. The delayed response makes her laugh again, spontaneously this time, and you both join in. When she recovers herself, she sings, "Logistics have requested that we find someone who can carry <tons> of cargo to <planet>. Is the <ship> available immediately?"
units.italian: Le sue mani fanno una breve serie di scossettine e un attimo dopo si ricorda di ridere per te. La risposta in ritardo la fa ridere di nuovo, questa volta spontaneamente, e ridete entrambi. Quando si riprende, canta: "La logistica ha chiesto che troviamo qualcuno che possa portare <tons> di carico su <planet>. La <ship> è disponibile subito?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Certainly!"|3883|0
units.english: "Certainly!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Sorry, it is not."|3885|0
units.english: "Sorry, it is not."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, no."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|label|3887|0
units.english: will do
units.italian: will do

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Excellent," she responds in a full alto, "I will let the project manager know the cargo will arrive promptly." She signs what you think is a farewell and turns to address someone else who has stepped up.|3888|0
units.english: "Excellent," she responds in a full alto, "I will let the project manager know the cargo will arrive promptly." She signs what you think is a farewell and turns to address someone else who has stepped up.
units.italian: "Eccellente," risponde con un contralto pieno, "dirò alla responsabile del progetto che il carico arriverà puntuale." Segna quello che credi sia un saluto e si volta verso qualcun altro che si è avvicinato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	You manage to chant and point your way through the cafeteria line, and you are aware of the flurry of signs around you. There doesn't seem to be a way to pay, so you find a table and sit alone until your commlink chimes to let you know that the <ship> has been refueled and the mystery cargo loaded.|3889|0
units.english: You manage to chant and point your way through the cafeteria line, and you are aware of the flurry of signs around you. There doesn't seem to be a way to pay, so you find a table and sit alone until your commlink chimes to let you know that the <ship> has been refueled and the mystery cargo loaded.
units.italian: Riesci a farti capire cantando e indicando lungo la fila della mensa, e sei consapevole del turbinio di segni intorno a te. Non sembra esserci un modo per pagare, quindi trovi un tavolo e ti siedi da solo finché il commlink suona per informarti che la <ship> è stata rifornita e il carico misterioso caricato.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|label|3891|0
units.english: not interested
units.italian: not interested

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"That is unfortunate," she sings as she makes a notation on her terminal. "But there will be others who are willing to help."|3892|0
units.english: "That is unfortunate," she sings as she makes a notation on her terminal. "But there will be others who are willing to help."
units.italian: "È un peccato," canta mentre prende nota sul suo terminale. "Ma ci saranno altri disposti ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|You step off the <ship> on <planet> to see a man wandering around your ship taking video with a datapad and softly dictating some running commentary. He dodges around the dock workers unloading and refueling, seemingly intent on recording every aspect of your ship.|3897|0
units.english: You step off the <ship> on <planet> to see a man wandering around your ship taking video with a datapad and softly dictating some running commentary. He dodges around the dock workers unloading and refueling, seemingly intent on recording every aspect of your ship.
units.italian: Scendi dalla <ship> su <planet> e vedi un uomo che gironzola intorno alla tua nave riprendendo con un datapad e dettando piano un commento continuo. Schiva gli scaricatori che scaricano e riforniscono, apparentemente intenzionato a registrare ogni aspetto della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Cousin!" he sings with excitement when you walk up to him. "It is good to meet you and to see your wonderful ship. It excites me to be able to examine something I have only seen in entertainments based on our scouting reports." He holds up the datapad facing you and says, "I am making a video for my companion. He will not believe me unless I have proof, and maybe not even then!" he laughs. You wave at the camera and he stops recording.|3898|0
units.english: "Cousin!" he sings with excitement when you walk up to him. "It is good to meet you and to see your wonderful ship. It excites me to be able to examine something I have only seen in entertainments based on our scouting reports." He holds up the datapad facing you and says, "I am making a video for my companion. He will not believe me unless I have proof, and maybe not even then!" he laughs. You wave at the camera and he stops recording.
units.italian: "Cugino!" canta con eccitazione quando gli vai incontro. "È bello conoscerti e vedere la tua nave meravigliosa. Mi emoziona poter esaminare qualcosa che ho visto solo negli spettacoli basati sui nostri rapporti di ricognizione." Alza il datapad verso di te e dice: "Sto facendo un video per il mio compagno. Non mi crederà se non ho le prove, e forse nemmeno allora!" ride. Saluti verso la telecamera e lui smette di registrare.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"I hope I have not offended you. I get carried away looking at ships." He runs his hand along the landing strut but then seems to collect himself and turn back to you. "I am named Eon," he says. "Would you have time to talk about logistics support?"|3899|0
units.english: "I hope I have not offended you. I get carried away looking at ships." He runs his hand along the landing strut but then seems to collect himself and turn back to you. "I am named Eon," he says. "Would you have time to talk about logistics support?"
units.italian: "Spero di non averti offeso. Mi lascio prendere guardando le navi." Passa la mano lungo il montante di atterraggio ma poi sembra ricomporsi e torna verso di te. "Mi chiamo Eon," dice. "Avresti tempo di parlare di supporto logistico?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Yes, I've been looking for more work with the Remnant."|3901|0
units.english: "Yes, I've been looking for more work with the Remnant."
units.italian: "Sì, cercavo altro lavoro con i Remnant."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Yes, there haven't been many opportunities so far."|3902|0
units.english: "Yes, there haven't been many opportunities so far."
units.italian: "Sì, finora non ci sono state molte occasioni."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|Eon leads you to the bustling cafeteria, chattering about ship design since the Alpha Wars. He orders a couple of hot drinks and leads you to a quiet table overlooking the docks. You try your drink. It's strongly flavored but a bit odd, like someone's memory of what coffee should taste like, reconstituted from local foods.|3903|0
units.english: Eon leads you to the bustling cafeteria, chattering about ship design since the Alpha Wars. He orders a couple of hot drinks and leads you to a quiet table overlooking the docks. You try your drink. It's strongly flavored but a bit odd, like someone's memory of what coffee should taste like, reconstituted from local foods.
units.italian: Eon ti conduce nella mensa brulicante, chiacchierando di progettazione di navi dalle Guerre degli Alpha. Ordina un paio di bevande calde e ti porta a un tavolo tranquillo che dà sulle banchine. Assaggi la tua bevanda. Ha un sapore forte ma un po' strano, come il ricordo di qualcuno di come dovrebbe sapere il caffè, ricostituito con cibi locali.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	Eon leaves his untouched as he launches into conversation. "Those of us in logistics have noticed that you are spending time in our systems, and we wanted to see if you would be available to pick up work for us. It would be delivery work like the generator you brought for the housing project."|3904|0
units.english: Eon leaves his untouched as he launches into conversation. "Those of us in logistics have noticed that you are spending time in our systems, and we wanted to see if you would be available to pick up work for us. It would be delivery work like the generator you brought for the housing project."
units.italian: Eon lascia la sua intatta mentre si lancia nella conversazione. "Noi della logistica abbiamo notato che passi del tempo nei nostri sistemi, e volevamo vedere se saresti disponibile a prendere lavoro per noi. Sarebbe lavoro di consegna, come il generatore che hai portato per il progetto abitativo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	(Nod.)|3906|0
units.english: (Nod.)
units.italian: (Fai cenno.)

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"You put starship radiothermals in your houses?"|3908|0
units.english: "You put starship radiothermals in your houses?"
units.italian: "Mettete dei radiatori termici per astronavi nelle vostre case?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"You do not?" he responds playfully. "Well, 'generators in each community' would be more accurate. We maintain a decentralized power grid so we have more resiliency in the event of an attack or natural disaster. It also makes use of the power plants we salvage from the Korath and ones we recover from our own damaged ships. Besides, widely deploying the technology ensures that we have expertise to maintain and repair it all across the Remnant. But," he signs a pushing motion, "civil engineering is another subject. I hope you are more interested in how we move our various cargoes."|3909|0
units.english: "You do not?" he responds playfully. "Well, 'generators in each community' would be more accurate. We maintain a decentralized power grid so we have more resiliency in the event of an attack or natural disaster. It also makes use of the power plants we salvage from the Korath and ones we recover from our own damaged ships. Besides, widely deploying the technology ensures that we have expertise to maintain and repair it all across the Remnant. But," he signs a pushing motion, "civil engineering is another subject. I hope you are more interested in how we move our various cargoes."
units.italian: "Voi no?" risponde giocosamente. "Beh, 'generatori in ogni comunità' sarebbe più accurato. Manteniamo una rete elettrica decentralizzata per avere più resilienza in caso di attacco o disastro naturale. Ci permette anche di usare le centrali che recuperiamo dai Korath e quelle che riprendiamo dalle nostre navi danneggiate. Inoltre, distribuire ampiamente la tecnologia garantisce che abbiamo l'esperienza per mantenerla e ripararla in tutto lo spazio dei Remnant. Ma," segna un gesto di allontanamento, "l'ingegneria civile è un altro argomento. Spero che ti interessi di più come spostiamo i nostri vari carichi."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"That generator was originally scheduled for delivery 30 days from now, but it was ready earlier and the project can install it now. So, by bringing it over, you have enabled us to move the project forward and free up delivery capacity next month."|3912|0
units.english: "That generator was originally scheduled for delivery 30 days from now, but it was ready earlier and the project can install it now. So, by bringing it over, you have enabled us to move the project forward and free up delivery capacity next month."
units.italian: "Quel generatore era originariamente programmato per la consegna tra 30 giorni, ma era pronto prima e il progetto può installarlo ora. Quindi, portandolo qui, ci hai permesso di far avanzare il progetto e liberare capacità di consegna il mese prossimo."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"So, why did you offer this work to me?" you ask, trying to mimic the gestures you've seen that you think refer to one's self.|3913|0
units.english: "So, why did you offer this work to me?" you ask, trying to mimic the gestures you've seen that you think refer to one's self.
units.italian: "Allora, perché hai offerto questo lavoro a me?" chiedi, cercando di imitare i gesti che hai visto e che credi si riferiscano a se stessi.

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	He smiles and responds, "Very good! Very good! We schedule everything, but we maintain slack in the system to take advantage of opportunities like the power system being ready early, or to deal with emergencies. Sometimes, of course, we have to drop everything and sort the schedule out later. But, in normal times, we publish these jobs on the job board and captains that have capacity available can pick them up. The projects provide resource allocations to cover operating and crew costs, but there is no... what is the word? Margin, yes! Since your ship is not in our planned resources, you provide extra capacity, and we might be able to move some of our larger projects forward when you are in our space."|3914|0
units.english: He smiles and responds, "Very good! Very good! We schedule everything, but we maintain slack in the system to take advantage of opportunities like the power system being ready early, or to deal with emergencies. Sometimes, of course, we have to drop everything and sort the schedule out later. But, in normal times, we publish these jobs on the job board and captains that have capacity available can pick them up. The projects provide resource allocations to cover operating and crew costs, but there is no... what is the word? Margin, yes! Since your ship is not in our planned resources, you provide extra capacity, and we might be able to move some of our larger projects forward when you are in our space."
units.italian: Sorride e risponde: "Molto bene! Molto bene! Programmiamo tutto, ma manteniamo un margine di slack nel sistema per approfittare di occasioni come il sistema di alimentazione pronto in anticipo, o per gestire emergenze. A volte, naturalmente, dobbiamo lasciar perdere tutto e sistemare la pianificazione dopo. Ma in tempi normali pubblichiamo questi lavori sulla bacheca e i capitani che hanno capacità disponibile possono prenderli. I progetti forniscono assegnazioni di risorse per coprire i costi operativi e dell'equipaggio, ma non c'è... come si dice? Margine, sì! Dato che la tua nave non è nelle nostre risorse pianificate, tu fornisci capacità extra, e potremmo riuscire a far avanzare alcuni dei nostri progetti più grandi quando sei nel nostro spazio."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Thanks for the opportunity."|3916|0
units.english: "Thanks for the opportunity."
units.italian: "Grazie per l'opportunità."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	"Will your pilots be upset at the competition?"|3918|0
units.english: "Will your pilots be upset at the competition?"
units.italian: "I tuoi piloti si arrabbieranno per la concorrenza?"

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	Eon smiles at the question. "You should talk to the other pilots and see, but I think the ancestral approach is different. We work more like a military: the ships are owned by the Remnant, but each captain is responsible for the ship, the crew, and the transport work that needs to be done. I think they will be happy to see new homes being built, and freeing up more time for them and their crews to spend within the community."|3919|0
units.english: Eon smiles at the question. "You should talk to the other pilots and see, but I think the ancestral approach is different. We work more like a military: the ships are owned by the Remnant, but each captain is responsible for the ship, the crew, and the transport work that needs to be done. I think they will be happy to see new homes being built, and freeing up more time for them and their crews to spend within the community."
units.italian: Eon sorride alla domanda. "Dovresti parlare con gli altri piloti e vedere, ma credo che l'approccio ancestrale sia diverso. Funzioniamo più come un esercito: le navi sono di proprietà dei Remnant, ma ogni capitano è responsabile della nave, dell'equipaggio e del lavoro di trasporto da svolgere. Credo che saranno felici di vedere costruire nuove case e di liberare più tempo per loro e i loro equipaggi da passare nella comunità."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	Before you can ask more about transport jobs, Eon takes out his commlink and taps on it for a few minutes. "You now have access to the logistics job board. You should be able to see our current job list for each system when you check."|3922|0
units.english: Before you can ask more about transport jobs, Eon takes out his commlink and taps on it for a few minutes. "You now have access to the logistics job board. You should be able to see our current job list for each system when you check."
units.italian: Prima che tu possa chiedere altro sui lavori di trasporto, Eon tira fuori il commlink e ci batte sopra per qualche minuto. "Ora hai accesso alla bacheca degli incarichi logistici. Dovresti riuscire a vedere la nostra lista attuale di lavori per ogni sistema quando controlli."

units.id: mission:Remnant: Logistics 1|	You continue to chat with Eon as you sip your drink. When you finish, his commlink chirps. As he stands, he signs what you think means "goodbye" as he says he has to leave for another meeting. He walks off quickly with his head down looking at the datapad. Your commlink notifies you that <payment> have been added to your account.|3923|0
units.english: You continue to chat with Eon as you sip your drink. When you finish, his commlink chirps. As he stands, he signs what you think means "goodbye" as he says he has to leave for another meeting. He walks off quickly with his head down looking at the datapad. Your commlink notifies you that <payment> have been added to your account.
units.italian: Continui a chiacchierare con Eon sorseggiando la tua bevanda. Quando finisci, il suo commlink trilla. Mentre si alza segna quello che credi significhi "arrivederci" mentre dice che deve andare a un'altra riunione. Si allontana in fretta a testa bassa guardando il datapad. Il tuo commlink ti avvisa che <payment> sono stati aggiunti al tuo conto.
